rules.title: Bases Ending in @deva[च्], @deva[छ्], @deva[ज्], @deva[झ्], @deva[श्], @deva[ष्], @deva[ह्]
rules.body: Bases ending in @deva[च्], @deva[छ्], @deva[ज्], or @deva[झ्] and @deva[श्], @deva[ष्], @deva[ह्].

rules.title: Palatal Consonant Changes: @deva[च्], @deva[ज्], @deva[श्], @deva[छ्]
rules.body:
**(a)** @deva[च्] or @deva[ज्] is changed to @deva[क्] when followed by a hard consonant or by nothing, and to @deva[ग्] when followed by a soft consonant.[^1]

**(b)** The ending @deva[श्] or @deva[छ्] of root-nouns and the final of @deva[व्रश्च्], @deva[भ्रस्ज्], @deva[सृज्], @deva[मृज्], @deva[यज्], @deva[राज्] and @deva[भ्राज्] are changed to @deva[ष्] when followed by any consonant except a nasal or a semi-vowel or by nothing[^2]; the @deva[ष्] is changed to @deva[ट्] or @deva[ड्] when at the end of a word, and to @deva[ड्] when followed by a soft consonant. The @deva[ज्] of @deva[परिव्राज्] is similarly changed to @deva[ट्] or @deva[ड्].

**(c)** But the @deva[श्] of the root-nouns @deva[दिश्], @deva[दृश्], @deva[स्पृश्] and @deva[सृश्] is changed to @deva[क्] as also the @deva[ष्] of @deva[दधृष्] 'a bold or impudent man' and the @deva[क्ष्] of such words as @deva[विपक्ष्] &c. The @deva[श्] of @deva[नश्] is optionally changed to @deva[ट्] or @deva[क्], as also the @deva[क्ष्] of @deva[तक्ष्] and @deva[गोरक्ष्]. The @deva[ज्] of @deva[ऋत्विज्] is changed to @deva[क्].

**(d)** @deva[त्] may optionally be inserted between @deva[ट्] and the loc. pl. term. @deva[सु].

**(e)** Before vowel terminations final @deva[छ्] may optionally be changed to @deva[श्].

---

[^1]: @deva[चोः कुः] — Pāṇ. VIII. 2. 30.

[^2]: @deva[व्रश्चभ्रस्जसृजमृजयजराजभ्राजच्छशां षः] — Pāṇ. VIII. 2. 36.

rules.title: Special Rules for @deva[ह्] Changes
rules.body:
**(a)** @deva[ह्] is changed to @deva[ढ्] when at the end of a *pada* or when followed by a consonant except a nasal or a semi-vowel. **(b)** In the case of roots beginning with @deva[द्] it is changed to @deva[घ्] under the same circumstances; **(c)** when forming part of the roots @deva[द्रुह्], @deva[मुह्], @deva[स्नुह्] and @deva[स्निह्], it is optionally changed to @deva[घ्] i. e. to @deva[ढ्] or @deva[घ्]; **(d)** and in the case of the root @deva[नह्] it is changed to @deva[ध्] under the above-mentioned circumstances.[^1]

**(e)** The @deva[ह्] of @deva[उष्णिह्] f. a kind of metre is changed to @deva[क्] when followed by a hard consonant or by nothing, and to @deva[ग्] before a soft consonant (Pāṇ. III. 2, 59).

---

[^1]: @deva[हो ढः । दादेर्धातोर्घः । वा द्रुहमुहष्णुहष्णिहाम् । नहो धः] — Pāṇ. VIII. 2. 31-34.

rules.title: Monosyllabic Roots with Initial @deva[ब्], @deva[ग्], or @deva[द्]
rules.body:
When a mono-syllabic root (or root-noun) begins with @deva[ब्], @deva[ग्] or @deva[द्] and ends with @deva[घ्], @deva[ढ्], @deva[ध्], @deva[भ्] or @deva[ह्], the @deva[ब्], @deva[ग्] or @deva[द्] is respectively changed to @deva[भ्], @deva[घ्] or @deva[ध्] before @deva[स्] or @deva[ध्व्] or when followed by nothing or when the final soft aspirate is changed to an unaspirate letter.[^1]

---

[^1]: @deva[एकाचो बशो भष् झषन्तस्य स्ध्वोः] — Pāṇ. VIII. 2. 37.

rules.body:

rules.title: @deva[वाह्]-Ending Root Nouns: @deva[विश्ववाह्] Paradigm
rules.body:
The @deva[वा] of root-nouns ending in @deva[वाह्] is changed to @deva[ऊ] before the vowel terminations beginning with the Acc. plu.[^1]; e. g. @deva[विश्ववाह्] m. the sustainer of the universe, a lord:—

| A. | @deva[विश्ववाहम्] | ,, | @deva[विश्वौहः] |
| I. | @deva[विश्वौहा] | @deva[विश्ववाड्भ्याम्] | @deva[विश्वशाड्भिः] |

---

[^1]: @deva[वाह ऊठ् । सप्रसारणाच्च] — Pāṇ. VI. 4. 132. VI. 1. 108. @deva[आ] and @deva[ऊ] combine into @deva[औ] by Pāṇ. VI. 1. 89. See @ref[20].

rules.title: Directional Nouns from @deva[अञ्च्] 'to go'
rules.body:
## Bases derived from the root @deva[अञ्च्] 'to go' to worship.

Nouns derived form the root @deva[अञ्च्] 'to go' by means of such affixes as @deva[क्विन्], @deva[क्विप्] &c. such as @deva[प्राञ्च्] (@deva[प्रा-अञ्च्]) eastern, @deva[प्रत्यञ्च्] (@deva[प्रति-अञ्च्]) western, @deva[सम्यङ्] (@deva[सह-अञ्च्]) a companion, @deva[तिर्यञ्च्] (@deva[तिरस्-अञ्च्]) going away, @deva[सम्यञ्च्] (@deva[सम्-अञ्च्]) going with or well, @deva[विष्वञ्च्] (@deva[विष्वञ्च्-अञ्च्]) following, @deva[देवद्र्यञ्च्] (@deva[देव-अञ्च्]) adoring a deity, @deva[सर्वद्र्यञ्च्] (@deva[सर्व-अञ्च्]) going everywhere, @deva[उदञ्च्] northern, @deva[अन्वञ्च्] following, @deva[उदद्र्यञ्च्], @deva[अदमुयञ्च्], @deva[अमुमुयञ्च्] going to that (all these derived from @deva[अदस्+अञ्च्]), @deva[गोअञ्च्] &c.

**(a)** In the Nom sing. @deva[अञ्च्] becomes @deva[अङ्]. The nasal of @deva[अञ्च्] is dropped before all terminations beginning with the Acc. plu. and the preceding semi-vowel is changed to its corresponding long vowel before the vowel terminations after which @deva[अ] is dropped. When @deva[अञ्च्] is not preceded by a semi-vowel, its @deva[अ] is changed to @deva[ई] if not preceded by a long vowel; otherwise it remains unchanged. @deva[तिर्यञ्च्] becomes @deva[तिरश्च्] under similar circumstances. In other respects these words are declined like words ending in @deva[च्].

| @deva[गोङ्] | @deva[गोञ्चः] | ,, | @deva[गोग्भ्याम्] | @deva[गोक्षु] |

Neu.

The neu. forms should be similarly made up.

| N. V. A. Sing. | N. V. A. Dual | N. V. A. Plural |
|---|---|---|
| @deva[प्राक्] | @deva[प्राची] | @deva[प्राञ्चि] |
| @deva[प्रत्यक्] | @deva[प्रतीची] | @deva[प्रत्यञ्चि] |

| @deva[विश्वक्] | @deva[विषूची] | @deva[विश्वञ्चि] |
| @deva[देवद्र्यक्] | @deva[देवद्रीची] | @deva[देवद्र्यञ्चि] |
| @deva[उदक्] | @deva[उदीची] | @deva[उदञ्चि] |
| @deva[अन्वक्] | @deva[अनूची] | @deva[अन्वञ्चि] |
| @deva[अदद्र्यक्] | @deva[अदद्रीची] | @deva[अदद्र्यञ्चि] |
| @deva[अदमुयक्] | @deva[अदमुईची] | @deva[अदमुयञ्चि] |
| @deva[गवाक्] | @deva[गोची] | @deva[गवाञ्चि] |
| @deva[गोअक्] | ,, | @deva[गोअञ्चि] |
| @deva[गोक्] | ,, | @deva[गोञ्चि] |

The rest like the mas.

**(b)** When @deva[अञ्च्] means 'to worship' or 'honour' the nasal of @deva[अञ्च्] is not dropped and these words are regularly declined.[^1] They drop their final @deva[च्] only before the consonantal terminations; e. g.

The rest should be similarly declined.

| N. V. A. | @deva[तिर्यङ्] | @deva[तिर्यञ्ची] | @deva[तिर्यञ्चि] |

[^1]: @deva[नाञ्चेः पूजायाम्] — Pāṇ. VI. 4. 30.

rules.title: Irregular Bases: @deva[क्रुञ्च्], @deva[खञ्ज्], and @deva[सुवल्ग्]
rules.body:
## Irregular Bases.

@deva[क्रुञ्च्] a heron &c. (derived from @deva[क्रुञ्च् कौटिल्याल्पीभावयोः]), @deva[खञ्ज्] a lame man, and @deva[सुवल्ग्] beautifully bounding. These become @deva[क्रुङ्], @deva[खन्] and @deva[सुवल्] before consonantal terminations; e. g.

| N. sing. | N. dual | I. dual. | Loc. plu. |
|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[क्रुङ्] | @deva[क्रुञ्चौ] | @deva[क्रुङ्भ्याम्] | @deva[क्रुङ्क्षु] or- |
| @deva[खन्] | @deva[खञ्जौ] | @deva[खन्भ्याम्] | @deva[खन्सु] |
| @deva[सुवल्] | @deva[सुवल्गौ] | @deva[सुवल्भ्याम्] | @deva[सुवल्सु] |

The remaining forms should be similarly made up.

Neu.

| N. V. A. Sing. | N. V. A. Dual | N. V. A. Plural |
|---|---|---|
| @deva[क्रुङ्] | @deva[क्रुञ्ची] | @deva[क्रुञ्चि] |
| @deva[खन्] | @deva[खञ्जी] | @deva[खञ्जि] |

The rest like the mas.

rules.title: @deva[ऊर्ज्] (Strength): Regular Declension
rules.body:
@deva[ऊर्ज्] m. n. strength, is regularly declined; e. g. m. @deva[ऊर्क्-ग्] @deva[ऊर्जौ] @deva[ऊर्जः] N.; @deva[ऊर्जा] @deva[ऊर्ग्भ्याम्] @deva[ऊर्ग्भिः] I.; @deva[ऊर्जि] @deva[ऊर्जोः] @deva[ऊर्क्षु] L.

Neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. A. | @deva[ऊर्क्] | @deva[ऊर्जी] | @deva[ऊर्ञ्जि]; [^1]the rest like the mas. |
| with @deva[बहु—] | @deva[बहूर्क्] | @deva[बहूर्जी] | @deva[बहूर्जि] or @deva[बहूर्ञ्जि].[^2] |

---

[^1]: @deva[नरजानां संयोगः] । Sid. Kau.

[^2]: @deva[बहूर्जि नुम्प्रतिषेधः । अन्त्यात्पूर्वो वा नुम्] । Várt.

rules.title: Nouns Ending in @deva[म्]: @deva[प्रशाम्]
rules.body:
Nouns ending in @deva[म्]. There are a few nouns derived from the roots ending in @deva[म्]. They have no other peculiarity than this, that they change their @deva[म्] to @deva[न्] before consonantal terminations, e. g. @deva[प्रशाम्] m. f. one who is tranquil.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[प्रशान्] | @deva[प्रशामौ] | @deva[प्रशामः] |
| A. | @deva[प्रशामम्] | ,, | ,, |
| I. | @deva[प्रशामा] | @deva[प्रशान्भ्याम्] | @deva[प्रशान्भिः] |
| L. | @deva[प्रशामि] | @deva[प्रशामोः] | @deva[प्रशान्सु] or @deva[प्रशांसु] |

Neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. A. | @deva[प्रशाम्] | @deva[प्रशामी] | @deva[प्रशामि] |

The rest like the mas.

rules.title: @deva[स्]-Ending Nouns with Lengthened Penultimate @deva[अ]
rules.body:
## Bases ending in @deva[स्]:—

The penultimate @deva[अ] of nouns ending in @deva[स्] is lengthened in the Nom. sing. if it does not belong to root nouns.[^1]

@deva[चन्द्रमस्] m. the moon.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[चन्द्रमाः] | @deva[चन्द्रमसौ] | @deva[चन्द्रमसः] |
| V. | @deva[चन्द्रमः] | ,, | ,, |
| A. | @deva[चन्द्रमसम्] | @deva[चन्द्रमसौ] | @deva[चन्द्रमसः] |
| I. | @deva[चन्द्रमसा] | @deva[चन्द्रमोभ्याम्] | @deva[चन्द्रमोभिः] |
| D. | @deva[चन्द्रमसे] | ,, | @deva[चन्द्रमोभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[चन्द्रमसः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | ,, | @deva[चन्द्रमसोः] | @deva[चन्द्रमसाम्] |
| L. | @deva[चन्द्रमसि] | ,, | @deva[चन्द्रमःसु-स्सु] |

Decline similarly @deva[वेधस्] god Brahmā, @deva[सुमनस्] good-minded, @deva[दुर्मनस्] ill-minded, @deva[उन्मनस्] anxious-hearted &c.

@deva[मनस्] neu. the mind.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. A. | @deva[मनः] | @deva[मनसी] | @deva[मनांसि] |

The rest like @deva[चन्द्रमस्].

Decline similarly @deva[पयस्], milk, @deva[वयस्] age, @deva[अवस्] protection, fame &c. @deva[श्रेयस्] good, @deva[सरस्], @deva[वचस्], &c.

**(a)** Nouns in @deva[इस्], @deva[उस्] or @deva[ओस्] such as @deva[उदर्चिस्] flaring upwards, @deva[अचक्षुस्] blind, @deva[दीर्घायुस्] long-living, @deva[दोस्] an arm &c. are similarly declined; e. g.

| | N. sing. | N. dual. | I. sing. | I. dual. | Loc. plu. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[उदर्चिस्] | @deva[उदर्चिः] | @deva[उदर्चिषौ] | @deva[उदर्चिषा] | @deva[उदर्चिर्भ्याम्] | @deva[उदर्चिष्षु-ःषु] |
| @deva[अचक्षुस्] | @deva[अचक्षुः] | @deva[अचक्षुषौ] | @deva[अचक्षुषा] | @deva[अचक्षुर्भ्याम्] | @deva[अचक्षुष्षु-ःषु] |
| @deva[दीर्घायुस्] | @deva[दीर्घायुः] | @deva[दीर्घायुषौ] | @deva[दीर्घायुषा] | @deva[दीर्घायुर्भ्याम्] | @deva[दीर्घायुष्षु-ःषु] |
| @deva[दोस्] | @deva[दोः] | @deva[दोषौ] | @deva[दोषा] | @deva[दोर्भ्याम्] | @deva[दोष्षु-ःषु] |

Neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. A. | @deva[उदर्चिः] | @deva[उदर्चिषी] | @deva[उदर्चींषि] |
| | @deva[अचक्षुः] | @deva[अचक्षुषी] | @deva[अचक्षूंषि] |
| | @deva[दोः] | @deva[दोषी] | @deva[दोंषि] |

Decline similarly @deva[ज्योतिस्] lustre, @deva[हविस्] an oblation, @deva[चक्षुस्] the eye, @deva[धनुस्] a bow, &c.

@deva[सुवस्] (@deva[सुष्ठु वस्ते]) one who wears a garment well.

Mas.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[सुवः] | @deva[सुवसौ] | @deva[सुवसः] |

The rest like @deva[चन्द्रमस्].

Neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. A. | @deva[सुवः] | @deva[सुवसी] | @deva[सुवंसि] |

The rest like @deva[मनस्]. Decline similarly @deva[पिण्डग्रस्], @deva[पिण्डग्लस्] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[अत्वसन्तस्य चाधातोः] — Pāṇ. VI. 4. 14. The penultimate vowel of nouns ending in @deva[मत्] or @deva[वत्] and in @deva[अस्] not belonging to a root is lengthened when followed by @deva[सु] (@deva[स्]) not belonging to the Vocative.

rules.title: Special Nominative Forms: @deva[अनेहस्], @deva[पुरुदंसस्], @deva[उशनस्]
rules.body: The Nom. sing. of @deva[अनेहस्] time, @deva[पुरुदंसस्] name of Indra, and @deva[उशनस्] name of Śukrāchārya is @deva[अनेहा], @deva[पुरुदंसा] and @deva[उशना] respectively; the Voc. sing. of @deva[उशनस्] is @deva[उशनन्], @deva[उशन], and @deva[उशन]; the other forms are regular.

rules.title: Feminine @deva[स्]-Ending Nouns: @deva[भास्] Paradigm
rules.body:
To feminine nouns ending in @deva[स्] simply add the terminations.

@deva[भास्] f. splendour.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |

| I. | @deva[भासा] | @deva[भाभ्याम्] | @deva[भाभिः] |
| L. | @deva[भासि] | @deva[भासोः] | @deva[भास्सुः] |

rules.title: @deva[उक्थशास्] (Uttering Hymns): Special Form
rules.body: **Obs.** The @deva[शा] of @deva[उक्थशास्] uttering hymns, becomes @deva[श] before the consonantal terminations, except that of the Nom. sing.; e. g. Nom. @deva[उक्थशाः] sing. @deva[उक्थशासौ] dual.; Instr. sing. @deva[उक्थशासा]; dual @deva[उक्थशोभ्याम्]; Loc. plu. @deva[उक्थशाःसु-स्सु].

rules.title: Irregular Bases: @deva[स्रस्], @deva[ध्वस्], @deva[सुहिंस्], @deva[जिघांस्]
rules.body:
Irregular bases.

@deva[स्रस्] that falls, @deva[ध्वस्] a destroyer, @deva[सुहिंस्] one who kills well, @deva[जिघांस्] desirous of killing. The first two change their @deva[स्] to @deva[त्] before consonantal terminations while the last two change their @deva[स्] to @deva[न्] under the same circumstances, the preceding nasal being dropped.

Mas.

| | N. V. sing. | N. V. dual. | I. sing. | I. dual. | Loc. plu. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[स्रस्] | @deva[स्रत्] | @deva[स्रसौ] | @deva[स्रसा] | @deva[स्रद्भ्याम्] | @deva[स्रत्सु] |
| @deva[ध्वस्] | @deva[ध्वत्] | @deva[ध्वसौ] | @deva[ध्वसा] | @deva[ध्वद्भ्याम्] | @deva[ध्वत्सु] |
| @deva[सुहिंस्] | @deva[सुहिन्] | @deva[सुहिंसौ] | @deva[सुहिंसा] | @deva[सुहिन्भ्याम्] | @deva[सुहिन्सु-न्त्सु] |
| @deva[जिघांस्] | @deva[जिघान्] | @deva[जिघांसौ] | @deva[जिघांसा] | @deva[जिघान्भ्याम्] | @deva[जिघान्सु-न्त्सु] |

The remaining forms should be similarly made up by adding the terminations.

Neu.

| N. V. A. Sing. | N. V. A. Dual | N. V. A. Plural |
|---|---|---|
| @deva[स्रत्] | @deva[स्रसी] | @deva[स्रंसि] |
| @deva[ध्वत्] | @deva[ध्वसी] | @deva[ध्वंसि] |
| @deva[सुहिन्] | @deva[सुहिंसी] | @deva[सुहिंसि] |

The remaining forms like those of the mas.

rules.body:

rules.title: Nouns with Lengthened Penultimate @deva[इ] or @deva[उ]
rules.body:
The penultimate @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] of the words @deva[पिपठिष्] wishing to read, @deva[सजुष्] m. f. a companion, @deva[चिकीर्ष्] wishing to do, @deva[सुपिस्] one stepping well, @deva[आशिष्] f. a blessing, @deva[सुतुस्], cutting well, and also of @deva[गिर्], speech, @deva[धुर्] a yoke, @deva[पुर्] a town all fem. is lengthened before consonantal terminations; their final is changed to visarga in the Nom. Sing. e. g. @deva[पिपठिष्]—

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. | @deva[पिपठीः] | @deva[पिपठिषौ] | @deva[पिपठिषः] |
| A. | @deva[पिपठिषम्] | @deva[पिपठिषौ] | @deva[पिपठिषः] |
| I. | @deva[पिपठिषा] | @deva[पिपठीर्भ्याम्] | @deva[पिपठीर्भिः] |
| D. | @deva[पिपठिषे] | @deva[पिपठीर्भ्याम्] | @deva[पिपठीर्भ्यः] |
| L. | @deva[पिपठिषि] | @deva[पिपठिषोः] | @deva[पिपठीष्षु-ःषु][^1] |

The remaining forms should be similarly made up by adding the terminations. @deva[सजुष्] and the following words should be similarly declined.

| | N. sing. | N. dual. | I. sing. | I. dual. | Loc. Plu. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

rules.title: Nouns Ending in @deva[अत्], @deva[मत्], and @deva[वत्]
rules.body:
Nouns ending in @deva[अत्], @deva[मत्], and @deva[वत्]:—

@deva[अ] is lengthened in the Nom. sing.[^1], and @deva[न्] is inserted between @deva[अ] and the final @deva[त्] in the first five inflections. The final @deva[त्] is dropped in the Nom. sing.; the @deva[अ] of @deva[महत्] is lengthened before this @deva[न्] except in the Voc. sing.

rules.title: Participial Bases Ending in @deva[अत्]
rules.body:
Participial bases ending in @deva[अत्]:—

**(a)** The declension of these does not differ from that of nouns in @deva[मत्] except in the Nom. sing. mas. in which the @deva[अ] of @deva[अत्] is not lengthened. In the case of the dual of the Nom. Voc. and the Acc. neu. @deva[न्] is inserted before the final @deva[त्] necessarily in the case of the present participles of the roots of the 1st, 4th, and 10th classes, and of causal, desiderative and nominal verbs, optionally in the case of those of the 6th class, of roots ending in @deva[आ] of the 2nd class, and of those of the Fut. in @deva[स्यत्] or @deva[ष्यत्], and not at all in the case of the remaining participles of the present tense.

rules.title: Nouns Ending in @deva[अन्]: Declension Rules
rules.body:
Nouns ending in @deva[अन्] and @deva[इन्].

@deva[न्] is dropped in the Nom. sing. and before all consonantal terminations. In the case of mas. nouns the preceding @deva[अ] is lengthened in the first five inflections and @deva[इ] in the Nom. sing. only. The @deva[अ] and @deva[इ] are lengthened in the plu. of the Nom. Voc. and Acc. of neuter nouns. The @deva[अ] is dropped before the vowel terminations beginning with that of the Acc. plu. except when it is preceded by a conjunct consonant having @deva[म्] or @deva[व्] for its latter member; it is optionally dropped in the Loc. sing. of mas. and neuter nouns and optionally in the Nom. Voc. and Acc. dual of the latter.

In the Voc. sing. the @deva[न्] of neu. nouns is optionally retained.

rules.title: @deva[अहन्] (Day) and @deva[दीर्घाहन्]
rules.body:
@deva[अहन्] n. meaning 'a day' changes its final to @deva[र्] (and finally to *visarga*) when followed by consonantal terminations or by nothing; in other cases it is declined like @deva[नामन्].

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. A. | @deva[अहः] | @deva[अह्नी], @deva[अहनी] | @deva[अहानि] |
| I. | @deva[अह्ना] | @deva[अहोभ्याम्] | @deva[अहोभिः] |
| D. | @deva[अह्ने] | ,, | @deva[अहोभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[अह्नः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | @deva[अह्नः] | @deva[अह्नोः] | @deva[अह्नाम्] |
| L. | @deva[अह्नि-हनि] | ,, | @deva[अहस्सु-ःसु] |

Obs :—@deva[दीर्घाहन्] when mas. is declined like @deva[चन्द्रमस्] when it takes the consonantal terminations and like @deva[राजन्] when it takes the vowel terminations; when neu. it is declined like @deva[अहन्].

|---|---|---|---|

| V. | @deva[दीर्घाहः] | ,, | ,, |
| A. | @deva[दीर्घाहाणम्] | ,, | @deva[दीर्घाह्नः] |
| I. | @deva[दीर्घाह्ना] | @deva[दीर्घाहोभ्याम्] | @deva[दीर्घाहोभिः] |
| D. | @deva[दीर्घाह्ने] | ,, | @deva[दीर्घाहोभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[दीर्घाह्नः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | @deva[दीर्घाह्नः] | @deva[दीर्घाह्नोः] | @deva[दीर्घाह्नाम्] |
| L. | @deva[दीर्घाह्नि] | ,, | @deva[दीर्घाहस्सु] |

Neu.

| N. V. A. | @deva[दीर्घाहः] | @deva[दीर्घाहणी-दीर्घाह्नी] | @deva[दीर्घाहाणि] |

The rest like the mas.

[^1]: The @deva[न्] may be optionally retained (@deva[दीर्घाहानौ] &c.) by Pāṇ. VIII. 4. 11.

rules.title: @deva[अर्वन्] (Horse): Special Declension
rules.body:
@deva[अर्वन्] m. a horse, except when preceded by the negative particle @deva[अन्] (forming a neg. Tat.) is declined like a word ending in @deva[त्] in all cases except the Nom. and Voc. singulars; e. g. N. @deva[अर्वा] @deva[अर्वन्तौ] @deva[अर्वन्तः]; V. @deva[अर्वन्] @deva[अर्वन्तौ], @deva[अर्वन्तः]; A. @deva[अर्वन्तम्], @deva[अर्वन्तौ], @deva[अर्वतः] &c. But @deva[अनर्वन्] (@deva[न विद्यतेऽर्वास्य]) is regularly declined like @deva[यज्वन्]; @deva[अनर्वा] @deva[अनर्वाणौ] &c.

@deva[स्वर्वन्] neu. is declined as @deva[स्वर्वत्] @deva[स्वर्वती] @deva[स्वर्वन्ति] Nom. Voc. Acc.; the rest like @deva[अर्वन्] mas.

rules.title: Words Ending in @deva[इन्]
rules.body:
Words ending in @deva[इन्]—

@deva[करिन्] mas. an elephant.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[करी] | @deva[करिणौ] | @deva[करिणः] |
| V. | @deva[करिन्] | ,, | ,, |
| A. | @deva[करिणम्] | ,, | ,, |
| I. | @deva[करिणा] | @deva[करिभ्याम्] | @deva[करिभिः] |
| D. | @deva[करिणे] | ,, | @deva[करिभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[करिणः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | ,, | @deva[करिणोः] | @deva[करीणाम्] |
| L. | @deva[करिणि] | ,, | @deva[करिषु] |

Decline similarly @deva[शशिन्] the moon, @deva[दण्डिन्] one having a stick, @deva[धनिन्] a wealthy man, @deva[हस्तिन्] an elephant, @deva[स्रग्विन्] one having a garland, @deva[आततायिन्] and all other words in @deva[इन्].

@deva[दण्डिन्] neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. A. | @deva[दण्डि] | @deva[दण्डिनी] | @deva[दण्डीनि] |
| V. | @deva[दण्डि-न्] | ,, | ,, |

The rest like the mas. Decline similarly @deva[स्रग्विन्] n., @deva[वाग्मिन्] n., eloquent, @deva[भाविन्] n. &c.

rules.title: @deva[पथिन्] (Road) and Other Irregular @deva[इन्]-Bases
rules.body:
Irregular Bases.

The first five forms of @deva[पथिन्] a road, @deva[मथिन्] a churning handle, and @deva[ऋभुक्षिन्] name of Indra are irregular.[^1] They drop their @deva[इन्] before vowel terminations beginning with the Acc. plu.

@deva[पथिन्].

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. | @deva[पन्थाः] | @deva[पन्थानौ] | @deva[पन्थानः] |
| A. | @deva[पन्थानम्] | ,, | @deva[पथः] |
| I. | @deva[पथा] | @deva[पथिभ्याम्] | @deva[पथिभिः] |
| D. | @deva[पथे] | ,, | @deva[पथिभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[पथः] | @deva[पथिभ्याम्] | @deva[पथिभ्यः] |
| G. | @deva[पथः] | @deva[पथोः] | @deva[पथाम्] |
| L. | @deva[पथि] | ,, | @deva[पथिषु] |

Decline similarly @deva[मथिन्] and @deva[ऋभुक्षिन्]; the latter word, however, does not insert the @deva[न्] in the first five inflections; e. g. Nom. @deva[मन्थाः] @deva[मन्थानौ] @deva[मन्थानः], @deva[ऋभुक्षाः-क्षाणौ-क्षाणः]; Acc. @deva[मन्थानम्] @deva[मन्थानौ-मथः], @deva[ऋभुक्षाणम्-ऋभुक्षाणौ-ऋभुक्षः]

---

[^1]: @deva[पथिमथ्यृभुक्षामात्] । @deva[इतोऽत्सर्वनामस्थाने] । @deva[थोन्थः] । @deva[भस्य टेर्लोपः] । Pāṇ. VII. 1. 85–88.

rules.title: Bases Ending in @deva[वस्] or @deva[इवस्] (Perfect Participles)
rules.body:
Bases ending in @deva[वस्] or @deva[इवस्]—

These are the perfect participles derived from roots with the affix @deva[वस्] to which the intermediate @deva[इ] is prefixed in some cases. They have a @deva[न्] prefixed to their final @deva[स्] in the first five inflections, the penultimate @deva[अ] being lengthened before it. In the Nom. sing. m. the @deva[स्] is dropped and the Voc. sing. ends in @deva[वन्]. @deva[उ] is substituted for @deva[व], before which the preceding short @deva[इ], if any, is dropped, before the vowel terminations beginning with those of the Acc plu. and before the @deva[ई] of the Nom. Voc. and Acc. dual of the neuter nouns. The final @deva[म्] of a root is changed to @deva[न्] before @deva[वस्] reappears before this @deva[उ]; final @deva[स्] is changed to @deva[द्] before the consonantal terminations and in the Nom. Voc. and Acc. sing of the neuter.

@deva[विद्वस्] m. a learned man.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[विद्वान्] | @deva[विद्वांसौ] | @deva[विद्वांसः] |
| V. | @deva[विद्वन्] | ,, | ,, |
| A. | @deva[विद्वांसम्] | ,, | @deva[विदुषः] |
| I. | @deva[विदुषा] | @deva[विद्वद्भ्याम्] | @deva[विद्वद्भिः] |
| D. | @deva[विदुषे] | ,, | @deva[विद्वद्भ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[विदुषः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | ,, | @deva[विदुषोः] | @deva[विदुषाम्] |
| L. | @deva[विदुषि] | ,, | @deva[विद्वत्सु] |

Neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. A. | @deva[विद्वत्] | @deva[विदुषी] | @deva[विद्वांसि] |

The rest like the mas.

Decline similarly @deva[जग्मिवस्] or @deva[जगन्वस्] one who has gone, @deva[तस्थिवस्] one who has stood, @deva[निनीवस्] one who has carried, @deva[मीढ्वस्] bountiful, @deva[शुश्रुवस्] one who has heard, @deva[सेदिवस्] one who has sat, @deva[दाश्वस्] honouring or serving the gods, &c. m. and n.; e. g.

| Nom. sing. | Nom. dual. | I. sing. | I. dual |
|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[जग्मिवान्] | @deva[जग्मिवांसौ] | @deva[जग्मुषा] | @deva[जग्मिवद्भ्याम्] |
| @deva[जगन्वान्] | @deva[जगन्वांसौ] | ,, | @deva[जगन्वद्भ्याम्] |
| @deva[तस्थिवान्] | @deva[तस्थिवांसौ] | @deva[तस्थुषा] | @deva[तस्थिवद्भ्याम्] |
| @deva[निनीवान्] | @deva[निनीवांसौ] | @deva[निन्युषा] | @deva[निनीवद्भ्याम्] |
| @deva[मीढ्वान्] | @deva[मीढ्वांसौ] | @deva[मीढुषा] | @deva[मीढ्वद्भ्याम्] |
| @deva[शुश्रुवान्] | @deva[शुश्रुवांसौ] | @deva[शुश्रुवुषा] | @deva[शुश्रुवद्भ्याम्] |
| @deva[सेदिवान्] | @deva[सेदिवांसौ] | @deva[सेदुषा] | @deva[सेदिवद्भ्याम्] |
| @deva[दाश्वान्] | @deva[दाश्वांसौ] | @deva[दाशुषा] | @deva[दाश्वद्भ्याम्] |

rules.title: Comparatives Ending in @deva[यस्] or @deva[ईयस्]
rules.body:
Bases in @deva[यस्] or @deva[ईयस्]

Comparatives in @deva[यस्] are declined like bases in @deva[वस्] in the first five inflections and the Voc. sing. and like nouns in @deva[अस्] in other respects; e. g.

@deva[श्रेयस्] (comparative of @deva[प्रशस्य]) more praiseworthy.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[श्रेयान्] | @deva[श्रेयांसौ] | @deva[श्रेयांसः] |
| V. | @deva[श्रेयन्] | ,, | ,, |
| A. | @deva[श्रेयांसम्] | ,, | @deva[श्रेयसः] |
| I. | @deva[श्रेयसा] | @deva[श्रेयोभ्याम्] | @deva[श्रेयोभिः] |

The rest like @deva[चन्द्रमस्]. Decline all comparatives in @deva[ईयस्] such as @deva[गरीयस्], @deva[लघीयस्], @deva[द्राघीयस्], &c. similarly.

Neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. A. | @deva[श्रेयः] | @deva[श्रेयसी] | @deva[श्रेयांसि] |

The rest like @deva[मनस्]. Decline n. nouns in @deva[ईयस्] similarly.

rules.title: Irregular Neuters: @deva[अस्थि], @deva[दधि], @deva[सक्थि], @deva[अक्षि]
rules.body:
## WORDS OF IRREGULAR DECLENSION.

@deva[अस्थि] n. a bone, @deva[दधि] n. curds, @deva[सक्थि] n. a thigh and @deva[अक्षि] n. an eye, become @deva[अस्थन्], @deva[दधन्], @deva[सक्थन्], and @deva[अक्षन्] respectively before the vowel terminations beginning with the I. sing.[^1] and then they follow the declension of nouns in @deva[न्]; in other respects they are declined like @deva[वारि].

@deva[अस्थि].

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[अस्थि] | @deva[अस्थिनी] | @deva[अस्थीनि] |
| V. | @deva[अस्थे-स्थि] | ,, | ,, |
| A. | @deva[अस्थि] | ,, | ,, |
| I. | @deva[अस्थ्ना] | @deva[अस्थिभ्याम्] | @deva[अस्थिभिः] |
| D. | @deva[अस्थ्ने] | @deva[अस्थिभ्याम्] | @deva[अस्थिभ्यः] |

@deva[दधि] and the rest should be similarly declined.

---

[^1]: @deva[अस्थिदधिसक्थ्यक्ष्णामनङुदात्तः] । VII. 1. 75.

rules.title: @deva[अप्] (Water): Plural-Only Declension
rules.body: @deva[अप्] f. water, is declined in the plural; it lengthens its @deva[अ] in the N. and changes its @deva[प्] to @deva[द्] before consonantal terminations. @deva[आपः-अपः-अद्भिः-अद्भ्यः-अद्भ्यः-अपाम्-अप्सु].

rules.body:

@deva[जरा].

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|

| V. | @deva[जरे] | ,, | ,, |
| A. | @deva[जराम्, जरसम्] | ,, | ,, |
| I. | @deva[जरया, जरसा] | @deva[जराभ्याम्] | @deva[जराभिः] |
| D. | @deva[जरायै, जरसे] | ,, | @deva[जराभ्यः] |

| L. | @deva[जरायाम्, जरसि] | ,, | @deva[जरासु] |

Decline @deva[निर्जर] &c. like @deva[राम] and @deva[चन्द्रमस्]:—

| N. | @deva[निर्जरः] | @deva[निर्जरौ-निर्जरसौ] | @deva[निर्जराः-निर्जरसः] |
| A. | @deva[निर्जरम्-निर्जरसम्] | ,, | @deva[निर्जरान्-निर्जरसः] |

| &c. | &c. | &c. | &c. |

| V. | @deva[अजर] | ,, | ,, |
| A. | @deva[अजरम्] | ,, | ,, |

The rest like the mas.

rules.title: Words with Optional Alternative Stems: @deva[पाद्], @deva[दन्त], @deva[दोस्], @deva[निशा], &c.
rules.body:
The words @deva[पाद्], @deva[दन्त], @deva[नासिका], @deva[मास], @deva[हृदय], @deva[निशा], @deva[असृज्], @deva[यूष], @deva[दोस्], @deva[यकृत्], @deva[शकृत्], @deva[उदक], @deva[आस्य][^1]; @deva[मांस], @deva[पृतना] and @deva[सानु][^2] optionally assume the forms @deva[पद्], @deva[दत्], @deva[नस्], @deva[मास्], @deva[हृद्], @deva[निश्], @deva[असन्], @deva[यूषन्], @deva[दोषन्], @deva[यकन्], @deva[शकन्], @deva[उदन्], @deva[आसन्], @deva[मांस्], @deva[पृत्], and @deva[स्नु] before all terminations beginning with the Acc. plu.

rules.title: Case Suffixes: @deva[तस्] and @deva[त्र]
rules.body:
The following suffixes are sometimes added to nominal bases to express the meanings of cases.

**(a)** The suffix @deva[तस्] added to the base of a noun gives it the sense of the Ab.[^1]; as @deva[प्रमादतः], 'from carelessness'. @deva[वस्तुतः] from the real state of the thing, in reality, @deva[ज्ञानतः] 'from knowledge,' @deva[बहुतः] &c.

**(b)** The suffix @deva[त्र] is used to denote the meaning of the Loc.[^1] case, and is generally added to pronominal adjectives; as @deva[तत्र] 'in that place, there'; @deva[सर्वत्र] 'in every place, everywhere, &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[पञ्चम्यास्तसिल्] । @deva[सप्तम्यास्त्रल्] Pāṇ. V. 3. 7. 10. By '@deva[इतराभ्योपि दृश्यन्ते] । Pāṇ. V. 3. 14. @deva[तस्], @deva[त्रल्] &c. may stand for all cases except the Nom. (though they may be used for the Nom. also).

rules.title: Indeclinable Nouns
rules.body: A few nouns such as @deva[भूर्] 'the lowest world,' @deva[स्वर्] 'heaven,' @deva[संवत्] 'a year of an era', @deva[अस्तम्] 'setting,' @deva[शम्] 'ease,' @deva[नमस्] 'a bow', @deva[स्वस्ति] 'hail, farewell' &c. are indeclinables.

rules.title: Definition of Pronouns: The 35 Sanskrit Pronouns
rules.body:
# Chapter IV.
# PRONOUNS AND THEIR DECLENSION.

The following 35 words are termed 'Pronouns' in Sanskrit:—@deva[सर्व], @deva[विश्व], @deva[उभ], @deva[उभय], @deva[डतर], @deva[डतम] (i. e. the word formed by the addition of the terminations @deva[अतर] and @deva[अतम] to the pronouns @deva[किम्], @deva[यद्], and @deva[तद्] which become @deva[क], @deva[य] and @deva[त] respectively before these; e. g. @deva[कतर], @deva[कतम], @deva[यतर], @deva[यतम], and @deva[ततर], @deva[ततम]) @deva[अन्य], @deva[अन्यतर], @deva[इतर], @deva[त्वत्], @deva[त्व], @deva[नेम], @deva[सन], @deva[सिम], @deva[पूर्व], @deva[पर], @deva[अवर], @deva[दक्षिण], @deva[उत्तर], @deva[अपर], @deva[अधर], @deva[स्व], @deva[अन्तर]; @deva[त्यद्], @deva[तद्] @deva[एतद्], @deva[इदम्], @deva[अदस्], @deva[एक], @deva[द्वि], @deva[युष्मद्], @deva[अस्मद्], @deva[भवत्] and @deva[किम्].

rules.title: Personal Pronouns: @deva[अस्मद्], @deva[युष्मद्], @deva[भवत्]
rules.body:
## 1—Personal Pronouns.

The pronouns @deva[अस्मद्] 'I,' @deva[युष्मद्] 'thou', and @deva[भवत्] 'your honour:'—

**N. B.**—The declension of the first two of these pronouns is the same in all the three genders.

@deva[अस्मद्][^1] m. f. n.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[अहम्] | @deva[आवाम्] | @deva[वयम्] |
| A. | @deva[माम्], @deva[मा] | @deva[आवाम्], @deva[नौ] | @deva[अस्मान्], @deva[नः] |
| I. | @deva[मया] | @deva[आवाभ्याम्] | @deva[अस्माभिः] |
| D. | @deva[मह्यम्], @deva[मे] | @deva[आवाभ्याम्], @deva[नौ] | @deva[अस्मभ्यम्], @deva[नः] |
| Ab. | @deva[मत्] | @deva[आवाभ्याम्] | @deva[अस्मत्] |
| G. | @deva[मम], @deva[मे] | @deva[आवयोः], @deva[नौ] | @deva[अस्माकम्], @deva[नः] |
| L. | @deva[मयि] | @deva[आवयोः] | @deva[अस्मासु] |

@deva[युष्मद्] m. f. n.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[त्वम्] | @deva[युवाम्] | @deva[यूयम्] |
| A. | @deva[त्वाम्], @deva[त्वा] | @deva[युवाम्], @deva[वाम्] | @deva[युष्मान्], @deva[वः] |
| I. | @deva[त्वया] | @deva[युवाभ्याम्] | @deva[युष्माभिः] |
| D. | @deva[तुभ्यम्], @deva[ते] | @deva[युवाभ्याम्], @deva[वाम्] | @deva[युष्मभ्यम्], @deva[वः] |
| Ab. | @deva[त्वत्] | @deva[युवाभ्याम्] | @deva[युष्मत्] |
| G. | @deva[तव], @deva[ते] | @deva[युवयोः], @deva[वाम्] | @deva[युष्माकम्], @deva[वः] |
| L. | @deva[त्वयि] | @deva[युवयोः] | @deva[युष्मासु] |

@deva[भवत्] to be declined like @deva[भगवत्]; @deva[भवान् भवन्तौ भवन्तः] N. @deva[भवन्तम् भवन्तौ भवतः] A. &c. @deva[अत्रभवत्], @deva[तत्रभवत्] (see Syntax 'Pronouns') are similarly declined.

---

[^1]: @deva[युष्मदस्मदोः षष्ठीचतुर्थीद्वितीयास्थयोर्वान्नावौ । बहुवचनस्य वस्नसौ । तेमयावेकवचनस्य । त्वामौ द्वितीयायाः ।] Pāṇ. VIII. 1. 20-23.

rules.title: Usage Rules for Shorter Pronoun Forms
rules.body:
**(a)** The optional shorter forms of the pronouns @deva[अस्मद्] and @deva[युष्मद्] are never used at the beginning of a sentence or of a foot of a metre;[^1] nor can they be used immediately before the particles @deva[च], @deva[वा], @deva[ह] or @deva[हा], @deva[अह] and @deva[एव];[^2] as @deva[मम गृहं] my house, and not @deva[मे गृहम्]; @deva[वेदैरशेषैः संवेद्योस्मान् कृष्णः सर्वदावतु] (Sid. Kau.), 'may Krshna, revered throughout or capable of being known properly from all the Vedas, always protect us; and not @deva[नः कृष्णः] &c.; @deva[तवैव कृत्यमेतत्] 'this is surely your deed,' and not @deva[ते एव] &c. But if these particles do not connect these forms they may be used with them;[^3] as @deva[हरो हरिश्च मे स्वामी] (Sid. Kau.) Hara and Hari are my lords, &c.

**Obs.**—**(b)** The shorter forms may be used in a sentence having one verb; @deva[शालीनां ते ओदनं दास्यामि]; but @deva[ओदनं पच तव भविष्यति] as there are two verbs.[^4]

**(c)** These shorter forms are not also used immediately after the Vocative case except when a qualifying adjective follows it;[^5] @deva[देवास्मान्] (and not @deva[नः]) @deva[पाहि सर्वदा] (Sid. Kau.) 'Oh God! do thou protect us always'; but @deva[हरे दयालो नः पाहि] (Sid. Kau.) 'Oh merciful Hari, protect us.'

**(d)** The shorter forms may or may not be used when there is no @deva[अन्वादेश] (the subsequent mention of a thing already mentioned); @deva[धाता ते भक्तोस्ति], @deva[धाता तत्र भक्तोस्ति], @deva[इति वा ।]; but must be used when there is anvadeś'a;[^6] @deva[तस्मै ते नमः] 'bow to thee (already described) only.'

---

[^1]: @deva[पदात् । अनुदात्तं सर्वमपादादौ ।] Pāṇ. VIII. 1. 17. 18. The following couplets illustrate the use of these short forms:—@deva[श्रीशस्त्वावतु मापीह दत्ता ते मेपि शर्म सः । स्वामी ते मेपि स हरिः पातु वामपि नौ विभुः ॥ सुखं वा नौ ददात्वीशः पतिर्वामपि नौ हरिः । सोऽव्याद्वो नः शिवं वो नो द्यात्सेव्योऽत्र वः स नः ॥] Sid. Kau.

[^2]: @deva[न चवाहाऽहैवयुक्ते ।] Pāṇ. VIII. 1. 24.

[^3]: @deva[युक्तग्रहणात्साक्षाद्योगेऽयं निषेधः । परम्परासम्बन्धे तु आदेशः स्यादेव ।] Sid. Kau.

[^4]: @deva[समानवाक्ये निघातयुष्मदस्मदादेशा वक्तव्याः ।] Vārt.

[^5]: Pāṇ. VIII. 1. 72. 73.

[^6]: @deva[एते वांनावादय आदेशा अनन्वादेशे वा वक्तव्याः ।] Vārt.

rules.title: Demonstrative Pronouns: @deva[तद्], @deva[एतद्], @deva[इदम्], @deva[अदस्]
rules.body:
## 2—Demonstrative Pronouns.

The pronouns @deva[तद्] 'that or he, she, it,' @deva[एतद्] 'this,' @deva[इदस्] 'this' and @deva[अदस्] 'that'. The Nom. sing of the first two is respectively @deva[सः] and @deva[एषः] mas. and @deva[सा] and @deva[एषा] fem. In other cases they become @deva[त] and @deva[एत] and are declined like nouns in @deva[अ] except in the Nom. pl., D. Ab. sings., G. pl. and L. sing. the terminations of which are @deva[ई], @deva[स्मै], @deva[स्मात्], @deva[इषाम्] and @deva[स्मिन्] mas. and @deva[स्यै], @deva[स्यास्], @deva[स्यास्], @deva[साम्] and @deva[स्याम्] fem. respectively. All pronouns ending in @deva[अ] are similarly declined.

@deva[तद्] mas.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[सः] | @deva[तौ] | @deva[ते] |
| A. | @deva[तम्] | @deva[तौ] | @deva[तान्] |
| I. | @deva[तेन] | @deva[ताभ्याम्] | @deva[तैः] |
| D. | @deva[तस्मै] | ,, | @deva[तेभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[तस्मात्] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | @deva[तस्य] | @deva[तयोः] | @deva[तेषाम्] |
| L. | @deva[तस्मिन्] | ,, | @deva[तेषु] |

Fem.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[सा] | @deva[ते] | @deva[ताः] |
| A. | @deva[ताम्] | ,, | ,, |
| I. | @deva[तया] | @deva[ताभ्याम्] | @deva[ताभिः] |
| D. | @deva[तस्यै] | ,, | @deva[ताभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[तस्याः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | ,, | @deva[तयोः] | @deva[तासाम्] |
| L. | @deva[तस्याम्] | ,, | @deva[तासु] |

Decline @deva[त्यद्] which means the same thing as @deva[तद्], similarly, e. g. @deva[त्यः त्यौ त्ये] Nom.; @deva[त्यं त्यौ त्यान्] Acc. &c.

@deva[तद्] neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. and A. | @deva[तत्] | @deva[ते] | @deva[तानि] |

The following cases like the mas.

@deva[एतद्] mas.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[एषः] | @deva[एतौ] | @deva[एते] |
| A. | @deva[एतम्-एनम्][^1] | @deva[एतौ-एनौ] | @deva[एतान्-एनान्] |
| I. | @deva[एतेन-एनेन] | @deva[एताभ्याम्] | @deva[एतैः] |
| D. | @deva[एतस्मै] | ,, | @deva[एतेभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[एतस्मात्] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | @deva[एतस्य] | @deva[एतयोः-एनयोः] | @deva[एतेषाम्] |
| L. | @deva[एतस्मिन्] | ,, | @deva[एतेषु] |

Fem.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[एषा] | @deva[एते] | @deva[एताः] |
| A. | @deva[एताम्-एनाम्] | @deva[एते-एने] | @deva[एताः-एनाः] |
| I. | @deva[एतया-एनया] | @deva[एताभ्याम्] | @deva[एताभिः] |
| D. | @deva[एतस्यै] | ,, | @deva[एताभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[एतस्याः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | @deva[एतस्याः] | @deva[एतयोः-एनयोः] | @deva[एतासाम्] |
| L. | @deva[एतस्याम्] | ,, | @deva[एतासु] |

Neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[एतत्] | @deva[एते] | @deva[एतानि] |
| A. | @deva[एतत्-एनत्] | @deva[एते-एने] | @deva[एतानि-एनानि] |

The rest like the mas.

**Notes:**—The visarga of @deva[सः] and @deva[एषः] is dropped when followed by any letter except @deva[अ] in which case the usual Sandhi takes place; @deva[स गच्छतु], @deva[एष आयाति]; but @deva[एषोऽगच्छत्] &c, Vide @ref[50].

@deva[इदम्] mas.

|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[अयम्] | @deva[इमौ] | @deva[इमे] |
| A. | @deva[इमम्-एनम्] | @deva[इमौ-एनौ] | @deva[इमान्-एनान्] |
| I. | @deva[अनेन-एनेन] | @deva[आभ्याम्] | @deva[एभिः] |
| D. | @deva[अस्मै] | ,, | @deva[एभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[अस्मात्] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | @deva[अस्य] | @deva[अनयोः-एनयोः] | @deva[एषाम्] |
| L. | @deva[अस्मिन्] | ,, | @deva[एषु] |

Fem.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[इयम्] | @deva[इमे] | @deva[इमाः] |
| A. | @deva[इमाम्-एनाम्] | @deva[इमे-एने] | @deva[इमाः-एनाः] |
| I. | @deva[अनया-एनया] | @deva[आभ्याम्] | @deva[आभिः] |
| D. | @deva[अस्यै] | ,, | @deva[आभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[अस्याः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | ,, | @deva[अनयोः-एनयोः] | @deva[आसाम्] |
| L. | @deva[अस्याम्] | ,, | @deva[आसु] |

Neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[इदम्] | @deva[इमे] | @deva[इमानि] |
| A. | @deva[इदम्-एनत्] | @deva[इमे-एने] | @deva[इमानि-एनानि] |

The rest like the mas.

@deva[अदस्] mas.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[असौ] | @deva[अमू] | @deva[अमी] |
| A. | @deva[अमुम्] | ,, | @deva[अमून्] |
| I. | @deva[अमुना] | @deva[अमूभ्याम्] | @deva[अमीभिः] |
| D. | @deva[अमुष्मै] | ,, | @deva[अमीभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[अमुष्मात्] | ,, | @deva[अमीभ्यः] |
| G. | @deva[अमुष्य] | @deva[अमुयोः] | @deva[अमीषाम्] |
| L. | @deva[अमुष्मिन्] | ,, | @deva[अमीषु] |

Fem.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[असौ] | @deva[अमू] | @deva[अमूः] |
| A. | @deva[अमूम्] | ,, | ,, |
| I. | @deva[अमुया] | @deva[अमूभ्याम्] | @deva[अमूभिः] |
| D. | @deva[अमुष्यै] | ,, | @deva[अमूभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[अमुष्याः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | ,, | @deva[अमुयोः] | @deva[अमूषाम्] |
| L. | @deva[अमुष्याम्] | ,, | @deva[अमूषु] |

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |

---

[^1]: @deva[द्वितीयाटौस्स्वेनः ।] Pāṇ. II. 4. 34. @deva[एन] is optionally substituted for @deva[इदम्] and @deva[एतद्] in the Acc., Inst. Sing. and Gen. and Loc. Duals when there is @deva[अन्वादेश] (see @ref[137]).

rules.title: Usage Rules for Demonstrative Pronouns
Optional Forms with @deva[अन्वादेश]
rules.body:
The optional forms of @deva[इदम्] and @deva[एतद्] in the Acc., Inst. Sing. and Gen. & Loc. Duals are to be used when there is anvádes'a[^1] i. e. their proper forms have already been used in a previous clause; e. g. @deva[अनेन व्याकरणमधीतं एनं छन्दोऽध्यापय] 'he has studied grammar, teach him prosody,' @deva[अनयोः पवित्रं कुलं, एनयोः प्रभूतं स्वम्], 'The family of them both is pure, and their wealth ample.'

---

[^1]: @deva[किंचित्कार्यं विधातुमुपात्तस्य कार्यान्तरं विधातुं पुनरुपादानमन्वादेशः ।] Sid. Kau.

rules.title: Relative Pronoun: @deva[यद्]
rules.body:
## 3—The Relative Pronouns.

The pronouns @deva[यद्] 'who, which'; mas. fem. and neu.; mas. base @deva[य], fem. base @deva[या].

@deva[यद्] mas.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[यः] | @deva[यौ] | @deva[ये] |
| A. | @deva[यम्] | @deva[यौ] | @deva[यान्] |
| I. | @deva[येन] | @deva[याभ्याम्] | @deva[यैः] |
| D. | @deva[यस्मै] | ,, | @deva[येभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[यस्मात्] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | @deva[यस्य] | @deva[ययोः] | @deva[येषाम्] |
| L. | @deva[यस्मिन्] | ,, | @deva[येषु] |

Fem.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[या] | @deva[ये] | @deva[याः] |
| A. | @deva[याम्] | ,, | ,, |
| I. | @deva[यया] | @deva[याभ्याम्] | @deva[याभिः] |
| D. | @deva[यस्यै] | ,, | @deva[याभ्यः] |
| Ab. | @deva[यस्याः] | ,, | ,, |
| G. | ,, | @deva[ययोः] | @deva[यासाम्] |

The rest like the mas.

rules.body:

rules.title: Reflexive Pronouns: @deva[आत्मन्] and @deva[स्वयम्]
rules.body:
## 5—Reflexive Pronouns.

The sense of the reflexive pronoun is, in Sanskrit, expressed by the word @deva[आत्मन्] 'self' which is invariably used in the masculine gender and singular number, and by the reflexive adverb @deva[स्वयम्] e. g. @deva[गुप्तं ददृशुरात्मानं सर्वाः स्वप्नेषु वामनैः] "they all (the wives of Das'aratha) saw in dreams that they were guarded by dwarfs;" so @deva[स] or @deva[सा कृतापराधमिव आत्मानमवगच्छति ।] @deva[राजा स्वयं समरभूमिं जगाम], &c.

rules.title: Indefinite Pronouns: Formation with @deva[चित्], @deva[चन], @deva[अपि], @deva[स्वित्]
rules.body:
## 6—Indefinite Pronouns.

Indefinite pronouns are formed by the addition of @deva[चित्] or @deva[चन] or @deva[अपि] and sometimes of @deva[स्वित्] to the various cases of the pronoun @deva[किम्] in all the genders; e. g. @deva[कश्चित्], @deva[कश्चन] a certain one, @deva[कोपि], @deva[केनापि], @deva[कयाचन], @deva[कयापि]; @deva[कास्वित्], &c.

rules.title: Indefinite Adverbs
rules.body: The terminations given above are also added to interrogative adverbs in the sense of indefiniteness; as @deva[कदाचित्] at some time, @deva[कदाचन], @deva[कतिचित्] some, @deva[क्वचित्] somewhere, &c.

rules.title: Correlative Pronouns: Formation with @deva[वत्] and @deva[दृश]
rules.body:
## 7—Correlative Pronouns.

Correlatives are formed by the affixes @deva[वत्] added to @deva[यद्], @deva[तद्] and @deva[एतद्], and @deva[यत्] added to @deva[इदम्] and @deva[किम्] in the sense of 'as much as;' and @deva[दृश] or @deva[दृश्] in the sense of 'similar to'; @deva[तद्], @deva[एतद्] and @deva[यद्] become @deva[ता], @deva[एता] and @deva[या] respectively before these, and @deva[इदम्] and @deva[किम्] @deva[इ] and @deva[कि] before @deva[वत्] and @deva[ई] and @deva[की] before @deva[दृश] or @deva[दृश्]; e. g. @deva[तावत्] (@deva[तत्परिमाणमस्य]), @deva[इयत्] (@deva[इदं परिमाणमस्य]), @deva[तादृश] like that, @deva[ईदृश], like this, @deva[कियद्] how much, &c.

rules.title: Numerical Correlatives: @deva[तति], @deva[यति], @deva[कति]
rules.body: The affix @deva[अति] is added to @deva[तद्], @deva[यद्] and @deva[किम्] to show number or measure e. g. @deva[तति] 'so many', @deva[यति] 'as many,' and @deva[कति] 'how many'. These are declined in the plural only, and take no termination in the Nom. and Acc.; e. g. Nom. and Acc. @deva[कति] Inst. @deva[कतिभिः] the rest like @deva[हरि].

rules.title: Reciprocal Pronouns: @deva[अन्योन्य], @deva[इतरेतर], @deva[परस्पर]
rules.body:
## 8—Reciprocal Pronouns.

Reciprocity is expressed by the repetition of the pronominal adjectives @deva[अन्य], @deva[इतर] and @deva[पर]; e. g. @deva[अन्योन्य], @deva[इतरेतर], and @deva[परस्पर]. These are generally used in the sing. and also adverbially e. g. @deva[परस्परेण स्पृहणीयशोभं] &c. (Rag. VII. 14); @deva[परस्परं विवदन्ते] &c. They are more commonly used as the first members of compounds; as @deva[अन्योन्यशोभाजननाद् बभूव] &c. (Ku. I, 44; @deva[इतरेतरयोगाः] (Sis. X. 24.) &c.

rules.title: Possessive Pronouns: Formation and Declension
rules.body:
## 9—Possessive Pronouns.

Possessive pronouns are formed by means of the secondary affix @deva[ईय] added to @deva[तद्], @deva[एतद्], @deva[अस्मत्], and @deva[युष्मत्]; and @deva[अ] and @deva[ईन] added to @deva[अस्मत्], and @deva[युष्मत्], changed respectively to @deva[मामक्] and @deva[तावक्] in the sing. and @deva[आस्माक्] and @deva[यौष्माक्] in the plu. before these; e. g.

@deva[अस्मत्]

Mas.

| Sing. | Plural |
|---|---|
| @deva[मदीय] 'my, mine' | @deva[अस्मदीय] 'our, ours' |
| @deva[मामक] " | @deva[आस्माक] " |
| @deva[मामकीन] " | @deva[आस्माकीन] " |

Fem.

| Sing. | Plural |
|---|---|
| @deva[मदीया] 'my, mine' | @deva[अस्मदीया] 'our, ours' |
| @deva[मामिका] " | @deva[आस्माकी] " |
| @deva[मामकीना] " | @deva[आस्माकीना] " |

@deva[युष्मद्]

mas.

| Sing. | Plural |
|---|---|
| @deva[त्वदीय] 'thy, thine.' | @deva[युष्मदीय] 'your, yours.' |
| @deva[तावक] " | @deva[यौष्माक] " |
| @deva[तावकीन] " | @deva[यौष्माकीण] " |

fem.

| Sing. | Plural |
|---|---|
| @deva[त्वदीया] 'thy, thine.' | @deva[युष्मदीया] 'your, yours.' |
| @deva[तावकी] " | @deva[यौष्माकी] " |
| @deva[तावकीना] " | @deva[यौष्माकीणा] " |

| @deva[तद्] | @deva[एतद्] |
|---|---|
| mas. @deva[तदीय] | mas. @deva[एतदीय] |
| fem. @deva[तदीया] | fem. @deva[एतदीया] |

**N. B.** These are declined like nouns ending in @deva[अ], @deva[आ] or @deva[ई] regularly. @deva[स्व] is a possessive pronoun by itself.

rules.title: Pronominal Adjectives: @deva[अन्य], @deva[कतर], @deva[यतर], @deva[ततर]
rules.body:
## 10—Pronominal Adjectives.

@deva[अन्य] 'another,' @deva[अन्यतर] 'either of two,' @deva[इतर] 'other,' @deva[एकतम] 'one of many,' @deva[कतर] 'who or which of two,' @deva[कतम] 'who or which of many,' @deva[यतर] 'who or which of two,' @deva[यतम] 'who or which of many,' @deva[ततर] 'that one (of two),' @deva[ततम] 'that one (of many),' are declined in all the three genders like @deva[यद्] e. g.

mas.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[कतरः] | @deva[कतरौ] | @deva[कतरे] |
| &c. | | | |

fem.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. | @deva[कतरा] | @deva[कतरे] | @deva[कतराः] |
| &c. | | | |

neu.

| | Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. & A. | @deva[कतरत्] | @deva[कतरे] | @deva[कतराणि] |
| &c. | | | |

**N. B.** @deva[अन्यतम] is not a pronoun, as it is not mentioned in the group @deva[सर्वादि] (@deva[तत्रान्यतमशब्दस्य गणे पाठाभावान्न संज्ञा] Sid. Kau.). It is, therefore, declined like nouns ending in @deva[अ].

rules.title: Pronominal Adjectives: @deva[सर्व], @deva[विश्व], @deva[उभ], @deva[उभय]
rules.body:
Decline @deva[सर्व], @deva[विश्व], @deva[सम] and @deva[सिम] all having the same meaning, @deva[उभ] (declined in the dual only) and @deva[उभय] (which has no dual according to Kaiyata and other grammarians) both meaning 'both,' @deva[इतर] and @deva[एकतर] 'one of two,' like @deva[यद्] except in the Nom. and Acc. sing. of the neu. which is formed by adding @deva[म्], e. g.

@deva[सर्व] mas. 'all.'

**(a)**—@deva[सम] when it means 'equal' is not a pronoun and is declined like nouns in @deva[अ]; e. g. @deva[समः समौ समाः] Nom., @deva[समाय] D. sing., @deva[समानाम्] G. plu. as in the Sutra of Pāṇ. @deva[यथासंख्यमनुदेशः समानाम् ।] 1. 3. 10.

rules.title: @deva[त्व]: @deva[उदात्त] and @deva[अनुदात्त] Forms
rules.body: **Obs:**—@deva[त्व] and @deva[त्व] (the 10th and 11th @deva[सर्वादि]s) the one @deva[उदात्त] (udātta), the other @deva[अनुदात्त] (anudātta), both synonyms of @deva[अन्य] are declined like @deva[सर्व]. The former is of the form @deva[त्वत्] according to some and then it is declined regularly by adding the terminations; e. g. @deva[त्वत् त्वतौ त्वतः] Nom. &c.

rules.title: @deva[स्व] as Pronoun: Optional Forms
@deva[अन्तर] as Pronoun: Optional Declension
@deva[नेम] (Half): Optional Declension
rules.body: @deva[नेम] meaning 'half' is a pronoun, but it is optionally declined like @deva[राम] in the Nom. plu. mas.; in other respects it is declined like @deva[सर्व].

rules.title: Directional Pronouns: @deva[पूर्व], @deva[अपर], @deva[दक्षिण], @deva[उत्तर], @deva[अधर]
Numerals: @deva[एक] and @deva[द्वि]
rules.body:
@deva[एक] when a numeral is declined in the sing. and @deva[द्वि] in the dual only; @deva[द्वि], is considered as @deva[द्व], and they are both declined like @deva[सर्व] in all the three genders; e g.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| | Mas. | Fem. | Mas. | Fem. &c. Neu. |
| N. | @deva[एकः] | @deva[एका] | @deva[द्वौ] | @deva[द्वे] |
| V. | @deva[एक] | @deva[एके] | ,, | ,, |
| A. | @deva[एकम्] | @deva[एकाम्] | @deva[द्वौ] | @deva[द्वे] |
| I. | @deva[एकेन] | @deva[एकया] | @deva[द्वाभ्याम्] | The rest like the mas. |
| D. | @deva[एकस्मै] | @deva[एकस्यै] | ,, | |
| Ab. | @deva[एकस्मात्] | @deva[एकस्याः] | ,, | |
| G. | @deva[एकस्य] | ,, | @deva[द्वयोः] | |
| L. | @deva[एकस्मिन्] | @deva[एकस्याम्] | ,, | |

@deva[एक] neu. @deva[एकम्] N. A. The rest like the mas.

@deva[एक] when it does not mean 'one' is declined in the dual and plural also.

rules.title: Meanings of @deva[एक]
Optional Pronominal Nominative Forms
rules.body: @deva[प्रथम], @deva[चरम], @deva[अल्प], @deva[अर्ध], @deva[कतिपय], and words ending in the termination @deva[तय] optionally form their Nom. plu. like that of pronouns; e. g. @deva[प्रथमे-प्रथमाः], @deva[कतिपये-कतिपयाः], @deva[द्वितये-द्वितयाः] &c.

rules.title: Pronominal Adverbs: Formation and Examples
Pronominal Words in Compounds: Declension Exceptions
rules.body:
When a pronominal word is used as the subordinate member of a compound, or is at the end of an Inst. Tat., or of sentence having the sense of the Inst. Tat., or at the end of a Dwandwa, it is not declined like a pronoun[^1]; e. g. @deva[अतिक्रान्तः सर्वं अतिसर्वः], @deva[तस्मै अतिसर्वाय] and not @deva[सर्वस्मै]; so @deva[अतिकतरं कुलम्]; @deva[मासपूर्वाय] or @deva[मासेन पूर्वाय] and not @deva[मासपूर्वस्मै], @deva[वर्णाश्रमेतराणाम्] &c.; in the case of a Dwandwa comp., however, it is optionally declined like a pronoun in the Nom. plu.,[^2] as @deva[वर्णाश्रमेतरे] or @deva[वर्णाश्रमेतराः ।]

---

[^1]: @deva[संज्ञोपसर्जनीभूतास्तु न सर्वादयः ।] Vārt. @deva[तृतीयासमासे । द्वंद्वे च ॥] Pāṇ. I. 1. 30. 31.

[^2]: @deva[विभाषा जसि ।] Pāṇ. 1. 1. 32.

rules.title: Formation of Compound Numbers
rules.body:
The cardinal numbers between @deva[विंशति] and @deva[त्रिंशत्], @deva[त्रिंशत्] and @deva[चत्वारिंशत्], it will be seen, are made up by prefixing @deva[एक], @deva[द्वि], &c. up to @deva[नवन्] to the lower. The ninth intermediate number may also be made up by prefixing @deva[एकोन], @deva[ऊन] or @deva[एकान्न] to the higher. In these compounds @deva[द्वि], @deva[त्रि] and @deva[अष्टन्] are changed to @deva[द्वा], @deva[त्रयः], and @deva[अष्टा] necessarily before @deva[विंशति] and @deva[त्रिंशत्], and optionally before the rest except @deva[अशीति] before which they remain unchanged.[^1]

---

[^1]: @deva[द्व्यष्टनः संख्यायामबहुव्रीह्यशीत्योः । त्रेस्त्रयः । विभाषा चत्वारिंशत्प्रभृतौ सर्वेषाम् ।] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 47-49

rules.title: Expressing Numbers Between Hundreds
rules.body: The cardinal numbers between 100 and 200, 200 and 300, &c are generally expressed by means of @deva[अधिक] added to the number showing the excess and then optionally prefixing the whole to 100, 200, &c, e. g. @deva[एकाधिकं शतं] or @deva[एकाधिकशतं] 101, @deva[द्वादशाधिकं शतं] or @deva[द्वादशाधिकशतं] 112, @deva[पञ्चाशदधिकं शतं] 150. &c. After 1000 this @deva[अधिक] may be repeated with every multiple of ten or hundred; e. g. @deva[द्वि-द्वानवत्यधिकाष्टशताधिकसहस्रम्] 1892, @deva[एकोनचत्वारिंशदधिकषट्शताधिकसप्तसप्ततिसहस्राधिकं लक्षम्] 177639, &c. Similarly @deva[उत्तर] may also be used insted of @deva[अधिक] e. g. @deva[चतुःपञ्चाशदुत्तरं सप्तशतम्] 754. Or these may also be, at times, expressed by the copulative particle @deva[च] as @deva[सप्त च शतानि विंशतिश्च] 720.

rules.title: Formation with Taddhita Affix @deva[अ]
rules.body:
The Tad. affix @deva[अ][^1] may be used, instead of @deva[अधिक], in the case of the cardinal numbers ending in @deva[दशन्], the numeral @deva[विंशति] and those ending in @deva[शत्] i. e. in the case of the numerals 111-159, 211-259, 311-359, &c. and qualifying the numerals @deva[शत] and @deva[सहस्र] before which the final @deva[अन्], @deva[अति] and @deva[अत्] are dropped e. g. @deva[एकादशं शतम्] 111, @deva[विंशं शतं] 120, @deva[पञ्चाशं शतं] 150, @deva[सप्तदशं द्विशतं] 217, @deva[त्रिंशं त्रिशतं] 330 and so on.

---

[^1]: @deva[तदस्मिन्नधिकमिति दशान्ताड्डः । शदन्तविंशतेश्च ।] Pāṇ. V. 2. 45. 46. @deva[शतसहस्रयोरेवेष्यते ।] Vārt.

rules.title: Formation of Ordinal Numbers
rules.body:
The ordinals from @deva[एक], @deva[द्वि], @deva[त्रि], @deva[चतुर्] and @deva[षष्][^1] are irregularly formed. The ordinal from other numerals up to @deva[दशन्] inclusive are formed by dropping the final @deva[न्] and adding @deva[म] and after @deva[दशन्] up to @deva[नवदशन्] by simply dropping the @deva[न्]. The ordinals from @deva[विंशति][^2] above are formed by adding @deva[तम] or by dropping the @deva[ति] of @deva[विंशति] and the final consonant of the rest; the compound numerals, in this latter case, change the final vowel to @deva[अ], while the simple ones ending in a vowel i. e. @deva[षष्टि] @deva[सप्तति], @deva[अशीति] and @deva[नवति] form their ordinals in the first way only; as @deva[एकषष्टः] or @deva[एकषष्टितमः], but @deva[षष्टितम] only. @deva[शत] has invariably @deva[शततम].

---

[^1]: @deva[षट्कतिपयचतुरां थुक् ।] Pāṇ. V. 2. 51; so @deva[कतिथः], @deva[चतुर्थः] &c.; '@deva[चतुरश्छयतावाद्यक्षरलोपश्च]' Vārt. @deva[तुरीय], @deva[तुर्य । द्वेस्तीयः । त्रेः सम्प्रसारणं च ।] Pāṇ. V. 2. 54, 55.

[^2]: @deva[विंशत्यादिभ्यस्तमडन्यतरस्याम् । षष्ट्यादेश्चासंख्यादेः ।] Pāṇ. V.3.56,58.

rules.title: Numerals as Adjectives: Gender Agreement
rules.body:
# DECLENSION OF THE NUMERALS (CARDINALS AND ORDINALS)

@deva[एक] (@deva[एका] fem.), @deva[द्वि] (@deva[द्वा] fem.), @deva[त्रि] (@deva[तिसृ][^1] fem.), and @deva[चतुर्] (@deva[चतसृ] fem.), are all adjectives and takes the gender, number and case of the nouns they qualify.

---

[^1]: @deva[त्रिचतुरोः स्त्रियां तिसृचतसृ ।] Pāṇ. VII. 2. 99.

rules.title: Declension of @deva[त्रि] and @deva[चतुर्]
rules.body:
@deva[एक] is declined in the sing. (though it may have the dual and plural also), and @deva[द्वि] in the dual alone. For further particulars see @ref[154]. @deva[त्रि] and @deva[चतुर्] are declined in the plu. alone. E. g.

| | Mas. | Fem. | | Mas. | Fem. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | @deva[त्रि] | | | @deva[चतुर्] | |
| N. | @deva[त्रयः] | @deva[तिस्रः] | N. | @deva[चत्वारः] | @deva[चतस्रः] |
| A. | @deva[त्रीन्] | ,, | A. | @deva[चतुरः] | ,, |
| I. | @deva[त्रिभिः] | @deva[तिसृभिः] | I. | @deva[चतुर्भिः] | @deva[चतसृभिः] |
| D. Ab. | @deva[त्रिभ्यः] | @deva[तिसृभ्यः] | D. Ab. | @deva[चतुर्भ्यः] | @deva[चतसृभ्यः] |
| G. | @deva[त्रयाणाम्] | @deva[तिसृणाम्] | G. | @deva[चतुर्णाम्] | @deva[चतसृणाम्] |
| L. | @deva[त्रिषु] | @deva[तिसृषु] | L. | @deva[चतुर्षु] | @deva[चतसृषु] |

neu.

| | @deva[त्रि] | | @deva[चतुर्] |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. A. | @deva[त्रीणि] | N. V. A. | @deva[चत्वारि] |

The rest like the mas.

rules.title: Declension of @deva[पञ्चन्]—@deva[नवदशन्]
rules.body:
@deva[पञ्चन्]—@deva[नवदशन्]. These are also adjectives agreeing in case with the nouns to which they are applied. They are declined in the pl. and are uniform in all the three genders.

| | @deva[पञ्चन्] | @deva[षष्] | @deva[अष्टन्] |
|---|---|---|---|
| N. V. A. | @deva[पञ्च] | @deva[षट्-ड्] | @deva[अष्टन्] |
| I. | @deva[पञ्चभिः] | @deva[षड्भिः] | @deva[अष्टभिः-अष्टाभिः] |
| Dat. & Ab. | @deva[पञ्चभ्यः] | @deva[षड्भ्यः] | @deva[अष्टभ्यः-अष्टाभ्यः] |
| G. | @deva[पञ्चानाम्] | @deva[षण्णाम्] | @deva[अष्टानाम्] |
| L. | @deva[पञ्चसु] | @deva[षट्सु] | @deva[अष्टसु-अष्टासु] |

@deva[सप्तन्], @deva[नवन्] and the following cardinals up to @deva[नवदशन्] ought to be declined like @deva[पञ्चन्].

rules.title: Declension of @deva[विंशति] and Higher Cardinals
rules.body: @deva[ऊनविंशति], @deva[विंशति] and other cardinal numbers up to @deva[नवनवति] are all feminine substantives, the numerals @deva[शत], @deva[सहस्र], &c. are all neuter, with the exception of @deva[लक्ष] which is neu. and fem. @deva[कोटि] which is fem. and @deva[शंकु] and @deva[जलधि] both of which are mas. and have no declensional peculiarities. They are declined in the sing. and so used with a plural noun; e. g. @deva[पंचविंशतिब्राह्मणाः] 25 Brāhmaṇas; @deva[एकादशाधिकशतेन] or @deva[एकादशोत्तरेण शतेन नरैः] or @deva[स्त्रीभिः] by 111 men or women; @deva[एकोनसहस्रेण रूपकैः] with Rs. 999 &c. They may be made to have duals and plurals by being used as fixed standards of counting; e. g. @deva[ब्राह्मणानां विंशतयः] many twenties of Brāhmaṇas; @deva[द्वे शते नारीणाम्] two hundreds of women &c.

rules.title: Declension of Ordinal Numbers
rules.body:
The ordinals are declined regularly except:—

@deva[प्रथम] (see @ref[156]) and @deva[द्वितीय] and @deva[तृतीय] which are optionally declined like pronouns in the Dat. Ab. Gen. and Loc. sing ; e. g. @deva[द्वितीयस्मै-द्वितीयाय], &c. @deva[द्वितीयायाः-द्वितीयस्याः] &c.

rules.title: Numeral Adverbs: Frequency, Distribution, Division
rules.body:
## NUMERAL ADVERBS.

**(a)** @deva[सकृत्] once, @deva[द्विः] twice, @deva[त्रिः] thrice, @deva[चतुः] four times; from @deva[पञ्चन्] onwards adverbs of frequency are formed by adding @deva[कृत्वः] before which final @deva[न्] is dropped e. g. @deva[पञ्चकृत्वः] five times, @deva[सप्तकृत्वः] seven times, &c.

**(b)** @deva[एकधा][^1] or @deva[ऐकध्यम्] in one way or part, @deva[द्विधा] or @deva[द्वेधा] or @deva[द्वैधं] in two ways or parts, @deva[त्रिधा] or @deva[त्रेधा] or @deva[त्रैधम्] in three ways, &c.; @deva[चतुर्धा] in four ways, @deva[षोढा] or @deva[षड्धा] in six ways, @deva[सप्तधा], @deva[अष्टधा], &c.

**(c)** @deva[एकशः] one by one; @deva[द्विशः] two and two, by twos; so @deva[त्रिशः] @deva[शतशः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[संख्याया विधार्थे धा । अधिकरणविचाले च । एकाद्धो ध्यमुञन्यतरस्याम् । द्वित्र्योश्च धमुञ् । एधाच्च] Pāṇ. V. 3. 42-46.

rules.title: Other Derivatives from Numerals
rules.body:
Other derivatives from the numerals:—

**(a)** by the Taddhita affix @deva[क] which is added to numerals ending in @deva[शत्] and @deva[ति] e. g. @deva[पञ्चकः] bought for five (rupees &c.) @deva[चत्वारिंशत्कः] bought for forty; @deva[वैंशतिकः] bought for twenty (coins, &c.)

**(b)**[^1] by means of the Tad. affix @deva[तय] in the sense of "consisting of parts" or "collection"; e. g. @deva[चतुष्टय] (@deva[चतुष्टयी] fem.) consisting of four parts or a collection of four; so @deva[पञ्चतय] (fem. @deva[यी]); @deva[तय] is optionally changed to @deva[अय] after @deva[द्वि] and @deva[त्रि] e. g. @deva[द्वय] or @deva[द्वितय] (@deva[-यी] fem.) twofold, consisting of two parts, or a pair; @deva[त्रय] or @deva[त्रितय] (@deva[-यी] fem.) threefold or consisting of three parts, a collection of three, a triad.

**(c)** by means of @deva[क] and @deva[अत्] e. g. @deva[षट्क] a collection of six, @deva[पञ्चत्] collection of five, @deva[दशत्] a collection of ten, a decade, &c.

---

[^1]: See Chap. IX. Intro. rules.

rules.title: Comparative and Superlative: @deva[तर] and @deva[तम]
rules.body:
# Chapter VI.
# DEGREE OF COMPARISON.

@deva[तर] and @deva[तम] are the most common terminations of the comparative and the superlative degrees respectively.[^1] They are added to that crude form of words which they assume, before the Inst. dual termination; e. g. @deva[अयमेतयोरतिशयेन लघुः लघुतरः], @deva[अयमेषामतिशयेन लघुतमः]; similarly @deva[युवन्],—@deva[युवतर], @deva[युवतम]; @deva[विद्वस्]-@deva[विद्वत्तर], @deva[विद्वत्तम]; @deva[प्राच्]-@deva[प्राक्तर], @deva[प्राक्तम]; @deva[धनिन्]-@deva[धनितर], @deva[धनितम]; @deva[धर्मभुध्]—@deva[धर्मभुत्तर], @deva[धर्मभुत्तम]; @deva[गुरु] - @deva[गुरुतर], @deva[गुरुतम], &c; @deva[अति]-@deva[अतितर] @deva[अतितम]; @deva[उत्]-@deva[उत्तर], @deva[उत्तम], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[अतिशायने तमबिष्ठनौ । द्विवचनविभज्योपपदे तरबीयसुनौ । तिङश्च । तरप्तमपौ घः] Pāṇ. V. 3. 55. 57. 56; I. 1. 22. When atiś'aya or excess of the one thing over many is to be shown @deva[तम] and @deva[इष्ठ] are the affixes used; and when out of two things one is to be separated as possessing some quality in excess @deva[तर] and @deva[ईयस्] are affixed. @deva[तर] and @deva[तम] may also added to verbs.

rules.title: Optional Shortening of @deva[ई] and @deva[ऊ] Before @deva[तर] and @deva[तम]
rules.body: Before these the final @deva[ई] and @deva[ऊ] of a prátipadika are optionally shortened, e. g. @deva[श्रीतरा] or @deva[श्रितरा], @deva[श्रीतमा] or @deva[श्रितमा]; @deva[घेमूतरा] (more lame) or @deva[घेमुतरा], @deva[घेमूतमा], @deva[घेमुतमा], &c.

rules.title: Forms @deva[तराम्] and @deva[तमाम्] with Verbs and Adverbs
Comparative @deva[ईयस्] and Superlative @deva[इष्ठ]
Dropping Possessive Affixes Before @deva[ईयस्] and @deva[इष्ठ]
rules.body:
The possessive affixes at the end of words and the affix @deva[तृ] are dropped before @deva[ईयस्] and @deva[इष्ठ][^1] and then these terminations are applied subject to the above rule; e. g. @deva[मतिमत्] talented @deva[मतीयस्], @deva[मतिष्ठ]; @deva[मेधाविन्]-@deva[मेधीयस्], @deva[मेधिष्ठ]; @deva[धनिन्]-@deva[धनीयस्]-@deva[धनिष्ठ]; @deva[कर्तृ]-@deva[करीयस्], @deva[करिष्ठ] (@deva[अतिशयेन कर्ता]); @deva[स्तोतृ]-@deva[स्तवीयस्], @deva[स्तविष्ठ]; so @deva[स्रजीयस्], @deva[स्रजिष्ठ] from @deva[स्रग्विन्] one having a garland &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[विन्मतोर्लुक् । तुरिष्ठेमेयस्सु ।] Pāṇ. VI. 4, 154.

rules.title: Substitution of @deva[र] for @deva[ऋ] Before @deva[ईयस्] and @deva[इष्ठ]
rules.body:
@deva[र] is substituted for the @deva[ऋ] (short) of a base preceded by a consonant before @deva[ईयस्], @deva[इष्ठ] and the Tad. aff. @deva[इमन्] e. g.[^1]

| | Comp. | Superl. |
|---|---|---|
| @deva[कृश] 'thin' | @deva[क्रशीयस्] | @deva[क्रशिष्ठ] |
| @deva[दृढ] 'strong, firm' | @deva[द्रढीयस्] | @deva[द्रढिष्ठ] |
| @deva[परिवृढ] 'head, chief' | @deva[परिव्रढीयस्] | @deva[परिव्रढिष्ठ] |
| @deva[पृथु] 'broad' | @deva[प्रथीयस्] | @deva[प्रथिष्ठ] |
| @deva[भृश] 'much' | @deva[भ्रशीयस्] | @deva[भ्रशिष्ठ] |
| @deva[मृदु] 'soft' | @deva[म्रदीयस्] | @deva[म्रदिष्ठ] |

---

[^1]: @deva[र ऋतो हलादेर्लघोः ।] Pāṇ. VI. 4. 161.

rules.title: Irregular Comparatives and Superlatives
rules.body:
The following is an alphabetical list of the irregular comparatives and superlatives that are commonly met with:-

| Positive | Comparative | Superlative |
|---|---|---|
| @deva[अन्तिक] 'near'[^1] | @deva[नेदियस्] | @deva[नेदिष्ठ] |
| @deva[अल्प] 'little'[^2] | @deva[अल्पीयस्] | @deva[अल्पिष्ठ] |
| | @deva[कनीयस्] | @deva[कनिष्ठ] |
| @deva[उरु] 'wide'[^3] | @deva[वरीयस्] | @deva[वरिष्ठ] |
| @deva[क्षिप्र] 'quick'[^4] | @deva[क्षेपीयस्] | @deva[क्षेपिष्ठ] |
| @deva[क्षुद्र] 'mean,' 'small' | @deva[क्षोदीयस्] | @deva[क्षोदिष्ठ] |
| @deva[गुरु] 'heavy' | @deva[गरीयस्] | @deva[गरिष्ठ] |
| @deva[तृप्र] 'restless or anxious' } | @deva[त्रपीयस्] | @deva[त्रपिष्ठ] |
|     'satisfied'         } | | |
| @deva[दीर्घ] 'long' | @deva[द्राघीयस्] | @deva[द्राघिष्ठ] |
| @deva[दूर] 'distant' | @deva[दवीयस्] | @deva[दविष्ठ] |
| @deva[प्रशस्य] 'praiseworthy'[^5] | @deva[श्रेयस्] or @deva[ज्यायस्] | @deva[श्रेष्ठ] or @deva[ज्येष्ठ] |
| @deva[प्रिय] 'dear' | @deva[प्रेयस्] | @deva[प्रेष्ठ] |
| @deva[बहु] 'much'[^6] | @deva[भूयस्] | @deva[भूयिष्ठ] |
| @deva[बहुल] ,, | @deva[बंहीयस्] | @deva[बंहिष्ठ] |
| @deva[बाढ] 'firm, well' | @deva[साधीयस्] | @deva[साधिष्ठ] |
| @deva[युवन्] 'young' | @deva[यवीयस्], @deva[कनीयस्] | @deva[यविष्ठ], @deva[कनिष्ठ] |
| @deva[विपुल] 'much' | @deva[ज्यायस्] | @deva[ज्येष्ठ] |
| @deva[वृद्ध] 'old' | @deva[वर्षीयस्], @deva[ज्यायस्] | @deva[वर्षिष्ठ], @deva[ज्येष्ठ] |
| @deva[वृन्दारक] 'great lovely' | @deva[वृन्दीयस्] | @deva[वृन्दिष्ठ] |
| @deva[स्थिर] 'steady' | @deva[स्थेयस्] | @deva[स्थेष्ठ] |
| @deva[स्थूल] 'big, large' | @deva[स्थवीयस्] | @deva[स्थविष्ठ] |
| @deva[स्फिर] 'much' | @deva[स्फेयस्] | @deva[स्फेष्ठ] |
| @deva[ह्रस्व] 'short' | @deva[ह्रसीयस्] | @deva[ह्रसिष्ठ] |

---

[^1]: @deva[अन्तिकबाढयोर्नेदसाधौ ।] Pāṇ. V. 3. 36.

[^2]: @deva[युवाल्पयोः कननन्यतरस्याम् ।] Pāṇ. 3. 64.

[^3]: @deva[प्रियस्थिरस्फिरउरुबहुलगुरुवृद्धतृप्रदीर्घवृन्दारकाणां प्रस्थस्फवर्बंहिगर्वर्षित्रप्द्राघिवृन्दाः ।] Pāṇ. VI. 4. 157. @deva[प्र], @deva[स्थ], @deva[स्फ], @deva[वर्] &c. are substituted for @deva[प्रिय], @deva[स्थिर], @deva[स्फिर], &c. respectively.

[^4]: @deva[स्थूलदूरयुवह्रस्वक्षिप्रक्षुद्राणां यणादिपरं पूर्वस्य च गुणः ।] Pāṇ. VI. 4. 156. The words @deva[स्थूल] &c. drop their final portion beginning with @deva[यण्] (@deva[य्], @deva[र्], @deva[ल्] or @deva[व्]) and the preceding vowel takes guṇa.

[^5]: @deva[प्रशस्यस्य श्रः । ज्य च । वृद्धस्य च ।] Pāṇ. V. 3. 60-62. @deva[बहोर्लोपो भू च बहोः । इष्ठस्य यिट् च ।] Pāṇ. VI. 4. 158-159.

[^6]: See note × p. 112.

rules.title: Intensification with @deva[तर] and @deva[तम]
rules.body: Sometimes the terminations @deva[तर] and @deva[तम] are added to the comp. and super. in @deva[ईयस्] and @deva[इष्ठ] to intensify the meaning; as @deva[पापीयस्तर], @deva[पापीयस्तम]; @deva[श्रेष्ठतर], @deva[श्रेष्ठतम].

rules.title: Vṛitti: The Five Types of Complex Formations
rules.body:
# Chapter VII.
# COMPOUNDS.

Vṛitti (@deva[वृत्ति]) is the general term for any complex formation in Sanskrit requiring explanation or resolution. These Vṛittis are five in number; viz. @deva[कृद्वृत्ति] or the formation of words from roots by primary affixes; @deva[तद्धितवृत्ति] or the formation of derivative bases from nouns by secondary affixes; @deva[धातुवृत्ति] or the formation of derivative verbs from primitive roots; @deva[समासवृत्ति] or the formation of a compound word by the composition of several words; and @deva[एकशेषवृत्ति] or the composition of words in which one of several nouns generally alike in form is retained. The first three will be treated in their proper places. We will treat of the last two in this Chapter.

rules.title: Samāsas: Compound Words
rules.body:
In Sanskrit simple words, whether substantives, adjectives, verbs or indeclinables, have the power of entering into combination with one another and forming what are called 'Samāsas'[^1], compound words or, in short, compounds.

**(a)** A compound thus formed may further be compounded with another simple or compound word, and this again may become the member of a new compound.

---

[^1]: From @deva[अस्] with @deva[सम्] to throw together.

rules.title: General Rules for Compound Formation
rules.body: In a compound, as a general rule, words are simply joined together, without any relation between the component parts being actually expressed; the whole compound word has the power to express the various relations that exist between the several parts. The last word only takes the case termination required by its grammatical position in a sentence, the remaining words (those ending in a consonant) generally assuming their crude forms before the consonantal case terminations; e. g. @deva[विद्वस्] + @deva[जनः] = @deva[विद्वज्जनः] (see below), @deva[राजन्] + @deva[पुरुषः] = @deva[राजपुरुषः], &c.

rules.title: Sandhi Rules in Compounds
rules.body: Final vowels or consonants (modified as mentioned above) of preceding members of compounds combine with the initial letters of the succeeding members according to the usual rules of Sandhi.

rules.title: Aluk Compounds: Retention of Case Endings
rules.body: In a few cases, the intermediate members retain their case endings in which case the compounds are called 'Aluk' (@deva[अलुक्]); e. g. @deva[देवानांप्रियः] a fool, @deva[युधिष्ठिरः] name of the eldest Pāṇḍava &c.

rules.title: Vigrahavākya: Expounding Compounds
rules.body:
The expounding of a Samāsa (i. e. giving its Vigrahavākya) consists in the expression of the various relations existing between the objects or ideas denoted by the various members of a Samāsa by means of the proper cases or subordinate sentences.

**(a)** When the Vigrahavākya cannot be given, or cannot be given by using the words actually compounded, the compound is called nityasamāsa (@deva[अविग्रहो नित्यसमासः अस्वपदविग्रहो वा ।] Sid. Kau.).

rules.title: Four Principal Classes of Compounds
rules.body:
Compounds are divided into four principal classes:[^1]—(1) Dwandwa or Copulative, (2) Tatpurusha or Determinative, (3) Bahuvrīhi or Attributive, and (4) Avyayībhāva or Adverbial.

**N. B.** These names themselves mean nothing i. e. they do not denote any of the characteristics of the different compounds. They are simply proper names distinguishing the various classes from one another (to which they vaguely refer if they do so at all).

---

[^1]: This is true only generally speaking. For there is a fifth class of compounds, viz. @deva[सह सुपा]-compounds not governed by any of the rules given under the four classes but explained on the general principle that any *subanta pada* may be compounded with any other *subanta pada*. According to some there are six kinds of compounds, viz. @deva[सुपां सुपा तिङा नाम्ना धातुनाथ तिङा तिङा । सुबन्तेनेति विज्ञेयः समासः षड्विधो बुधैः ॥] e. g. @deva[सुपां सुपा राजपुरुषः । तिङा पर्यभूषत् । नाम्ना कुम्भकारः । धातुना कटप्रूः, अजस्रम् । तिङा तिङा पिबतखादता, खादतमोदता । तिङा सुपा कृन्तविचक्षणेति यस्यां क्रियायां सा कृन्तविचक्षणा । एहीडादयोन्यपदार्थे इति मयूरव्यंसकादौ पाठात्समासः ।] Sid Kau.

rules.title: Dwandwa Compound: Definition and Three Species
rules.body:
## DWANDWA OR THE COPULATIVE COMPOUNDS.

A Dwandwa compound consists of two or more nouns which, if not compounded, would be connected by the copulative particle @deva[च] (and),[^1] as @deva[रामकृष्णौ] which is equal to @deva[रामः च कृष्णः च]; @deva[पाणिपादं] which is the same as @deva[पाणी च पादौ च]. There are three species of the Dwandwa; viz. @deva[इतरेतरद्वन्द्व], @deva[समाहारद्वन्द्व] and @deva[एकशेष].[^2]

---

[^1]: @deva[चार्थे द्वन्द्वः ।] Pāṇ. II. 2. 22.

[^2]: The Ekasesha is not strictly speaking a subdivision of Dwandwa. It is a separate Vṛitti by itself (Vide @ref[179]). Sanskrit grammarians do not regard it as a Dwandwa, though it may be so regarded for the sake of convenience. 'It is not a Dwandwa,' remarks Bhattoji Dikshita, 'as it does not contain more than one subanta (@deva[अनेकसुबन्ताभावाद्द्वन्द्वः]).' It should be further remembered that since it is not a samāsa, its final vowel does not become udātta, as in the case of a Dwandwa compound.

rules.title: Itaretara Dwandwa: Separate Members
rules.body:
When the several members of a Dwandwa compound are viewed separately, it is called Itaretara Dwandwa, e. g. @deva[धवखदिरौ छिन्धि], 'cut down the Dhava and the Khadira trees' In this species each member is of equal importance i. e. has its own independent meaning. It takes the dual or the plural according as the objects denoted by it are two or more in number; the gender of the final noun is the gender of the whole;[^1] as @deva[कुक्कुटश्च] a cock @deva[मयूरी] a pea-hen @deva[च कुक्कुटमयूर्यौ इमे] (fem. dual of @deva[इदम्]); but @deva[मयूरी च कुक्कुटश्च मयूरीकुक्कुटौ इमौ]; @deva[रामश्च लक्ष्मणश्च भरतश्च शत्रुघ्नश्च रामलक्ष्मणभरतशत्रुघ्नाः] &c.

**Exceptions**—@deva[अश्वश्च वडवा च अश्ववडवौ] (mas. dual) a horse and a mare; @deva[अहश्च रात्रिश्च अहोरात्रः] (mas. sing. day and night).

---

[^1]: @deva[परवल्लिङ्गं द्वन्द्वतत्पुरुषयोः ।] Pāṇ. II. 4. 26.

rules.title: Samāhāra Dwandwa: Aggregate Meaning
rules.body: Samāhāra Dwandwa is that species of Dwandwa which implies an aggregate or the things enumerated in which constitute a complex idea. It is always singular and neuter. Thus @deva[आहारनिद्राभयम्] does not merely mean 'food, sleep and fear' but all that characterises animal life. In this species the meaning of the different members is subordinate to the collective sense of the whole compound.

rules.title: Obligatory Samāhāra Dwandwa Cases
rules.body:
[^1]A Dwandwa compound of words denoting limbs of the body of an animal, players on musical instruments, parts of an army, inanimate objects (things or @deva[द्रव्य]s and not qualities) names of rivers differing in gender, as also of countries (and not villages), and insects, and animals between which there is natural antipathy, is always of this nature; @deva[पाणी च पादौ च पाणिपादम्] hands and feet; @deva[रथिकाश्च अश्वारोहाश्च रथिकाश्वारोहम्] chariot-warriors and horse-men @deva[मार्दंगिकाश्च पाणविकाश्च मार्दंगिकपाणविकम्] players on mridanga and panava (kinds of tabors); @deva[धानाश्च] fried barley or rice @deva[शष्कुल्यश्च] a kind of sweetmeat @deva[धानाशष्कुलि]; but @deva[रूपं च रसश्च रूपरसौ] form and flavour, as these denote qualities; @deva[गंगा च शोणश्च गंगाशोणम्] the rivers Ganges and Sona; but @deva[गंगायमुने] as these do not differ in gender; @deva[कुरवश्च कुरुक्षेत्रं च कुरुकुरुक्षेत्रम्] names of countries; but @deva[जाम्बवशालूकिन्यौ] (two villages of that name); @deva[मद्राश्च केकयाश्च मद्रकेकयः] (two names of the same gender); @deva[यूका] a louse @deva[च लिक्षा] a nit @deva[च यूकालिक्षम्]; @deva[अहिश्च नकुलश्च अहिनकुलम्] a snake and an ichneumon, &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[द्वन्द्वश्च प्राणितूर्यसेनाङ्गानाम् ।] Pāṇ. II. 4. 2, @deva[जातिरप्राणिनाम्] Pāṇ. II. 4. 6.; @deva[विशिष्टलिङ्गो नदीदेशोऽग्रामाः ।] Pāṇ. II. 4. 7., @deva[क्षुद्रजन्तवः] Pāṇ. II. 4. 8. @deva[येषां च विरोधः शाश्वतिकः] Pāṇ. II. 4. 9.

rules.title: Optional Samāhāra Dwandwa Cases
rules.body:
Names of trees, deer, grass, corn, condiments, beasts, birds, the pairs of words—@deva[अश्व] and @deva[वडव], @deva[पूर्व] and @deva[अपर], @deva[उत्तर] and @deva[अधर]—and words of opposite import not qualifying things (@deva[द्रव्य]s), are optionally compounded into a Samāhāra Dwandwa;[^1] instances in order—@deva[प्लक्षाश्च न्यग्रोधाश्च प्लक्षन्यग्रोधम्-धाः]; similarly @deva[रुरुपृषतम्-ताः] (kinds of deer), @deva[कुशकाशम्-शाः] kinds of grass, @deva[व्रीहियवम्-वाः] kinds of corn, @deva[दधिघृतं-ते], @deva[गोमहिषम्-षाः], @deva[शुकबकं-काः], @deva[अश्ववडवं-वौ], @deva[पूर्वापरं-रे], @deva[अधरोत्तरं-रे]; but @deva[शीतोष्णे जले].

---

[^1]: @deva[विभाषा वृक्षमृगतृणधान्यव्यञ्जनपशुशकुन्यश्ववडवपूर्वापराधोत्तराणाम् । विप्रतिषिद्धं चानधिकरणवाचि ।] Pāṇ. II. 4. 12, 13.

rules.title: Samāhāra Dwandwa for Fruits, Army Parts, etc.
rules.body:
The names of fruits, parts of an army, herbs, deer, birds, insects, corn and grass form a Samāhāra-Dwandwa, only when they are taken in the plural;[^1] as @deva[बदराणि च आमलकानि च बदरामलकम्], but @deva[बदरं च आमलकं च बदरामलके]; @deva[रथिकश्च अश्वारोहश्च रथिकाश्वारोहौ], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[फलसेनावनस्पतिमृगशकुनिक्षुद्रजन्तुधान्यतृणानां बहुप्रकृतिरेव द्वंद्व एकवदिति वाच्यम् ।] Vārtika.

rules.title: Irregular Dwandwa Compounds
rules.body:
The following compounds are always what they are laid down to be ( though they do not conform to the proper rules ); viz.

**(a)** Samāhāra Dwandwas:—@deva[गावश्च अश्वाश्च गवाश्वम्]; @deva[पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च पुत्रपौत्रम्]; so @deva[स्त्रीकुमारम्], @deva[उष्ट्रखरम्] camels and asses, @deva[उष्ट्रशशम्] camels and rabbits, @deva[मांसशोणितम्], @deva[दर्भशरम्] holy grass and reeds, @deva[तृणोलपम्] grass and soft grass or shrubs, @deva[दासीदासम्] &c.

**(b)** Itaretara Dwandwas:—@deva[दधिपयसी] curds and milk, @deva[इध्माबर्हिषी] holy sticks and grass, @deva[सर्पिर्मधुनी], @deva[मधुसर्पिषी] honey and ghee, @deva[शुक्लकृष्णौ], @deva[अध्ययनतपसी], @deva[आद्यवसाने], @deva[उलूखलमुसले], @deva[ऋक्सामे] (@deva[ऋक्+सामन्]) Rik and the Sāman verses, @deva[वाङ्मनसे] (@deva[वाक्+मनस्]) speech and mind (the @deva[न्] of @deva[सामन्] dropped and @deva[अ] added to @deva[मनस्] irregularly by Pān. V. 4. 77).

rules.title: @deva[ऋ] → @deva[आ] in Dwandwa with Relationships
rules.body:
When words ending in @deva[ऋ] and implying relationship by blood or literary avocation are compounded together, the last but one word changes its @deva[ऋ] to @deva[आ]. The same happens when the word @deva[पुत्र] follows a word ending in @deva[ऋ] under the same circumstances;[^1] @deva[होता च पोता च होतापोतारौ] two priests so called, @deva[होता च पोता च नेष्टा च उद्गाता च होतृपोतृनेष्टोद्गातारः], (but if two words be taken at a time the @deva[ऋ] may, at every step, be changed into @deva[आ]; as @deva[होता च पोता च होतापोतारौ तौ च उद्गाता च होतापोतोद्गारः] &c.); @deva[पिता च पुत्रश्च पितापुत्रौ], @deva[माता च पिता च मातापितरौ], also @deva[मातरपितरौ] (Pān. VI. 3. 32.), and @deva[पितरौ] (vide @ref[197] a).

---

[^1]: @deva[आनङ् ऋतो द्वन्द्वे ।] Pān. VI. 3. 25. @deva[द्वयोर्द्वयोर्द्वंद्वं कृत्वा पुनर्द्वंद्वे तु होतापोतोद्गातारः ।] Sid. Kau.

rules.title: Vowel Changes in Deity Names
rules.body:
**(a)** When the names of deities well known to be in constant association with each other are compounded, @deva[आ] is substituted for the final vowel of the preceding word, except in the case of the word @deva[वायु];[^1] e.g. @deva[मित्रावरुणौ], @deva[सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ], @deva[अग्नामरुतौ], &c. but @deva[अग्निवायू] or @deva[वाय्वग्नी].

**(b)** The word @deva[अग्नि] followed by the word @deva[सोम] or @deva[वरुण] lengthens its @deva[इ]; as @deva[अग्नीषोमौ], @deva[अग्नीवरुणौ].

---

[^1]: @deva[देवताद्वंद्वे च ।] Pān. VI. 3. 26. @deva[वायुशब्दप्रयोगे प्रतिषेधः ।] Vārt. @deva[ईदग्नेः सोमवरुणयोः ।] Pān. VI. 3. 27.

rules.title: Adding @deva[अ] to Samāhāra Dwandwa Endings
rules.body:
When a Samāhāra-Dwandwa ends in a consonant of the palatal class or @deva[द्], @deva[ष्] or @deva[ह्], @deva[अ] is added to it;[^1] @deva[वाक् च त्वक् च वाक्त्वचम्] speech and skin, @deva[त्वक्स्रजम्] a bark and a garland, @deva[शमीदृषदम्], @deva[वाक्त्विषम्], @deva[छत्रोपानहम्] an umbrella and shoes, &c, But @deva[प्रावृट्शरदौ] ( as it is not a Sam. Dwa. ).

---

[^1]: @deva[द्वन्द्वाच्चुदषहान्तात्समाहारे ।] Pāṇ. V. 4. 106.

rules.title: Irregular Dwandwa Compounds
rules.body:
The following compounds are instances of irregular Dwandwas:—

**(a)** @deva[द्यौश्च पृथिवी च द्यावापृथिव्यौ] or @deva[दिवस्पृथिव्यौ][^1] heaven and earth; so @deva[द्यावाभूमी], @deva[द्यावाक्षमे]; @deva[उषस् + सूर्य = उषासासूर्यौ] the goddess of dawn and the sun.

**(b)** @deva[जाया + पति = दम्पती],[^2] @deva[जम्पती] and @deva[जायापती] husband and wife.

**(c)** [^3]@deva[स्त्री च पुमांश्च स्त्रीपुंसौ], @deva[धेनुश्च अनड्वांश्च धेन्वनडुहौ], @deva[अक्षिणी च भ्रुवौ च अक्षिभ्रुवम्], @deva[दाराश्च गावश्च दारगवम्], @deva[ऊरू च अष्ठीवन्तौ च ऊर्वष्ठीवम्] (thighs and knees), @deva[पादौ च अष्ठीवन्तौ च पदष्ठीवम्]; @deva[नक्तं च दिवा च नक्तंदिवम्], @deva[रात्रौ च दिवा च रात्रिन्दिवम्], @deva[अहनि च दिवा च अहर्दिवम्], all meaning 'day and night'.

---

[^1]: @deva[दिवो द्यावा । दिवसश्च पृथिव्याम् ।] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 29, 30.

[^2]: @deva[दम्पती] is considered by some to be a word of regular formation. @deva[दम्] in the Vedic literature means 'a house' and @deva[पति] 'a master'. Hence the full word @deva[दम्पती] would mean 'the mistress of the house.'

[^3]: A final @deva[अ] is added in the case of these compounds according to a Sūtra of Pāṇ. (@deva[अचतुर] V. 4. 77.) quoted further on under @ref[284].

rules.title: Ekaśeṣa-Dwandwa: Retention of One Word
rules.body:
When several words of the same form ( or dissimilar in form but of the same import[^1] ) are compounded together, only one of them is retained with the necessary number—e. g. @deva[रामश्च रामश्च रामौ], @deva[रामश्च रामश्च रामश्च रामाः ।] This is called @deva[एकशेषद्वन्द्वः]. In the case of the mas. and fem. genders the one of the mas. gender is retained;[^2] as @deva[हंसी च हंसश्च हंसौ]; similarly @deva[ब्राह्मणौ], @deva[शूद्रौ], @deva[अजौ], &c.

**(a)** This principle is further extended to some words dissimilar in form, as in the following examples:—@deva[भ्राता च स्वसा च भ्रातरौ]; @deva[पुत्रश्च दुहिता च पुत्रौ];[^3] @deva[माता च पिता च पितरौ] (see also @ref[193]), @deva[श्वश्रूश्च श्वशुरश्च श्वशुरौ][^4] (also @deva[श्वश्रूश्वशुरौ]); @deva[स च सा च तौ], @deva[स च देवदत्तश्च तौ], @deva[स च यश्च यौ] or @deva[तौ].[^5] In the case of words of the mas. fem and neu. gender that of the neu. gender is retained; as @deva[तच्च देवदत्तश्च ते]; @deva[तच्च देवदत्तश्च यज्ञदत्ता च तानि ।]

---

[^1]: @deva[विरूपाणामपि समानार्थानाम् ।] Vārt. @deva[वक्रदण्डश्च कुटिलदण्डश्च वक्रदण्डौ] or @deva[कुटिलदण्डौ ।]

[^2]: @deva[पुमान् स्त्रिया ।] Pāṇ. 1. 2. 67.

[^3]: @deva[मातृपुत्रौ स्वसृदुहितृभ्याम् । पिता मात्रा ।] Pāṇ. 2. 68, 70.

[^4]: @deva[श्वशुरः श्वश्र्वा । त्यदादीनि सर्वैर्नित्यम् ।] Pāṇ. 1. 2. 71. 72.

[^5]: @deva[पूर्वशेषोपि दृश्यते इति भाष्यम् ।] Sid. Kau. on Pāṇ. 1. 2. 72.

rules.title: Order of Members in Dwandwa Compounds
rules.body:
The following rules should be observed in arranging the various members of a Dwandwa Compound:—

**(a)**[^1] A word ending in @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] should be placed first, and when there are more than one of such words one of these should be placed first, the rest being arranged according to the will of the speaker or writer; @deva[हरिहरौ], @deva[हरिहरगुरवः], @deva[हरिगुरुहराः], &c.

**(b)**[^2] Words beginning with a vowel and ending in @deva[अ] ought to precede others; as @deva[अश्वरथेंद्राः] or @deva[इंद्राश्वरथाः]. This rule should have preference even over the above rule in case both would be simultaneously applicable; @deva[इंद्राग्नी].
