**(b)** @deva[पाद] becomes @deva[पद्] and the comp. takes @deva[ई] in the *fem.* in the case of the words @deva[कुम्भपदी], and others (i. e. @deva[कुम्भपदी], @deva[एकपदी], @deva[जालपदी], @deva[सूत्रपदी], @deva[शतपदी], @deva[विपदी], @deva[द्विपदी], @deva[त्रिपदी], @deva[दासीपदी], @deva[विष्णुपदी], @deva[सुपदी], &c.;)[^2] but @deva[कुम्भपादः] *mas.*

**(c)**[^3] @deva[दन्त] necessarily when it is preceded by a numeral or @deva[सु] indicating age, or when the whole compound forms a feminine name; and optionally when it is preceded by @deva[श्याव], @deva[अरोक], a word ending in @deva[अम], @deva[शुद्ध], @deva[शुभ्र], @deva[वृष], or @deva[वराह]; @deva[द्वौ दन्तौ यस्य स द्विदन्] 'a child so small as to have two teeth only,' @deva[षड् दन्ता अस्य][^4] @deva[षोडन्]; @deva[शोभना दन्ता अस्य सुदन्], @deva[सुदती] (i. e. youthful) *fem.*; but @deva[द्विदन्तः करी], @deva[सुदन्तः] (having beautiful teeth) @deva[पुरुषः], @deva[अयोदती], @deva[फलदती] (both proper names,) &c. but @deva[समदन्ती] having even rows of teeth; @deva[श्यावा] (black) @deva[दन्ता यस्य स शावदन्-न्तः], @deva[अरोकदन्-दन्तः] having black or thick-set teeth; @deva[कुमडलाग्रदन्-न्तः], having teeth like the points of buds, @deva[शुभ्रदन्-न्तः] &c.

**(d)**[^5] @deva[ककुद्] 'when the compound denotes a particular stage of growth;' @deva[अजातं ककुदं यस्य सः अजातककुद्] 'a bull that has not got his hump as yet' i. e. 'who is very young'; also when it is preceded by @deva[त्रि] and the compound designates the mountain of that name; as @deva[त्रिककुद्] 'name of a mountain with three peaks'; but @deva[त्रिककुदः] 'having three humps'.

**(e)**[^6] @deva[काकुद] 'the palate' (@deva[काकुदं तालु] Kās.) necessarily when preceded by @deva[उत्] and @deva[वि] and optionally when preceded by @deva[पूर्ण]; as @deva[उत्काकुद], @deva[विकाकुद]; @deva[पूर्णकाकुद-कुदः].

---

[^1]: @deva[पादस्य लोपोऽहस्त्यादिभ्यः । संख्यासुपूर्वस्य ।] Pāṇ. V. 4. 138. 140.

[^2]: @deva[कुम्भपदीषु च ।] Pāṇ. V. 4. 139.

[^3]: @deva[वयसि दन्तस्य दतृ । स्त्रियां संज्ञायाम् । विभाषा श्यावारोकाभ्याम् । अमान्तशुद्धशुभ्रवृषवराहेभ्यश्च ।] Pāṇ. V. 4. 141. 143-145.

[^4]: See Foot-note p. 102.

[^5]: @deva[ककुदस्यावस्थायां लोपः । त्रिककुत्पर्वते ।] Pāṇ. V. 4. 146, 147.

[^6]: @deva[उद्विभ्यां काकुदस्य । पूर्णाद्विभाषा ।] Pāṇ. V. 4. 148, 149.

rules.title: Transformation of @deva[हृदय]
Combat Compounds with Vowel Changes
rules.body:
Two nouns[^1] alike in form in the Loc. and meaning 'something that can be seized,' or in the Instrumental, meaning 'weapons or things used as weapons,' may be compounded in a Bah. when the sense is 'the fight thus began' and the idea of an exchange of action is to be implied. In such compounds the final vowel of the first member is lengthened and that of the second is changed to @deva[इ]. The compounds so formed are of the nature of Avyayībhāvas and are indeclinable. The final @deva[उ] takes Guṇa substitute before the final @deva[इ].[^2] e. g. @deva[केशेषु केशेषु गृहीत्वेदं युद्धं प्रवृत्तं केशाकेशि] 'a battle in which the warriors fight seizing each other's hair'; @deva[दण्डैश्च दण्डैश्च प्रहृत्येदं युद्धं प्रवृत्तं दण्डादण्डि]; similarly @deva[मुष्टीमुष्टि], @deva[हस्ताहस्ति], @deva[बाहूबाहवि], @deva[मुसलामुसलि], &c.; but if the instruments used by both the parties be not the same, no compound is possible; @deva[हलामुसलि] will, therefore, be wrong.

**Obs.**—**(a)** The following words also change their final to @deva[इ]; @deva[द्वौ दण्डौ यस्मिन्प्रहरणे तद् द्विदण्डि]; similarly @deva[द्विमुसलि], @deva[उभा-उभयाञ्जलि], @deva[उभाहस्ति], @deva[उभयहस्ति], @deva[उभा-उभया-पाणि], @deva[०बाहु] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[तत्र तेनेदमिति सरूपे ।] Pāṇ. II. 2. 27. @deva[सप्तम्यन्ते ग्रहणविषये सरूपे पदे तृतीयान्ते च प्रहरणविषये इदं युद्धं प्रवृत्तमित्यर्थे समस्येते कर्मव्यतिहारे द्योत्ये स बहुव्रीहिः ।] Sid. Kau.

[^2]: @deva[अन्येषामपि दृश्यते । इच् कर्मव्यतिहारे ।] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 137. V. 4. 127. @deva[तिष्ठद्गुप्रभृतिष्विच्प्रत्ययस्य पाठादव्ययीभावत्वमव्ययत्वं च ।] Sid. Kau. @deva[ओर्गुणः ।] Pāṇ. VI. 4. 146.

rules.title: Irregular Bahuvrīhi Forms
rules.body:
The following Bahuvrīhis are laid down as irregular.[^1] @deva[शोभनं प्रातरस्य सुप्रातः] *m.* 'one having an auspicious morning or a day having an auspicious dawn'; see Bhaṭṭi. II. 49. @deva[शोभनं श्वः अस्य सुश्वः] 'having an auspicious morrow;' @deva[शोभनं दिवास्य सुदिवः] 'one who has passed a happy day', @deva[शारेरिव कुक्षिरस्य शारिकुक्षः] 'having a round belly;' @deva[चतस्रोऽश्रयोऽस्य चतुरश्रः] 'four-cornered, quadrangular;' @deva[एण्या] (of a female black deer) @deva[इव पादौ अस्य एणीपदः], @deva[अजपदः], @deva[प्रोष्ठस्य इव पादौ अस्य प्रोष्ठपदः] having the feet like those of a bull'.

---

[^1]: @deva[सुप्रातसुश्वसुदिवशारिकुक्षचतुरश्रैणीपदाजपदप्रोष्ठपदाः ।] Pāṇ. V. 4. 120.

rules.title: Addition of @deva[क] to Specific Words in Bahuvrīhi
rules.body:
The words @deva[उरस्], @deva[सर्पिस्], @deva[उपानह्], @deva[दाधि], @deva[मधु], @deva[शालि-ली] and @deva[पुंस्], @deva[अनडुह्], @deva[पयस्], @deva[नौ] and @deva[लक्ष्मी] when used in the singular, have a @deva[क] added to them, when they form the latter member of a Bah. comp.;[^1] @deva[व्यूढं] (expanded, well-developed) @deva[उरः यस्य व्यूढोरस्कः], @deva[प्रियसर्पिष्कः] 'one fond of ghee', &c. @deva[एकः पुमान् यस्य असौ एकपुंस्कः] 'having one man only', &c.; when @deva[पुंस्] and the words following it are used in the dual and the plural they take @deva[क] optionally. @deva[द्विपुमान्] or @deva[द्विपुंस्कः] &c.

**(a)**[^2] @deva[अर्थ] takes the final @deva[क], necessarily when preceded by @deva[अन्] and optionally in any other case; @deva[अनर्थकः] 'useless'; but @deva[अपार्थ-र्थकं] 'meaningless' @deva[वचः].

---

[^1]: @deva[उरःप्रभृतिभ्यः कप् ।] Pāṇ. V. 4. 151. @deva[इह पुमान्, अनड्वान्, पयः, नौः, लक्ष्मीरिति एकवचनान्तानि पठ्यन्ते । द्विवचनान्तेभ्यस्तु 'शेषाद्विभाषा' इति विकल्पेन कप् ।] Sid. Kau.

[^2]: @deva[अर्थान्नञः ।] Vārtika.

rules.title: @deva[क] for Feminine Bahuvrīhi Ending in @deva[इन्]
rules.body:
A *fem.* Bah. ending in @deva[इन्] takes this @deva[क] necessarily;[^1] as @deva[बहुदाण्डिका नगरी] 'a city having many ascetics'; @deva[बहुवाग्मिका सभा] 'an assembly having many eloquent speakers in it'; but @deva[बहुदण्डी] or @deva[बहुदाण्डिको ग्रामः] (vide @ref[263] below), as it is *mas.*

---

[^1]: @deva[इनः स्त्रियाम् ।] Pāṇ. V. 4. 152.

rules.title: General Optional @deva[क] for Bahuvrīhi
rules.body:
And as a general rule, when the final word of a Bah. comp. does not undergo any additions or alterations mentioned in the foregoing rules, it optionally takes the affix @deva[क].[^1] @deva[महायशस्कः]-@deva[महायशाः] 'of mighty glory'; but @deva[उत्तरपूर्वा], @deva[व्याघ्रपात्], @deva[सुगन्धिः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[शेषाद्विभाषा ।] Pāṇ. V. 4. 154.

rules.title: Mandatory @deva[क] for Certain Feminine Endings
rules.body: But if the last word of a Bah. compound be a *fem.* noun ending in @deva[ई] or @deva[ऊ] not capable of being changed into @deva[इय्] or @deva[उव्] before the vowel case termination, or if it ends in @deva[ऋ], @deva[क] is necessarily affixed; @deva[ईश्वरः कर्ता यस्य तद् ईश्वरकर्तृकं जगत्], @deva[बहुनदीको देशः], @deva[रूपवती वधूः यस्य स रूपवद्वधूकः], &c.; but @deva[सुधीः स्त्री] is an exception; @deva[बहुस्त्रीकः], @deva[सस्त्रीकः] &c.

rules.title: Shortening @deva[आ] before @deva[क]
rules.body:
The final @deva[आ] is optionally shortened before @deva[क];[^1] as @deva[बहुमालः]-@deva[मालाकः]-@deva[मालकः], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[आपोऽन्यतरस्याम् ।] Pāṇ. VII. 4. 15.

rules.title: Exceptions Where @deva[क] Is Not Affixed
rules.body:
No @deva[क] is affixed[^1]

**(a)** when the whole compound is used as a name or when it ends in @deva[ईयस्], as @deva[विश्वे देवा यस्य विश्वदेवः] 'whose deities are the Viswadevas'; @deva[बहवः श्रेयांसः यस्य बहुश्रेयान्]. A Bah. ending in @deva[ईयस्] *f.* (i. e. @deva[ईयसी][^2]) does not shorten its final vowel; e. g. @deva[बह्व्यः श्रेयस्यो यस्य बहुश्रेयसीः] 'one having many excellent wives.' But @deva[अतिश्रेयसिः] as a Tatpurusha.

**(b)** to the word @deva[भ्रातृ] preceded by a term of praise; @deva[प्रशस्तो भ्राता यस्य स प्रशस्तभ्राता]; but @deva[मूर्खभ्रातृकः] one whose brother is a fool.

**(c)** to the words @deva[नाडि] and @deva[तन्त्री] both referring to the body of an animal; @deva[बहुनाडिः कायः] 'the body having many arteries'; @deva[बहुतन्त्रीग्रीवा] 'the many-veined neck'; but @deva[बहुनाडीकः स्तम्भः] 'a pillar with many ornamental lines'; @deva[बहुतन्त्रीका] (many-stringed) @deva[वीणा].

**(d)** to the final of the compound @deva[निष्प्रवाणिः] (@deva[निर्गता प्रवाणी] 'a weaver's shuttle' @deva[यस्य]) @deva[पटः] 'a new, unbleached garment.'

**(e)** to compounds formed according to rules @ref[251], @ref[252], and @ref[253]; as @deva[सपुत्रः], @deva[उपबहवः], @deva[दक्षिणपूर्वा], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[न संज्ञायाम् । ईयसश्च । वन्दिते भ्रातुः । नाडीतन्त्र्योः स्वाङ्गे । निष्प्रवाणिश्च ।] Pāṇ. V. 4. 155-57, 159-60.

[^2]: @deva[ईयसो बहुव्रीहेर्नेति वाच्यम् ।]

rules.title: Masculine Restoration in @deva[समानाधिकरण] Bahuvrīhi
rules.body:
In the formation of a @deva[समानाधिकरणबहुव्रीहि], if the first member be a *fem.* noun derived from the *mas.* the affix @deva[आ] or @deva[ई], the *mas.* is restored if followed by another *fem.* noun;[^1] @deva[चित्रा गावः यस्य स चित्रगुः], @deva[जरती गौः यस्य स जरद्गुः], @deva[रूपवती भार्या यस्य स रूपवद्भार्यः]; but @deva[गंगा भार्या यस्य स गंगाभार्यः]; @deva[वामोरूभार्यः]; @deva[कल्याणी प्रधानं यस्य स कल्याणीप्रधानः ।]

**Exception:**—**(a)** This change in the first member does not take place, when it is followed by an ordinal (*fem.*) or any of the words @deva[प्रिया], @deva[मनोज्ञा], @deva[कल्याणी], @deva[सुभगा], @deva[भक्ति], @deva[सचिवा], @deva[स्वसा], @deva[कान्ता], @deva[क्षान्ता], @deva[समा], @deva[चपला], @deva[दुहिता], @deva[वामा], @deva[अबला] and @deva[तनया]; as @deva[कल्याणी प्रिया यस्य स कल्याणीप्रियः] 'one to whom a virtuous woman is dear.' @deva[दृढा भक्तिर्यस्य स दृढाभक्तिः], but @deva[दृढं भक्तिर्यस्य दृढभक्तिः][^2]

**(b)** If the first member be a proper name, an ordinal number, name of a limb of the body of an animal ending @deva[ई], name of a class, or a word having a penultimate @deva[क] in a few cases, it does not undergo this change; @deva[दत्ता] (a proper name) @deva[भार्या यस्य स दत्ताभार्यः], @deva[पञ्चमीभार्यः], @deva[सुकेशीभार्यः], @deva[शूद्राभार्यः], @deva[रसिकाभार्यः], @deva[पाचिकाभार्यः], &c.; but @deva[अकेशा भार्या यस्य स अकेशभार्यः] as the first word does not end in @deva[ई]; @deva[पाका भार्या यस्य स पाकभार्यः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[स्त्रियाः पुंवद्भाषितपुंस्कादनूङ् समानाधिकरणे स्त्रियामपूरणीप्रियादिषु ।] Pāṇ. VI. 3. 34.

[^2]: @deva[स्त्रीत्वविवक्षायां तु दृढाभक्तिः ।] Sid. Kau. @deva[लिङ्गविशेषविवक्षायां तु दृढाभक्तिरित्यादि-सिद्धये प्रियादिषु भक्तिशब्दपाठः ।] Tb.

rules.title: Definition of Avyayībhāva
rules.body:
## IV. AVYAYĪBHĀ'VA OR THE ADVERBIAL COMPOUNDS.

An Avyayībhāva comp. consists of two members the first of which is, in most cases, an indeclinable ( a preposition or an adverb ) and the second a noun, the whole being treated like the Nom. sing. of *neu*. nouns. the comp so formed is indeclinable; *e. g.* @deva[अधिहरि] 'in Hari'; @deva[अन्तर्गिरि] 'in a mountain,' &c.

rules.title: Formation Rules for Avyayībhāva
rules.body:
In forming the Avyayībhāva compounds the following rules should be observed:—

**(a)** The final long vowel is shortened, and the ending @deva[ए] or @deva[ऐ] is changed to @deva[इ] and @deva[ओ] to @deva[उ]; @deva[गोपायति गाः पातीति वा गोपाः] । @deva[तस्मिन्निति अधिगोपम्], @deva[अनुविष्णु] after Vishnu, @deva[उपगु] near a cow, &c.

**(b)** The final @deva[न्] of *mas.* and *fem.* nouns in @deva[अन्] is dropped; and optionally that of *neuter* nouns ending in @deva[अन्];[^1] @deva[उपराजम्]; @deva[उपचर्मम्-र्म].

**(c)** @deva[अ] is optionally substituted for the final of @deva[नदी], @deva[पौर्णमासी], @deva[आग्रहायणी] and @deva[गिरि];[^2] @deva[उपनदम्-दि], @deva[उपपौर्णमासम्-सि], @deva[उपाग्रहायणम्-णि] 'near to the full-moon day of Mārgas'irsha'; @deva[उपगिरम्-रि].

**(d)** It is also optionally added to all nouns ending in any of the first four letters of a class;[^3] @deva[उपसमिधम्-मित्].

**(e)** @deva[अ] is attached to the final of the following nouns when compounded in an Avyaya.[^4]:—@deva[शरद्], @deva[विपाश्], @deva[अनस्], @deva[मनस्], @deva[उपानह्], @deva[अनडुह्], @deva[दिव्], @deva[हिमवत्], @deva[दिश्], @deva[दृश्], @deva[विश्], @deva[चेतस्], @deva[चतुर्], @deva[तद्], @deva[यद्], @deva[कियत्], @deva[जरस्] ( substituted for @deva[जरा] ) &c; @deva[शरदः समीपम् उपशरदम्], @deva[प्रतिविपाशम्], 'towards the Vipāśā;' @deva[दिशोर्मध्ये अपदिशम्] between two divisions of the compass, @deva[उपजरसम्] towards old age, @deva[अध्यात्मम्] on the soul, &c.; and to @deva[अक्षि] when preceded by @deva[प्रति], @deva[पर] changed to @deva[परो], @deva[सम्] and @deva[अनु], the @deva[इ] of @deva[अक्षि] being dropped; @deva[अक्ष्णः प्रति प्रत्यक्षम्] before one's eyes; @deva[अक्ष्ण परं परोक्षम्] out of sight; @deva[समक्षम्], and @deva[अन्वक्षम्] afterwards, forthwith.

---

[^1]: @deva[अनश्च] । @deva[नपुंसकादन्यतरस्याम्] Pāṇ. V. 4. 108, 109.

[^2]: @deva[नदीपौर्णमास्याग्रहायणीभ्यः] । @deva[गिरेश्च सेनकस्य] Pāṇ. V. 4. 110, 112.

[^3]: @deva[झयः] । Pāṇ. V. 4. 111.

[^4]: @deva[अव्ययीभावे शरत्प्रभृतिभ्यः] । Pāṇ. V. 4. 107.

rules.title: Meanings of Avyayībhāva Compounds
rules.body:
The indeclinables forming Avyayībhāva compounds have various senses[^1]; *e. g.* (1) the meaning of case; as @deva[गोपि इति अधिगोपम्] 'in the protector of the cowherd,' so @deva[हराविति अधिहरि], @deva[अध्यात्मम्] &c.; (2) @deva[सामीप्य] or 'vicinity;' as @deva[कृष्णस्य समीपमुपकृष्णम्] near Krishna; so @deva[उपगवम्] &c., (3) @deva[समृद्धि] or 'prosperity' as @deva[मद्राणां समृद्धिः सुमद्रम्], 'in a country wherein the Madras are in a prosperous condition,' (4) @deva[व्यृद्धि] ( @deva[वि+ऋद्धिः] ) or 'bad condition;' as @deva[यवनानां व्यृद्धिः दुर्यवनम्] 'when the Yavanas are in a bad condition;' (4) @deva[अभाव] or absence; as @deva[मक्षिकाणामभावः निर्मक्षिकम्] 'where flies are utterly absent' i. e. 'perfect loneliness,' or 'quiet;' so @deva[निर्जनम्] &c. (6) @deva[अत्यय] or 'the close or the transgression of' as @deva[हिमस्य अत्ययः अतिहिमम्] 'after the wintry season,' so @deva[अतिवसन्तम्], @deva[अतियौवनम्], @deva[अतिमात्रम्] 'transgressing the proper limits,' &c.; (7) @deva[असम्प्रति] or 'unfitness of time; as @deva[निद्रा संप्रति न युज्यते इति अतिनिद्रम्] past sleeping time; as @deva[अतिनिद्रम् उत्तिष्ठति पुरुषः]; (8) @deva[प्रादुर्भाव] or 'manifestation' as @deva[हरिशब्दस्य प्रकाशः इतिहरि] in which the name Hari is manifested (loudly uttered); (9) @deva[पश्चात्] or 'after'; as @deva[विष्णोः पश्चाद् अनुविष्णु]; (10) @deva[योग्यता][^2] or 'fitness' as @deva[रूपस्य योग्यं अनुरूपम्] in a corresponding manner; so @deva[अनुगुणम्] agreeably or comformably to, favourably; &c. (11) @deva[वीप्सा] or 'repetition' as @deva[अर्थम् अर्थं प्रति प्रत्यर्थम्] in every case; @deva[अहन्यहनीति प्रत्यहम्-ह] every day; so @deva[प्रतिपर्वतम्], &c. (12) @deva[अनतिवृत्ति] or the 'non-violation of;' so @deva[शक्तिमनतिक्रम्य यथाशक्ति] 'not going beyond' i. e. 'according to one's power'; so @deva[यथाविधि][^3] &c. (13) @deva[सादृश्य] or 'similarity'; as @deva[हरेः सादृश्यं सहरि] like Hari. (14) @deva[आनुपूर्व्य] or 'succession in order, priority'; as @deva[ज्येष्ठस्य आनुपूर्व्येण अनुज्येष्ठम्] 'according to seniority,' so @deva[अनुक्रमम्] according to the proper order; &c. (15) @deva[यौगपद्य] or 'simultaneousness', as @deva[चक्रेण युगपत् सचक्रम्] 'along with the wheel'. (16) @deva[सम्पत्ति] or 'power, influence; as @deva[क्षत्राणां सम्पत्तिः सक्षत्रम्] 'with the Kshatriyas in a satisfactory condition,' or 'very influencial' or 'powerful'. (17) @deva[साकल्य] or 'entirety, fulness'; as @deva[तृणमपि अपरित्यज्य सतृणम्] 'in a manner not leaving out even grass' @deva[अत्ति]; and (18) @deva[अन्त] or 'end'; as @deva[अन्ते अग्निग्रन्थपर्यन्तमधीते साग्नि] including the work on fire (which is studied last of all); so @deva[सभाष्यम्], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[अव्ययं विभक्तिसमीपसमृद्धिव्यृद्ध्यर्थाभावात्ययासम्प्रतिशब्दप्रादुर्भावपश्चाद्यथानुपूर्व्ययौगपद्यसादृश्यसम्पत्तिसाकल्यान्तवचनेषु] । Pāṇ. II. 1. 6.

[^2]: 10-13 are the senses of @deva[यथा]; @deva[योग्यतावीप्सापदार्थानतिवृत्तिसादृश्यानि यथार्थाः ।] Sid. Kau.

[^3]: @deva[यथाऽसादृश्ये ।] Pāṇ. II. 1. 7. @deva[यथा] is not compounded when it indicates similarity; @deva[यथा हरिः तथा हरः] &c.

rules.title: @deva[यावत्] Compounds Showing Definite Measure
rules.body:
**(a)** @deva[यावत्] showing a definite measure may be compounded with any word;[^1] *e. g.* @deva[यावन्तः श्लोकाः तावन्तः अच्युतप्रणामाः] @deva[यावच्छ्लोकम् अच्युतप्रमाणा] 'bowing down to Achyuta as many times as there are Ślokas ;' so @deva[यावान् अवकाशः तावान् अभ्यासः] @deva[यावदवकाशम् अभ्यासः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[यावदवधारणे ।] Pāṇ. II. 1. 8.

rules.title: @deva[प्रति] Meaning 'Very Little'
@deva[परि] Compounds for Loss in Games
rules.body:
The words @deva[अक्ष], and @deva[शलाका] and a numeral, are compounded with @deva[परि] and placed first to express 'loss in a game';[^1] @deva[अक्षेण विपरीतं वृत्तं अक्षपरि], 'so as to be a loser by an unlucky throw of dice'; @deva[शलाकापरि] 'an unlucky throw or movement of one of the pieces at a game played with Śalākās'; @deva[एकपरि] 'loss of one throw of dice', &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[अक्षशलाकासंख्याः परिणा] । Pāṇ. II. 1. 10. @deva[द्यूतव्यवहारे पराजये एवायं समासः] । Sid. Kau.

rules.title: Optional Avyayībhāva Compounds with Ablative/Accusative
rules.body:
**(a)** The prepositions @deva[अप], @deva[परि] and @deva[बहिः] and words derived from the root @deva[अञ्च्] ( @deva[प्राक्], @deva[प्रत्यच्], @deva[उदच्], @deva[अवाच्], @deva[तिर्यच्], &c. ), are optionally compounded with a noun in the Ablative;[^1] @deva[अपविष्णु] or @deva[अपविष्णोः] 'away from Vishṇu'; @deva[परिविष्णु] or @deva[परिविष्णोः]; @deva[बहिर्वनम्] or @deva[बहिर्वनात्]; @deva[प्राग्वनम्] or @deva[प्राग्वनात्] 'to the east of the forest' &c

**(b)** @deva[आ] showing limit, inclusive and exclusive, is optionally compounded with a noun in the Ablative; and so are @deva[अनु], @deva[अभि], and @deva[प्रति] all meaning 'towards' with a noun in the Accusative;[^2] @deva[आमुक्ति] or @deva[आमुक्तेः] 'until final liberation' @deva[संसारः], @deva[आबालं] or @deva[आबालेभ्यः] up to the child; @deva[हरिभक्तिः]; @deva[अभ्यग्नि] or @deva[अग्निमभि] towards the fire @deva[शलभाः पतन्ति]; @deva[प्रत्यग्नि] or @deva[अग्निं प्रति], @deva[अनुवनम्] or @deva[वनमनु].

**(c)** @deva[अनु] meaning 'towards' or 'alongside of,' 'lengthwise,' is also similarly compounded; @deva[अनुवनम्] ( @deva[वनस्य समीपं अशनिर्गतः] 'the thunderbolt passed ) towards the forest'; @deva[गङ्गाया अनु अनुगङ्गम् वाराणसी] 'Varânasi is alongside the Ganges' ( @deva[गंगादैर्घ्यसदृशदैर्घ्योपलक्षिता इत्यर्थः] S. K. )

---

[^1]: @deva[विभाषा] । @deva[अपपरिबहिरञ्चवः पञ्चम्या] Pāṇ. II. 1. 11-12.

[^2]: @deva[आङ्मर्यादाभिविध्योः] । @deva[लक्षणेनाभिप्रती आभिमुख्ये] । @deva[अनुर्यत्समया] । @deva[यस्य चायामः] Pāṇ. II. 1. 13-16.

rules.title: @deva[पार] and @deva[मध्य] Compounds
rules.body:
The words @deva[पार] and @deva[मध्य] optionally form Avya. compounds with any nominal base, and are placed first, the final @deva[अ] being changed to @deva[ए] when thus compounded;[^1] *e. g.* @deva[पारे-मध्ये-गंगात्] from the middle of the Gangetic stream; optionally of course, the Gen. Tat.; also @deva[गङ्गापारात्], @deva[गङ्गामध्यात्]. In this case the Ab. termination is irregularly retained. If the final noun has the sense of the Loc. the final vowel may be changed to @deva[अम्]; as @deva[पारे-मध्ये-गङ्गम्]; *cf.* @deva[पारेसमुद्रम्] Bhaṭṭi V. 4.

---

[^1]: @deva[पारेमध्ये षष्ठ्या वा] । Pān. II. 1. 18.

rules.title: Numeral Compounds with Relations/Learning and Rivers
rules.body:
**(a)** A numeral may optionally be compounded with a noun, showing relation by blood or by some kind of learning, to form an Avya. comp.;[^1] @deva[द्वौ मुनी वंश्यौ द्विमुनि], @deva[व्याकरणस्य त्रिमुनि]; *e. g.* @deva[त्रिमुनि व्याकरणम्], 'Sans. Grammar of which the three sages, Pânini, Kâtyâyana and Patanjali, are the authors in succession.'

**(b)** and with names of rivers, this comp. also shows an aggregate;[^2] @deva[सप्तगंगम्], @deva[द्वियमुनम्].

---

[^1]: @deva[संख्या वंश्येन] । Pân. II. 1. 19. @deva[वंशो द्विधा विद्यया जन्मना च] । Sid. Kau.

[^2]: @deva[नदीभिश्च] । Pân. II. 1. 20 @deva[समाहारे चायमिष्यते] । Vârt.

rules.title: River Compounds for Place Names
rules.body:
Any noun may be compounded with the name of a river, into an Avya. comp. to form a name;[^1] @deva[उन्मत्तगंगम्], a place where the Ganges is very boisterous.' so @deva[लोहितगंगम्], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[अन्यपदार्थे च संज्ञायाम्] । Pân. II. 1. 21.

rules.title: Indeclinables That Do Not Compound
rules.body: The indeclinables @deva[समया], @deva[निकषा], @deva[आरात्], @deva[अभितः], @deva[परितः], @deva[पश्चात्], do not combine with any noun; @deva[समया ग्रामम्], @deva[निकषा लङ्काम्] &c.

rules.title: Anomalous Avyayībhāva Compounds
rules.body:
The following Avya. compounds are anomalous[^1]:—

@deva[तिष्ठन्ति गावः यस्मिन् काले स तिष्ठद्गु दोहनकालः] 'the time when cows stand for being milked;' see Bhaṭṭi. IV. 14. So @deva[वहद्गु] 'the time when cows conceive or bulls bear the plough; @deva[आयत्याः गावः अस्मिन् काले आयतीगवम्] 'the evening time,' 'the time when the cows come home'; @deva[खलेयवम्], 'the time when the barley is on the thrashing ground;' similarly @deva[खलेबुसम्]; @deva[लूनयवम्] 'when barley is reaped,' @deva[लूयमानयवम्], @deva[संहृतयवम्], &c. @deva[समभूमि] 'when the ground is even;' @deva[समपदाति] 'when the foot-soldiers are in right lines,; @deva[सुषमम्], @deva[विषमम्], @deva[अपसमम्] at the end of the year; @deva[आयतीसमम्], @deva[पापसमम्] in an evil year; @deva[पुण्यसमम्], @deva[प्राह्णम्], @deva[प्ररथम्] 'when the chariots move forth,' @deva[प्रमृगम्] 'when the deer comes,' @deva[विमृगम्], @deva[प्रदक्षिणम्], @deva[संप्रति] and @deva[असंप्रति].

**N. B.**—According to all followers of Pân. compounds of this group are precluded from being further compounded though poets do not seem to respect the prohibition except in so far as to place such words at the end of these comps.; *cf.* @deva[प्रदक्षिणक्रियार्हायाम्] । Rag. I. 76; also IV. 25, VII. 24, &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[तिष्ठद्गुप्रभृतीनि च] । Pân. II. 1. 17.

rules.title: Addition of @deva[अ] to @deva[ऋच्], @deva[पुर्], @deva[अप्], @deva[धुर्], @deva[पथ्]
rules.body:
## GENERAL RULES APPLICABLE TO ALL COMPOUNDS.

The words @deva[ऋच्], @deva[पुर्], @deva[अप्], @deva[धुर्] when is does not mean 'the yoke of a carriage', and @deva[पथ्],[^1] at the end of any compound take the suffix @deva[अ];[^2] @deva[अर्धर्चः-र्चम्] 'half a Rik;' @deva[विष्णुपुरं][^3] 'the town of Vishṇu;' @deva[विमलाप सरः] 'a lake with pure water;' @deva[राज्यधुरा] 'the yoke of a kingdom', *i. e.* 'the heavy responsibilities of governing it' &c. @deva[रम्यपथो देशः] 'a country with pleasant roads', &c.

**(a)** But in the case of @deva[ऋच्] preceded by @deva[अन्] or @deva[बहु] the @deva[अ] is added only when the compound denotes a student of the Rig Veda;[^4] @deva[अनृचः] one who does not study the Rig Veda; @deva[बह्वृचः] 'one that has studied the Rig Veda;' but @deva[अनृक् साम], 'the Sâma Veda that contains no riks;' @deva[बह्वृक् सूक्तम्] 'a hymn consisting of many riks.'

**(b)** @deva[धुर्] when it refers to @deva[अक्ष] 'a car' does not take this @deva[अ]; @deva[अक्षधूः] the yoke of a carriage; @deva[दृढधूः अक्षः]

---

[^1]: Substituted for @deva[पथिन्] ।

[^2]: @deva[ऋक्पूरब्धूःपथामानक्षे] । Pân. V. 4. 14.

[^3]: @deva[क्लीबत्वं लोकात्] । Sid. Kau.

[^4]: @deva[अनृचबह्वृचावध्येतर्येव] । Sid. Kau.

rules.title: Vowel Changes in @deva[अप्] Compounds
rules.body:
The @deva[अ] of the word @deva[अप्] is changed to @deva[ई] when preceded by @deva[द्वि], @deva[अन्तर्], or a preposition; and to @deva[ऊ] when preceded by @deva[अनु] and the compound is the name of a country;[^1] as @deva[द्विगता आपो यस्मिन् इति द्वीपम्] a peninsula, @deva[अन्तर्गता आपो अवेति अन्तरीपम्] 'an island' @deva[प्रतीपम्] 'in oppsition to the force of waters;' @deva[समीपम्]; @deva[अनूपः][^2] ( @deva[अनुगताः आपोऽत्र] ) 'name of a place or country.' The change of @deva[अ] to @deva[ई] is optional if the preposition end in @deva[अ]; @deva[प्रकृष्टा आपः][^3] @deva[यस्मिन् प्रेपम्-प्रापम्]; @deva[परेपम्-परापम्] 'a pond or a tank, a passage for water.'

---

[^1]: @deva[द्व्यन्तरुपसर्गेभ्योऽप ईत्] । @deva[ऊदनोर्देशे] । Pān. VI. 3. 97-98.

[^2]: @deva[नानाद्रुमलतावीरुन्निर्झरप्रान्तशीतलैः] । @deva[वनैर्व्याप्तमनूपं तत् सस्यैर्व्रीहियवादिभिः] ॥

[^3]: @deva[अवर्णान्ताद्वा] । Vârtika.

rules.title: Adding @deva[अ] with Vowel/Consonant Dropping
rules.body:
The following words take the suffix @deva[अ] before which the final vowel, with the following consonant, if any, is dropped.[^1]

**(a)** @deva[सामन्] and @deva[लोमन्] when preceded by @deva[प्रति], @deva[अनु] or @deva[अव]; @deva[प्रतिसामं], @deva[साम अनुगतः अनुसामः] friendly; @deva[अवरं साम अवसामम्] a bad hymn; @deva[प्रतिलोमम्] 'in inverse order, inversely'; @deva[अनुलोमम्] 'in natural order, successively, directly.'

**(b)** @deva[भूमि] preceded by @deva[कृष्ण], @deva[उदच्], @deva[पाण्डु] or a numeral; @deva[कृष्णा भूमिः यस्य स कृष्णभूमः]; similarly @deva[उदीची भूमिः यस्य स उदग्भूमः]; @deva[पाण्डुभूमिः यस्य स पाण्डुभूमः]; @deva[द्वे भूमी यस्य स द्विभूमः] [@deva[प्रासादः]] 'having two floors.'

**(c)** The words @deva[नदी] and @deva[गोदावरी] preceded by a numeral; @deva[पञ्चनदम्], @deva[सप्तगोदावरम्].

**(d)** @deva[अक्षि] when used in a metaphorical sense, and not meaning the eye'; as @deva[गवामक्षीव गवाक्षः] *lit.* resembling the eye of a bull: hence 'a round window.'

**(e)** @deva[अध्वन्] when preceded by a preposition; @deva[प्रगतोऽध्वानं] a carriage that has reached a road, @deva[प्रकृष्टो] ( distant ) @deva[अध्वा] journey @deva[वा प्राध्वः] ।

**(f)** [^2] also @deva[नाभि] in compounds like @deva[पद्मनाभः] ।

---

[^1]: @deva[अच्च प्रत्यन्ववपूर्वात्सामलोम्नः] । Pân. V. 4. 75. @deva[कृष्णोदक्पाण्डुसंख्यापूर्वाया भूमेरजिष्यते] । @deva[संख्याया नदीगोदावरीभ्यां च] । Vârtikas. @deva[अक्ष्णोऽदर्शनात्] । Pân. V. 4. 76. @deva[उपसर्गादध्वनः] । Pân. V. 4. 85.

[^2]: @deva[अजिति योगविभागादन्यत्रापि] । Sid. Kau.; this is obtained by separating the portion @deva[अच्] from the Sûtra '@deva[अच् प्रत्यन्वव०]' But this is no sanction for forming new compounds ending in @deva[नाभ]. It is only a device used by grammarians to explain such words as @deva[नलिननाभ] &c.

rules.title: Adding @deva[अ] to Specific Finals
rules.body:
[^1] @deva[अ] is added to the finals of the following—

**(a)** @deva[वर्चस्] preceded by @deva[ब्रह्मन्] or @deva[हस्तिन्]; @deva[ब्रह्मवर्चसम्] 'the devine Majesty of Bramhan or the glory of a Brâhmana'; 'pre-eminence or sanctity arising from sacred knowledge'; @deva[हस्तिवर्चसम्] 'the splendour or magnificence of an elephant'.

**(b)** @deva[तमस्] preceded by @deva[अव], @deva[सम्] and @deva[अन्ध]; *e. g.* @deva[अवततं तमः अवतमसम्] 'slight darkness;' @deva[संततं तमः संतमसम्] 'great or continuous darkness; @deva[अन्धं तमः अन्धतमसम्] 'pitchy darkness.'

**(c)** @deva[रहस्] preceded by @deva[अनु], @deva[अव] or @deva[तप्त]; @deva[अनुगतं रहः अनुरहसम्] 'secret, solitary'; @deva[अवततं रहः अवरहसं] 'a little secret,' or 'desolate'; @deva[तप्तं रहः तप्तरहसम्] 'a hot secluded place.'

**(d)** @deva[उरस्] in the Loc. and preceded by @deva[प्रति]; @deva[उरसि प्रति प्रत्युरसम्] 'against the breast'

**(e)** @deva[गो] preceded by @deva[अनु], when length is implied; @deva[अनुगव यानम्] 'a vehicle measuring as much as a bull in length.'

---

[^1]: @deva[ब्रह्महस्तिभ्यां वर्चसः] । @deva[अवसमन्धेभ्यस्तमसः] । @deva[अन्ववतप्ताद्रहसः] । @deva[प्रतेरुरसः सप्तमीस्थात्] । @deva[अनुगवमायामे] । Pān. V. 4. 78. 79; 81-83.

rules.title: Twenty-Five Compounds Always Taking @deva[अ]
rules.body:
[^1] @deva[अ] is always added in the case of the following twentyfive compounds which are:—@deva[अविद्यमानानि चत्वारि अस्य अचतुरः] destitute of four; so @deva[विचतुरः] and @deva[सुचतुरः] all three Bah. compounds; then eleven Dw. compounds for which see @ref[192] (b) the last two; and @ref[196] (c); @deva[रजोऽपि अपरित्यज्य सरजसम्] Avya. ( @deva[सरजः] as a Bah. ); @deva[निश्चितं श्रेयो निःश्रेयसम्], 'sure, never failing bliss;' @deva[पुरुषस्य आयुः पुरुषायुषम्] 'the period of human life'; both Tat.; @deva[द्वयोरायुषोः समाहाराः द्व्यायुषम्] 'the period of two lives;' similarly, @deva[त्र्यायुषम्], both Dwigus; @deva[ऋग्यजुषम्] Dw.; @deva[जातश्चासौ उक्षा च जातोक्षः] 'a young bull'; @deva[महोक्षः] 'a grown up bull,' @deva[वृद्धोक्षः] 'an old bull'; all Karms.; @deva[शुनः समीपम् उपशुनम्] 'near the dog', Avya. @deva[गोष्ठे श्वा गोष्ठश्वः], 'a dog in a cowpen that barks at others'; hence figuratively 'a person who idly stays at home and slanders others'. Tat.

---

[^1]: @deva[अचतुरविचतुरसुचतुरस्त्रीपुंसधेन्वनडुहर्क्सामवाङ्मनसाक्षिभ्रुवदारगवोर्वष्ठीवपदष्ठीवनक्तन्दिवरात्रिन्दिवाहर्दिवसरजसनिःश्रेयसपुरुषायुषद्व्यायुषत्र्यायुषर्ग्यजुषजातोक्षमहोक्षवृद्धोक्षोपशुन गोष्ठश्वाः] । Pān V. 4. 77.

rules.title: Unchanged Finals with @deva[सु], @deva[अति], @deva[किम्]
rules.body:
[^1] The finals of compounds having for their first member @deva[सु] or @deva[अति] in the sense of 'praise' and @deva[किं] in the sense of 'censure', remain unchanged; @deva[सुराजा] 'a good king' @deva[अतिराजा] 'a pre-eminent king'. @deva[अतिगौ] 'an excellent bull' @deva[अतिश्वा] &c. but @deva[परमराजः]; @deva[गामतिक्रान्तः अतिगवः]; @deva[कुत्सितो राजा किंराजा] 'a bad king', @deva[किंसखा] 'a bad friend'; but @deva[किंराजः], @deva[किंसखः] in other cases. This prohibition does not apply to Bah. compounds @deva[सुसक्थः]; @deva[स्वक्षः].

---

[^1]: @deva[न पूजनात्] । Pān. V. 4. 69. @deva[स्वतिभ्यामेव] । Vārt. @deva[किमः क्षेपे] । Pān. V. 4. 70.

rules.title: @deva[पाद्] → @deva[पद्] Transformations
rules.body:
## OTHER CHANGES IN CONNECTION WITH COMPOUNDS.

[^1] The word @deva[पाद्] is changed to @deva[पद्] when followed by @deva[आजि], @deva[आति], @deva[ग] and @deva[उपहत]; and to @deva[पद्] necessarily when followed by @deva[हिम], @deva[काषिन्], and @deva[हति], and optionally when followed by @deva[घोष], @deva[मिश्र], @deva[शब्द] and @deva[निष्क]; as @deva[पादाभ्यामजतीति पदाजिः], @deva[पद्भ्यामततीति पदातिः] @deva[पद्भ्यां गच्छतीति पद्गः] all meaning one walking on foot, a pedestrian; a foot-soldier', &c.; @deva[पदोपहतः] 'beaten down by the feet'; @deva[पद्धिमम्] 'coldness of the feet;' @deva[पादौ कषितुं शीलमस्य पत्काषी] 'one accustomed to tax his legs, a footman'; @deva[पदा हतिः पद्धतिः] a beaten-track, a way, a road; @deva[पद्घोषः] or @deva[पादघोषः], @deva[पन्मिश्रः] or @deva[पादमिश्रः]; @deva[पच्छब्दः] or @deva[पादशब्दः] @deva[पन्निष्कः] or @deva[पादनिष्कः] 'quarter of a Nishka' ( a gold coin ).

---

[^1]: @deva[पादस्य पदाज्यातिगोपहतेषु] । Pān. VI. 3. 52. @deva[हिमकाषिहतिषु च] । @deva[वा घोषमिश्रशब्देषु] । Pān. VI. 3. 54, 56.

rules.title: @deva[हृदय] → @deva[हृद्] Transformations
rules.body:
[^1] @deva[हृदय] becomes @deva[हृद्] necessarily when followed by @deva[लेख] ( formed with the affix @deva[अण्] ), and @deva[लास] and the Tad. affixes @deva[य] ( @deva[यद्] ) and @deva[अ] ( @deva[अण्] ), and optionally when followed by @deva[शोक] and @deva[रोग] and the Tad. @deva[य] ( @deva[ष्यञ्] ); @deva[हृदयं लिखतीति हृल्लेखः] 'heart-ache'; ( @deva[घञि तु हृदयलेख] Sid. Kau. ), @deva[हृल्लासः] 'disquietude,' 'hiccough'; @deva[हृदयस्य प्रियं हृद्यं] 'agreeable to the heart'; @deva[हृदयस्येदं हार्दं], @deva[हृच्छोकः] or @deva[हृदयशोकः] 'the pang of the heart;' @deva[हृदयरोगः], @deva[हृद्रोगः].

---

[^1]: @deva[हृदयस्य हृल्लेखयदणलासेषु] । @deva[वा शोकष्यञ्रोगेषु] । Pān. VI. 3. 50. 51.

rules.title: @deva[उदक] → @deva[उद्] Transformations
rules.body:
**(a)** @deva[उदक][^1] becomes @deva[उद्] necessarily (1) when it forms a proper name, also when it is final; or (2) when followed by the words @deva[पेषं], @deva[वास], @deva[वाहन], and @deva[धि]; @deva[उदमेघः] 'a particular cloud filled with water; @deva[उदधिः], @deva[क्षीरोदः] the sea of milk; @deva[लवणोदः] &c.; @deva[उदपेषं पिनष्टि], @deva[उदवासः] standing in water; @deva[उदवाहनः], @deva[उदधिः] 'a vessel for holding water' @deva[घटः], @deva[समुद्रे तु पूर्वेण सिद्धम्] Sid. Kau.;

**(b)** and optionally when followed by a word beginning with a simple consonant and denoting 'a vessel to be filled up with water', and by @deva[मन्थ], @deva[ओदन], @deva[सक्तु], @deva[बिन्दु], @deva[वज्र], @deva[भार], @deva[हार], @deva[वीवध] 'a yoke with a pan at each end for carrying loads' ( @deva[कावड] Marâthi ) and @deva[गाह]; @deva[उदककुम्भः] or @deva[उदकुम्भः]; but @deva[उदकस्थाली] ( as @deva[स्थाली] begins with a conjunct consonant ), @deva[उदकपर्वतः]; @deva[उदमन्थः] or @deva[उदकमन्थः] barley-water; @deva[उदौदनः] or @deva[उदकौदनः] rice boiled with water, water-meal; @deva[उदवीवधः] or @deva[उदकवीवधः], 'a yoke for carrying water;' @deva[उदगाहः] or @deva[उदकगाहः] 'plunging or bathing in water' &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[उदकस्योदः संज्ञायाम्] । @deva[उत्तरपदस्य चेति वक्तव्यम्] । Vârt. @deva[पेषंवासवाहनधिषु च] । @deva[एकहलादौ पूरयितव्येऽन्यतरस्याम्] । @deva[मन्थौदनसक्तुबिन्दुवज्रभारहारवीवधगाहेषु च] । Pān. VI. 3. 57–60.

rules.title: Shortening @deva[ई] and @deva[ऊ] in First Member
rules.body:
**(a)** [^1] When the first member of a compound ends in @deva[ई] or @deva[ऊ] not capable of changing into @deva[इय्] or @deva[उव्] and not belonging to a *fem.* termination or an indeclinable, the @deva[ई] or @deva[ऊ] is optionally shortened; @deva[ग्रामणीपुत्रः] or @deva[ग्रामणिपुत्रः] the son of a leader of a village; &c.; but @deva[गौरीपतिः], @deva[श्रीमत्], @deva[भ्रूभङ्गः], @deva[शुक्लीभावः] &c.

**(b)** But the word @deva[भ्रू] followed by @deva[कुंस] and @deva[कुटि] is an exception; @deva[भ्रू+कुंस=भ्रू-भ्रुकुंस] ( @deva[भ्रुवा कुंसो भाषणं शोभा वा यस्य स स्त्रीवेषधारी नर्तकः] Sid. Kau. ) an actor; @deva[भ्रू-भ्रुकुटिः] the knit eyebrow; according to some, @deva[भ्रू] optionally becomes @deva[भ्र] when followed by @deva[कुंस] or @deva[कुटि]: as @deva[भ्रकुंसः] and @deva[भ्रकुटिः] ( see ft. note ).

---

[^1]: @deva[इको ह्रस्वोऽङ्यो गालवस्य] । Pān. VI. 3. 61. @deva[इयङुवङ्भाविनामव्ययानां च नेति वाच्यम्] । @deva[अभ्रुकुंसादीनामिति वक्तव्यम्] Vârtikas. @deva[अकारोऽनेन विधीयते इति व्याख्यान्तरम्] । Sid. Kau.

rules.title: Shortening Feminine @deva[आ] and @deva[ई] in First Member
rules.body:
**Obs.**—[^1] The *fem.* affix @deva[आ] or @deva[ई] at the end of a word forming the first member of a compound is shortened in most cases when the whole is a name or in the Veda; @deva[रेवतिपुत्रः], @deva[भरणिपुत्रः], @deva[कुमारिदारा], @deva[प्रदर्बिदा], @deva[अजक्षीरम्] ( as @deva[अजक्षीरेण जुहोति] ), @deva[शिलप्रस्थम्], &c.; but @deva[नान्दीकरः], @deva[नान्दीघोषः], @deva[फाल्गुनीपौर्णमासी], @deva[जगतीछन्दः], @deva[लोमकागृहम्], &c. The @deva[आ] or @deva[ई] is optionally shortened when followed by @deva[त्व]; @deva[अजत्वं], @deva[अजात्वम्], @deva[रोहिणि-णी-त्वम्].

---

[^1]: @deva[ङ्यापोः संज्ञाछन्दसोर्बहुलम्] । @deva[त्वे च] । Pān. VI. 3. 63. 64.

rules.title: Shortening of @deva[इष्टका], @deva[इषीका], @deva[माला]
rules.body:
**Obs.**—[^1] The words @deva[इष्टका], @deva[इषीका] and @deva[माला] shorten their final when followed by @deva[चित], @deva[तूल] and @deva[मारिन्] respectively; @deva[इष्टकचितम्] made of bricks, @deva[पक्केष्टकचितम्]; @deva[इषीकतूलम्] 'the point of a reed,' @deva[मुञ्जेषीकतूलम्], @deva[मालभारि] having or wearing garlands; @deva[उत्पलमालभारि], ( *cf.* Mâl. Mâd. IX. 2. ) &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[इष्टकेषीकामालानां चिततूलभारिषु] । Pān. VI. 3. 65.

rules.title: Insertion of Nasal in Specific Compounds
rules.body:
**Obs.**—[^1] A nasal is inserted in the case of the following words:—@deva[सत्य], @deva[अगद] and @deva[अस्तु] followed by @deva[कार]; @deva[धेनु] by @deva[भव्या]; @deva[लोक] by @deva[पृणि]; @deva[अनभ्याश] by @deva[इत्य]; @deva[भ्राष्ट्र] and @deva[अग्नि] by @deva[इन्ध], @deva[तिमि] by @deva[गिल] or @deva[मिलगिल]; and @deva[उष्ण] and @deva[भद्र] by @deva[करण]; as @deva[सत्यङ्कारः], 'making true, earnest money,' &c; *cf.* Kir. XI. 50. @deva[अगदङ्कारः] 'a physician,' @deva[अस्तुङ्कारः], 'efficacious,' 'admittance' ( @deva[अभ्युपगमः] Tat. B. ); @deva[धेनुम्भव्या] ( @deva[भविष्यती धेनुः] Tat. B ); @deva[लोकम्पृणः] 'pervading or filling the world,' @deva[अनभ्याशमित्यः] 'not to be approached, to be shunned from afar,' ( @deva[दूरतः परिहर्तव्य इत्यर्थः] Sid. Kau. ); @deva[भ्राष्ट्रमिन्धैः], 'one who fries or roasts in a frying-pan,' @deva[अग्निमिन्धः], 'one who kindles fire,' @deva[तिमिङ्गिलः] 'a monstrous fish that swallows down Timi ( a large fish said to be 100 Yojanas in length );' @deva[तिमिङ्गिलगिलः][^2] 'a very large fish that swallows even a Timingila;' @deva[उष्णङ्करणम्] heating; @deva[भद्रङ्करणम्] conferring prosperity.

---

[^1]: @deva[कारसत्यागदस्य] । Pān. VI. 3. 70. @deva[अस्तोश्चेति वक्तव्यम्] । @deva[धेनोर्भव्यायाम्] । @deva[लोकस्य पृणे] । @deva[इत्येऽनभ्याशस्य] । @deva[भ्राष्ट्राग्न्योरिन्धे] । @deva[गिलेऽगिलस्य] । @deva[गिलगिले च] । @deva[उष्णभद्रयोः करणे] । Vârtikas.

[^2]: Vide Rag. XIII. 10. and Mallinâtha on it '@deva[अस्ति मत्स्यस्तिमिर्नाम शतयोजनमायतः] । @deva[तिमिङ्गिलगिलोऽप्यस्ति तद्गिलोऽप्यस्ति राघवः] ।'

rules.title: Optional Nasal Insertion in @deva[रात्रि]
rules.body: @deva[रात्रि] followed by a krit affix inserts a nasal optionally; @deva[रात्रिंचरः] or @deva[रात्रिचरः], 'a night-rover,' 'a demon;' @deva[रात्रिमटः] or @deva[रात्र्यटः] &c.

rules.title: @deva[सह] → @deva[स] Transformations
rules.body:
[^1] @deva[सह] forming the first member of a compound, is changed to @deva[स]—

**(a)** when the whole compound is a name; *e. g.* @deva[सपलाशम्]; but @deva[सहयुध्वा] a comrade in battle ( Upapada comp. ).

**(b)** when it means 'including a certain literary work,' or 'in addition to;' as @deva[समुहूर्तं] ( Avya. comp. ) @deva[ज्योतिषमधीते] 'he studies the science of astronomy, including that of finding out the auspicious times;' @deva[सद्रोणा खारी] 'a *khâri* with a drona in addition to it.'

**(c)** and when the object denoted by the latter member is not visibly seen, but is to be inferred: as @deva[सराक्षसीका] ( Bah. comp. ) @deva[निशा] 'a night in which presence of demoness is to be inferred'.

---

[^1]: @deva[सहस्य सः संज्ञायाम्] । @deva[ग्रन्थान्ताधिके च] । @deva[द्वितीये चानुपाख्ये] । Pān. VI. 3. 78–80.

rules.title: @deva[समान] → @deva[स] Transformations
rules.body:
@deva[समान] becomes @deva[स]—[^1]

**(a)** when followed by the words @deva[ज्योतिस्], @deva[जनपद], @deva[रात्रि], @deva[नाभि], @deva[नामन्], @deva[गोत्र], @deva[रूप], @deva[स्थान], @deva[वर्ण], @deva[वयस्], @deva[वचन], and @deva[बन्धु]; @deva[समानं ज्योतिः अस्य सज्योतिः] a kind of mourning which lasts from the rising of the sun or a particular collection of stars to its setting. ( @deva[समानं ज्योतिरस्येति बहुव्रीहिः] । @deva[यस्मिन् ज्योतिषि आदित्ये नक्षत्रे वा संजातं तदस्तमयपर्यन्तमनुवर्तमानमाशौचं सज्योतिरित्युच्यते] । Tat Bod. ); @deva[सजनपदः] belonging to the same country; @deva[सरात्रिः], @deva[सनाभिः] 'connected by the same navel, sprung from the same ancestor,' &c.

**(b)** when followed by the word @deva[ब्रह्मचारिन्][^2] 'a student of the Veda who belongs to the same S'âkhâ or branch as another;' @deva[समानः ब्रह्मचारी सब्रह्मचारी].

**(c)** when followed by @deva[तीर्थ] with the Tad. affix @deva[य] added to it; as @deva[समानतीर्थे वासी सतीर्थ्यः] 'a disciple of the same preceptor;' and optionally when followed by @deva[उदर] under the same circumstances; @deva[समानोदरे शयितः सोदर्यः] or @deva[समानोदर्यः] 'born of the same womb,' 'a brother by whole blood.'

**(d)** when followed by @deva[दृक्], @deva[दृश] and @deva[दृक्ष]; @deva[सदृक्], @deva[सदृशः], @deva[सदृक्षः] ।

**(e)** [^3] and in the case of compounds like @deva[सपक्ष], @deva[साधर्म्य], @deva[सजातीय], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[ज्योतिर्जनपदरात्रिनाभिनामगोत्ररूपस्थानवर्णवयोवचनबन्धुषु] । @deva[चरणे ब्रह्मचारिणि] । @deva[तीर्थे ये] । @deva[विभाषोदरे] । @deva[दृग्दृशवतुषु] Pān. VI. 3. 85–89. @deva[दृक्षे चेति वक्तव्यम्] । Vārt.

[^2]: @deva[चरणः शाखा], @deva[ब्रह्म वेदः] । @deva[तदध्ययनार्थं व्रतमपि ब्रह्म तच्चरतीति ब्रह्मचारी] । Sk:

[^3]: @deva[समानस्य छन्दस्यमूर्धप्रभृत्युदर्केषु] । Pān. VI. 3. 84. The proper meaning of this sûtra is that the word @deva[समान] is changed to @deva[स] in the Veda when followed by any other word than @deva[मूर्धन्], @deva[प्रभृति] and @deva[उदक]; @deva[अनु भ्राता सगर्भ्यः] ( @deva[समानो गर्भः सगर्भः तत्र भवः] ); @deva[अनु सखा सयूथ्यः], @deva[सनुत्यः] &c.; but @deva[समानमूर्धा], @deva[समानप्रभृतयः], @deva[समानोदर्काः] । But as compounds like @deva[सपक्ष], &c, cannot be properly explained by any of the sûtras following this, grammarians like Vâmana think that the portion @deva[समानस्य] ought to be separated from this sûtra and considered a separate sûtra by itself. Bhaṭṭoji Dikshita conforms to this opinion of Vâmana, but following Haradatta, suggests that the @deva[स] in compounds like @deva[सपक्ष] may also be taken to be a substitute for @deva[सह] meaning 'like or similar to', the compounds being considered as Bahuvrîhis; @deva[समानस्येति योगो विभज्यते । तेन सपक्षः, साधर्म्यं सजातीयमित्यादि सिद्धमिति काशिका । अथवा सहशब्दः सदृशवचनोऽप्यस्ति । सदृशः सख्या ससखीति यथा । तेनायमस्वपदविग्रहो बहुव्रीहिः । समानः पक्षोऽस्येत्यादि ।] Sid. Kau.

rules.title: @deva[स्] → @deva[ष्] Transformations in Compounds
rules.body:
@deva[स्] is changed to @deva[ष्] when the following words are compounded[^1];

**(a)** @deva[अङ्गुलि] and @deva[सङ्ग]; @deva[अङ्गुलिषङ्गः] ।

**(b)** @deva[भीरु] and @deva[स्थान] n.; @deva[भीरुष्ठानम्].

**(c)** @deva[ज्योतिस्] or @deva[आयुस्] and @deva[स्तोम]; @deva[ज्योतिष्टोमः], @deva[आयुष्टोमः] a sacrifice performed for the obtainment of long life.

**(d)** and in the case of the words @deva[सुषामा] and others; @deva[शोभनं साम यस्य सुषामा]; so @deva[निःषामा], @deva[सुषेधः], @deva[सुषन्धिः], @deva[सुष्ठु], @deva[दुष्ठु] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[समासेऽङ्गुलेः सङ्गः] । @deva[भीरोः स्थानम्] । @deva[ज्योतिरायुषस्तोमः] । @deva[सुषामादिषु च] । Pāṇ. VIII. 3. 80–81, 83, 98.

rules.title: @deva[अन्य] → @deva[अन्यत्] Transformations
@deva[पृषोदरादि] — Irregular Formations
rules.body:
A certain number of compounds and other words of irregular formation are classed under the head of @deva[पृषोदर].[^1] Any word whose formation cannot be properly explained is included into this group. These are to be taken as found in the language. The principal of these are:—@deva[पृषतः उदरं पृषोदरम्] 'wind, air'; @deva[हन्ति गच्छतीति हसतीति वा हंसः][^2] (either from @deva[हन्] or @deva[हस्]); @deva[हिनस्तीति सिंहः] (fr. @deva[हिंस्] con. 7 to kill), @deva[गूढश्चासौ आत्मा गूढोत्मा] the soul that is concealed from the external senses; @deva[वारिणां वाहकाः बलाहकाः] 'clouds'; @deva[जीवनस्य मूतः] (a bag) @deva[जीमूतः] 'a cloud'; @deva[श्मानः] (dead bodies) @deva[शेरते अत्र श्मशानं] or @deva[शवानां शयनं] (Kās.); @deva[ऊर्ध्वं च तत् खं च ऊर्ध्वखं तत् लातीति उलूखलम्], 'a wooden mortar'; @deva[पिशितमाचामतीति पिशाचः], @deva[ब्रुवन्तोस्यां सीदन्तीति बृसी] 'the seat of ascetics or holy sages discussing philosophical subjects'; @deva[मयते असौ, मह्यां रौतीति वा, मयूरः] a peacock.

**(a)** @deva[तीर] becomes @deva[तार] optionally when compounded with the names of directions;[^3] as @deva[दक्षिणतीरम्] or @deva[दक्षिणतारम्]; @deva[उत्तरतीरम्-तारम्], &c.

**(b)** **Obs.**—@deva[दुर्] becomes @deva[दू] in the following cases—[^4]@deva[दुःखेन दाश्यते दूडाशः] 'difficult to be given or hurt'; @deva[दुःखेन नाश्यते दूणाशः] not easy to be destroyed; @deva[दुःखेन दभ्यते दूडभः] 'difficult to be injured or impelled;' @deva[दुःखेन ध्यायतीति दूढ्यः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[पृषोदरादीनि यथोपदिष्टम्] । Pāṇ. VI. 3. 109.

[^2]: @deva[भवेद्वर्णागमाद्धंसः सिंहो वर्णविपर्ययात्] । @deva[गूढोत्मा वर्णविकृतेर्वर्णनाशात्पृषोदरम्] ॥ Sid. Kau.

[^3]: @deva[दिक्शब्देभ्यस्तीरस्य तारभावो वा] । Vārtika.

[^4]: @deva[दुरो दाशनाशदभ्यध्येषूत्वमुत्तरपदादेः ष्टुत्वं च] । Vārtika.

rules.title: Lengthening of First Member Vowel
rules.body:
The vowel of the first member is lengthened in the following cases:—[^1]

**(a)** When the nouns derived from the roots @deva[नह्], @deva[वृत्], @deva[वृष्], @deva[व्यध्], @deva[रुच्], @deva[सह्], and @deva[तन्] with the aff. @deva[क्विप्] ( o ) follow prepositions termed Gati or nouns which they govern; @deva[उपानह्], @deva[नीवृत्] an inhabited country, a realm, @deva[प्रावृद्] the rainy season, @deva[मर्मावित्] piercing the vitals; so @deva[मृगावित्] a hunter ( *cf.* Bhaṭṭi II. 7 ). @deva[नीरुक्], @deva[अभीरुक्], @deva[ऋतीषद्] overpowering an assailant @deva[परीतत्]. But @deva[परिणहनम्] as @deva[नह्] is not followed by *Kvip.*

**(b)** When followed by the aff. @deva[वल], and the whole is a name; @deva[कृषीवलः] a husbandman.

**(c)** Words containing more than two vowels when followed by @deva[मत्] ( @deva[वत्] ) except in the case of @deva[अजिर], @deva[खदिर], @deva[पुलिन], @deva[हंस], @deva[कारण्डव] and @deva[चक्रवाक] and the whole is a name; @deva[अमरावती] and @deva[इरावती] which are names; but @deva[अजिरवती]; @deva[व्रीहिमती], @deva[वलयवती] which is not a name. Also in the case of @deva[शर], @deva[वंश], @deva[धूम], @deva[अहि], @deva[कपि], @deva[मुनि], @deva[शुचि], and @deva[हनु]; @deva[शरावती] &c.

**(d)** When a verbal derivative with the aff. @deva[अ] ( @deva[घञ्] ) follows a preposition, in most cases, when the comp. does not signify a human being; @deva[परिपाकः]-@deva[परीपाकः]; but @deva[निषादः] one of a mountain-tribe. Similarly @deva[प्रति-ती-वंशः]; @deva[प्रति-ती-कारः] &c.

**(e)** When @deva[काश] follows a preposition ending in @deva[इ]; @deva[वीकाशः], @deva[नीकाशः]; but @deva[प्रकाशः]

**(f)** When @deva[अष्टन्] is the first, and @deva[नर] the second member of a compound, and the whole is a name; @deva[अष्टापदम्] gold, @deva[अष्टापदः] a spider; but @deva[अष्टपुत्रः], @deva[विश्वानरः] an epithet of Savitṛi.

**(g)** When @deva[मित्र] is the latter member and the whole is the name of a ṛishi; @deva[विश्वामित्रः], but @deva[विश्वमित्रो माणवकः] ।

---

[^1]: @deva[नहिवृतिवृषिव्यधिरुचिसहितनिषु क्वौ] । @deva[वले] । @deva[मतौ बह्वचोऽनजिरादीनाम्] । @deva[शरादीनां च] । @deva[उपसर्गस्य घञ्यमनुष्ये बहुलम्] । @deva[इकः काशे] । @deva[अष्टनः संज्ञायाम्] । @deva[नरे संज्ञायाम्] । @deva[मित्रे चर्षौ] । Pāṇ. VI. 3. 116, 118-120, 122, 123, 125, 129, 130.

rules.title: Insertion of @deva[स्] in Compounds
rules.body:
@deva[स्][^1] is inserted in the case of the following compounds:—

**(a)** @deva[अपर] followed by @deva[पर] when continuity of an action is implied; @deva[अपरस्पराः सार्था गच्छन्ति] । @deva[सततमविच्छेदेन गच्छन्तीत्यर्थः]; but @deva[अपरपरा गच्छन्ति] । @deva[अपरे च परे च सकृदेव गच्छन्तीत्यर्थः] । and in the case of @deva[आ + चर्य] when wonder is meant; @deva[आश्चर्यं यदि स भुञ्जीत] । But @deva[आचर्यं कर्म शोभनम्] ।

**(b)** @deva[अवकीर्यते इति अवस्करः] when it means @deva[वर्चस्कं] ( @deva[कुत्सितं वर्चः वर्चस्कमन्नमलम्] । Sid. Kau. ) otherwise @deva[अवकरः]; @deva[अपस्करः] when it means @deva[रथाङ्गम्] 'part of a carriage'; @deva[विष्किरः] ( or @deva[विकिरः] ) 'a bird'. @deva[प्रतिष्कशः] ( @deva[सहायः पुरोयायी वा] Sid. Kau. ), but @deva[प्रतिगतः कशां प्रतिकशः] 'one who boldly faces the whip, a disobedient servant' &c. @deva[मस्करः] 'a bamboo', but @deva[मकरः] 'a shark', @deva[मस्करिन्] 'an ascetic' but @deva[मकरिन्] 'the sea'; @deva[कारस्करः] when it means 'a particular kind of tree,' otherwise @deva[कारकरः] ।

**(c)** in the case of the words of the @deva[पारस्करादि] group, such as @deva[पारस्करः], @deva[किष्कुः], @deva[किष्किन्धा], &c. when they are names.

**(d)** and when the words @deva[तद्] and @deva[बृहत्] are followed by @deva[कर] and @deva[पति] and the meaning is 'a thief', and 'a deity' respectively, and @deva[द्] and @deva[त्] being dropped before @deva[स्]; @deva[तस्करः], @deva[बृहस्पतिः]. Also @deva[प्रायश्चित्तम्], @deva[प्रायश्चित्तिः], @deva[वनस्पतिः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[अपरस्पराः क्रियासातत्ये] । @deva[आश्चर्यमनित्ये] । @deva[वर्चस्केऽवस्करः] । @deva[अपस्करो रथाङ्गम्] । @deva[विष्किरः शकुनिर्विकिरो वा] । @deva[प्रतिष्कशश्च कशेः] । @deva[मस्करमस्करिणौ वेणुपरिव्राजकयोः] । @deva[कारस्करो वृक्षः] । @deva[पारस्करप्रभृतीनि च संज्ञायाम्] । Pān. VI. 1. 144, 147, 148-152, 154, 156, 157. @deva[तद्बृहतोः करपत्योश्चोरदेवतयोः सुट् तलोपश्च] । Vārt. @deva[प्रायस्य चित्तिचित्तयोः] । Vārt.

rules.title: Vowel Lengthening and @deva[न] → @deva[ण] Before @deva[वन]
rules.body:
[^1] When the words @deva[पुरग], @deva[मिश्रक], @deva[सिध्रक], @deva[सारिक] and @deva[कोटर] are followed by @deva[वन] in a compound they lengthen their ending vowel, and the @deva[न] of @deva[वन] is changed to @deva[ण] ( also after @deva[अग्रे] ); @deva[पुरगावणम्], @deva[मिश्रकावणम्], @deva[सिध्रकावणम्], @deva[सारिकावणम्], @deva[कोटरावणम्]; but @deva[असिपत्रवनम्]; @deva[वनस्याग्रे अग्रेवणम्].

---

[^1]: @deva[वनं पुरगामिश्रकासिध्रकासारिकाकोटराग्रेभ्यः] । Pān. VIII. 4. 4.

rules.title: @deva[न] → @deva[ण] in @deva[वन] with Prepositions and Plants
rules.body:
**Obs.**—[^1] The @deva[न] of @deva[वन] is changed to @deva[ण] necessarily when preceded by @deva[प्र], and optionally when compounded with names of herbs or plants containing two or three vowels; @deva[प्रवणम्], @deva[कार्ष्यवणम्], &c. @deva[दूर्वावणम्-वनम्], @deva[शिरीषवणम्-वनम्]; but @deva[देवदारुवनम्] ( as the word contains more than three vowels ); exceptions:—@deva[इरिकावनम्], @deva[मिरिकावनम्], and @deva[तिमिरावनम्].

---

[^1]: @deva[प्रनिरन्तः शरेक्षुप्लक्षाम्रकार्ष्यखदिरपीयूक्षाभ्योऽसंज्ञायामपि] । @deva[विभाषौषधिवनस्पतिभ्यः] । Pān. VIII. 4. 5-6.

rules.title: @deva[न] → @deva[ण] in @deva[वाहन]
rules.body:
[^1] The @deva[न] of @deva[वाहन] is changed to @deva[ण] when preceded by a word denoting an object that can be borne; @deva[इक्षुवाहणम्]; but @deva[इन्द्रवाहनम्] ( @deva[इन्द्रस्वामिकं वाहनमित्यर्थः] Sid. Kau. ).

---

[^1]: @deva[वाहनमाहितात्] । Pān. VIII. 4. 8.

rules.title: @deva[न] → @deva[ण] in @deva[पान] and Other Compounds
rules.body:
[^1] The @deva[न] of @deva[पान] is changed to @deva[ण] necessarily when the compound implies a country and optionally when it signifies merely the act of drinking; as @deva[सुरापाणाः] ( @deva[प्राच्याः] ); @deva[क्षीरपाणाः] ( @deva[उशीनराः] ); but @deva[क्षीरपाणम्] or @deva[पानम्].

**(a)** @deva[न] is also optionally changed to @deva[ण] in the case of the following compounds:—@deva[गिरि-णदी-नदी], @deva[गिरि-णख-नख], @deva[गिरि-णड्य-नड्य], @deva[गिरिनितम्ब णितम्ब], @deva[चक्र-णदी-नदी], @deva[चक्र-णितम्ब-नितम्ब], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[पान देशे] । @deva[वा भावकरणयोः] । Pān. VIII. 4. 9-10. @deva[गिरिनद्यादीनां वा] । Vârt.

rules.title: Introduction to Feminine Formation
rules.body:
# Chapter VIII. Formation of Feminine Bases

Feminine bases are derived from the masculine by the addition of the affixes @deva[आ] ( @deva[टाप्], @deva[डाप्], @deva[चाप्] ), @deva[ई] ( @deva[ङीप्], @deva[ङीष्], @deva[ङीन्] ), @deva[ऊ] ( @deva[ऊङ्] ) and @deva[ति].

rules.title: Changes Before Feminine Affix @deva[ई]
rules.body:
Before the affix @deva[ई]—

**(a)** nouns ending in consonants assume that form which they take before the termination of Inst. sing.; @deva[प्रत्यञ्च्-प्रतीची], @deva[राजन्-राज्ञी], @deva[मघवन्-मघोनी], @deva[श्वन्-शुनी], @deva[अर्यमन्-अर्यम्णी], @deva[विद्वस्-विदुषी], &c. There are some exceptions, @deva[अर्वन्-अर्वणी] &c.

**(b)** the preceding @deva[अ] or @deva[ई] is dropped; as @deva[गौर-गौरी], @deva[औत्स-औत्सी], @deva[पार्वती]. &c.

**(c)** if a *Prâtipadika*[^1] end in @deva[य], part of a Taddhita affix, that @deva[य] is dropped @deva[गार्ग्य + ई = गार्गी] 'the daughter of Garga.' &c.

**(d)** the final @deva[य] of the words @deva[सूर्य], @deva[तिष्य] the constellation of stars called @deva[पुष्य], @deva[अगस्त्य] and @deva[मत्स्य][^2] is dropped; as @deva[सौरी], @deva[मत्सी], &c.

**(e)** in the case of the participles of the present and the future @deva[न्] is inserted, as in the Nom. dual of the *neu.* ( vide @ref[311]. *a. b.* ); for instances, see @ref[236].

---

[^1]: @deva[हलस्तद्धितस्य] । Pān VI. 4. 150. For the meaning of the term *Prâtipadika* vide @ref[52].

[^2]: @deva[सूर्यतिष्यागस्त्यमत्स्यानां य उपधायाः] । Pān VI. 4. 149.

rules.title: Feminine Formation in @deva[आ]
rules.body:
A *Prâtipadika* ending in @deva[अ] and the words included in the Ajâdi group[^1] form their *feminine* in @deva[आ];[^2] as @deva[भुञ्जान-भुञ्जाना]; @deva[अज-अजा], @deva[एडका], @deva[अश्वा], @deva[चटका], @deva[मूषिका]; @deva[बाला], @deva[वत्सा], @deva[होडा], @deva[मन्दा], @deva[विलाता], all meaning 'a young girl'; ( of these the first five form an exception to @ref[313], and the second to @ref[308], *c* ); @deva[आ] is also added to @deva[फल] when compounded with @deva[सत्], @deva[भस्त्रा], @deva[अजिन], @deva[पण] and @deva[पिण्ड]; to @deva[पुष्प] when compounded with @deva[सत्], words ending in @deva[अच्], to @deva[काण्ड], @deva[प्रान्त], @deva[शत] and @deva[एक]; to @deva[शूद्र] not preceded by @deva[महत्], when class is implied, and to @deva[मूल] preceded by @deva[अ]; @deva[संफला]; @deva[भस्त्राफला], @deva[पणफला], &c all 'kinds of creeper'; @deva[सत्-पाक्-काण्ड-प्रान्त-शत-एक-पुष्पा], 'kinds of creeper' @deva[शूद्रा] 'a woman of the @deva[शूद्र] class;' @deva[अमूला].

**(a)**[^5] But if the *Prâtipadika* end in @deva[क] ( the member of the termination ) the preceding @deva[अ] is changed to @deva[इ]; @deva[सर्विका], @deva[कारिका], &c.; the words @deva[मामक], @deva[नरक], and those ending in the Tad. affix @deva[त्य] with @deva[क] suffixed to it, changed their @deva[अ] to @deva[इ] similarly; @deva[मामिका], @deva[नरान् कायति] calls out to @deva[इति नरिका], @deva[दाक्षिणात्यिका], @deva[इहत्यिका] a woman of this place.

Exceptions:—[^3] The @deva[अ] is not changed to @deva[इ] when the @deva[क] is added to the pronouns @deva[यद्] and @deva[तद्], or when it is a part of the Tad. affix @deva[त्यक], or when there is a compound, or when there is a word included in the Kshipaka group[^6] ( @deva[क्षिपकगण] ); as @deva[यका], @deva[सका], @deva[अधित्यका] 'a tableland', @deva[उपत्यका] 'the land at the foot of a mountain', @deva[बहुपरिव्राजका नगरी], @deva[क्षिपका], @deva[ध्रुवका], @deva[कन्यका], &c.

**(b)** [^4] @deva[अ] is optionally changed to @deva[इ] in the following cases.—

**(1)** @deva[तारका] 'a star', @deva[तारिका] 'able to protect'; @deva[वर्णका] 'a cloak, a garment,' @deva[वर्णिका] ( in other cases ), @deva[वर्तक-वर्तका शकुनौ प्राचाम्] @deva[उदीचां तु वर्तिका]; @deva[अष्टका] 'kind of Shrâddha,' @deva[अष्टिका] ( in other cases ).

**(2)** @deva[सूतिका-सूतका], a woman recently delivered; @deva[पुत्रिका] or @deva[पुत्रका], @deva[वृन्दारका] or @deva[वृन्दारिका], a goddess.

**(3)** when the @deva[क] follows upon the *fem.* termination @deva[आ] shortened to @deva[अ] and is preceded by @deva[य] or @deva[क]; as @deva[आर्या+क=आर्यक+आ=आर्यिका] or @deva[आर्यका]; @deva[चटका+क=चटकक+आ=चटकिका] or @deva[चटकका] &c. but @deva[संकाश्ये भवा सांकाश्यिका], @deva[अश्विका], @deva[शुभंयातीति शुभंयाः]; @deva[अज्ञाता शुभंयाः शुभंयिका].

**(c)** This change of @deva[अ] to @deva[इ] is necessary when the @deva[क] follows the @deva[य] or @deva[क] of a root @deva[सुनयिका], @deva[सुपाकिका], &c.

---

[^1]: The words included in the Ajâdi group are.—@deva[अज], @deva[एडक] 'a ram', @deva[अश्व], @deva[चटक] 'a sparrow', @deva[मूषक], @deva[बाल], @deva[वत्स], @deva[होड], @deva[पाक] 'a young child,' @deva[मन्द], @deva[विलात], @deva[कुञ्च] 'a heron,' @deva[उष्णिह्], @deva[देवविश्] 'a deity,' @deva[ज्येष्ठ], @deva[मध्यम], @deva[कनिष्ठ] and @deva[कोकिल].

[^2]: @deva[अजाद्यतष्टाप्] । Pān IV. 1. 4. 4. @deva[संभस्त्राजिनपणपिण्डेभ्यः फलात्] @deva[सदच्काण्डप्रान्तशतैकेभ्यः पुष्पात्] । @deva[शूद्रा चामहत्पूर्वा जातिः] । @deva[मूलान्नञः] । Vârtikas.

[^3]: @deva[न यासयोः] । Pān. VII. 3. 45. @deva[त्यकनश्च निषेधः] । @deva[क्षिपकादीनां च] । Vârtikas.

[^6]: The following words are included in the @deva[क्षिपकगण]:—@deva[क्षिपक] 'an archer,' @deva[ध्रुवक], @deva[चरक] 'a spy,' @deva[सेवक], @deva[करक] 'a kind of bird, hail,' @deva[चटक]; @deva[अवक] 'a kind of plant,' @deva[हलक], @deva[अलका], @deva[कन्यका], and @deva[एडक].

[^4]: @deva[तारका ज्योतिषि] । @deva[वर्णका तान्तवे] । @deva[वर्तका शकुनौ प्राचाम्] । @deva[सूतिकापुत्रिकावृन्दारकाणां वेति वक्तव्यम्] । Vârtika. @deva[उदीचामातः स्थाने यकपूर्वायाः] । Pān. VII. 3. 46. @deva[यात्वन्तयकोस्तु नित्यम्] । Vârtika.

[^5]: @deva[प्रत्ययस्थात्कात्पूर्वस्यात इदाप्यसुपः] । Pān. VII. 3. 44. @deva[मामकनरकयोरुपसंख्यानम्] । @deva[त्यक्तपोश्च] । Vârtikas.

rules.title: Feminine Formation in @deva[ई]
rules.body:
**(a)** A *prâtipadika*[^1] ending in @deva[कर], except @deva[यत्कर], @deva[तत्कर], @deva[किंकर][^6] and @deva[बहुकर]; @deva[घ्न], @deva[सर], preceded by @deva[पुरः], @deva[अग्रतः], @deva[अग्रे] and @deva[पूर्व]; and @deva[चर] preceded by @deva[सेना], @deva[दाय] and words expressive of place; the words @deva[नद], @deva[चोर], @deva[देव], @deva[ग्राह], @deva[गर], @deva[प्लव], and @deva[नद], nominal bases ending in @deva[एय], nominal and verbal derivatives formed by the affix @deva[अ] causing Vṛiddhi or Guṇa, such as @deva[औपगः], @deva[औत्सः], @deva[कुंभकारः], @deva[भारहारः], @deva[यादृशः], @deva[तादृशः], &c. and words ending in the Tad. affixes @deva[द्वयस], @deva[दघ्न], @deva[मात्र] and @deva[इक] ( with some exceptions ) and in the kṛit affix @deva[त्वर] form their *feminine* in @deva[ई] when they are not used adjectively; *e. g.* @deva[भोगकरी] conducing to pleasures; @deva[एककरी] &c.; @deva[पातिघ्नी], @deva[पित्तघ्नी], &c ; @deva[अग्रेसरी], &c.; @deva[सेनाचरी], @deva[कुरुचरी], a woman of the Kuru country; @deva[मत्स्यचरी], &c.; @deva[नदी], @deva[देवी], @deva[सूदी], &c.; @deva[सौपर्णेयी], @deva[वैनतेयी], &c.; @deva[ऐन्द्री], @deva[औत्सी], &c ; @deva[कुंभकारी], @deva[नगस्कारी], &c.; @deva[उरुद्वयसी-दघ्नी-मात्री], measuring or reaching as far as the knee; &c. @deva[आक्षिकी], @deva[लावणिकी], &c.; @deva[यादृशी], @deva[तादृशी], @deva[इत्वरी], evanescent, an unchaste woman &c.; @deva[गत्वरी] &c.; but @deva[किंकरा], @deva[बहुकुरुचरा नगरी].

**(b)** [^2] Also words ending in the Tad. affixes @deva[न], @deva[स्न], @deva[ईक], @deva[य] ( causing Vṛiddhi ) and the words @deva[तरुण] and @deva[तलुन]; @deva[स्त्रैणी], @deva[पौंस्नी] fit for a man; @deva[शाक्तीकी], @deva[तरुणी], @deva[तलुनी], &c. also words ending in the krit. affix @deva[अन] causing a nasal to be inserted before it; @deva[आढ्यंकरणी].

**(c)** [^3] Words indicative of the stages of life except the last take the *fem.* @deva[ई]; @deva[कुमारी], @deva[किशोरी], @deva[बर्करी], @deva[वधूटी], @deva[चिरण्टी] ( both meaning a 'a young woman' ); but @deva[वृद्धा], @deva[स्थविरा] &c. as these imply old age; @deva[कन्या] is an exception.

**(d)** **Obs.**—[^4] The words @deva[केवल], @deva[मामक], @deva[भागधेय], @deva[पाप], @deva[अपर], @deva[समान], @deva[आर्यकृत], @deva[सुमङ्गल] and @deva[भेषज] form their *fem.* in @deva[ई] when they are used as names ( or in the Veda ); @deva[केवली], @deva[मामकी], @deva[समानी], @deva[आर्यकृती] &c; but @deva[केवला], @deva[समाना], &c. when they are not names.

**(e)** The words @deva[नर्तक], @deva[खनक], @deva[रञ्जक] and @deva[रजक], those derived by adding the Krit affixes @deva[आक] and @deva[त्र] ( added to certain roots ) and the words included in the @deva[गौरादिगण][^5] form their *fem.* in @deva[ई]; @deva[नर्तकी], @deva[रजकी] &c. @deva[कुट्टाकी] one who divides or cuts; @deva[लुंटाकी] robbing or stealing, @deva[धात्री], &c.; @deva[गौरी], @deva[मनुषी], @deva[शृंगी], @deva[हरिणी], @deva[मातामही], @deva[पितामही] &c.; @deva[सुंदर] has @deva[सुंदरा] and @deva[सुंदरी].

---

[^1]: @deva[टिड्ढाणञ्द्वयसज्दघ्नञ्मात्रच्तयप्ठक्ठञ्कञ्क्वरपः] । Pān. IV. 1. 15.

[^2]: @deva[नञ्स्नञीकक्ख्युंस्तरुणतलुनानामुपसंख्यानम्] । Vârt. @deva[यञश्च] Pān. IV. 1. 16.

[^3]: @deva[वयसि प्रथमे] । Pān. IV. 1. 20. @deva[वयस्यचरम इति वाच्यम्] । Vârt.

[^4]: Vide Pān. V. 1. 30.

[^6]: Vide the Kâshikâ on Pān. III. 2. 21.

[^5]: @deva[षिद्गौरादिभ्यश्च] । Pān. IV. 1. 41. The following are the more important of the words included in the @deva[गौरादि] group:—@deva[गौर], @deva[मनुष्य], @deva[ऋष्य], @deva[पुट], @deva[द्रोण], @deva[हरिण], @deva[कण], @deva[आमलक], @deva[बदर], @deva[बिंब], @deva[पुष्कर], @deva[शिखण्ड], @deva[सुषम], @deva[आलिन्द], @deva[आढक], @deva[अश्वत्थ], @deva[उभय], @deva[भृङ्ग], @deva[मह], @deva[मठ], @deva[श्वन्], @deva[तक्षन्], @deva[अनडुह्], @deva[अनडवाह्], @deva[देह], @deva[देहली], @deva[रजन], @deva[आरट], @deva[नट], @deva[आस्तरण], @deva[आग्रहायण], @deva[मङ्गल], @deva[मन्थर], @deva[मण्डल], @deva[पिण्ड], @deva[हृद्], @deva[बृहत्], @deva[महत्], @deva[सोम], @deva[सौधर्म] &c.

rules.title: Insertion of @deva[आयन्] Before @deva[ई]
rules.body:
[^1] Some *prâtipadikas* ending in the Tad. affix @deva[य] insert @deva[आयन्] before @deva[ई]; @deva[गार्ग्यायणी] ( the grand-daughter of @deva[गर्ग] ), @deva[लोहित्यायनी], @deva[कात्यायनी]. &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[सर्वत्र लोहितादिकतन्तेभ्यः] । Pān. IV. I. 18.

rules.title: Eleven Prātipadikas with Conditional @deva[ई]
rules.body:
The following eleven *prâtipadikas* form their *feminine* in @deva[ई] under the circumstances mentioned §[^1]—@deva[जानपद] when it qualifies @deva[वृत्ति] or 'maintenance', @deva[कुण्ड] when it means 'a vessel' or 'a man of a mixed class', @deva[गोण] 'a full sack', @deva[स्थल] 'natural site', @deva[भाज] 'boiled,' @deva[नाग] 'a huge elephant', and @deva[काल] 'a particular colour, @deva[नील] when it does not refer to a garment ( or rather refers to an animal ) or means 'indigo', @deva[कुश] when it means 'something made of iron. @deva[कामुक] 'desirous of enjoyment,' and @deva[कबर] 'a knot of hair; as @deva[जानपदी] [ @deva[वृत्तिः] ], '@deva[जानपदा नगरी]'; @deva[कुण्डी अमत्रं] [ a vessel ] @deva[कुण्डान्या], ( one that burns ) @deva[गोणी आवपनं चेत्], @deva[गोणा अन्या] *i. e.* 'an empty sack;' @deva[स्थली अकृत्रिमा चेत्], @deva[स्थला अन्या] *i. e.* ground artificially prepared; @deva[भाजी श्राणा] ( rice-gruel ) @deva[चेत्], @deva[भाजा अन्या]; @deva[नागी स्थूला चेत्], @deva[नागा अन्या], @deva[काली वर्णश्चेत्], @deva[काला अन्या]; *i. e.* 'if it be a proper name;' @deva[नीली अवाच्छादनं] [ @deva[ओषधिविशेषो गौर्वा] ] @deva[चेत्], @deva[नीला अन्या नील्या रक्ता छाटी इत्यर्थे नीली] or @deva[नीला] ( when a name ), @deva[कुशी अयोविकारश्चेत्] but @deva[कुशा] 'a wooden peg'; @deva[कामुकी] 'a woman desirous of enjoyment,' @deva[कामुका] 'one anxious to meet her lover,' @deva[कबरी] 'a braid of hair,' but @deva[कबरा] variegated; @deva[शोण] has @deva[शोणी]-@deva[णा].

---

[^1]: @deva[जानपदकुण्डगोणस्थलभाजनागकालनीलकुशकामुककबराद्वृत्त्यमत्रावपनाकृत्रिमाश्राणास्थौल्यवर्णानाच्छादनायोविकारमैथुनेच्छाकेशवेशेषु] । Pān. IV. 1. 42. @deva[अनाच्छादनेऽपि न सर्वत्र किंतु] । @deva[नीलादौषधौ] । @deva[प्राणिनि च] । @deva[संज्ञायां वा] । Vârt. @deva[शोणात्प्राचाम्] । Pān. VI. 1. 43.

rules.title: Feminine @deva[ई] for Wife of Male
rules.body:
[^1] The *feminine* of nouns denoting 'a male' is formed by adding @deva[ई] when the wife of that male is meant; @deva[गोपस्य स्त्री गोपी]; @deva[शूद्री] ( sometimes @deva[शूद्राणी] also ) 'wife of a Śudra'.

**(a)** but not of nouns ending in @deva[पालक]; as @deva[गोपालिका] 'the wife of a cowherd' ( but @deva[गोपाल] has @deva[गोपाली] ), @deva[अश्वपालिका] 'the wife of a horse-groom'.

**(b)** @deva[सूर्य] has @deva[सूर्या] 'the divine wife of Śurya;' but @deva[सूरी] *i. e.* @deva[कुन्ती] who was a mortal

---

[^1]: @deva[पुंयोगादाख्यायाम्] । Pān. IV. 1. 48 @deva[पालकान्तान्न] । Vârtika. @deva[सूर्याद्देवतायां चाप् वाच्यः] । Vârtika.

rules.title: Insertion of @deva[आन्] Before @deva[ई]
rules.body:
[^1] The words @deva[इन्द्र], @deva[वरुण], @deva[भव], @deva[शर्व], @deva[रुद्र], @deva[मृड], and @deva[आचार्य]. @deva[हिम] and @deva[अरण्य] both implying 'vastness'; @deva[यव] meaning 'bad or spoiled barley', @deva[यवन] when the *feminine* denotes the alphabet of the Yavanas, @deva[मातुल] and @deva[आचार्य] form their *fem* in @deva[ई] but insert @deva[आन्] before this @deva[ई] *e. g.* @deva[इन्द्राणी] 'the wife of Indra;' @deva[वरुणानी] 'the wife of Varuna', &c.; @deva[हिमानी] 'a vast sheet of ice,' @deva[अरण्यानी] 'an immense expanse of forests,' @deva[दुष्टो यवो यवानी], @deva[यवनानां लिपिर्यवनानी], but @deva[यवनी] 'the wife of a Yavana or Yavana woman;' @deva[आचार्यानी][^2] ( and not @deva[णी] ) 'the wife of an Achârya or a holy teacher'; but @deva[आचार्या] 'a woman who teaches; a spiritual preceptress'.

**(a)**[^3] The words @deva[मातुल] and @deva[उपाध्याय] insert this @deva[आन्] optionally; @deva[मातुलानी], @deva[मातुली]; @deva[उपाध्यायानी], @deva[उपाध्यायी] 'the wife of a preceptor,' but @deva[उपाध्यायी] or @deva[उपाध्याया] 'a female preceptor', 'a woman who herself performs the work of an @deva[उपाध्याय]'; in the case of @deva[अर्य] and @deva[क्षत्रिय], @deva[आन्] is optionally inserted before the @deva[ई], when no wife is meant; @deva[अर्या—अर्याणी], 'a mistress or a woman of the Vaisya or trader class', @deva[क्षत्रिया], @deva[क्षत्रियाणी] 'a woman of the Kshatriya or warrior class', @deva[अर्यी] 'the wife of a Vaishya'; @deva[क्षत्रियी] 'the wife of a Kshatriya.'

---

[^1]: @deva[इन्द्रवरुणभवशर्वरुद्रमृडहिमारण्ययवयवनमातुलाचार्याणामानुक्] । Pān. IV. 1. 49, @deva[हिमारण्ययोर्महत्वे] । @deva[यवाद्दोषे] । @deva[यवनाल्लिप्याम्] । Vârtikas.

[^2]: @deva[आचार्यादणत्वं च] । Vârtika.

[^3]: @deva[मातुलोपाध्याययोरानुक् वा] । @deva[या तु स्वयमेवाध्यापिका तत्र वा वाच्यः] । @deva[अर्यक्षत्रियाभ्यां वा स्वार्थे] । Vârtikas.

rules.title: Feminine @deva[ई] for Class and Kind
rules.body:
[^1] Nouns ending in @deva[अ] and not having @deva[य्] for their penultimate, except @deva[हय], @deva[गवय] a wild ox, @deva[मुकय], @deva[मनुष्य] and @deva[मत्स्य] take @deva[ई] when 'class' is implied *e. g.* @deva[वृषली] 'A Śudra female' ( also the wife of a @deva[वृषल], see @ref[311]. above ); similarly @deva[ब्राह्मणी], @deva[महाशूद्री], &c., @deva[हरिणी], @deva[मृगी], @deva[औपगवी] 'a woman of the @deva[औपगव] class of Brâhmaṇas,' @deva[कठी] 'a woman of the @deva[कठ] class of Brâhmaṇas', &c., @deva[हयी]; @deva[गवयी], @deva[मुकयी], @deva[मनुषी], and @deva[मत्सी] ( vide @ref[306]. *d.* ); but @deva[देवदत्ता] 'a woman of that name'; @deva[अश्वा] as it is one of the words included in the Ajâdi group; ( see @ref[307]. and foot-note ); @deva[शूद्रा] 'a woman of the Śudra class ( see @ref[307] above ).'

**(a)** Words ending in @deva[पाक], @deva[कर्ण], @deva[पर्ण], @deva[पुष्प], @deva[फल], @deva[मूल] and @deva[वाल] form their fem. in @deva[ई] when kind is implied; @deva[ओदनपाकी], @deva[शङ्कुकर्णी], @deva[शालपर्णी], @deva[शंखपुष्पी], @deva[दासीफली], @deva[दर्भमूली] and @deva[गोवाली] all names of particular herbs.

**(b)** Also words ending in @deva[इ] and denoting mankind; @deva[दाक्षी] 'a woman of the @deva[दाक्षि] family,' @deva[औदमेयी] ( @deva[उदमेयस्यापत्यं] ), but @deva[तित्तिरिः].

---

[^1]: @deva[जातेरस्त्रीविषयादयोपधात्] । Pān IV. 1. 63. @deva[योपधप्रतिषेधे हयगवयमुकयमनुष्यमत्स्यानामप्रतिषेधः] । Vârtika. @deva[पाककर्णपर्णमूलवालोत्तरपदाच्च] । @deva[इतो मनुष्यजातेः] । Pān. IV. 1. 64. 65.

rules.title: Feminine of Color Words
rules.body:
[^1] *Prâtipadikas* expressive of colour, having @deva[त] for their penultimate and ending in an Anudâtta vowel, except @deva[असित] black and @deva[पलित] grey, and the word @deva[पिशङ्ग] form their *feminine* in @deva[ई] or @deva[आ]; @deva[एता] or @deva[एती] 'variegated' from @deva[एत]; @deva[रोहिता], @deva[रोहिती]; @deva[पिशङ्गी]-@deva[पिशङ्गा]; but @deva[असिता], @deva[पलिता], @deva[श्वेता] ( as the @deva[त] here is Udâtta ).

**(a)**[^2] But if the *Prâtipadika* has no @deva[त] for its penultimate, it simply takes @deva[ई]; @deva[कल्माषी] variegated, @deva[सारङ्गी]; but @deva[कृष्णा] @deva[कपिला] ( as the last vowels are not Anudâtta ).

---

[^1]: @deva[वर्णादनुदात्तात्तोपधात्तो नः] । Pân. IV. 1. 39. @deva[पिशङ्गादुपसंख्यानम्] । @deva[असितपलितयोर्न] । Vârtikas.

[^2]: @deva[अन्यतो ङीष्] । Pân. IV. 1. 40.

rules.title: @deva[नारी] and Shārṅgaravādi Group
rules.body:
The *Feminine* of @deva[नृ] and @deva[नर] is @deva[नारी] and that of words included in the *Shârṅgaravâdi* ( @deva[शार्ङ्गरवादिगण] ) group[^1] is formed by adding @deva[ई]; as @deva[शार्ङ्गरवी], @deva[गौतमी], @deva[आतिथेयी], @deva[आशोकेयी], @deva[बैदी], @deva[पुत्री], &c.

---

[^1]: This group consists of the following words—@deva[शार्ङ्गरव], @deva[कापटव], @deva[ब्राह्मण], @deva[गौतम], @deva[आतिथेय], @deva[आशोकेय], @deva[वात्स्यायन], @deva[मौआयन], @deva[शैव्य], @deva[आश्मरथ्य], @deva[चाण्डाल], @deva[पुत्र] and some others not very important.

rules.title: Irregular Feminine of Relationship Words
rules.body: The *feminine* of words expressive of relationship is irregular; @deva[श्वशुर-श्वश्रू], @deva[पितृ-मातृ], &c.

rules.title: Feminine of @deva[पति]
rules.body:
The *feminine* of @deva[पति] is @deva[पत्नी] meaning 'the sharer with her husband in the fruit of the sacrifices performed by him;[^1] but if it end a compound it may optionally remain unchanged except when preceded by @deva[समान], @deva[एक], @deva[वीर], @deva[पिण्ड], @deva[श्व], @deva[भ्रातृ], @deva[भद्र], and @deva[पुत्र] &c before which this change is necessary; @deva[गृहपति] or @deva[गृहपत्नी], the mistress of the house; or @deva[दृढपति] or @deva[दृढपत्नी]; @deva[वृषलपति] or @deva[वृषलपत्नी] &c. but @deva[समानः पतिर्यस्याः सा सपत्नी] a co-wife, @deva[एकपत्नी], @deva[वीरपत्नी].

**N. B.**—[^2] If there be no compound this change does not take place; as, @deva[ग्रामस्य पतिः] 'the mistress of a village', and not @deva[पत्नी], similarly @deva[गवां पतिः] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[पत्युर्नो यज्ञसंयोगे] । Pân. IV. 1. 33. @deva[पतिशब्दस्य नकारादेशः स्यात् यज्ञेन सम्बन्धे] । @deva[वसिष्ठस्य पत्नी] । @deva[तत्कर्तृकयज्ञस्य फलभोक्त्रीत्यर्थः] । Sid. Kau

[^2]: @deva[विभाषा सपूर्वस्य] । @deva[नित्यं सपत्न्यादिषु] । Pân. IV. 1. 34, 35.

rules.title: Feminine with @deva[न्] Insertion
rules.body:
[^1] The words @deva[अन्तर्वत्] and @deva[पतिवत्] form their *feminine* in @deva[ई] but have a @deva[न्] prefixed to the @deva[ई], @deva[अन्तर्वत्नी] 'a woman big with a child' @deva[पतिवत्नी] 'a woman whose husband is living'. But if the word @deva[पति] means 'a lord or master of' @deva[ई] only is added; as @deva[पतिमती पृथ्वी] ( the earth having a king ).

---

[^1]: @deva[अन्तर्वत्पतिवतोर्नुक्] । Pân. IV. 1. 32.

rules.title: @deva[इ]-Ending Adjectives Unchanged
rules.body: Adjectives ending in @deva[इ] short or long, have no other form for the *feminine*; as @deva[शुचिः], @deva[सुधीः] &c.

rules.title: Optional @deva[ई] for @deva[उ]-Ending Adjectives
rules.body:
[^1] Adjectives ending in @deva[उ] not preceded by a conjunct consonant, except @deva[खरु], take @deva[ई] optionally; *e g* @deva[मृदु-मृदुः-द्वी], @deva[पटुः-ट्वी], @deva[बहुः-ह्वी]; but @deva[खरुः] 'a girl who chooses her husband' ( @deva[पतिवरा कन्या] Sid. Kau. ), @deva[पाण्डुः] and not @deva[पाण्ड्वी] as the @deva[उ] is preceded by a conjunct consonant; @deva[आखुः] as it is a noun.

---

[^1]: @deva[वोतो गुणवचनात्] Pân. IV. 1. 44. @deva[खरुसंयोगोपधान्न] । Vârtika.

rules.title: Lengthening to @deva[ऊ] for @deva[उ]-Ending Words
rules.body:
[^1] A *prâtipadika* ending in @deva[उ] not preceded by @deva[य] and denoting mankind forms its *feminine* in @deva[ऊः]: *e. g.* @deva[कुरूः] 'a woman of the Kuru country'; but @deva[अध्वर्युः] 'the wife of an Adhvaryu'; also when it does not denote animal-kind[^2]; as @deva[अलाबूः], @deva[कर्कन्धूः]; except in the case of @deva[रज्जु] and @deva[हनु]; @deva[रज्जुः], @deva[हनुः].

**(a)** *Obs.* [^3] A *prâtipadika* ending in @deva[बाहु] and used as a proper name, and the word @deva[पङ्गूः] also form their *feminine* in @deva[ऊ]; as @deva[भद्रबाहुः] 'a woman of that name'; but @deva[वृत्तबाहुः] 'a woman having well-rounded arms'; @deva[पङ्गूः] ।

**(b)** @deva[कद्रु] and @deva[कमण्डलु] if used as proper names take @deva[ई]; @deva[कद्रूः] 'a woman of that name,' @deva[कमण्डलूः]; but @deva[कमण्डलुः], @deva[कद्रुः] in other cases.

---

[^1]: @deva[ऊङुतः] Pân. IV. 1. 66. @deva[उकारान्तादयोपधान्मनुष्यजातिवाचिनः स्त्रियामूङ्स्यात्] । Sid. Kau.

[^2]: @deva[अप्राणिजातेश्चारज्ज्वादीनामुपसंख्यानम्] । Pân. Vârtika.

[^3]: @deva[बाह्वन्तात्संज्ञायाम्] । Pân. IV. 1. 67. @deva[पङ्गोश्च] । Pân. IV. 1. 68. @deva[संज्ञायाम्] । Pân. IV. 1. 72.

rules.title: Feminine of @deva[ऊरु] Compounds
rules.body:
[^1] If a compound has for its last member @deva[ऊरु] and for its first, words signifying a standard of comparison, or one of the words @deva[संहित], @deva[शफ], @deva[लक्षण], @deva[वाम], @deva[सहित] and @deva[सह], it forms its *feminine* in @deva[ऊ]; @deva[रम्भोरूः] @deva[रम्भे इव ऊरू यस्याः] plantain-thighed; @deva[करभोरूः] having thighs ( beautifully tapering ) like the fore-arm or the trunk of an elephant; @deva[संहितोरूः] having well-turned thighs; @deva[शफौ खुरौ ताविव संश्लिष्टत्वादूरू यस्याः सा शफोरूः]; [ @deva[हितेन सह सहितौ ऊरू यस्याः सा] ] @deva[सहितोरूः], [ @deva[सहेते इति सहौ ऊरू यस्याः सा] ] @deva[सहोरूः] 'a woman whose thighs are capable of enduring great fatigue or pain'; or 'one having excellent thighs.'

---

[^1]: @deva[ऊरूत्तरपदादौपम्ये] । @deva[संहितशफलक्षणवामादेश्च] । Pân. IV. 1. 69. 70. @deva[सहितसहाभ्यां चेति वक्तव्यम्] । Vârtika.

rules.title: @deva[ऐ] Before @deva[ई] for Specific Words
rules.body:
[^1] The *fem.* of @deva[वृषाकपि], Vishnu or Shiva, @deva[अग्नि], @deva[कुसित] or @deva[कुसिद] 'a usurer' is formed in @deva[ई] before which the final vowel of these is changed to @deva[ऐ]; @deva[वृषाकपायी], @deva[अग्नायी], @deva[कुसितायी] or @deva[कुसिदायी].

---

[^1]: @deva[वृषाकप्यग्निकुसितकुसिदानामुदात्तः] । Pân. IV. 1. 37.

rules.title: Optional Feminine of @deva[मनु]
rules.body:
[^1] The *feminine* of @deva[मनु] is optionally formed by adding @deva[ई] before which the final @deva[उ] is changed to @deva[औ] or @deva[ऐ]; @deva[मनावी], @deva[मनायी] or @deva[मनुः] ।

---

[^1]: @deva[मनोरौ वा] । Pân. IV. 1. 38. @deva[मनुशब्दस्यौकारादेशः स्यादुदात्तैकारश्च] । Sid. Kau.

rules.title: Feminine of @deva[ऋ]/@deva[न्]-Ending Words and @deva[युवन्]
rules.body:
[^1] A *prâtipadika* ending in short @deva[ऋ] or @deva[न्] forms its *feminine* by the addition of @deva[ई]; @deva[कर्तृ-कर्त्री], @deva[दण्डिन्-दण्डिनी], @deva[शुनी], @deva[राज्ञी], @deva[परिदिवन्-परिदिव्नी]; &c.

*N. B.* Words like @deva[स्वसृ], @deva[ननान्दृ], @deva[तिसृ], @deva[दुहितृ], @deva[स्वसृ] &c. being themselves *feminine* do not take this termination.

**(a)** [^2] @deva[युवन्] forms its *feminine* by the addition of @deva[ति] before which the final @deva[न्] is dropped; @deva[युवतिः]

---

[^1]: @deva[ऋन्नेभ्यो ङीप्] । Pân. IV. 1. 5.

[^2]: @deva[यूनस्तिः] ।

rules.title: @deva[वन्] → @deva[वर्] Before @deva[ई]
rules.body:
[^1] If *prâtipadika* end in @deva[वन्] it changes its @deva[न्] to @deva[र्] before @deva[ई]; @deva[शक्वन्-शक्वरी] the strong one; @deva[पीवन्-पीवरी], @deva[शर्वन्-शर्वरी] the night, @deva[सुत्वानमतिक्रान्ता अतिसुत्वरी], @deva[अतिधीवरी], &c.

**Exception.**—[^2] But if a base end in @deva[वन्] applied to roots ending in a soft consonant; or if a compound has such a base for its latter member, the *fem.* is formed by adding @deva[आ] only, before which the preceding @deva[अन्] is dropped, *e. g.* @deva[अवावन्+आ=अवावा] a Brâhmaṇa woman ( @deva[ब्राह्मणी] ) or a female thief; @deva[राजयुध्वा].

---

[^1]: @deva[वनोरच] । Pân. VI. 1. 77, 7.

[^2]: @deva[अनो बहुव्रीहे:] । @deva[अन उपधालोपिनोऽन्यतरस्याम्] Pân. IV. 1. 12. 28.

rules.title: Feminine of Bahuvrīhi Ending in @deva[अन्]
rules.body:
[^1] A Bahuvrîhi ending in @deva[अन्] forms its *fem.* in @deva[आ] optionally; as @deva[सु+पर्वन्=सुपर्वन्-र्वा], @deva[बहु+यज्वन् ज्वा], &c. but if the word ending in @deva[अन्] be such as drops its @deva[अ] before the @deva[आ] of the Inst. sing. it takes @deva[ई] also optionally; *e. g.* @deva[बहु+राजन्—बहुराजन्—राजा--राज्ञी] &c.

**(a)** [^2] If a Bah. ends in @deva[वन्], the @deva[न्] is optionally changed to @deva[र्]; as @deva[बहुधीवन्-बहुधीवा] or @deva[बहुधीवरी] a town in which there are many fishermen.

---

[^1]: @deva[वनो न हश इति वक्तव्यम्] । Vârtika.

[^2]: @deva[बहुव्रीहौ वा] । Vârt. on Pân. IV. 1. 7.

rules.title: Feminine of @deva[ऊधस्] and Age-Related Compounds
rules.body:
[^1] If a Bah. end in @deva[ऊधस्] it takes the suffix @deva[ई] in the *fem.* before which @deva[न्] is substituted for the final @deva[अस्]; @deva[पीनं ऊधः यस्याः सा पीनोध्नी] having a large udder: @deva[कुण्डोध्नी] ( see Rag. I. 84. ); also when it is preceded by a numeral or an indeclinable; as @deva[द्व्युध्नी], @deva[अत्युध्नी] having an udder exceedingly large; but @deva[ऊधः अतिक्रान्ता अत्यूधाः].

**(a)** Similarly a Bah. ending in @deva[दामन्], and @deva[हायन] denoting age, and having a numeral for its first member takes @deva[ई] in the *fem.*; @deva[द्विदाम्नी], @deva[द्विहायनी] 'a girl two years old;', @deva[त्रिहायणी], &c; but @deva[द्विहायना शाला] a building built two years since.

*N. B.*—the @deva[न] of @deva[हायन] is changed to @deva[ण] after @deva[त्रि] and @deva[चतुर्] only when it takes @deva[ई]; @deva[चतुर्हायणी बाला]; but @deva[त्रिहायना], @deva[चतुर्हायना शाला].

---

[^1]: @deva[ऊधसोऽनङ्] । Pân V. 4. 131. @deva[बहुव्रीहेरूधसो ङीष्] । @deva[संख्याव्ययादेर्ङीष्] । @deva[दामहायनान्ताच्च] Pân. IV. 1. 25-27. @deva[वयोवाचकस्यैव हायनशब्दस्य ङीष्णत्वं चेष्यते] । Vârtika.

rules.title: Feminine of Limb-Denoting Compounds
rules.body:
[^1] When a compound has for its second member a word denoting a limb of the body of an animal and having no conjunct consonant preceding its final vowel, the *fem.* is formed by the addition of @deva[आ] or @deva[ई]; @deva[अतिकेशा-शी]; 'a woman having abundant hair;' @deva[सुकेशा-शी], @deva[चंद्रमुखा-खी]; but @deva[सुगुल्फा] having beautiful ankles; @deva[सुस्तनी] or @deva[सुस्तना] ( @deva[स्त्री वा प्रतिमा वा] ; ) @deva[सुमुखा शाला] 'an edifice with a beautiful front'.

**(a)** [^2] If the word, denoting the limb, however, be one of the words @deva[क्रोड], @deva[नख], @deva[खुर], @deva[उखा], @deva[शिखा], @deva[बाल], @deva[शफ], @deva[शुक], @deva[भुज], @deva[कर] &c. or have more than two syllables, the *fem.* is formed in @deva[आ] alone; @deva[कल्याणक्रोडा] ( @deva[अश्वानामुरः क्रोडा] Sid. Kau. ), @deva[पृथुजघना], having large hips; @deva[चटुलनयना], &c.

**(b)** [^3] Also when the first member is one of @deva[स], @deva[सह], or @deva[विद्यमान], the *fem.* is formed in @deva[आ] necessarily; @deva[सकेशा], @deva[अकेशा], @deva[विद्यमाननासिका], @deva[सहनासिका] &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[स्वाङ्गाच्चोपसर्जनादसंयोगोपधात्] । Pân. IV. 1. 54.

[^2]: @deva[न क्रोडादिबह्वचः] । Pân. IV. 1. 56.

[^3]: @deva[सहनञ्विद्यमानपूर्वाच्च] । Pân. IV. 1. 57.

rules.title: Specific Body-Part Compounds
rules.body:
[^1] Of Bah. compounds having for their last member one of the words @deva[नासिका], @deva[उदर], @deva[ओष्ठ], @deva[जङ्घा], @deva[दन्त], @deva[कर्ण], @deva[शृङ्ग], @deva[अङ्ग], @deva[गात्र], @deva[कण्ठ] and @deva[पुच्छ] the *fem.* is formed either in @deva[आ] or @deva[ई]; @deva[तुङ्गनासिका-की]; @deva[कृशोदरा-री] 'a woman having a slender waist;' @deva[बिम्बोष्ठी-ष्ठा] 'with a lip as red as the *bimba* fruit,' @deva[दीर्घे जङ्घे यस्याः सा दीर्घजङ्घा-ङ्घी] 'one having long legs,' hence 'a she-camel;' @deva[स्वङ्गा-ङ्गी] ( @deva[शोभनं अङ्गं यस्याः सा] ) fair-bodied; @deva[सुपुच्छा-च्छी]; &c.

**(a)** but if @deva[पुच्छ] be preceded by @deva[कबर], @deva[मणि] and @deva[विष], or if @deva[पुच्छ] and @deva[पक्ष] be used in a Bah. involving comparison, the *fem.* is formed in @deva[ई] only; @deva[कबरपुच्छी], 'one having a variegated plumage' *i. e.* 'pea-hen', @deva[उलूकपक्षी शाला] 'a hall having its sides like the wings of an owl'; @deva[उलूकपुच्छी सेना] 'an army with its rear arrayed in the shape of the tail of an owl'.

---

[^1]: @deva[नासिकोदरौष्ठजङ्घादन्तकर्णशृङ्गाच्च] । Pân. IV. 1. 55. @deva[अङ्गगात्रकण्ठेभ्यो वक्तव्यम्] । @deva[पुच्छाच्च] । @deva[कबरमणिविषशरेभ्यो नित्यम्] । @deva[उपमानात्पक्षाच्च पुच्छाच्च] । Vârtikas.

rules.title: Feminine of @deva[नख]/@deva[मुख] Names
rules.body:
[^1] A Bah. ending in @deva[नख] and @deva[मुख] and used as proper names forms *fem.* in @deva[आ]; @deva[शूर्पणखा], @deva[गौरमुखा]; but @deva[ताम्रमुखी] a girl having a ruddy face.

---

[^1]: @deva[नखमुखात्संज्ञायाम्] । Pân. IV. 1. 58.

rules.title: Feminine of Cardinal + Limb Compounds
rules.body:
[^1] Names of the limbs of the body, preceded by words denoting a cardinal point in a compound, form their *fem.* in @deva[ई] @deva[उदङ्मुखी], &c.

---

[^1]: @deva[दिक्पूर्वपदान्ङीप्] । Pân. IV. 1. 60.

rules.title: Feminine of @deva[पाद्] Compounds
rules.body:
