rules.title: Introduction to General Tenses - Seṭ, Veṭ, Aniṭ Roots
rules.body:
## II. GENERAL OR NON-CONJUGATIONAL TENSES AND MOODS.

In the General Tenses and Moods and in the formation of verbal derivatives generally, the augment @deva[इ] is prefixed (necessarily or optionally) to terminations beginning with any consonant except @deva[य] in the case of certain roots. Such roots as take the augment @deva[इ] necessarily are called Seṭ (@deva[स]+@deva[इट्] i. e. with @deva[इ]); such as take it optionally are called Veṭ (@deva[वा]+@deva[इट्]), and those that do not, are called Aniṭ (@deva[अन्]+@deva[इट्] i. e. without @deva[इ]).

rules.title: Classification of Seṭ, Veṭ, and Aniṭ Roots
Roots Ending in @deva[ए], @deva[ऐ], @deva[ओ] Treated as Ending in @deva[आ]
rules.body: Roots ending in @deva[ए], @deva[ऐ], and @deva[ओ] are to be treated as roots ending in @deva[आ]. Also the roots @deva[मि] 5. Â. 'to throw,' @deva[मी] 9 P. Â. 'to kill,' and @deva[दी] 4. Â. 'to perish,' before a termination causing Guṇa or Vṛddhi; @deva[ली] 9 P. 4 Â. 'to adhere or cling to' changes its vowel to @deva[आ] optionally under the same circumstances.

rules.title: Tenth Class Roots Preserving @deva[अय्] in General Tenses
rules.body: Roots of the tenth class preserve their @deva[अय्] (i. e. @deva[अय] with the final @deva[अ] dropped) with all the changes that the root undergoes before it in the general tenses.

rules.title: Roots Preserving Conjugational Bases Optionally
rules.body: The roots @deva[गुप्], @deva[धूप्], @deva[विच्छ्], @deva[पण्], @deva[पन्], @deva[कम्], and @deva[ऋत्] preserve their conjugational bases optionally.

rules.title: @deva[अस्] and @deva[ब्रू] Substitutions
rules.body: @deva[अस्] and @deva[ब्रू] substitute for themselves @deva[भू] and @deva[वच्] respectively.

rules.title: Sixth Class Roots Without Guṇa/Vṛddhi
rules.body: Neither Guṇa nor Vṛddhi is substituted for the vowel of a few roots of the 6th class even before a strong termination except the @deva[अ] of the 1st and 3rd person sing. of the Perfect, the @deva[अय] of the causal and the @deva[इ] of the 3rd pers. sing. of the Passive Aorist. These are @deva[कुट्], @deva[पुट्], @deva[कुच्], @deva[गुज्], @deva[छुर्], @deva[स्फुट्], @deva[त्रुट्], @deva[लुट्], @deva[स्फुर्], @deva[गुर्], @deva[नू], @deva[धू], @deva[कु], and a few more not often to be met with.

rules.title: @deva[भ्रस्ज्] Assuming Forms @deva[भ्रज्ज्] and @deva[भर्ज्]
rules.body: The root @deva[भ्रस्ज्] assumes the forms @deva[भ्रज्ज्] and @deva[भर्ज्] in the Non-conjugational Tenses.

rules.title: Penultimate @deva[ऋ] of @deva[सृज्] and @deva[दृश्]
rules.body: The penultimate @deva[ऋ] of @deva[सृज्] and @deva[दृश्] is changed to @deva[र्] before a consonantal strong termination in the General Tenses.

rules.title: Weak Intermediate @deva[इ] in @deva[विज्] and @deva[ऊर्णु]
rules.body: The intermediate @deva[इ] is weak in the case of the root @deva[विज्] 6. Â. 7 P.; and optionally so in the case of @deva[ऊर्णु].

rules.title: @deva[दीधी] and @deva[वेवी] Without Guṇa/Vṛddhi
rules.body: The roots @deva[दीधी] 2 Â. 'to shine' and @deva[वेवी] 2 Â. 'to go' do not take Guṇa or Vṛddhi before any termination. They also drop their final vowel before the intermediate @deva[इ] and @deva[य्]. @deva[दरिद्रा] also drops its @deva[आ] before a non-conjugational termination except in the Desiderative and the Aorist where it retains it optionally.

rules.title: First Future: Terminations
rules.body:
## The Two Futures and Conditional.

## (1) First Future (@deva[लुट्])

Also called Periphrastic Future.

**Terminations:—**

| | Parasm. | | | Ātm. | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | S. | D. | P. | S. | D. | P. |
| 1. | @deva[तास्मि][^1] | @deva[तास्वः] | @deva[तास्मः] | @deva[ताहे] | @deva[तास्वहे] | @deva[तास्महे] |
| 2. | @deva[तासि] | @deva[तास्थः] | @deva[तास्थ] | @deva[तासे] | @deva[तासाथे] | @deva[ताध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[ता] | @deva[तारौ] | @deva[तारः] | @deva[ता] | @deva[तारौ] | @deva[तारः] |

[^1]: The forms of the First Future may be derived by adding to the Nom. sing. of the noun of agency derived with the affix @deva[तृ] the forms of the Present Tense of the root @deva[अस्] 'to be' in the 1st and 2nd persons. The forms of the Nom. are the forms of the 3rd pers.

rules.title: Augment @deva[इ] Before First Future Terminations
rules.body: To these terminations the augment @deva[इ] is prefixed in the case of Seṭ roots, optionally in the case of Veṭ roots, and not fixed at all in that of Aniṭ roots.

rules.title: First Future Terminations Are Strong
rules.body: All these terminations are strong. The final vowel and the penultimate short of a root therefore take their Guṇa substitute before these.

rules.title: First Future: Aniṭ Roots and the Paradigm of @deva[दा]
rules.body:
Aniṭ roots with a penultimate @deva[ऋ] change it to @deva[र्] optionally before a strong termination beginning with any consonant except a nasal or a semi-vowel; @deva[सृप्]–@deva[सर्प्तास्मि], @deva[स्रप्तास्मि] &c.

## @deva[दा] P. Â. 'to give &c.,'

| | Par. | | | Ātm. | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | S. | D. | P. | S. | D. | P. |
| 1. | @deva[दातास्मि] | @deva[दातास्वः] | @deva[दातास्मः] | @deva[दाताहे] | @deva[दातास्वहे] | @deva[दातास्महे] |
| 2. | @deva[दातासि] | @deva[दातास्थः] | @deva[दातास्थ] | @deva[दातासे] | @deva[दातासाथे] | @deva[दाताध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[दाता] | @deva[दातारौ] | @deva[दातारः] | @deva[दाता] | @deva[दातारौ] | @deva[दातारः] |

@deva[नी] P. Â. 'carry'—@deva[नेतास्मि], @deva[नेतास्वः], @deva[नेतास्मः] &c., @deva[नेताहे], @deva[नेतास्वहे], @deva[नेतास्महे], &c.

@deva[पत्] P.—@deva[पतितास्मि], @deva[पतितास्वः], @deva[पतितास्मः] &c.

@deva[ईक्ष्] Â.—@deva[ईक्षिताहे], @deva[ईक्षितास्वहे], @deva[ईक्षितास्महे] &c.

rules.title: Roots Admitting @deva[इ] Optionally in First Future
rules.body:
**Irregular Bases.**

The roots @deva[इष्], @deva[सह्] 1 Â., @deva[लुभ्], @deva[रिष्] and @deva[रुष्] admit @deva[इ] optionally in the First Future; e. g. 1 sing. @deva[एषितास्मि], @deva[एष्टास्मि]; @deva[सहिताहे], @deva[सोढाहे]; @deva[लोभितास्मि], @deva[लोब्धास्मि]; @deva[रेषितास्मि], @deva[रेष्टास्मि]; @deva[रोषितास्मि], @deva[रोष्टास्मि].

rules.title: @deva[कॢप्] Optionally Parasmaipada
rules.body: @deva[कॢप्] is optionally Parasm. in the First Future and when so it rejects @deva[इ]: @deva[कल्पिताहे], @deva[कल्प्ताहे]; @deva[कल्प्तास्मि] 1 sing. &c.

rules.title: @deva[ग्रह्] with Long Augment @deva[इ]
rules.body: The augment @deva[इ] as added to @deva[ग्रह्] is long in all Non-conjugational Tenses, except in the Perfect; @deva[ग्रहीतास्मि] 1 sing.

rules.title: Optional Lengthening of Intermediate @deva[इ]
rules.body: The intermediate @deva[इ] is optionally lengthened in the case of @deva[वृ] and roots ending in @deva[ॠ], except in the Perfect, the Benedictive Ātm. and the Aorist Par.; @deva[वरितास्मि], @deva[वरीतास्मि], 1 sing. @deva[कॄ]–@deva[करितास्मि], @deva[करीतास्मि] 1 sing.

rules.title: Insertion of @deva[न्] in @deva[मस्ज्] and @deva[नश्]
rules.body: @deva[न्] is inserted before the ending consonant of the root @deva[मस्ज्] before which @deva[स्] is dropped, and after the vowel of @deva[नश्] when they are followed by any consonant except a nasal or a semi-vowel: @deva[मङ्क्ता] &c.; @deva[नंष्टा], @deva[नशिता]. The @deva[स्] of @deva[मस्ज्] is changed to @deva[ज्] when not dropped.

rules.title: @deva[वी] for @deva[अज्] and the Second Future
rules.body:
@deva[वी] is substituted for @deva[अज्] 1 P. 'to go' necessarily before any non-conjugational termination, and optionally before such as begin with any consonant except @deva[य्]; @deva[वेता], @deva[अजिता]; @deva[वेष्यति], @deva[अजिष्यति] &c.

## (2) Second Future (@deva[लृट्]) and (3) Conditional (@deva[लृङ्]).

rules.title: Second Future Terminations
rules.body:
**Terminations of the Second Future:—**

| | Parasm. | | | Ātmane | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | S. | D. | P. | S. | D. | P. |
| 1. | @deva[स्यामि][^1] | @deva[स्यावः] | @deva[स्यामः] | @deva[स्ये] | @deva[स्यावहे] | @deva[स्यामहे] |
| 2. | @deva[स्यसि] | @deva[स्यथः] | @deva[स्यथ] | @deva[स्यसे] | @deva[स्येथे] | @deva[स्यध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[स्यति] | @deva[स्यतः] | @deva[स्यन्ति] | @deva[स्यते] | @deva[स्येते] | @deva[स्यन्ते] |

[^1]: These terminations, it will be seen, are obtained by adding those of the Present to @deva[स्य] with its @deva[अ] lengthened before initial @deva[म] and @deva[व], and dropped before a vowel.

rules.title: Conditional Terminations
rules.body:
**Terminations of the Conditional:—**

| | Parasm. | | | Ātmane | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | S. | D. | P. | S. | D. | P. |
| 1. | @deva[स्यम्][^1] | @deva[स्याव] | @deva[स्याम] | @deva[स्ये] | @deva[स्यावहि] | @deva[स्यामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[स्यः] | @deva[स्यतम्] | @deva[स्यत] | @deva[स्यथाः] | @deva[स्येथाम्] | @deva[स्यध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[स्यत्] | @deva[स्यताम्] | @deva[स्यन्] | @deva[स्यत] | @deva[स्येताम्] | @deva[स्यन्त] |

[^1]: These are obtained similarly by adding the terminations of the Imperfect to @deva[स्य] the usual rules of Sandhi being observed.

rules.title: @deva[त्] for Final @deva[स्] Before @deva[स्]
rules.body: @deva[त्] is substituted for the ending @deva[स्] of a root when followed by any non-conjugational termination beginning with @deva[स्].

rules.title: Augment @deva[इ] in Second Future and Conditional
rules.body:
## Augment @deva[इ] in Second Future and Conditional

@deva[इ] is to be prefixed, or not, or optionally to the terminations given above, according as the root is Seṭ or Aniṭ or Veṭ. Before the terminations the final vowel and the penultimate short take their Guṇa substitute.

rules.title: Augment @deva[अ] in Conditional and Paradigms
rules.body:
## Augment @deva[अ] in Conditional and Paradigms

In the Conditional the augment @deva[अ] is prefixed to the root as in the Imperfect.

Paradigms.

**Second Future**

| | @deva[शक्] 5 P. | | | @deva[लभ्] P. 1 Â. | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[शक्ष्यामि] | @deva[शक्ष्यावः] | @deva[शक्ष्मामः] | @deva[लप्स्ये] | @deva[लप्स्यावहे] | @deva[लप्स्यामहे] |
| 2. | @deva[शक्ष्यसि] | @deva[शक्ष्यथः] | @deva[शक्ष्यथ] | @deva[लप्स्यसे] | @deva[लप्स्येथे] | @deva[लप्स्यध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[शक्ष्यति] | @deva[शक्ष्यतः] | @deva[शक्ष्यन्ति] | @deva[लप्स्यते] | @deva[लप्स्येते] | @deva[लप्स्यन्ते] |

**Conditional**

| | @deva[शक्] 5 P. | | | @deva[लभ्] P. 1 Â. | | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अशक्ष्यम्] | @deva[अशक्ष्याव] | @deva[अशक्ष्याम] | @deva[अलप्स्ये] | @deva[अलेप्स्यावहि] | @deva[अलप्स्यामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अशक्ष्यः] | @deva[अशक्ष्यतम्] | @deva[अशक्ष्यत] | @deva[अलप्स्यथाः] | @deva[अलप्स्येथाम्] | @deva[अलप्स्यध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अशक्ष्यत्] | @deva[अशक्ष्यताम्] | @deva[अशक्ष्यन्] | @deva[अलप्स्यत] | @deva[अलप्स्येताम्] | @deva[अलप्स्यन्त] |

@deva[ग्रह्]—@deva[ग्रहीष्यामि]-@deva[ष्ये]; @deva[अग्रहीष्यम्]-@deva[ष्ये] &c.

rules.title: Admission of @deva[इ] by @deva[गम्], @deva[हन्] and Aniṭ Roots
Optional Parasmaipada for @deva[कॢप्], @deva[वृत्], @deva[वृध्], @deva[शृध्], @deva[स्यन्द्]
rules.body:
## Optional Parasmaipada for @deva[कॢप्], @deva[वृत्], @deva[वृध्], @deva[शृध्], @deva[स्यन्द्]

The roots @deva[कॢप्], @deva[वृत्], @deva[वृध्], @deva[शृध्] and @deva[स्यन्द्] optionally take Parasmaipada terminations in the Second Future, Conditional and the Desiderative. They reject the augment @deva[इ] when Parasmaipadi; @deva[कल्पिष्ये], @deva[कल्प्स्ये], @deva[कल्प्स्यामि]; @deva[वर्तिष्ये], @deva[वर्त्स्यामि]; @deva[वर्धिष्ये], @deva[वर्त्स्यामि]; @deva[शर्धिष्ये], @deva[शर्त्स्यामि]; @deva[स्यन्दिष्ये], @deva[स्यन्त्स्ये], @deva[स्यन्त्स्यामि] 1 sing. 2nd Fut.; @deva[अकल्पिष्ये], @deva[अकल्प्स्ये], @deva[अकल्प्स्यम्]; @deva[अवर्तिष्ये], @deva[अवर्त्स्यम्]; @deva[अवर्धिष्ये], @deva[अवर्त्स्यम्]; @deva[अशर्धिष्ये], @deva[अशर्त्स्यम्], @deva[अस्यन्दिष्ये], @deva[अस्यन्त्स्ये], @deva[अस्यन्त्स्यम्] 1. sing. Cond.

rules.title: Optional @deva[इ] before Ārdhadhātuka with @deva[स्]
rules.body:
## Optional @deva[इ] before Ārdhadhātuka with @deva[स्]

The roots @deva[कृत्], @deva[चृत्], @deva[छृद्], @deva[तृद्] and @deva[नृत्] take @deva[इ] optionally when followed by an *ârdhadhâtuka* (Non-conjugational termination) beginning with @deva[स्] except in the Aorist; @deva[कृत्]-@deva[कर्तिष्यामि], @deva[कर्त्स्यामि]; @deva[अकर्तिष्यम्], @deva[अकर्त्स्यम्] Cond. &c.

rules.title: Substitution of @deva[गा] for @deva[इ] with @deva[अधि]; @deva[ई] for Final Vowel of @deva[दा], @deva[धा], &c.
rules.body:
## Substitution of @deva[गा] for @deva[इ] with @deva[अधि]; @deva[ई] for Final Vowel of @deva[दा], @deva[धा], &c.

In the case of @deva[इ] with @deva[अधि], @deva[गा] is optionally substituted for @deva[इ] in the Conditional and the Aorist. @deva[ई] is substituted for the final vowel of the verbs @deva[दा] 3 P. Â. 1 P. @deva[धा], @deva[दो], @deva[दे], @deva[धे], @deva[मा], @deva[स्था], @deva[गा] (substituted for @deva[इ] 2 P. and @deva[इ] with @deva[अधि],) @deva[पा], @deva[हा], and @deva[सो] before a consonantal weak termination. All terminations added to @deva[गा] substituted for @deva[इ] are weak.

Paradigms.

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अध्यैष्ये] | @deva[अध्यैष्यावहि] | @deva[अध्यैष्यामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अध्यैष्यथाः] | @deva[अध्यैष्येथाम्] | @deva[अध्यैष्यध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अध्यैष्यत] | @deva[अध्यैष्येताम्] | @deva[अध्यैष्यन्त] |
| 1. | @deva[अध्यगीष्ये] | @deva[अध्यगीष्यावहि] | @deva[अध्यगीष्यामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अध्यगीष्यथाः] | @deva[अध्यगीष्येथाम्] | @deva[अध्यगीष्यध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अध्यगीष्यत] | @deva[अध्यगीष्येताम्] | @deva[अध्यगीष्यन्त] |

rules.title: Paradigms of Difficult Conjugations
rules.body:
## Paradigms of Difficult Conjugations

We give below the first pers. sing. of some of the roots of more difficult conjugation. The student should find out the various rules by which he should arrive at them.

| Roots | 1st Future | 2nd Future | Conditional |
|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[भू] | @deva[भवितास्मि] | @deva[भविष्यामि] | @deva[अभविष्यम्] |
|  | @deva[स्तरितास्मि] | @deva[स्तरिष्यामि-ष्ये] | @deva[अस्तरिष्यम्-ष्ये] |
|  | @deva[स्तरीतास्मि] | @deva[स्तरीष्यामि-ष्ये] | @deva[अस्तरीष्यम्-ष्ये] |
| @deva[यु] 2. P. | @deva[यवितास्मि] | @deva[यविष्यामि] | @deva[अयविष्यम्] |
| @deva[शी] | @deva[शयिताहे] | @deva[शयिष्ये] | @deva[अशयिष्ये] |
| @deva[स्नु] | @deva[स्नवितास्मि] | @deva[स्नविष्यामि] | @deva[अस्नविष्यम्] |
| @deva[श्वि] | @deva[श्वयितास्मि] | @deva[श्वयिष्यामि] | @deva[अश्वयिष्यम्] |
| @deva[श्रि] | @deva[श्रयितास्मि-हे] | @deva[श्रयिष्यास्मि-ष्ये] | @deva[अश्रयिष्यम्-ष्ये] |
| @deva[पच्] | @deva[पक्तास्मि] | @deva[पक्ष्यामि] | @deva[अपक्ष्यम्] |
| @deva[मुच्] | @deva[मोक्तास्मि] | @deva[मोक्ष्यामि] | @deva[अमोक्ष्यम्] |
| @deva[सिच्] | @deva[सेक्तास्मि] | @deva[सेक्ष्यामि] | @deva[असेक्ष्यम्] |
| @deva[भञ्ज्] | @deva[भंक्तास्मि] | @deva[भङ्क्ष्यामि] | @deva[अभङ्क्ष्यम्] |
| @deva[भुज्] | @deva[भोक्तास्मि] | @deva[भोक्ष्यामि] | @deva[अभोक्ष्यम्] |
| @deva[भ्रस्ज्] | @deva[भ्रष्टास्मि] | @deva[भ्रक्ष्यामि] | @deva[अभ्रक्ष्यम्] |
|  | @deva[भर्ष्टास्मि] | @deva[भर्क्ष्यामि] | @deva[अभर्क्ष्यम्] |

rules.title: Two Kinds of Perfect
rules.body:
## Two Kinds of Perfect

**(4) The Perfect (@deva[लिट्])**

There are two kinds of Perfect, Reduplicative and Periphrastic.

rules.title: Reduplicative Perfect Formation
rules.body:
## Reduplicative Perfect Formation

The Reduplicative Perfect is formed of all monosyllabic roots beginning with consonants, as well as of those beginning with the vowels @deva[अ] or @deva[आ], and @deva[इ], @deva[उ], and @deva[ऋ] short.

Exceptions—@deva[दय्], @deva[अय्], @deva[कास्], @deva[आस्]. These take the Periphrastic Perfect necessary.

rules.title: Periphrastic Perfect Formation
rules.body:
## Periphrastic Perfect Formation

The Periphrastic Perfect is formed of all roots beginning with any vowel except @deva[अ] or @deva[आ] which is naturally or prosodially long, and of roots of more than one syllable (roots of the 10th class and other derivative roots included). Exceptions:—@deva[ऊर्णु] and @deva[ऋच्छ्] which take the Reduplicative Perfects.

rules.title: Roots Taking Both Perfects
rules.body:
## Roots Taking Both Perfects

The roots @deva[उष्], @deva[विद्], @deva[जागृ], @deva[भी], @deva[ह्री], @deva[भृ], @deva[हु], and @deva[दरिद्रा] take both the perfects.

rules.title: Reduplication in Perfect Tense
rules.body:
## Reduplication in Perfect Tense

**The Reduplicative Perfect.**

The root is reduplicated according to the rules laid down in §§ @ref[444]—@ref[449].

rules.title: Perfect Tense Terminations
rules.body:
## Perfect Tense Terminations

**Terminations.**

**Parasmaipada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अ] | @deva[व] | @deva[म] |
| 2. | @deva[थ] | @deva[अथुस्] | @deva[अ] |
| 3. | @deva[अ] | @deva[अतुस्] | @deva[उस्] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[ए] | @deva[वहे] | @deva[महे] |
| 2. | @deva[से] | @deva[आथे] | @deva[ध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[ए] | @deva[आते] | @deva[इरे] |

rules.title: Strong and Weak Terminations in Perfect
rules.body:
## Strong and Weak Terminations in Perfect

The Parasmaipada singular terminations are strong; the rest weak. Before the strong terminations the penultimate short vowel takes its Guṇa substitute. The final vowel and penultimate @deva[अ] take Vṛddhi necessarily in the third and optionally in the first person singular. In the 2nd person singular the final vowel takes Guṇa and the penultimate @deva[अ] remains unchanged.

rules.title: Admission of Intermediate @deva[इ] before Terminations
rules.body:
## Admission of Intermediate @deva[इ] before Terminations

Special rules about the admission of the intermediate @deva[इ] before the terminations @deva[व], @deva[म], @deva[थ], @deva[से], @deva[वहे], @deva[महे], @deva[ध्वे]; see (§ @ref[457]).[^1]

(a) All roots, whether Seṭ or Aniṭ, except @deva[कृ], @deva[सृ], @deva[भृ], @deva[वृ], @deva[स्तु], @deva[द्रु], @deva[स्रु] and @deva[श्रु], admit @deva[इ]. But @deva[कृ] with @deva[सम्], and @deva[वृ] admit it before @deva[थ]; as @deva[संचस्करिथ], @deva[ववरिथ].

(b) Aniṭ roots ending in short @deva[ऋ], except @deva[ऋ], reject it before @deva[थ]; as @deva[सस्मर्थ] from @deva[स्मृ]; but @deva[आरिथ] from @deva[ऋ].

(c) Aniṭ roots with a final vowel or with a penultimate @deva[अ] admit it optionally before @deva[थ].

[^1]: @deva[कृसृभृवृस्तुद्रुस्रुश्रुवो लिटि ।] Pāṇ. VII. 2. 13. @deva[अजन्तोऽकारवान्वायस्तास्यनिद् थलि वेडयम् । ऋदन्त इदृङ् नित्यानिद् काद्यन्यो लिटि सेड् भवेत् ॥] (Sid. Kau.)

rules.title: Reduplicative @deva[इ] and @deva[उ] Changes
rules.body:
## Reduplicative @deva[इ] and @deva[उ] Changes

When initial @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] of a root takes Guṇa or Vṛddhi substitute, the reduplicative @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] is changed to @deva[इय्] or @deva[उव्]; otherwise the two vowels combine to form long @deva[ई] or @deva[ऊ]; as @deva[इएष्]+@deva[अ]=@deva[इयेष], @deva[उओख्]+@deva[अ]=@deva[उवोख]; @deva[ईषिव]; &c.

rules.title: Final @deva[उ] and @deva[इ] Changes before Weak Terminations
rules.body:
## Final @deva[उ] and @deva[इ] Changes before Weak Terminations

The final @deva[उ], short or long, is changed to @deva[उव्] before a vowel weak termination and @deva[इ] to @deva[इय्] or @deva[य्] as it is preceded by a conjunct consonant or not; as @deva[दुधू]+@deva[इव]=@deva[दुधुविव] 1 dual; @deva[निनी]+@deva[इव]=@deva[निन्य्]+@deva[इव]=@deva[निन्यिव], @deva[शिश्रि]+@deva[इव]=@deva[शिश्रियिव], &c.

rules.title: Roots Ending in @deva[आ] in Perfect
rules.body:
## Roots Ending in @deva[आ] in Perfect

Roots ending in @deva[आ] take @deva[औ] instead of @deva[अ] in the 1st and 3rd per. sing. and drop their final @deva[आ] before vowel weak terminations, and before such as take the augment @deva[इ]; as @deva[ददौ], @deva[ददिव], @deva[ददिम] 1st Per. @deva[ददाथ], @deva[ददिथ] 2. Per. sing. of @deva[दा].

rules.title: Guṇa Substitution for Final Vowels in Perfect
rules.body:
## Guṇa Substitution for Final Vowels in Perfect

Guṇa is substituted for the final vowel of roots ending in @deva[ऋ] preceded by a conjunct consonant, and in long @deva[ऋ] and of the roots @deva[ऋ], @deva[ऋच्छ्] and @deva[जागृ]; as @deva[सस्मरिव] 1 dual of @deva[स्मृ], &c. @deva[शॄ], @deva[दॄ] and @deva[पॄ] optionally take the Guṇa substitute before the weak terminations, and shorten their vowel when they do not; as @deva[शशरिव], @deva[शश्रिव]. 1 dual of @deva[शॄ]. &c.

rules.title: Monosyllabic Roots with Penultimate @deva[अ]
rules.body:
## Monosyllabic Roots with Penultimate @deva[अ]

Monosyllabic roots, having a short @deva[अ] for their penultimate, change it to @deva[ए] and drop the reduplicative syllable before the weak terminations and before @deva[थ] when it takes @deva[इ], provided their initial letter undergoes no change in the reduplication, e. g. @deva[पत्] 1st dual @deva[पपत्]+@deva[इव]=@deva[पेत्]+@deva[इव]=@deva[पेतिव], @deva[पेतिथ] 2 sing, @deva[शेकिथ], @deva[शशक्थ] 2. sing. of @deva[शक्], but @deva[ननन्दिथ] 2nd dual of @deva[नन्द्] as the @deva[अ] here is prosodially long.

Exceptions:—Roots beginning with @deva[व] and the roots @deva[शस्] and @deva[दद्].

rules.title: Insertion of @deva[न्] after Reduplicative Syllable
rules.body:
## Insertion of @deva[न्] after Reduplicative Syllable

@deva[न्] is inserted after the reduplicative syllable in the case of roots beginning with @deva[अ] and ending in a conjunct consonant and in that of @deva[अश्] 'to pervade' and @deva[ऋच्छ्] 'to go'. The reduplicative @deva[अ] is changed to @deva[आ]; @deva[अञ्ज्]. @deva[अअञ्ज्]+@deva[अ]=@deva[अ]+@deva[न्]+@deva[अञ्ज्]+@deva[अ]=@deva[आनञ्ज्]+@deva[अ]=@deva[आनञ्ज], similarly @deva[आनर्द] 1 sing. of @deva[अर्द्], @deva[आनशे] of @deva[अश्], &c.

rules.title: Samprasāraṇa in Perfect Tense
rules.body:
## Samprasāraṇa in Perfect Tense

The change of a semi-vowel to its corresponding vowel is called Samprasâraṇa. Samprasâraṇa generally takes place before weak terminations in the case of the following roots—@deva[वच्], @deva[यज्], @deva[वप्], @deva[वह्], @deva[वस्] 'to dwell,' @deva[वे], @deva[ज्ये], @deva[ह्वे], @deva[श्वि], @deva[वद्], @deva[स्वप्], @deva[ज्या], @deva[वश्], @deva[व्यच्], @deva[प्रच्छ्], @deva[व्रश्च्], @deva[भ्रस्ज्], @deva[ग्रह्] and @deva[व्यध्]. In the case of the Perfect the roots @deva[प्रच्छ्], @deva[व्रश्च्] and @deva[भ्रस्ज्] form an exception.

rules.title: Samprasāraṇa in Reduplicative Syllable
rules.body:
## Samprasāraṇa in Reduplicative Syllable

Before the strong terminations of the Perfect Samprasâraṇa takes place in the reduplicative syllable only. In this case the initial conjunct consonant of a root is reduplicated as it is; i. e. @deva[स्वप्]-@deva[सस्वप्] &c.

(a) The vowel following the Samprasâraṇa is dropped.

rules.body:
## Roots Rejecting @deva[इ] in Perfect

**But @deva[कृ] with @deva[सम्][^1]**

| 3 | @deva[सञ्चस्कार] | @deva[सञ्चस्करतुः] | @deva[सञ्चस्करुः] | @deva[सञ्चस्करे] | @deva[सञ्चस्कराते] | @deva[सञ्चस्करिरे] |

**@deva[स्तु] P. Â.**

| | Par. Sing. | Dual | Plural | Âtm. Sing. | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | @deva[तुष्टाव]-@deva[तुष्टव] | @deva[तुष्टुव] | @deva[तुष्टुम] | @deva[तुष्टुवे] | @deva[तुष्टुवहे] | @deva[तुष्टुमहे] |

| 3 | @deva[तुष्टाव] | @deva[तुष्टुवतुः] | @deva[तुष्टुवुः] | @deva[तुष्टुवे] | @deva[तुष्टुवाते] | @deva[तुष्टुविरे] |

Conjugate similarly @deva[द्रु], @deva[स्रु], @deva[श्रु].

---

[^1]: @deva[सपरिभ्यां करोतौ भूषणे । समवाये च । उपात्प्रतियत्नवैकृतवाक्याध्याहारेषु च] Pāṇ. VI. 1. 137—139. @deva[स्] is prefixed to the root @deva[कृ] after the prepositions @deva[सम्] and @deva[परि] when it means to ornament or collect together; and after the preposition @deva[उप] in the above sense, as well as in the senses of 'imparting an additional quality to a thing without destroying the thing itself ( @deva[सतो गुणान्तराधानं प्रतियत्नः] Kâs. on Pāṇ. II. 3. 53. ) or preparing as food, or supplying what is implied.'

[^2]: The @deva[ऋ] is changed to Guṇa as it is preceded by a conjunct consonant now ( Vide § @ref[499] Sid. Kau. on Pāṇ. VII. 1. 10-11. )

[^3]: The @deva[ध्] of the terminations @deva[षीध्वम्], @deva[ध्वम्], and @deva[ध्वे] of 2nd per. pl. of the Benedictive, the Aorist and the Perfect, is changed to @deva[ढ्] when preceded by any vowel except @deva[अ] or @deva[आ] or by @deva[य्], @deva[र्], @deva[ल्], @deva[व्] or @deva[ह्]. When the intermediate @deva[इ] is added, this change is optional, if the @deva[इ] be preceded by one of the consonants given above.

[^4]: @deva[वे] optionally assumes the form @deva[उवय्] before the strong, and @deva[ऊय्] or @deva[ऊव्] before the weak terminations of the Perfect.

[^5]: @deva[व्ये] becomes @deva[विव्यय्] before strong terminations and @deva[विव्य्] before the weak ones in the Perf.

[^6]: @deva[ह्वे] is to be considered as @deva[हु] in the Perf.

rules.body:
## Veṭ Roots Admitting @deva[इ] Necessarily Before Consonantal Terminations

The roots @deva[स्वृ], @deva[सू] and @deva[धू] admit @deva[इ] necessarily before consonantal terminations except @deva[थ]; @deva[स्वृ]-@deva[सस्वरिव] 1 dual, @deva[सस्वरिथ], @deva[सस्वर्थ] 2 sing.; @deva[दुधविथ], @deva[दुधोथ] 2 sing. of @deva[धू], &c.

## Nasal-Dropping Roots in Perfect

rules.title: Formation of Periphrastic Perfect
rules.body:
## Formation of Periphrastic Perfect

**PERIPHRASTIC PERFECT**

The Periphrastic Perfect is formed by adding @deva[आम्] to the root and then adding the forms of the reduplicated Perfect of @deva[कृ], @deva[भू], or @deva[अस्] as terminations; when the forms of @deva[कृ], are added, a Parasmaipadi root takes the Parasmaipadi forms and an Ātmanepadi one takes the Ātmanepadi forms.

rules.title: Guṇa Substitution before @deva[आम्] in Periphrastic Perfect
rules.body:
## Guṇa Substitution before @deva[आम्] in Periphrastic Perfect

Before @deva[आम्] the final vowel and the penultimate short, except that of @deva[विद्], take their Guna substitute.

Paradigms.

**@deva[ईड्] 2. Â. 'to praise.'**

|  |  |  |  |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[ईडांचक्रे] | @deva[ईडांचकृवहे] | @deva[ईडांचकृमहे] |

|  | @deva[ईडामासिथ] | @deva[ईडामासथुः] | @deva[ईडामास] |
|  | @deva[ईडांबभूविथ] | @deva[ईडांबभूवथुः] | @deva[ईडांबभूव] |
| 3. | @deva[ईडांचक्रे] | @deva[ईडांचक्राते] | @deva[ईडांचक्रिरे] |
|  | @deva[ईडामास] | @deva[ईडामासतुः] | @deva[ईडामासुः] |
|  | @deva[ईडांबभूव] | @deva[ईडांबभूवतुः] | @deva[ईडांबभूवुः] |

@deva[ईश्], @deva[ईर्], @deva[ऊह्], &c. are similarly conjugated.

**@deva[दय्] 'to give.'**

|  |  |  |  |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[दयांचक्रे] | @deva[दयामास] | @deva[दयांबभूव] |
| 2. | @deva[दयांचकृषे] | @deva[दयामासिथ] | @deva[दयांबभूविथ] |
| 3. | @deva[दयांचक्रे] | @deva[दयामास] | @deva[दयांबभूव] |

**@deva[आस्]**

|  |  |  |  |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[आसांचक्रे] | @deva[आसांचकृवहे] | @deva[आसांचकृमहे] |
| 2. | @deva[आसांचकृषे] | @deva[आसांचक्राथे] | @deva[आसांचकृढ्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[आसांचक्रे] | @deva[आसांचक्राते] | @deva[आसांचक्रिरे] |

also @deva[आसामास], @deva[आसांबभूव], &c.

| 2. | @deva[उवोषिथ] | @deva[ऊषथुः] | @deva[ऊष] |

| 3. | @deva[उवोष] | @deva[ऊषतुः] | @deva[ऊषुः] |

**@deva[विद्] 2. P. 'to know.'**

rules.title: Reduplication before @deva[आम्] in @deva[भी], @deva[ह्री], @deva[भृ], and @deva[हु]
rules.body:
## Reduplication before @deva[आम्] in @deva[भी], @deva[ह्री], @deva[भृ], and @deva[हु]

When @deva[आम्] is added to the roots @deva[भी], @deva[ह्री], @deva[भृ] and @deva[हु] they are first reduplicated as in the third conjugation; e. g.—

**@deva[भी] 3. P. 'to fear.'**

|  |  |  |  |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[बिभाय, बिभय] | @deva[बिभ्यिव] | @deva[बिभ्यिम] |
|  | @deva[बिभयांचकार-चकर], &c. | @deva[बिभयांचकृव], &c. | @deva[बिभयांचकृम], &c. |
| 2. | @deva[बिभयिथ, बिभेथ] | @deva[बिभ्यथुः] | @deva[बिभ्य] |
|  | @deva[बिभयांचकर्थ], &c. | @deva[बिभयांचक्रथुः], &c. | @deva[बिभयांचक्र], &c. |
| 3. | @deva[बिभाय] | @deva[बिभ्यतुः] | @deva[बिभ्युः] |
|  | @deva[बिभयांचकार], &c. | @deva[बिभयांचक्रतुः] &c. | @deva[बिभयांचक्रुः] &c. |

| 2. | @deva[जिह्रयिथ-जिह्रेथ] | @deva[जिह्रियथुः] | @deva[जिह्रिय] |

rules.title: Seven Varieties of the Aorist
rules.body:
**(5) THE AORIST @deva[लुङ्].**

## Seven Varieties of the Aorist

There are seven Varieties or Forms of the Aorist. The augment @deva[अ] is prefixed to the root as in the Imperfect.

rules.title: Terminations of First Aorist Variety
rules.body:
## Terminations of First Aorist Variety

**First Variety or Form.**

The terminations of the First Variety are the same as those of the Imperf., except that of third person plural, which is @deva[उस्]—

| Person | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|--------|----------|------|--------|
| 1. | @deva[अम्] | @deva[व] | @deva[म] |
| 2. | @deva[स्] | @deva[तम्] | @deva[त] |
| 3. | @deva[त्] | @deva[ताम्] | @deva[उस्] |

rules.title: Dropping of Radical @deva[आ] before @deva[उस्]
rules.body:
## Dropping of Radical @deva[आ] before @deva[उस्]

The radical @deva[आ] is dropped before @deva[उस्].

rules.title: Roots Taking First Aorist Variety
rules.body:
## Roots Taking First Aorist Variety

@deva[इ], @deva[स्था], @deva[दा], @deva[धा], and roots assuming the forms of @deva[दा] and @deva[धा] (Vide @ref[459]), @deva[पा] 'to drink' and @deva[भू] take this Variety.

rules.title: Optional First Aorist for @deva[घ्रा], @deva[धे], @deva[शो], @deva[सो], and @deva[छो]
rules.body:
## Optional First Aorist for @deva[घ्रा], @deva[धे], @deva[शो], @deva[सो], and @deva[छो]

The roots @deva[घ्रा], @deva[धे], @deva[शो], @deva[सो], and @deva[छो] belong to this Variety optionally. They optionally take the Sixth Form. @deva[धे] takes the Third Form also.

Paradigms.

**@deva[स्था] P.**

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अस्थाम्] | @deva[अस्थाव] | @deva[अस्थाम] |
| 2. | @deva[अस्थाः] | @deva[अस्थातम्] | @deva[अस्थात] |
| 3. | @deva[अस्थात्] | @deva[अस्थाताम्] | @deva[अस्थुः] |

**@deva[शो] P.**

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अशाम्] | @deva[अशाव] | @deva[अशाम] |
| 2. | @deva[अशाः] | @deva[अशातम्] | @deva[अशात] |
| 3. | @deva[अशात्] | @deva[अशाताम्] | @deva[अशुः] |

rules.title: Special Forms of @deva[भू] in First Aorist
rules.body:
## Special Forms of @deva[भू] in First Aorist

@deva[भू] takes @deva[अन्] instead of @deva[उस्] in the 3rd per. pl. and changes its vowel to @deva[ऊव्] before the vowel terminations; e. g. @deva[अभूवम्], @deva[अभूव], @deva[अभूम] 1st pers.; @deva[अभूत्], @deva[अभूताम्], @deva[अभूवन्] 3rd per.

rules.title: Substitution of @deva[गा] for @deva[इ] in Aorist
rules.body:
## Substitution of @deva[गा] for @deva[इ] in Aorist

@deva[गा] is substituted for @deva[इ] in the Aorist, @deva[अगाम्], @deva[अगाव], @deva[अगाम] 1st per.; @deva[इ] with @deva[अधि] 'to remember' @deva[अध्यगाम्], @deva[अध्यगाव], @deva[अध्यगाम], &c.

rules.title: First Aorist Exclusively Parasmaipada; Ātmanepada Alternatives
rules.body:
## First Aorist Exclusively Parasmaipada; Ātmanepada Alternatives

This Variety is exclusively Parasmaipadi. @deva[दा], @deva[धा], and @deva[स्था] take the fourth Variety in the Ātm. @deva[भू] when Ātm. takes the fifth; and @deva[इ] with @deva[अधि] Ātm. the fourth.

rules.title: Formation of Second Aorist Variety
rules.body:
**Second Variety or Form.**

## Formation of Second Aorist Variety

In this Variety @deva[अ] is added on to the root and then the terminations of the Imperf. of the first group of conjugational classes are added; viz.

**Par.**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अम्] | @deva[व] | @deva[म] |
| 2. | @deva[स्] | @deva[तम्] | @deva[त] |
| 3. | @deva[त्] | @deva[ताम्] | @deva[अन्] |

**Ātm.**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[इ] | @deva[वहि] | @deva[महि] |
| 2. | @deva[थास्] | @deva[इथाम्] | @deva[ध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[त] | @deva[इताम्] | @deva[अन्त] |

rules.title: Vowel Changes in Second Aorist Variety
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in Second Aorist Variety

The preceding @deva[अ] is dropped before @deva[अम्], @deva[अन्], and @deva[अन्त] and lengthened before @deva[व] and @deva[म]. The radical vowel except a final @deva[ऋ], short or long, and the @deva[ऋ] of @deva[दृश्], does not undergo Guna or Vrddhi substitute.

rules.title: Second Aorist Variety: Parasmaipada and Exceptions
rules.body:
## Second Aorist Variety: Parasmaipada and Exceptions

This Variety is Parasmaipada with a few exceptions such as @deva[ऋ] with @deva[सम्], @deva[ख्या], @deva[वच्], and @deva[अस्] 'to throw' with a preposition. The roots @deva[लिप्], @deva[सिच्], and @deva[ह्वे] take this form in the Par. and optionally in the Ātm., in which they also take the Fourth Form.

rules.title: Dropping of Penultimate Nasal in Second Aorist
rules.body:
## Dropping of Penultimate Nasal in Second Aorist

The penultimate nasal of a root is dropped; as @deva[भ्रंश्]—@deva[अभ्रशत्], @deva[स्कन्द्]—@deva[अस्कदत्], &c.

rules.title: Root Changes in Second Aorist
rules.body:
## Root Changes in Second Aorist

The roots @deva[अस्], @deva[ख्या], @deva[पत्], @deva[वच्], @deva[शास्], @deva[श्वि] and @deva[ह्वे] become @deva[अस्थ्], @deva[ख्य], @deva[पप्त्], @deva[वोच्], @deva[शिष्], @deva[श्व], and @deva[ह्व], respectively; e. g. @deva[आस्थत्], @deva[अख्यत्], @deva[अवोचत्], @deva[अशिषत्] &c. 3rd sing.

rules.title: Roots Taking Second Aorist Variety (Complete List)
rules.body:
## Roots Taking Second Aorist Variety (Complete List)

The roots giving the following couplets (Kārikās) belong to this Variety necessarily:—

@deva[ख्यातीयर्ती ससर्तिह्वे कान्तौ शक्नोतिशक्यती ।
उच् मुच् वक्तिः शिचिश्वान्ता लुट्यतिः पततिस्तथा ॥ १ ॥
दान्ताः क्लिद् क्ष्विद् मदि मिदो विदन्तिः शद्सदिस्विदः ।
ऋधिक्रुधी क्षुधिगृधी रधिः शुध्यतिसिध्यती ॥ २ ॥
आप्कुपौ गुप्यतिडिपी युप् रुप् लिम्पतिलुप्यती ।
लुम्पतिः सर्पतिः पान्ताः क्षुभ्यतिस्तुभ्यतिर्नभिः ॥ ३ ॥
लुभ्यतिश्च भकारान्ता मान्ताः क्राम्यतिक्षाम्यती ।
गमिस्तमिर्दमिभ्रमी शाम्यतिः श्राम्यतिः समिः ॥ ४ ॥
शान्ताः पञ्च कृशिनशी भृशिर्भ्रंशतिवृश्यती ।
तुष्यतितृष्यतिदुषः पिनष्टिः पुष्यतिः प्लुषिः ॥ ५ ॥
रिष्यरुष् वेवेष्टिवुषो व्युषिः सह शिनष्टिना ।
शुष्यतिर्हृष्यतिः षान्ताः सान्ता अस्यतिकुस्यती ॥ ६ ॥
घसिजसी तसिदसौ बस्यतिर्बिस्यतिर्व्युसिः ।
मस्मुसी यस्वसिविसो वुस्यतिः शास्तिरित्यपि ॥ ७ ॥
द्रुह्यमुह्यस्निहिस्नुहो लुङ्यङ्विकरणा भवेत् ।
नवाशीतिश्च धातूनां परस्मैपदिनामियम् ॥ ८ ॥
समियर्तिः ख्यातिवक्ती अस्यतिश्चोपसर्गयुक् ।
आत्मनेपदिनोऽपीमे ह्वयतिर्लिपिसिञ्चती ॥ ९ ॥
एते विभाषयाङ्वन्त आत्मनेपदिनो यदा ।]

rules.title: Roots Optionally Taking Second Aorist Variety
rules.body:
## Roots Optionally Taking Second Aorist Variety

The following roots belong to the 2nd Variety optionally; they optionally take the Fourth or Fifth Variety according as they are Aniṭ or Seṭ.

@deva[श्वयतिर्जीर्यतिग्रुची ग्लुचिग्लुञ्चिम्रुचिम्लुचः ।
रिणक्तिश्च विनक्तिश्च चान्तास्त्वष्टौ च शुच्यतिः ॥ १ ॥
नेनेक्तिश्च युनक्तिश्च वेवेक्तिस्फोटती चुतिः ।
च्युतिजुती श्चोततिश्च श्च्युतिर्दान्ता रुदादयः ॥ २ ॥
क्षुदिच्छिदी छृदितृदी बुन्दतिश्च भिनत्तिना ।
रुदिस्कन्दी बोधतिश्च रुणद्धिश्च तृपिर्दृपिः ॥ ३ ॥
स्तभ्नातिः स्तभ्नोतिदृशी घोषतिश्लिष्यती उहिः ।
तोहतिर्दोहतिवृही चत्वारिंशदियं लुङि ॥ ४ ॥
विभाषयाङ्विकरणा परस्मैपदिनी यदा ।]

rules.title: 25 Ātmanepada Roots Taking Parasmaipada in Second Aorist
rules.body:
## 25 Ātmanepada Roots Taking Parasmaipada in Second Aorist

The following 25 roots, which are all Ātmanepadi, are conjugated in the Parasmaipada when they belong to this Variety. In the Ātmanepada they take the Fourth or Fifth Variety according as they are Aniṭ or Seṭ.

@deva[रुचिर्घुटिरुटिलुटो लोठते द्युतिवृत्श्वितः ।
क्ष्वेदते मेदते स्यन्दिः स्वेदते च वृधिः शृधिः ॥ १ ॥
कल्पते क्षुभ्तुभिनभः शोभते स्रंभते भ्रशिः ।
भ्रंशिध्वंसी भ्रंसिस्रंसी रुचादिः पञ्चविंशतिः ॥ २ ॥
आत्मनेपदिनी नित्यं लुङि त्वेषा विभाषया ।
अङं परस्मैपदिनी भजन्त्यन्यत्र सिज्वती ॥ ३ ॥]

rules.body:
## Roots Taking Third Aorist Variety

Roots of the tenth class, causals, some derivatives, the root @deva[कम्] and the roots @deva[श्रि], @deva[द्रु], and @deva[स्रु] when expressing the agent, take this Variety necessarily, and the roots @deva[धे] and @deva[श्वि] do it optionally.

rules.title: Formation of Third Aorist: Reduplication and Vowel Changes
rules.body:
## Formation of Third Aorist: Reduplication and Vowel Changes

(a) The root is first reduplicated and then the augment @deva[अ] and the terminations are added as in the 2nd Variety.

(b) Final @deva[इ] and @deva[उ] are changed to @deva[इय्] and @deva[उव्] before @deva[अ] and final @deva[ओ] is dropped.

Paradigms.

**@deva[श्रि] P. A. 'to go,' &c.**

**Par.**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अशिश्रियम्] | @deva[अशिश्रियाव] | @deva[अशिश्रियाम] |
| 2. | @deva[अशिश्रियः] | @deva[अशिश्रियतम्] | @deva[अशिश्रियत] |
| 3. | @deva[अशिश्रियत्] | @deva[अशिश्रियताम्] | @deva[अशिश्रियन्] |

**Ātm.**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अशिश्रिये] | @deva[अशिश्रियावहि] | @deva[अशिश्रियामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अशिश्रियथाः] | @deva[अशिश्रियेथाम्] | @deva[अशिश्रियध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अशिश्रियत] | @deva[अशिश्रियेताम्] | @deva[अशिश्रियन्त] |

@deva[द्रु]—@deva[अदुद्रुवत्] 3 Sing.; @deva[स्रु]—@deva[असुस्रुवत्] 3 Sing.; @deva[कम्]—@deva[अचकमत्]. (@deva[अचीकमत्] also, when it takes @deva[आङ्]; see @ref[461] and @ref[548].) 3 sing. @deva[श्वि]—@deva[अशिश्वियत्] (see p. 338, foot-note); @deva[धे]—@deva[अदधत्]. (@deva[धे] also takes 1st and 6th Varieties besides this.)

rules.title: Third Aorist of Tenth Class Roots and Causals
rules.body:
## Third Aorist of Tenth Class Roots and Causals

Roots of the tenth Class and Causals:—

(a) The @deva[अय] of the base is dropped (the vowel changes taking place before it being retained) and a short vowel substituted for the long one (@deva[ए] and @deva[ऐ] being shortened to @deva[इ], and @deva[ओ] and @deva[औ] to @deva[उ]).

The base so modified is then reduplicated according to the general rules; @deva[भावय] (Cau. B. of @deva[भू])=@deva[भाव्]=@deva[भव्]=@deva[बभव्] after reduplication; @deva[चेतय्] (from @deva[चित्])=@deva[चेत्]=@deva[चित्]=@deva[चिचित्], &c.

(b) @deva[इ] is substituted for the @deva[अ] of the reduplicative syllable if the syllable following it be short, and not prosodially long; the @deva[इ] of the reduplicative syllable is lengthened if not followed by a long syll. or a conjunct consonant; thus @deva[बभव्]=@deva[बिभव्]=@deva[बीभव्]; @deva[चिचित्]=@deva[चीचित्]; @deva[स्खल्]=@deva[चस्खल्]=@deva[चिस्खल्], the @deva[इ] is not lengthened as it is followed by a conjunct consonant; @deva[स्पन्द्]=@deva[पस्पन्द्] only, as @deva[प] is followed by a syllable prosodially long.

(c) Roots having a penultimate @deva[ऋ], short or long, optionally preserve it, the long @deva[ॠ] being changed to the short one; @deva[वृत्] causal base @deva[वर्तय]=@deva[वर्त्] after dropping @deva[अय], and @deva[वृत्] by this; @deva[वर्त्]=@deva[ववर्त्]; @deva[वृत्]=@deva[ववृत्]=@deva[विवृत्]=@deva[वीवृत्]; @deva[कृत्]—@deva[कीर्तय]=@deva[कीर्त्] and @deva[कृत्] by this; @deva[कीर्त्]—@deva[चिकीर्त्]; @deva[कृत्]—@deva[चीकृत्].

(d) To the base so prepared the augment @deva[अ] is to be prefixed and the terminations added, P. & A., as in the 2nd Variety:—@deva[अबीभवत्]-@deva[त] from @deva[भू]; @deva[अचीचितत्] from @deva[चित्], @deva[अचिस्खलत्]-@deva[त] from @deva[स्खल्], @deva[अपस्पन्दत्]-@deva[त] from @deva[स्पन्द्]; @deva[अववर्तत्]-@deva[त], @deva[अवीवृतत्]-@deva[त] from @deva[वृत्]; @deva[अचिकीर्तत्]-@deva[त], @deva[अचीकृतत्]-@deva[त] fr. @deva[कृत्]; @deva[अपपर्थत्]-@deva[त], @deva[अपीपृथत्]-@deva[त] from @deva[पृथ्], &c.

@note[type=note]{N. B. The Ātm. form in @deva[त] when not given should be supposed to be understood.}

rules.title: Third Aorist of Bases with Initial Vowels
rules.body:
## Third Aorist of Bases with Initial Vowels

Bases with initial vowels:—

(a) If a root begins with a vowel and ends in a single consonant, the consonant is reduplicated and @deva[इ] added to it in the reduplicative syllable: @deva[अद्]=@deva[अद्द्]=@deva[आदिद्]=@deva[आदिदत्]-@deva[त]; @deva[आप्]=@deva[आपिपत्]-@deva[त]; @deva[ऊह्]=@deva[औजिहत्]-@deva[त], &c.

(b) If it ends in a conjunct consonant with @deva[न्], @deva[द्] or @deva[र्] for its first member, the second member of the conjunct is reduplicated: @deva[उन्द्]=@deva[उन्द्द्]=@deva[उन्दिद्] and finally @deva[औन्दिदत्]-@deva[त] 3 sing; similarly @deva[आट्टिट्टत्]-@deva[त] from @deva[अट्ट्] (considered as @deva[अद्द्], otherwise @deva[आटिट्टत्]), @deva[आर्जिहत्]-@deva[त] from @deva[अर्ह्]; @deva[आर्जिजत्]-@deva[त] from @deva[अर्ज्], &c.

(c) The roots @deva[ऊर्ण्], @deva[अङ्क्], @deva[अङ्ग्], @deva[अन्ध्], @deva[अंस्], @deva[अर्थ्] Ātm. and some others, substitute @deva[अ] for @deva[इ] in the reduplicative syllable; 3 sing. @deva[औननत्], @deva[आब्रकत्], @deva[आञ्जगत्], @deva[आन्दधत्], @deva[आंससत्], @deva[आर्तथत्]; &c.

rules.title: Reduplication Rules for Roots Ending in @deva[उ]
rules.body:
## Reduplication Rules for Roots Ending in @deva[उ]

Roots ending in @deva[उ], short or long, substitute @deva[उ] (changeable to @deva[ऊ] like @deva[इ]) for @deva[इ] in the reduplicative syllable, provided it be not (immediately) followed by a labial consonant or a semivowel or @deva[ज्], followed by @deva[अ] or @deva[आ]; @deva[नु]-@deva[अनूनवत्]-@deva[त], @deva[कू]-@deva[अचूकवत्]-@deva[त], @deva[दू]-@deva[अदूदवत्], @deva[द्यु]-@deva[अदुद्यवत्]-@deva[त], &c. But @deva[पू]-@deva[अपीपवत्]-@deva[त], @deva[भू]-@deva[अबीभवत्]-@deva[त], @deva[जु] 'to hasten' @deva[अजीजवत्], @deva[म्रु] 'to bind'—@deva[अमीमवत्], @deva[यु] 'to bind' @deva[अयीयवत्], @deva[रु]-@deva[अरीरवत्]-@deva[त]; @deva[लू]-@deva[अलीलवत्], &c.

(a) The roots @deva[स्रु], @deva[श्रु], @deva[द्रु], @deva[प्रु] 'to go,' @deva[प्लु] 'to swim' and @deva[च्यु] optionally retain the @deva[इ]: @deva[असिस्रवत्] or @deva[असुस्रवत्], @deva[अशिश्रवत्] or @deva[अशुश्रवत्], @deva[अदिद्रवत्] or @deva[अदुद्रवत्], @deva[अपिप्रवत्] or @deva[अपुप्रवत्], @deva[अपिप्लुवत्] or @deva[अपुप्लुवत्], @deva[अचिच्यवत्] or @deva[अचुच्यवत्]-@deva[त].

rules.title: Roots Shortening Vowels in Third Aorist
rules.body:
## Roots Shortening Vowels in Third Aorist

The roots @deva[भ्राज्], @deva[भास्], @deva[भाष्], @deva[दीप्], @deva[जीव्], @deva[मील्], @deva[पीड्], @deva[कण्] 'to moan,' @deva[चण्] 'to sound,' 'to go,' @deva[रण्] 'to sound,' @deva[भण्], @deva[वण्] 'to sound,' @deva[श्रण्] 'to give,' @deva[लुप्] 6. P. A. 'to cut,' @deva[हेठ्] 'to harass,' @deva[ह्वे], @deva[लुट्], @deva[लुठ्] and @deva[लुप्] 4 P., shorten their penultimate optionally; 1. sing:—@deva[अबिभ्रजम्] or @deva[अबभ्राजम्], @deva[अबीभसम्] or @deva[अबभासम्], @deva[अबीभषम्] or @deva[अबभाषम्], @deva[अदीदिपम्] or @deva[अदिदीपम्], @deva[अजीजिवम्] or @deva[अजिजीवम्], @deva[अमीमिलम्] or @deva[अमिमीलम्], @deva[अपीपिडम्] or @deva[अपिपीडम्], @deva[अचीकणम्] or @deva[अचकाणम्], @deva[अचीचणम्] or @deva[अचचाणम्], @deva[अरीरणम्] or @deva[अरराणम्], @deva[अबीभणम्] or @deva[अबभाणम्], @deva[अवीवणम्] or @deva[अववाणम्], @deva[अशिश्रणम्] or @deva[अशश्राणम्], @deva[अलूलुपम्] or @deva[अलुलोपम्], @deva[अजीहिठम्] or @deva[अजिहेठम्], @deva[अजूहवम्] or @deva[अजुहावम्] (see @ref[553] below), @deva[अलूलुटम्] or @deva[अलुलोटम्], @deva[अलूलुठम्] or @deva[अलुलोठम्]; &c.

rules.title: Reduplicative Syllable @deva[अ] Not Changed to @deva[इ]
rules.body:
## Reduplicative Syllable @deva[अ] Not Changed to @deva[इ]

The @deva[अ] of the reduplicative syllable of @deva[स्मृ], @deva[दृ], @deva[त्वर्], @deva[प्रथ्], @deva[म्रद्] 'to pound, to wish,' @deva[स्तृ] and @deva[स्पश्], is not changed to @deva[इ]; @deva[वेष्ट्] 1 Ā. 'to surround' and @deva[चेष्ट्] optionally change their @deva[इ] to @deva[अ]; 1 sing. @deva[असस्मरम्], @deva[अददरम्], @deva[अतत्वरम्], @deva[अपप्रथम्], @deva[अमम्रदम्], @deva[अतस्तरम्], @deva[अपस्पशम्]; @deva[वेष्ट्]—@deva[अविवेष्टम्], @deva[अववेष्टम्]; @deva[चेष्ट्]—@deva[अचिचेष्टम्], @deva[अचचेष्टम्].

rules.title: Samprasāraṇa in Third Aorist
rules.body:
## Samprasāraṇa in Third Aorist

The roots @deva[ह्वे] and @deva[स्वप्] cau. take Samprasāraṇa; @deva[श्वि] does it optionally; @deva[ह्वे]-@deva[हु]-@deva[हावय्]—@deva[हाव्] or @deva[हव्], then @deva[जुहव्], @deva[जुहाव्] by @ref[550]; then @deva[अजुहावम्], @deva[अजूहवम्]; @deva[स्वप्]—@deva[स्वापय्]—@deva[स्वाप्]—@deva[सुप्]—@deva[सुषुप्]—@deva[सूषुप्]; @deva[असूषुपम्]; @deva[श्वि]—@deva[अशूशवम्], @deva[अशिश्वयम्] 1st sing.

rules.title: Roots Preserving Vowel in Reduplicative Syllable
rules.body:
## Roots Preserving Vowel in Reduplicative Syllable

The roots given under @ref[400] preserve their vowel unchanged; i. e. do not substitute @deva[इ] in the reduplicative syllable, &c. @deva[कथ्]—@deva[अचकथत्], @deva[वर्]—@deva[अववरत्], @deva[शठ्]—@deva[अशशठत्], @deva[रह्]—@deva[अररहत्], @deva[पत्]—@deva[अपपतत्], @deva[स्पृह्]—@deva[अपस्पृहत्], @deva[सूच्]—@deva[असुसूचत्].

rules.title: Roots Not Shortening Penultimate Vowel
rules.body:
## Roots Not Shortening Penultimate Vowel

The roots @deva[शास्], @deva[एज्], @deva[काश्], @deva[क्रीड्], @deva[क्षीब्], @deva[खाद्], @deva[खेल्], @deva[ढौक्], @deva[ताय्], @deva[दाश्], @deva[देव्], @deva[नाथ्], @deva[प्रोथ्], @deva[बाध्], @deva[याच्], @deva[योध्], @deva[राध्], @deva[राज्], @deva[लाघ्], @deva[लेप्], @deva[लोक्], @deva[लोच्], @deva[वेप्], @deva[वेल्], @deva[श्लाघ्], @deva[श्लोक्], @deva[सेक्], @deva[सेव्], @deva[हेष्], and others less important, do not shorten their penultimate; 3 sing. @deva[अशशासत्], @deva[ऐजिजत्], @deva[अचकाशत्], @deva[अचिक्रीडत्], @deva[अचिक्षिवत्], @deva[अचखादत्], @deva[अचिखेलत्], &c.

rules.title: Irregular Causal Aorist Forms
rules.body:
## Irregular Causal Aorist Forms

Roots which form their Causal Aorist irregularly:—

@deva[इ] with @deva[अधि] 'to study,—@deva[अध्यापिपत्], @deva[अध्यजीगपत्], (@deva[इ] with @deva[अधि] 'to remember' @deva[अध्यजीगमत्]).

@deva[ईर्ष्य्] 'to envy'—@deva[ऐर्षिष्यत्]-@deva[त], @deva[ऐर्ष्ययत्]-@deva[त]

@deva[ऊर्णु]—@deva[और्णूनवत्]

@deva[गण्]—@deva[अजगणत्], @deva[अजीगणत्]

@deva[घ्रा]—@deva[अजिघ्रपत्], @deva[अजिघ्रिपत्]

@deva[चकास्]—@deva[अचीचकासत्], @deva[अचचकासत्]

@deva[द्युत्]—@deva[अदुद्युतत्]-@deva[त]

@deva[पा] 'to drink' @deva[अपीप्यत्] (@deva[पा] 'to protect' forms its Causal Aorist regularly as @deva[अपीपलत्]).

@deva[स्था]—@deva[अतिष्ठिपत्]-@deva[त].

@deva[स्फुर्]—@deva[अपुस्फुरत्]-@deva[त].

### Paradigms

**@deva[कृ] 'to do.'**

**Parasmaipada:**

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अचीकरम्] | @deva[अचीकराव] | @deva[अचीकराम] |
| 2. | @deva[अचीकरः] | @deva[अचीकरतम्] | @deva[अचीकरत] |
| 3. | @deva[अचीकरत्] | @deva[अचीकरताम्] | @deva[अचीकरन्] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अचीकरे] | @deva[अचीकरावहि] | @deva[अचीकरामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अचीकरथाः] | @deva[अचीकरेथाम्] | @deva[अचीकरध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अचीकरत] | @deva[अचीकरेताम्] | @deva[अचीकरन्त] |

**@deva[त्रप्].**

**Parasmaipada:**

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अतित्रपम्] | @deva[अतित्रपाव] | @deva[अतित्रपाम] |
| 2. | @deva[अतित्रपः] | @deva[अतित्रपतम्] | @deva[अतित्रपत] |
| 3. | @deva[अतित्रपत्] | @deva[अतित्रपताम्] | @deva[अतित्रपन्] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अतित्रपे] | @deva[अतित्रपावहि] | @deva[अतित्रपामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अतित्रपथाः] | @deva[अतित्रपेथाम्] | @deva[अतित्रपध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अतित्रपत] | @deva[अतित्रपेताम्] | @deva[अतित्रपन्त] |

**@deva[चुर्].**

**Parasmaipada:**

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अचूचुरम्] | @deva[अचूचुराव] | @deva[अचूचुराम] |
| 2. | @deva[अचूचुरः] | @deva[अचूचुरतम्] | @deva[अचूचुरत] |
| 3. | @deva[अचूचुरत्] | @deva[अचूचुरताम्] | @deva[अचूचुरन्] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अचूचुरे] | @deva[अचूचुरावहि] | @deva[अचूचुरामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अचूचुरथाः] | @deva[अचूचुरेथाम्] | @deva[अचूचुरध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अचूचुरत] | @deva[अचूचुरेताम्] | @deva[अचूचुरन्त] |

**SIXTH VARIETY OR FORM**
(Only Parasmaipadi)

@note[type=note]{The Sixth and the Seventh Varieties are given here before the Fourth and Fifth as it is more convenient to do so.}

rules.title: Terminations of the Sixth Form
rules.body:
## Terminations of the Sixth Form

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[सिषम्] | @deva[सिष्व] | @deva[सिष्म] |
| 2. | @deva[सीः] | @deva[सिष्टम्] | @deva[सिष्ट] |
| 3. | @deva[सीत्] | @deva[सिष्टाम्] | @deva[सिषुः] |

rules.title: Roots Taking the Sixth Variety
rules.body:
## Roots Taking the Sixth Variety

Roots ending in @deva[आ] (including those that change their final to @deva[आ]), the roots @deva[यम्], @deva[रम्] P. (i. e. with @deva[वि], @deva[आ], @deva[परि]) and @deva[नम्] take this Variety. @deva[यम्] with @deva[उप] or @deva[उद्], Â. and @deva[रम्] Â. take the fourth Variety.

rules.title: Restrictions on Roots Ending in @deva[आ]
rules.body:
## Restrictions on Roots Ending in @deva[आ]

The roots ending in @deva[आ] which are restricted to the First, Second and Third Varieties do not take this Variety.

### PARADIGMS

**@deva[यम्].**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|

rules.title: Roots Taking the Fourth Form
rules.body:
## Roots Taking the Fourth Form

(a) Aniṭ roots not belonging to any of the preceding Varieties take this Form. Aniṭ roots that optionally take any of the preceding Varieties and Veṭ roots optionally belong to this Variety.

### Exceptions:

(1) @deva[स्तु] and @deva[सु], when Parasmaipadi, belong to the Fifth Variety.

(2) Roots ending in @deva[ऋ] preceded by a conjunct consonant may take Fourth or Fifth Form in the Ātmanepada.

(3) @deva[भञ्ज्] and @deva[धू] Par. take the Fifth Form only. @deva[धू] Â. may take the Fourth or the Fifth Form.

(4) Of Seṭ roots @deva[इ] and those ending in @deva[ऋ] (long) when Ātm. belong to either (4th or 5th Variety). @deva[स्तु], and @deva[क्रम्] when Â. belong to the Fourth.

rules.title: Vowel Changes in Fourth Aorist
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in Fourth Aorist

(a) In the Parasmaipada the radical vowel takes its Vṛddhi substitute; @deva[नी]-@deva[अनैषीत्]; @deva[कृ]-@deva[अकार्षीत्]; @deva[भञ्ज्]-@deva[अभांक्षीत्], &c.

(b) In the Ātmanepada, Guṇa is substituted for final @deva[इ] or @deva[उ], short or long; final @deva[ऋ] and the penultimate vowel remain unchanged; final @deva[ऋ] is changed to @deva[ईर्] or @deva[ऊर्] in accordance with @ref[394]; @deva[चि]-@deva[अचेष्ट], @deva[नी]-@deva[अनेष्ट], @deva[च्यु]-@deva[अच्योष्ट], @deva[सू]-@deva[असोष्ट], @deva[कृ] see below, @deva[भिद्]-@deva[अभित्त], @deva[स्तृ]-@deva[अस्तीर्ष्ट], @deva[वृ]-@deva[अवृष्ट].

(c) The Penultimate @deva[ऋ] of Aniṭ roots is optionally changed to @deva[र]; @deva[कृष्]-@deva[अकार्क्षीत्] or @deva[अक्राक्षीत्].

rules.title: Dropping of @deva[स्] in Fourth Aorist Terminations
rules.body:
## Dropping of @deva[स्] in Fourth Aorist Terminations

After a short vowel, and after a consonant except a nasal or semi-vowel, the @deva[स्] of terminations beginning with @deva[स्त] and @deva[स्थ] is dropped; @deva[हृ]—@deva[अहृत] 3 sing.; @deva[कृ]—@deva[अकृथाः] 2 sing.; @deva[क्षिप्]—@deva[अक्षिप्थाः], @deva[अक्षिप्त]; @deva[कृष्]—@deva[अकृष्ट] 3rd sing. &c.

rules.title: Vowel Substitution in @deva[दा], @deva[धा], @deva[स्था] Roots
rules.body:
## Vowel Substitution in @deva[दा], @deva[धा], @deva[स्था] Roots

@deva[दा], @deva[धा], and roots assuming the forms of @deva[दा] and @deva[धा] (Vide @ref[459]) and @deva[स्था] substitute @deva[इ] for their final vowel in the Ātm. This @deva[इ] does not take its Guṇa substitute. In the Parasm. these roots take the first Variety (vide @ref[532]).

rules.title: Root @deva[हन्] Dropping Nasal
Optional Nasal Dropping in @deva[गम्] and @deva[यम्]
rules.body:
## Optional Nasal Dropping in @deva[गम्] and @deva[यम्]

@deva[गम्], and @deva[यम्] with @deva[उप्] 'to marry,' optionally drop their nasal, when they take the Ātm. terminations. @deva[यम्] when it means 'to give out' (as the faults of others) necessarily drops its nasal

rules.title: Special Forms of @deva[पद्] and @deva[तुभ्]
rules.body:

rules.title: Terminations of the Fifth Form
rules.body:
## Terminations of the Fifth Form

Terminations:—These are obtained by prefixing @deva[इष्] @deva[इ] to the terminations of the Fourth Variety[^1] except in the case of the 2nd and 3rd per. sing.; e. g.

rules.title: Roots Taking the Fifth Variety
rules.body:
## Roots Taking the Fifth Variety

All roots not restricted to any of the preceding Varieties take this Variety. Consequently it is peculiar to Seṭ roots (Vide @ref[565]).

rules.title: Vowel Changes in Fifth Aorist
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in Fifth Aorist

(a) In the Parasmaipada, the final radical vowel and the penultimate @deva[अ] of roots ending in @deva[र्] or @deva[ल्] and that of @deva[वद्] and @deva[त्रज्] take their Vṛddhi substitute necessarily; @deva[लू]-@deva[अलाविषम्]; @deva[चर्]—@deva[अचारिषम्]; @deva[फल्]-@deva[अफालिषम्], &c.

(b) The penultimate short vowel of a root takes its Guṇa substitute; @deva[क्रुश्]-@deva[अक्रोषिषम्], &c.

(c) Vṛddhi is optionally substituted for the penultimate @deva[अ], not prosodially long, of roots having an initial consonant and not ending in @deva[र्] or @deva[ल्]; @deva[पद्]—@deva[अपादिषम्], @deva[अपदिषम्]; @deva[गह्]—@deva[अगाहिषम्]—@deva[अगहिषम्].

(d) But the vowel of roots ending in @deva[स्], @deva[व्], @deva[य], and of the roots @deva[क्षप्], @deva[क्षर्], @deva[नाघ्], @deva[चि], @deva[कट्] 'to cover, to surround,' @deva[वद्], 'to break, to pierce,' @deva[चत्], @deva[चर्], 'to ask, to beg,' @deva[वश्] 'to go or move,' @deva[मथ्] 'to churn,' @deva[लम्] 'to stick or cling to,' @deva[हुस्] and @deva[स्वस्] 'to sound or to be diminished,' does not take its Vṛddhi substitute.

(e) In the Ātmanepada the radical vowel takes its Guṇa substitute; @deva[लू]—@deva[अलेष्ट].

### Paradigms

| Root | 1st Sing. | 3rd Sing. | Root | 1st Sing. | 3rd Sing. |

| @deva[स्तु] | @deva[अस्ताविषम्] | @deva[अस्ताबीत्] | @deva[रद्] | @deva[अरदिसि] | @deva[अरदिष्ट] |

| | @deva[अरदिषि][^1] (Âtm.) | @deva[अरदीषिष्ठाष्] | @deva[भूज्] | @deva[अभाजिषम्] | @deva[अभाजीत्] |
| @deva[इ], @deva[हू] Â | @deva[अविषिषि]-@deva[अवरीषि] | @deva[अवरीषिष्] | @deva[वृत्] | @deva[अवर्तिषम्], @deva[अवर्तिषि] | |

| @deva[वध्] | @deva[अवधीषम्] or @deva[अवधिषिम्] (Par and Âtm.) (See @ref[569]) | | | | |

rules.title: Optional @deva[इ] for @deva[इष्ट] Substitution
rules.body:
## Optional @deva[इ] for @deva[इष्ट] Substitution

The roots @deva[दीप्], @deva[जन्], @deva[पूर्], @deva[ताय्] and @deva[प्याय्] optionally substitute @deva[इ] for @deva[इष्ट] (third person sing. Ātm.).

---

[^4]: Vide p. 249 foot-note; @deva[गुह्] also takes 7th Variety.

rules.title: 8th Class Roots Ending in Nasals
rules.body:
## 8th Class Roots Ending in Nasals

Roots of the 8th class ending in @deva[न्] or @deva[ण्] drop their nasal and substitute optionally @deva[यास्] and @deva[न्] for the terminations @deva[ष्ठाः] and @deva[ष्] of the 2nd and 3rd person sing. Âtm. @deva[तृण्] lengthens its vowel after dropping @deva[ण्], Ātm.

rules.title: Vowel Changes in @deva[ऊर्ण्]
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in @deva[ऊर्ण्]

The vowel of @deva[ऊर्ण्] takes Vṛddhi optionally in the Parasm, i. e. optionally takes Guṇa substitute; also it optionally remains unchanged before @deva[इ] (Vide @ref[466], @ref[518]).

rules.title: Optional Dropping of @deva[आ] in @deva[दरिद्रा]
rules.body:
## Optional Dropping of @deva[आ] in @deva[दरिद्रा]

The @deva[आ] of @deva[दरिद्रा] is optionally dropped in the Aorist; consequently it takes the Sixth and the Fifth Varieties.

### PARADIGMS

**@deva[ऊर्णु]**

| 2. | @deva[और्णुवीः] | @deva[और्णुविष्टम्] | @deva[और्णुविष्ट] |
| 3. | @deva[और्णुवीत्] | @deva[और्णुविष्टाम्] | @deva[और्णुविषुः] |

**(6) THE BENEDICTIVE (@deva[आशीर्लिङ्]).**

rules.title: Benedictive Mood Terminations
rules.body:
## Benedictive Mood Terminations

The Parasmaipada terminations of this mood may be obtained by prefixing @deva[यास्] to those of the Imperative after dropping its final @deva[स्] before @deva[स्त्] and @deva[त्] of the 2nd and 3rd per. sings.; and the Ātmanepada ones by prefixing @deva[स्] to the terminations of the Ātm. Potential and also to the @deva[त्] and @deva[थ्] occurring in them. These, therefore, are:—

**Parasmaipada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[यासम्] | @deva[यास्व] | @deva[यास्म] |
| 2. | @deva[याः] | @deva[यास्तम्] | @deva[यास्त] |
| 3. | @deva[यात्] | @deva[यास्ताम्] | @deva[यासुः] |

**Ātmanepada:**

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[सीय] | @deva[सीवहि] | @deva[सीमहि] |
| 2. | @deva[सीष्ठाः] | @deva[सीयाथाम्] | @deva[सीध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[सीष्ट] | @deva[सीयाताम्] | @deva[सीरन्] |

(a) Parasmaipadā.

rules.title: Benedictive Parasmaipada: No Guṇa or Vṛddhi
rules.body:
## Benedictive Parasmaipada: No Guṇa or Vṛddhi

The Par. terminations are weak and therefore occasion no Guṇa or Vṛddhi change in the root. All roots reject the augment @deva[इ].

rules.title: Vowel Changes in Benedictive Before Parasmaipada Terminations
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in Benedictive Before Parasmaipada Terminations

The final @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] is lengthened; final @deva[ऋ] short is changed to @deva[रि], and final @deva[ऋ] changed to @deva[ऋर्] or to @deva[ऊर्] when preceded by a labial or @deva[व्] before the Par. terminations of the Benedictive, and the @deva[य] of the Passive.

**Examples:**
- @deva[चि]—@deva[चीयात्]
- @deva[स्तु]—@deva[स्तुयात्]
- @deva[कृ]—@deva[कुरियात्]
- @deva[लृ]—@deva[लीरियात्]
- @deva[वृ]—@deva[वूरियात्], &c.

rules.title: Guṇa Substitution for Final @deva[ऋ] in Benedictive
rules.body:
## Guṇa Substitution for Final @deva[ऋ] in Benedictive

Final @deva[ऋ] preceded by a conjunct consonant and the root @deva[ऋ] are changed to Guṇa under the same circumstances.

**Examples:**
- @deva[स्मृ]—@deva[स्मर्यात्]
- @deva[ऋ]—@deva[अर्यात्]

rules.title: Samprasāraṇa in Benedictive
rules.body:
## Samprasāraṇa in Benedictive

Roots capable of taking Samprasāraṇa take it. @deva[शास्] substitutes @deva[इ] for its vowel.

rules.title: Dropping of Penultimate Nasal in Benedictive
Final Vowel Changes to @deva[ए] in Benedictive
Prefixing @deva[इ] to Benedictive Terminations
rules.body:
## Prefixing @deva[इ] to Benedictive Terminations

### (a) Seṭ and Veṭ Roots

@deva[इ] is prefixed to the terminations after Seṭ roots and optionally after Veṭ ones.

### (b) Roots Ending in @deva[ऋ]

Roots ending in @deva[ऋ] preceded by a conjunct consonant, the root @deva[ऋ] and roots ending in @deva[ॠ] admit of @deva[इ] optionally.

rules.title: Ātmanepada Benedictive Terminations and Paradigms
rules.body:
## Ātmanepada Benedictive Terminations and Paradigms

The Ātm. terminations, are strong. Before these radical vowel takes its Guṇa substitute, but when the intermediate @deva[इ] is not prefixed to the terminations, the final @deva[ऋ] remains unchanged and @deva[ऋ] is changed to @deva[ऋर्], or to @deva[उर्] if a labial or @deva[व्] precedes.

**Examples:**
- @deva[चि]—@deva[चेषीष्ट]
- @deva[धु]—@deva[धोषीष्ट]
- @deva[लृ]—@deva[लिरिषीष्ट]
- @deva[स्तृ]—@deva[स्तरिषीष्ट], or @deva[स्तीरिषीष्ट]
- @deva[वृ]—@deva[वुरिषीष्ट] or @deva[वूरिषीष्ट], &c.

rules.title: Special Cases: @deva[ई] and @deva[ऊह्] in Benedictive
Formation of Passive Voice
rules.body:
## Formation of Passive Voice

Every root in every one of the ten conjugational classes may take a Passive form conjugated like an Ātmanepadi root of the 4th Class.[^1]

---

[^1]: The only difference is in the accent; in the Passive it falls on @deva[य], whereas in the case of the primitive verbs of the 4th class, Ātm., it falls on the radical syllable.

rules.title: Three Types of Passive Verbs
rules.body:
## Three Types of Passive Verbs

There are three kinds of Passive Verbs:

1. **The Passive properly so called** (@deva[कर्मणि प्र॰]), as @deva[राघेण क्रयं दीयते]

2. **An Impersonal Passive** (@deva[भावे प्र॰]), as @deva[गच्यते] 'it is gone'

3. **A Reflexive** (@deva[आत्मनेपदी प्र॰]), as @deva[ओदनं पच्यते] 'rice is cooked'

---

**CONJUGATIONAL TENSES.**

rules.title: Formation of Passive Base with @deva[य]
rules.body:
## Formation of Passive Base with @deva[य]

### (a) Addition of @deva[य]

@deva[य] is added to the root, which is weak i. e. no Guṇa or Vṛddhi substitute takes place before it.

**Examples:**
- @deva[नी]—@deva[नीय]
- @deva[भिद्]—@deva[भिद्य]

### (b) Changes Before @deva[य]

Before @deva[य] roots undergo the same changes as they do before the Par. terminations of the Benedictive.

**Examples:**
- @deva[जि]—@deva[जीय]
- @deva[कृ]—@deva[क्रिय]
- @deva[स्मृ]—@deva[स्मर्य]
- @deva[ऋ]—@deva[अर्य]
- @deva[कॄ]—@deva[कीर्य]
- @deva[पॄ]—@deva[पूर्य]
- @deva[बन्ध्]—@deva[बध्य] (but @deva[निन्द्]—@deva[निन्द्य])
- @deva[वच्]—@deva[उच्य]
- @deva[ग्रह्]—@deva[गृह्य], &c.

### (c) Final @deva[आ] Changed to @deva[ई]

The final @deva[आ] (original or substituted) of @deva[दा] 'to give,' @deva[दे], @deva[दो], @deva[धा], @deva[धे], @deva[मा], @deva[गै], @deva[पा] 'to drink,' @deva[सो] and @deva[हा] 'to abandon' is changed to @deva[ई]; in other cases it remains unchanged.

**Examples:**
- @deva[दा] and @deva[दो]—@deva[दीय]
- @deva[गै]—@deva[गीय]
- @deva[हा]—@deva[हीय]

@note[type=exception]{@deva[दा] 'to cut, to purify'—@deva[दाय]; @deva[ज्ञा]—@deva[ज्ञाय]; @deva[ध्यै]—@deva[ध्याय].}

rules.title: Conjugation of Passive Base as Fourth Class
rules.body:
## Conjugation of Passive Base as Fourth Class

The passive base is conjugated like a root of the 4th class in the Âtm., i. e.[^1]

### Paradigm: @deva[भू] 'to be'

#### Present

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[भूये] | @deva[भूयावहे] | @deva[भूयामहे] |
| 2. | @deva[भूयसे] | @deva[भूयेथे] | @deva[भूयध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[भूयते] | @deva[भूयेते] | @deva[भूयन्ते] |

#### Imperfect

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अभूये] | @deva[अभूयावहि] | @deva[अभूयामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अभूयथाः] | @deva[अभूयेथाम्] | @deva[अभूयध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अभूयत] | @deva[अभूयेताम्] | @deva[अभूयन्त] |

#### Imperative

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[भूये] | @deva[भूयावहै] | @deva[भूयामहै] |
| 2. | @deva[भूयस्व] | @deva[भूयेथाम्] | @deva[भूयध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[भूयताम्] | @deva[भूयेताम्] | @deva[भूयन्ताम्] |

#### Potential

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[भूयेय] | @deva[भूयेवहि] | @deva[भूयेमहि] |
| 2. | @deva[भूयेथाः] | @deva[भूयेयाथाम्] | @deva[भूयेध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[भूयेत] | @deva[भूयेयाताम्] | @deva[भूयेरन्] |

### Paradigm: @deva[बुध्] 'to know'

#### Present

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[बुध्ये] | @deva[बुध्यावहे] | @deva[बुध्यामहे] |
| 2. | @deva[बुध्यसे] | @deva[बुध्येथे] | @deva[बुध्यध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[बुध्यते] | @deva[बुध्येते] | @deva[बुध्यन्ते] |

#### Imperfect

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[अबुध्ये] | @deva[अबुध्यावहि] | @deva[अबुध्यामहि] |
| 2. | @deva[अबुध्यथाः] | @deva[अबुध्येथाम्] | @deva[अबुध्यध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[अबुध्यत] | @deva[अबुध्येताम्] | @deva[अबुध्यन्त] |

#### Imperative

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[बुध्ये] | @deva[बुध्यावहै] | @deva[बुध्यामहै] |
| 2. | @deva[बुध्यस्व] | @deva[बुध्येथाम्] | @deva[बुध्यध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[बुध्यताम्] | @deva[बुध्येताम्] | @deva[बुध्यन्ताम्] |

#### Potential

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[बुध्येय] | @deva[बुध्येवहि] | @deva[बुध्येमहि] |
| 2. | @deva[बुध्येथाः] | @deva[बुध्येयाथाम्] | @deva[बुध्येध्वम्] |
| 3. | @deva[बुध्येत] | @deva[बुध्येयाताम्] | @deva[बुध्येरन्] |

---

[^1]: It might even be suspected, that the occasional assumption of an Intransitive signification and a Parasmaipada inflexion by a passive verb, was the cause which gave rise to a 4th class of Primitive verbs as distinct from the Passive. Instances of passively formed of passive verbs taking Parasmaipada terminations, and some passive verbs (e. g. @[jāyate] 'is born,' tr. @[jan]; @[pūryate], 'is filled,' tr. @[pṛ]; and @[upyate] 'is heated,' tr. @[tap]) are regarded by native grammarians as Âtmanepada verbs of cl. 4. Again, many roots appear in class 4 as Intransitive verbs, which also appear in some one of the other nine as Transitive. For example, @[yuj], 'to join' when used in a Transitive sense, is conjugated either in cl. 7, or in the Causal; when in an Intransitive, in cl. 4. So also @[puṣ], 'to nourish,' @[kṣubh], 'to agitate;' @[kliś] 'to vex'; @[ślāgh], 'to accomplish,' &c. — Monier Williams.

rules.title: Special Cases in Passive Base Formation
rules.body:
## Special Cases in Passive Base Formation

### (a) Nasal Dropping with Vowel Lengthening

The roots @deva[स्तञ्ज्], @deva[जन्], @deva[तन्], and @deva[सञ्ज्], 'to sprinkle' drop their @deva[न्] and at the same time lengthen their vowel.

**Examples:**
- @deva[स्तान्यते]
- @deva[जान्यते], &c.

### (b) Special Base Forms

@deva[शी] 'to lie down' and @deva[चि] form their bases as @deva[शय्] and @deva[चय्].

### (c) Vowel Shortening with Prepositions

@deva[ऊह्] shortens its @deva[ऊ] when a preposition is prefixed.

### (d) Final Vowel Elision

@deva[दरिद्रा], @deva[दौषी] and @deva[वेणी] drop their final vowel before @deva[य].

### (e) Special Substitutions

@deva[हू] and @deva[अस्] substitute @deva[हुय्] and @deva[अस्य्] for themselves; @deva[यज्] and @deva[भञ्ज्] also substitute @deva[इज्] and @deva[भज्] respectively.

rules.title: Perfect Forms in Passive Voice
rules.body:
## Perfect Forms in Passive Voice

### (a) Reduplicative Perfect

The Reduplicative Perfect of a root in the Passive is formed like that of the Active, except in that the Auxiliary verb @deva[भू] is used instead of @deva[अस्].

**Example:**
@deva[क्रीयते]—@deva[क्रीयां बभूव] &c.

### (b) Periphrastic Perfect

The Periphrastic Perfect of the Passive does not differ from that of the Active, except in that the Auxiliary verb @deva[भू]—@deva[चकार] is used.

**Examples:**
- @deva[क्रीयते]—@deva[क्रीयां चकार]
- @deva[पूज्यते]—@deva[पूजां चकार]

And before it @deva[इस्] is used.

rules.title: Futures, Conditional and Benedictive in Passive
rules.body:
## Futures, Conditional and Benedictive in Passive

### (a) Forms in Impersonal Passive

The forms of the two Futures, Conditional and also the Benedictive (especially @deva[भावे]—Passive, briefly stated below.

### (b) Optional Forms with Vṛddhi

The Aorist optionally forms the Futures, Conditional as well as the Benedictive of the Passive by changing their vowels to Vṛddhi and then by @deva[आ] regarded to them invariably; in the case of roots ending in a vowel, the vowel is lengthened before @deva[इ]; and the @deva[य्] inserted between the root and this @deva[इ].

**Examples:**
- @deva[दा]—@deva[दायिष्यते], @deva[दायि], @deva[दायात्]
- @deva[वच्]—@deva[वच्य]@deva[च्यते]
- @deva[युज्]@deva[यते]—@deva[युज्+य]
- @deva[चकरे] 'to do'—@deva[कारिष्यते], @deva[कारि], @deva[कार्यात्]

@note[type=exception]{See @ref[468]; these forms strictly forbidden with them; only @deva[इस्] used.}

### (c) Additional Forms

The First Future, Conditional and the 5th Variety of the Aorist containing a nasal or a @deva[र्], @deva[त्], @deva[स्] of the Passive, &c.

rules.title: Aorist Passive Formation Rules
rules.body:
## Aorist Passive Formation Rules

### (a) Fourth, Fifth and Seventh Varieties

The Passive of the Aorist of roots belonging to the 4th, 5th and 7th Varieties is made up similarly by appending the Ātmanepada terminations to the base.

**Examples:**
- @deva[भू]—@deva[अभाविषि]
- @deva[कृ]—@deva[अकारिषि]
- @deva[धा]—@deva[अधिषि]
- @deva[पच्]—@deva[अपक्षि]
- @deva[दिश्]—@deva[अदिक्षि]
- @deva[द्विष्]—@deva[अद्विक्षि], &c.

### (b) Varieties Taking Fourth, Fifth or Seventh Form

Roots belonging to the first, second, third and sixth Varieties take the fourth, fifth or seventh Variety in the Passive, in accordance with the general rules.

**Examples:**
- @deva[स्था]—@deva[अस्थिषि] 1 sing.
- @deva[ह्वा]—@deva[अह्वासि]
- @deva[जॄ]—@deva[अजरिषि]
- @deva[श्रि]—@deva[अश्रायिषि]
- @deva[स्तु]—@deva[अस्तोषि]
- @deva[नम्]—@deva[अनंसि], &c.

### (c) Third Person Singular with @deva[इ]

The third per. sing. of the Aorist Passive of all roots is formed by adding @deva[इ]—

#### (1) Guṇa and Vṛddhi Substitution Rules

Before this @deva[इ] the penultimate (prosodially) short vowel takes its Guṇa substitute, and penultimate @deva[अ] except that of @deva[जन्] and of Seṭ roots ending in @deva[अम्] except @deva[चम्] with @deva[आ], @deva[कम्], and @deva[वम्], and the final vowel take their Vṛddhi substitute.

**Examples:**
- @deva[भिद्]—@deva[अभेदि]
- but @deva[निन्द्]—@deva[अनिन्दि]
- @deva[तुद्]—@deva[अतोदि]
- @deva[कृष्]—@deva[अकार्षि]
- @deva[वद्]—@deva[अवादि]
- @deva[पद्]—@deva[अपादि]
- but @deva[जन्]—@deva[अजनि]
- @deva[गम्]—@deva[अगामि]
- but @deva[दम्]—@deva[अदमि], &c.
- @deva[चम्] with @deva[आ]—@deva[आचामि]
- @deva[कम्]—@deva[अकामि], &c.
- @deva[नी]—@deva[अनायि]
- @deva[स्तु]—@deva[अस्तावि]
- @deva[लू]—@deva[अलावि]
- @deva[कॄ] or @deva[कृ]—@deva[अकारि]

#### (2) Roots Ending in @deva[आ]

Roots ending in @deva[आ] original or substituted (i. e. of roots in @deva[ए], @deva[ऐ], @deva[ओ]) insert @deva[य्] before this @deva[इ].

**Examples:**
- @deva[दा]—@deva[अदायि]
- @deva[धे]—@deva[अधायि]
- @deva[गै]—@deva[अगायि]
- @deva[शो]—@deva[अशायि], &c.

#### (3) Nasal Insertion

@deva[रध्], @deva[जभ्] and @deva[रभ्] insert a nasal before their final consonant, so that their penultimate @deva[अ] cannot take Guṇa or Vṛddhi substitute.

**Examples:**
- @deva[अरन्धि]
- @deva[अजम्भि]
- @deva[अरम्भि]

#### (4) @deva[लभ्] Rules

@deva[लभ्] without a preposition does the same optionally and with a preposition necessarily.

**Examples:**
- @deva[अलम्भि], @deva[अलाभि]
- but @deva[प्रालम्भि]

#### (5) Special Forms

@deva[भञ्ज्] 'to break' forms @deva[अभञ्जि] or @deva[अभाजि]; @deva[शम्]—@deva[अशमि] and @deva[अशामि] in the sense of 'to observe (10 Â.).'

#### (6) @deva[मृज्] and @deva[गृह्]

@deva[मृज्] takes Vṛddhi; @deva[गृह्] lengthens its vowel; @deva[अमार्जि], @deva[अग्राहि].

#### (7) @deva[इ] Forms

@deva[इ] 'to go' has @deva[अगायि]; with @deva[अधि] Â., @deva[अध्यायि] or @deva[अध्यगायि].

### (d) Roots at § 461

The roots at @ref[461] will have two forms.

**Examples:**
- @deva[गुप्]—@deva[अगोपि], @deva[अगोपायि]
- @deva[विच्छ्]—@deva[अविच्छि], @deva[अविच्छायि] &c.
- @deva[ऋत्]—@deva[आर्ति] or @deva[आर्तियि] 3 sing.

### (e) Optional Forms

@ref[596] (b) holds good in the Passive Aorist except in the 3rd sing.; the optional forms must be made up by appending the Ātm. terminations of the 5th Variety as the roots necessarily take @deva[इ].

**Examples:**
- @deva[दा]—@deva[अदिषि], @deva[अदायिषि]
- @deva[नी]—@deva[अनेषि], @deva[अनायिषि]
- @deva[कृ]—@deva[अकृषि], @deva[अकारिषि]
- @deva[हन्]—@deva[आहसि], @deva[अघानिषि]; @deva[अवधिषि] 1 sing.
- @deva[ग्रह्]—@deva[अग्रहीषि], @deva[अग्राहिषि] 1 sing. &c.

rules.title: Passive Forms of Tenth Class Roots
rules.body:
## Passive Forms of Tenth Class Roots

### (a) Optional Dropping of @deva[अय्]

The @deva[अय्] (i. e. @deva[अय] with the final @deva[अ] dropped) is optionally dropped in the General Tenses, except the Perfect. The Aorist forms, except that of the 3rd sing., are made up by adding the terminations of the Fifth Form.

**Examples (@deva[चुर्] 1 sing.):**
- @deva[चोरयांचक्रे]-@deva[बभूवे], @deva[चोरयामासे] Perf.
- @deva[चोरयिताहे], @deva[चोरिताहे] 1st Fu.
- @deva[चोरयिष्ये], @deva[चोरिष्ये] 2nd Fu.
- @deva[अचोरयिषि], @deva[अचोरिषि] Aor.
- @deva[चोरयिषीय], @deva[चोरिषीय] Ben.

### (b) Optional Lengthening

Roots which do not lengthen their penultimate @deva[अ] (see also @ref[603]) lengthen it optionally in the general Tenses of the Passive, except in Perf., when @deva[अय्] is dropped.

**Example:**
@deva[कथ्]—@deva[अकथयिषि], @deva[अकथिषि] Aor. 1 sing., &c.

### (c) Third Person Singular

The 3 per. sing. of the Pass. Aorist is formed by dropping @deva[अय्] necessarily and adding @deva[इ].

**Examples:**
- @deva[चोरय]—@deva[अचोर्]—@deva[अचोरि]
- @deva[पीड्]—@deva[अपीडि]
- @deva[पॄ]—@deva[अपारि], &c.
- @deva[रह्]—@deva[अरहि], @deva[अराहि] Aor. 3 sing.
- @deva[रम्]—@deva[अरमि], @deva[अरामि] Aorist, 3rd sing. &c.

### Paradigms

#### @deva[बुध्] 1 P. 'to know'

##### Perfect

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[बुबुधे] | @deva[बुबुधिवहे] | @deva[बुबुधिमहे] |
| 2. | @deva[बुबुधिषे] | @deva[बुबुधाथे] | @deva[बुबुधिध्वे] |
| 3. | @deva[बुबुधे] | @deva[बुबुधाते] | @deva[बुबुधिरे] |

##### 1st Future

| | Singular | Dual | Plural |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. | @deva[बोधिताहे] | @deva[बोधितास्वहे] | @deva[बोधितास्महे] |
| 2. | @deva[बोधितासे] | @deva[बोधितासाथे] | @deva[बोधिताध्वे] |
