**SECTION III.**

**DERIVATIVE VERBS** (@deva[प्रत्ययान्तधातवः])
and
**THEIR CONJUGATION.**

rules.title: Classification of Derivative Verbs
rules.body:
## Classification of Derivative Verbs

The Derivative Verbs are divided into four classes:

1. **Causals or Nijantas** (@deva[णिजन्तः])
2. **Desideratives or Sanantas** (@deva[सन्नन्तः])
3. **Frequentatives or Yanantas** (@deva[यङन्तः])
4. **Denominatives or Nāmadhātus** (@deva[नामधातवः])

The formation and the conjugation of these will be given in the present section.

---

**I CAUSALS.**

rules.title: Causal Forms of Roots
rules.body:
## Causal Forms of Roots

Any root belonging to any one of the Conjugational classes may have causal form which is conjugated like a root of the Tenth class.

rules.title: Meaning and Use of Causals
rules.body:
## Meaning and Use of Causals

The Causal of a root implies that a person or a thing causes or makes another person or thing to perform the action denoted by the root. It is also employed, sometimes, to convert an intransitive verb into a transitive one.

**Formation of the Causal Base.**

rules.title: Formation of Causal Base Like Tenth Class
rules.body:
## Formation of Causal Base Like Tenth Class

The Causal Base of a root is formed like that of a root of the Tenth class. In the case of roots of the Tenth class the causal form is identical with the primitive. The Causal form takes either pada.

**Examples:**
- @deva[बुध्]—causal base @deva[बोधय], @deva[बोधयति] 'he causes to know'
- @deva[क्षुभ्]—@deva[क्षोभयति] 'he shakes or agitates'
- @deva[गण]—@deva[गणयति] 'he causes to count'
- @deva[नी]—@deva[नाययति] 'he makes another lead or to carry'
- @deva[कृ] 'to call' or 'to scatter'—@deva[करयति] 'he causes to do or scatter'
- @deva[कूद्]—@deva[कूदयति], &c.

rules.title: Vowel Changes in Causals
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in Causals

Roots ending in @deva[अम्], except @deva[अम्] 'to go' &c., @deva[कम्] 'to love,' @deva[चम्] 'to eat,' @deva[शम्] when it means 'to see' and @deva[यम्] when it does not mean 'to eat,' and the roots[^1] marked with an indicatory @deva[म्] do not change their vowel; i. e. their vowel takes its Guṇa substitute; @deva[गम्]—@deva[गमयति], @deva[क्रम्]—@deva[क्रमयति], @deva[घट्]—@deva[घटयति], @deva[जन्]—@deva[जनयति], @deva[व्यथ्]—@deva[व्यथयति]; @deva[जॄ]—@deva[जरयति]; @deva[श्रा][^2]—@deva[श्रपयति], @deva[जा][^2]—@deva[जपयति], &c. but @deva[कम्]—@deva[कामयते]; @deva[चम्]—@deva[चामयति], @deva[शम्] 'to see' @deva[शामयति]; but @deva[शमयति] in other cases; @deva[यम्]—@deva[यामयति], &c.; but @deva[यम्] 'to eat'—@deva[यमयति].

(a) The roots @deva[वम्], @deva[नम्], @deva[वन्], @deva[ज्वल्], @deva[ह्वल्], and @deva[ह्मल्], lengthen their vowel optionally when not preceded by a preposition; @deva[नमयति], @deva[नामयति], but @deva[प्रणमयति], &c.

[^1]: These are:—@deva[घट्], @deva[व्यथ्], @deva[प्रथ्], @deva[प्रस्], 'to spread,' @deva[म्रद्] 'to pound,' @deva[स्खद्] 1 A. 'to destroy, to cut,' @deva[क्षञ्ज्] 1 A. 'to go,' @deva[दक्ष्], @deva[क्रप्] I A. 'to pity,' @deva[क्रन्द्], @deva[क्लन्द्] 1 A., @deva[त्वर्], @deva[ज्वर्], @deva[गड्] 1 Par. 'to distil,' @deva[हेड्] 'to surround,' @deva[वट्], @deva[भट्] 'to speak,' @deva[नट्] 'to dance,' @deva[स्तक्] 1 P. 'to resist,' @deva[चक्] 1. P. 'to shine,' @deva[कख्] P. 'to laugh,' @deva[रग्] P. 'to doubt,' @deva[लग्] P. 'to cling to', @deva[ह्रग्], @deva[लग्], @deva[सग्], @deva[स्तग्], all meaning 'to cover,' @deva[कग], @deva[अक्], @deva[अग्] 'to move in a zigzag manner,' @deva[कण्], @deva[रण्] P. 'to go,' @deva[चण्], @deva[शण्], @deva[श्रण्] P. 'to give,' @deva[श्रथ्], @deva[क्नथ्], @deva[क्रथ्] @deva[क्लथ्], all P. and meaning 'to injure,' 'to kill,' @deva[चन्], 'to kill,' @deva[वन्], P. 'to honour,' @deva[ज्वल्], 'to shine,' @deva[ह्वल्], @deva[ह्मल्], 'to shake,' 'to move,' @deva[स्मृ], @deva[दृ] I P., 'to fear,' @deva[नॄ] 'to guide,' @deva[श्रा] 'to cook, to boil,' @deva[ज्ञा] 'to kill, to gratify, to sharpen, to manifest, @deva[चल्], @deva[छद्], 'to live or to be' (@deva[छादयति] in other senses), @deva[लड्] 'to sport, to loll the tongue,' @deva[मद्] 'to be poor, to reduce,' @deva[ध्वन्], @deva[स्वन्], @deva[जन्], @deva[जॄ], @deva[क्नस्] 'to be crooked, to shine,' @deva[रञ्ज्], @deva[रम्], @deva[क्रम्], @deva[गम्], and @deva[फण्] 1 P. 'to go.'

[^2]: See @ref[605] (b).

rules.title: Augment @deva[प्] in Causals of Roots Ending in @deva[आ]
rules.body:
## Augment @deva[प्] in Causals of Roots Ending in @deva[आ]

Roots ending in @deva[आ] (@deva[ए], @deva[ऐ] or @deva[ओ] changeable to @deva[आ]; see @ref[459]) and the roots @deva[ऋ] 'to go,' @deva[ह्री] 'to be ashamed,' @deva[री] 'to go,' (9 cl.), 'to flow' (4. cl. A.) and @deva[व्ली] 'to choose, to go,' insert the augment @deva[प्] before @deva[अय] and their vowel takes Guṇa substitute; @deva[दापयति] fr. @deva[दा], @deva[दे] or @deva[दी]; @deva[धापयति] fr. @deva[धे]; @deva[गापयति] fr. @deva[गै], &c. @deva[ऋ]—@deva[अर्पयति]; @deva[ह्री]—@deva[ह्रेपयति], @deva[री]—@deva[रेपयति], @deva[व्ली]—@deva[व्लेपयति].

rules.title: Special Causal Forms with @deva[प्] Augment
rules.body:
## Special Causal Forms with @deva[प्] Augment

(a) @deva[मि] 'to throw,' @deva[मी] 'to destroy,' @deva[दी] 'to perish,' @deva[जि] 'to conquer,' and @deva[क्री] 'to buy,' also insert @deva[प्], but after changing their final vowel to @deva[आ]; @deva[मापयति], @deva[दापयति], @deva[जापयति], @deva[क्रापयति].

(b) The roots @deva[क्षै], @deva[श्रा] or @deva[श्रै] 'to cook' and @deva[ज्ञा] (mit.), shorten their vowel necessarily, and @deva[ग्लै] and @deva[स्ना] optionally, before the inserted @deva[प्] when not preceded by prepositions; @deva[क्षपयति], &c. @deva[ज्ञपयति], (@deva[पशुं संज्ञपयति] slays; @deva[प्रज्ञपयति] @deva[शरं] &c.); but @deva[ज्ञापयति], @deva[ग्लपयति], @deva[ग्लापयति]; @deva[स्नपयति], @deva[स्नापयति]; but @deva[प्रग्लापयति], @deva[उपस्नापयति] only.

rules.title: Causals with @deva[य्] Augment
Nasal Insertion in Causals
rules.body:
## Nasal Insertion in Causals

The roots @deva[जभ्], @deva[रध्], @deva[रभ्], and @deva[लभ्] insert a nasal before their final; @deva[जम्भयति-ते], @deva[रन्धयति-ते], &c.

rules.title: Roots with Two Causal Forms
rules.body:
## Roots with Two Causal Forms

The roots @deva[गुप्], @deva[विच्छ्], @deva[धूप्], @deva[पण्], @deva[पन्], and @deva[ऋत्] have two forms in the causal; @deva[गोपयति-ते], @deva[गोपाययति-ते]; @deva[विच्छयति-ते], @deva[विच्छाययति-ते]; &c.

rules.title: Final Vowel Elision in Causals
rules.body:
## Final Vowel Elision in Causals

@deva[दीधी], @deva[वेवी] and @deva[दरिद्रा] drop their final vowel before @deva[अय्]; @deva[दीधयति-ते], @deva[वेवयति-ते], @deva[दरिद्रयति-ते].

rules.title: Anomalous Causal Forms
rules.body:
## Anomalous Causal Forms

The following roots form their Causal base anomalously:—

- @deva[इ] 'to go'—@deva[गमयति], with @deva[अधि] 'to remember.'—@deva[अधिगमयति],—'to study' @deva[अध्यापयति]. with @deva[प्रति]—@deva[प्रत्याययति].
- @deva[क्नू] or @deva[क्नूय्] 'to sound,' &c.—@deva[क्नोपयति] 'he causes to sound.'
- @deva[क्ष्माय्] 'to tremble'—@deva[क्ष्माययति] „ „ „ tremble.
- @deva[गुह्] 'to conceal'—@deva[गूहयति] „ „ „ conceal.
- @deva[चि] 5 cl. 'to collect'—@deva[चापयति-ते] @deva[चाययति-ते] „ collect.
- „ 10 cl.—@deva[चपयति-ते] @deva[चययति-ते] „ „
- @deva[जागृ] 'to awake'—@deva[जागरयति] he rouses
- @deva[दुष्]—'to sin, to be unchaste'—@deva[दूषयति-ते] he causes to sin, but @deva[दुषयति-ते], @deva[दोषयति-ते] in the sense of 'he corrupts or makes depraved.'
- @deva[धू] 'to shake'—@deva[धूनयति-ते] he causes to shake.
- @deva[प्री] 'to please'—@deva[प्रीणयति] „ „ „ please.
- @deva[भी] 'to fear.'—@deva[भाययति-ते] he frightens with. @deva[भापयते], @deva[भीषयते] he inspires fear.
- @deva[भ्रस्ज्]—'to fry'—@deva[भर्जयति-ते], @deva[भ्रज्जयति-ते] he causes to fry.
- @deva[मृज्]—'to wipe'—@deva[मार्जयति].
- @deva[रञ्ज्]—'to dye'—@deva[रञ्जयति] he dyes or paints: also in the sense of 'he propitiates or satisfies': cf. '@deva[ब्रह्मापि नरं न रञ्जयति]' Bh. Nî Śa. 3. But @deva[रजयति] only, in the sense of 'he hunts deer'; (Vide Kir. VI. 34).
- @deva[रुह्]—'to grow'—@deva[रोहयति-ते], @deva[रोपयति-ते] he plants or causes to grow.
- @deva[ला]—'to take' and @deva[ली]—'to embrace,' 'to adhere'—@deva[लालयति-ते], @deva[विलापयति-ते]; and @deva[लीनयति], @deva[लापयति] in the sense of 'melting an unctuous substance'
- @deva[वा] 'to blow'—@deva[वापयति] he causes to blow or move. @deva[वाजयति] he shakes.
- @deva[स्मि] 'to smile'—@deva[विस्माययति] he causes a smile by, or astonishes or frightens by. @deva[विस्मापयते] he astonishes.
- @deva[वी]—@deva[वापयति], @deva[वाययति] he causes to conceive; @deva[वाययति-ते] in other senses.
- @deva[शद्] 'to fall'—@deva[शातयति] he causes to fall, cuts down. @deva[शादयति] he causes to go.
- @deva[सिध्] 'to be accomplished'—@deva[साधयति] he accomplishes or prepares. @deva[सेधयति], he makes perfect, &c. with reference to sacred rites or things only; as @deva[सेधयति तापसं तपः] &c.
- @deva[स्फाय्]—'to swell'—@deva[स्फावयति], he causes to swell.
- @deva[स्फुर्]—'to tremble; to shine forth.' @deva[स्फोरयति], @deva[स्फारयति] he causes to tremble or shine
- @deva[हन्] 'to strike or kill'—@deva[घातयति] he causes to strike, &c.

rules.title: Conjugation of Causal Base Like Tenth Class
rules.body:
**Conjugation of the Causal Base.**

## Conjugation of Causal Base Like Tenth Class

The Causal base is conjugated like the base of a root of the 10th or Churādi class in all the ten Tenses and Moods of the Parasmaipada, the Ātmanepada and the Passive.

The @deva[अय] with the final @deva[अ] dropped is retained, as remarked before, in the General Tenses, except the Aorist and the Benedictive, and is dropped before the @deva[य] of the Passive.

The formation of the Aorist of causals has been fully explained along with that of the roots of the Tenth class, at @ref[548]-@ref[556].

rules.title: Formation of Desiderative Forms
rules.body:
**II. DESIDERATIVES.**

## Formation of Desiderative Forms

Any primitive root of the ten classes, as well as any causal base, may optionally[^1] take a Desiderative form, which, like the causal base, is conjugated in all the ten Tenses and Moods of three voices.

[^1]: Or the notion of desire may be conveyed by means of a sentence; i. e. @deva[पिपठिषति] or @deva[पठितुमिच्छति] 'he wishes to read,' &c.

rules.title: Meaning of Desiderative Forms
rules.body:
## Meaning of Desiderative Forms

The Desiderative expresses the notion that a person or thing wishes (or is about) to perform the action, or to be in the condition denoted by the root or the desiderative base; @deva[पिपठिषति] 'he wishes to study' from @deva[पठ्]; @deva[मुमूर्षति] 'he is about to die' fr. @deva[मृ]; &c.

rules.title: Desiderative Forms Without Desiderative Sense
rules.body:
## Desiderative Forms Without Desiderative Sense

There are a few primitive roots, which, though they take a Desiderative form, do not convey a desiderative sense (See @ref[396]). As these are looked upon as primitive roots, new Desiderative bases may be derived from them according to the rules given below; as @deva[जुगुप्सिषते] 'he wishes to censure' from @deva[जुगुप्स्] &c.

rules.title: Formation of Desiderative Base by Reduplication
rules.body:
## Formation of Desiderative Base by Reduplication

The Desiderative base is formed by reduplicating the root or base according to the general rules of reduplication given at @ref[444]-@ref[449] and @ref[549] (a) (b), and by adding @deva[स्] (which may by changed to @deva[ष्] according to the rules of Sandhi) to it. The @deva[अ] of the reduplicative syllable is changed to @deva[इ]; e. g. @deva[पठ्]—@deva[पपठ्]—@deva[पिपठ्] + @deva[स्] = @deva[पिपठिष्] by the following rule.

*N. B.* The @deva[स्] of a primitive root is not changed to @deva[ष्] when the characteristic @deva[स्] is changed to @deva[ष्]; @deva[सि]—@deva[सिसीष्], @deva[सिच्]—@deva[सिसिक्ष्] (@deva[क] + @deva[ष]); @deva[स्मि]—@deva[सिस्मयिष्]; @deva[सू]—@deva[सुसूष्]; but @deva[स्था]—@deva[तिष्ठास्]; @deva[सावय्] cau. of @deva[सू]—@deva[सुषावयिष्]; @deva[स्तु], however, forms @deva[तुष्टूषति].

Note:—(1) A root takes a Desiderative form only when the agent of the wish and of the action expressed by the root is the same; so @deva[शिष्याः पठन्तु इति इच्छति गुरु] and not @deva[पिपठिषति]; also the sense of the root must be the object of the wish: @deva[गमनेन इच्छति] cannot, therefore, be equal to @deva[जिगमिषति].

Note:—(2) Though the Desiderative form of a root is not to be found often used in classical language in its character of a verb, yet nominal and participal derivatives from it are not uncommonly to be met with.

rules.title: Prefixing Augment @deva[इ] to Desiderative @deva[स्]
rules.body:
## Prefixing Augment @deva[इ] to Desiderative @deva[स्]

To this @deva[स्] the augment @deva[इ] is to be prefixed after Seṭ roots, optionally after Veṭ ones and not after those that are Aniṭ, subject to the following exceptions:—

(1) Roots ending in @deva[उ] or @deva[ऊ], @deva[ऋ] and @deva[ऌ] short, and the roots @deva[ग्रह्] and @deva[गुह्] do not take @deva[इ]; @deva[नु]—@deva[नुनूष्]; Vide @ref[618]. (*d*); @deva[भू]—@deva[बुभूष्], &c.

Exceptions:—@deva[ऋ] 'to go,' @deva[दृ] A. 'to respect,' @deva[धृ] 6 A. 'to hold,' and @deva[पू] A. 'to purify,' admit of @deva[इ] (see also 4 below)

(2) @deva[स्मि], @deva[अञ्ज्], @deva[प्रच्छ्], @deva[अश्] take @deva[इ] necessarily.

(3) @deva[वृत्], @deva[वृध्], @deva[शृध्], @deva[स्यन्द्] and @deva[क्लृप्] do not admit of @deva[इ] in the Par. (see @ref[484]) In the Atm. they admit @deva[इ], the last two do so optionally; @deva[वृत्]—@deva[विवृत्सति], @deva[विवर्तिषते], &c.

(4) Roots ending in long @deva[ॠ] and @deva[इव्] and the roots @deva[दरिद्रा], @deva[श्रि], @deva[ऊर्णु], @deva[यु], @deva[भृ], @deva[वृ], @deva[स्तृ], @deva[ऋध्] 'to prosper,' @deva[दम्भ्], @deva[भ्रस्ज्], @deva[ज्ञप्] (i. e. @deva[ज्ञप्] of the 10 cl. and optional Cau. Base of @deva[ज्ञा]), @deva[सन्] 'to give,' @deva[तन्], @deva[पत्], @deva[कृत्], @deva[चृत्], @deva[छृद्], @deva[तृद्], and @deva[नृत्] (Vide @ref[485].) take @deva[इ] optionally.

Exceptions:—@deva[कॄ] 'to scatter,' @deva[गॄ] 'to swallow,' take @deva[इ] necessarily. The intermediate @deva[इ] is not lengthened in the case of these roots; @deva[चिकरिष्], &c.

(5) The roots @deva[क्रम्], @deva[गम्] and @deva[स्नु] take @deva[इ] in the Par. and reject it in the Atm.

rules.title: Radical Vowel Changes Before @deva[स्] in Desideratives
rules.body:
## Radical Vowel Changes Before @deva[स्] in Desideratives

The radical vowels undergo the following changes before @deva[स्]—

(a) The @deva[स्] with @deva[इ] is strong and without @deva[इ] weak. The usual rule as to Guṇa substitute holds good in the one case and does not in the other; @deva[वृत्]—@deva[विवर्तिष्], @deva[विवृत्स्]; @deva[दृ]—@deva[दिदरिष्], &c.

(b) The final @deva[इ] and @deva[उ] and the penultimate @deva[अ] of @deva[हन्] and @deva[गम्] (substituted for @deva[इ] 2 Par. 'to go,' and for @deva[इ] with @deva[अधि] 'to remember' or 'to study') are lengthened and final @deva[ऋ], short or long, changed to @deva[ईर्], or to @deva[ऊर्] after labials or @deva[व्] when the @deva[स्] is unaugmented; @deva[जि]—@deva[जिगीष्], @deva[द्रु]—@deva[दुद्रूष्], @deva[कृ]—@deva[चिकीर्ष्], @deva[तॄ]—@deva[तितीर्ष्], @deva[मृ]—@deva[मुमूर्ष्], @deva[पॄ]—@deva[पुपूर्ष्], &c.

(c) The roots @deva[रुद्], @deva[विद्] and @deva[मुष्] do not change their vowel to Guṇa; and the roots @deva[ग्रह्], @deva[स्वप्] and @deva[प्रच्छ्] take Samprasāraṇa; @deva[रुरुदिष्], @deva[विविदिष्], @deva[मुमुषिष्], @deva[जिघृक्ष्], @deva[सुषुप्स्], @deva[पिपृच्छिष्].

(d) Roots with an initial consonant, and having @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] short for their penultimate, and ending in any consonant, except @deva[य्] or @deva[व्], change their vowel to Guṇa optionally when @deva[इ] is prefixed to @deva[स्]; @deva[द्युत्]—@deva[दिद्युतिष्], @deva[दिद्योतिष्]; @deva[मुद्]—@deva[मुमुदिष्] or @deva[मुमोदिष्] &c.

rules.title: Desideratives of Causals and Tenth Class Roots
rules.body:
## Desideratives of Causals and Tenth Class Roots

The formation of Desiderative bases of causals and of roots of the Tenth class does not differ from that of primitive roots.

Art @ref[550]. should be attended to in forming Desideratives from Causals and roots of the Tenth class.

rules.title: Pada Selection in Desideratives
rules.body:
## Pada Selection in Desideratives

Roots in their Desiderative forms take the same terminations, Parasm. or Atmane. that they do in the primitive. The roots @deva[ज्ञा], @deva[श्रु], @deva[स्मृ] and @deva[दृश्] take Atm. terminations in the Desiderative.

rules.title: Conjugation of Desiderative Base in Conjugational Tenses
rules.body:
**(b) Conjugation of the Desiderative Base.**

**Conjugational Tenses.**

## Conjugation of Desiderative Base in Conjugational Tenses

@deva[अ] is added to the base in the Conjugational Tenses and then it is conjugated like the special base of the 6th class in the Active and Passive.

rules.title: Non-Conjugational Tenses of Desideratives
rules.body:
**Non-Conjugational Tenses.**

## Non-Conjugational Tenses of Desideratives

(*a*) The Perfect is formed by adding @deva[आम्] to the base and appending the Perfect forms of the auxiliary verbs @deva[अस्], @deva[भू], and @deva[कृ] (see @ref[490], @ref[526]).

(*b*) In the Aorist the Desiderative Bases take the terminations of the Vth Variety.

(*c*) In the Benedictive the Parasmai. terminations are added without @deva[इ] and the Atm. ones with the intermediate @deva[इ].

(*d*) The remaining tenses have no peculiarities.

rules.title: Formation and Use of Frequentatives
rules.body:
**III. FREQUENTATIVES.**

## Formation and Use of Frequentatives

A Frequentative or Intensive form may be derived from any monosyllabic root of the first nine classes, beginning with a consonant. The Frequentative or Intensive is used to signify the repetition or the intensity of the action denoted by the verb from which it is derived.[^1]

**Exceptions:**—

[^1]: @deva[धातोरेकाचो हलादेः क्रियासमभिहारे यङ्] । Pāṇ III 1. 23 @deva[पौनःपुन्यं भृशार्थश्च क्रियासमभिहारः । तस्मिन्द्योत्ये यङ् स्यात्] । Sid. Kau.

rules.title: Exceptions and Special Uses of Frequentatives
rules.body:
## Exceptions and Special Uses of Frequentatives

(a)[^1] A Frequentative may be formed from @deva[अट्] 'to go,' @deva[ऋ] 'to go,' @deva[अश्] 'to eat' and @deva[ऊर्णु] 'to conceal,' though these begin with a vowel; and from @deva[सूच्] cl. 10 'to hint,' @deva[सूत्र्] cl. 10 'to string together,' and @deva[मूत्र्] cl. 10. though they belong to the 10th cl.

(b) The Frequentative of roots signifying motion conveys the notion of tortuous motion and not of repetition.[^2] The Frequentative of roots @deva[लुप्] 'to cut,' @deva[सद्] 'to sink down,' @deva[चर्] 'to go,' @deva[जप्] 'to mutter prayers,' @deva[जभ्] 'to yawn,' @deva[दह्] 'to burn,' @deva[दंश्] 'to bite,' and @deva[गॄ] 'to swallow,' imply reproach on the manner of doing the act;[^3] @deva[लोलुप्यते] 'he cuts awkwardly,' @deva[सासद्यते] 'falls down badly,' @deva[चञ्चूर्यते] &c.

[^1]: @deva[सूचिसूत्रिमूत्र्यट्यर्त्यशूर्णोतिभ्यो यङ् वाच्यः] । Vārt. on the above.

[^2]: @deva[नित्यं कौटिल्ये गतौ] । Pāṇ. III. 1. 23.

[^3]: @deva[लुपसदचरजभदहदशगॄभ्यो भावगर्हायाम्] । Pāṇ III. 1. 24

rules.title: Two Types of Frequentative Bases
rules.body:
## Two Types of Frequentative Bases

There are two kinds of Frequentative bases derived from roots; both are formed by a peculiar reduplication of the root; but in one the affix @deva[य] (@deva[यङ्]) is added to the root before reduplication takes place, and the base is conjugated in the Atm. alone; in the other the affix @deva[य] is dropped (@deva[यङ्लुक्]) and the base is conjugated in Parasm. only (in the Atm. also, according to some grammarians). It will be convenient to call the one of the Atm. Frequentative, and the other the Parasm. Frequentative.

**ĀTMANEPADA-FREQUENTATIVE.**

rules.title: Formation of Ātmanepada Frequentative Base
rules.body:
## Formation of Ātmanepada Frequentative Base

The Atm. Frequentative base is formed by adding @deva[य] to the root before which it undergoes the same changes as before the @deva[य] of the Passive; @deva[दा]—@deva[दीय], @deva[चि]—@deva[चीय], @deva[नी]—@deva[नीय], @deva[भू]—@deva[भूय], @deva[स्मृ]—@deva[स्मर्य], @deva[ऋ]—@deva[अर्य], @deva[कॄ]—@deva[कीर्य], @deva[धे]—@deva[धीय] &c.; @deva[भिद्]—@deva[भिद्य], @deva[पॄ]—@deva[पूर्य], @deva[बन्ध्]—@deva[बध्य], @deva[नन्द्]—@deva[नन्द्य], &c.

(a) @deva[घ्रा] and @deva[ध्मा] change their vowel to @deva[ई], and @deva[ऋ] preceded by one radical consonant is changed to @deva[री], and not to @deva[रि]; @deva[घ्रा]—@deva[घ्रीय], @deva[ध्मा]—@deva[ध्मीय], @deva[कृ]—@deva[क्रीय].

(b) The roots @deva[व्यच्], @deva[व्यध्], @deva[स्यम्], @deva[स्वप्], @deva[ग्रह्], @deva[प्रच्छ्], @deva[भ्रस्ज्] and @deva[व्रश्च्] take Samprasāraṇa; @deva[ज्या] and @deva[व्ये] substitute @deva[ई], and @deva[ह्वे], @deva[ऊ] for their final vowel; @deva[शास्] becomes @deva[शिष्] and @deva[प्याय्] @deva[पी]; @deva[व्यच्]—@deva[विच्य], @deva[स्वप्]—@deva[सुप्य], @deva[ग्रह्]—@deva[गृह्य], @deva[ह्वे]—@deva[हूय], @deva[ज्या]—@deva[जीय], @deva[शास्]—@deva[शिष्य], @deva[प्याय्]—@deva[पीय].

(c) @ref[395] should be observed.

rules.title: Reduplication in Ātmanepada Frequentatives
Nasal Insertion in Ātmanepada Frequentatives
rules.body:
## Nasal Insertion in Ātmanepada Frequentatives

When a root ends in a nasal preceded by @deva[अ] and the nasal is not dropped, @deva[न्] (changeable to an Anusvāra or the nasal of the class to which the letter following it belongs) is inserted between the reduplicative @deva[अ] and the first radical consonant; the @deva[अ] of the reduplicative syllable remains unchanged (against @ref[629] b.).

@deva[यम्]—@deva[यम्य], @deva[ययम्य] = @deva[यंयम्यते] or @deva[यँय्यम्यते], @deva[जन्]—@deva[जन्य]—@deva[जजन्य] = @deva[जंजन्यते] or @deva[जञ्जन्यते], but when @deva[जन्] = @deva[जाय्], the A. Freq. base is @deva[जाजाय], 3rd sing. @deva[जाजायते].

(a) The same rule applies to the roots @deva[चर्], @deva[फल्], @deva[जप्], @deva[जभ्], @deva[दह्], @deva[दंश्], @deva[भञ्ज्] and @deva[पश्]. @deva[चर्] and @deva[फल्] after inserting @deva[न्] change the @deva[अ] of the following syllable to @deva[उ]; @deva[चर्]=@deva[चर्य]—@deva[चचर्य]=@deva[चंचुर्य] or @deva[चञ्चुर्य]=@deva[चंचूर्यते] or @deva[चञ्चूर्यते] by @ref[394]. @deva[फल्]=@deva[फल्य]=@deva[पफल्य]=@deva[पंफुल्यते] or @deva[पम्फुल्यते]; @deva[दह्]=@deva[दह्य]—@deva[ददह्य]=@deva[दंदह्यते] or @deva[दन्दह्यते] @deva[जप्]—@deva[जंजप्यते] or @deva[जञ्जप्यते].
(b) @deva[नी] is inserted after the @deva[अ] of the reduplicative syllable (which then remains unchanged) in the case of the roots @deva[वञ्च्], @deva[स्रंस्], @deva[ध्वंस्], @deva[भ्रंस्], @deva[कस्], @deva[पत्], @deva[पद्] and @deva[स्कन्द्]; @deva[वञ्च्]—@deva[वञ्च्य]—@deva[ववञ्च्य]—@deva[वनीवञ्च्यते], @deva[स्रंस्]—@deva[स्रस्य]—@deva[सनीस्रस्यते]; @deva[ध्वंस्]=@deva[दनीध्वस्यते], @deva[भ्रंस्]=@deva[बनीभ्रस्यते]. @deva[कस्]=@deva[कनीकस्यते], @deva[पत्]=@deva[पनीपत्यते], @deva[पद्]=@deva[पनीपद्यते], @deva[स्कन्द्]=@deva[कनीस्कद्यते].

rules.title: Insertion of @deva[री] in Ātmanepada Frequentatives with Penultimate @deva[ऋ]
rules.body:
## Insertion of @deva[री] in Ātmanepada Frequentatives with Penultimate @deva[ऋ]

When a root contains a penultimate @deva[ऋ] (@deva[ऌ]) original or brought in by samprasāraṇa the syllable @deva[री] is inserted between the @deva[अ] of the reduplicative syll. (which remains short against @ref[629] b) and the radical consonant; @deva[वृत्]=@deva[वृत्य]=@deva[ववृत्य]=@deva[वरीवृत्यते], @deva[प्रच्छ्]=@deva[पृच्छ्य]=@deva[परीपृच्छ्यते], @deva[नृत्]=@deva[नरीनृत्यते], @deva[ग्रह्]=@deva[जरीगृह्यते].

rules.title: Conjugation of Ātmanepada Frequentative Base
rules.body:
**Conjugation of the Atm. Freq. Base.**

## Conjugation of Ātmanepada Frequentative Base

In the Conjugational Tenses the Atm. Freq. Base is conjugated like the Conjugational base of the 4th class in Atm. In the General Tenses, and in all the Tenses of the Passive, the base loses its final @deva[अ] when the final @deva[य] is preceded by a vowel, and drops the @deva[य] itself, when it is preceded by a consonant. As regards the Perfect, the Freq. Base takes the Periphrastic Perfect. In the Aorist the Atm. terminations of the 5th form are added. In the remaining Tenses the Atm. terminations with the intermediate @deva[इ] prefixed to them are added as usual. The passive is also formed like the Passive of derived verbs.

rules.title: Paradigms of Ātmanepada Frequentatives
rules.body:
## Paradigms of Ātmanepada Frequentatives

Paradigms:—The 3 sing. of @deva[बोबुध्य] the Atm. Freq. Base of the root @deva[बुध्] and @deva[देदीय] that of the root @deva[दा].

| Tenses | Active | | Passive | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Present | @deva[बोबुध्यते] | @deva[देदीयते] | @deva[बोबुध्यते] | @deva[देदीय्यते] |
| Imperfect | @deva[अबोबुध्यत] | @deva[अदेदीयत] | @deva[अबोबुध्यत] | @deva[अदेदीय्यत] |
| Imperative | @deva[बोबुध्यताम्] | @deva[देदीयताम्] | @deva[बोबुध्यताम्] | @deva[देदीय्यताम्] |
| Potential | @deva[बोबुध्येत] | @deva[देदीयेत] | @deva[बोबुध्येत] | @deva[देदीय्येत] |

| Tense | Active | | Passive | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Perfect | @deva[बोधांचक्रे], &c. | @deva[देदीयांचक्रे] &c. | Like the Active. | |
| Aorist | @deva[अबोबुधिष्ट] | @deva[अदेदीयिष्ट] | @deva[अबोबुधि] | @deva[अदेदीयि] |
| F. Future | @deva[बोबुधिता] | @deva[देदीयिता] | Like the Active. | |
| Sec. Future | @deva[बोबुधिष्यते] | @deva[देदीयिष्यते] | „ | |
| Conditional | @deva[अबोबुधिष्यत] | @deva[अदेदीयिष्यत] | „ | |

rules.title: Reduplication in Parasmaipada Frequentatives
rules.body:
**PARASMAIPADA FREQUENTATIVES.**

The Parasm. Frequentative is peculiar to the Veda. Its forms are very rarely to be met with in Classical composition.

**Formation of the Base.**

## Reduplication in Parasmaipada Frequentatives

The root is reduplicated according to the general rules of reduplication; the vowels @deva[इ] and @deva[उ] of the reduplicative syllable take their guṇa substitute, and the @deva[अ] of the reduplicative syllable is lengthened; @deva[दा]—@deva[ददा]—@deva[दादा]; @deva[श्रि]—@deva[शिश्रि]—@deva[शेश्रि], @deva[भू]—@deva[बुभू]—@deva[बोभू]; @deva[कृ]—@deva[चकृ]—@deva[चाकृ]; @deva[विद्] @deva[विविद्]—@deva[वेविद्]; @deva[बुध्]—@deva[बुबुध्]—@deva[बोबुध्] &c.

rules.title: Extension of @ref[630] Rules to Parasmaipada Frequentatives
rules.body:
## Extension of @ref[630] Rules to Parasmaipada Frequentatives

The rules @ref[630] (a) (b) apply likewise to the Parasm. Frequen. Base; @deva[यम्]—@deva[यंयम्] or @deva[यँय्यम्]; @deva[दह्]—@deva[ददह्] or @deva[दन्दह्]; @deva[वञ्च्]—@deva[वनीवञ्च्] &c.

rules.title: Insertion of @deva[र्], @deva[रि], or @deva[री] in Parasmaipada Frequentatives
rules.body:
## Insertion of @deva[र्], @deva[रि], or @deva[री] in Parasmaipada Frequentatives

@deva[र्] or the syllable @deva[रि] or @deva[री] is inserted between the @deva[अ] of the reduplicative syllable and the radical consonant of roots ending in short @deva[ऋ] or having it for their penultimate; similarly @deva[ल्] or @deva[लि] or @deva[ली] is inserted in the case of @deva[क्लृप्]; @deva[वृत्]=@deva[ववृत्]—@deva[वर्वृत्] or @deva[वरिवृत्] or @deva[वरीवृत्]; @deva[कृ]—@deva[चर्कृ], or @deva[चरिकृ] or @deva[चरीकृ]; @deva[क्लृप्]—@deva[चल्क्लृप्], or @deva[चलिक्लृप्] @deva[चलीक्लृप्]; @deva[दृश्]—@deva[दर्दृश्], @deva[दरिदृश्] or @deva[दरीदृश्].

rules.title: Conjugation of Parasmaipada Frequentatives
rules.body:
**Conjugation of the Parasm. Fre. Base.**

## Conjugation of Parasmaipada Frequentatives

In the Conjugational Tenses the Parasm. Frequentatives follow the conjugation of the special base of a root of the 3rd class, @deva[ई] is optionally prefixed to the terminations of the singulars of the Present, of the 2nd and 3rd singulars of the Imperf. and of the 3rd sing. of the Impera.; when @deva[ई] is prefixed to these, a penultimate short vowel does not take Guṇa; @deva[दा]—@deva[दादाति] or @deva[दादेति]; @deva[वृत्]—@deva[वर्वर्ति] or @deva[वरिवर्ति] or @deva[वरीवर्ति] or @deva[वर्वृतीति] or @deva[वरिवृतीति] or @deva[वरीवृतीति], @deva[कृ]—@deva[चर्कर्ति] or @deva[चर्करीति], @deva[चरिकर्ति] or @deva[चरिकरीति], @deva[चरीकर्ति] or @deva[चरीकरीति].

rules.title: Non-conjugational Tenses and Paradigm of Parasmaipada Frequentatives
rules.body:
## Non-conjugational Tenses and Paradigm of Parasmaipada Frequentatives

As regards the formation of the Non-conjugational tenses grammarians seem to be at variance. The Perfect follows the usual rules for the polysyllabic roots. In the remaining tenses the augment @deva[इ] is always prefixed except in the Benedictive.

As this form of the Freq. is mostly confined to the Veda details are not given here.

**Paradigms.**

rules.body:
## Irregular Frequentative Forms

The following roots form their Frequentatives irregularly.

| Roots | Atm. Fre. | Par. Freq. |

| @deva[ऊर्णु] to cover | @deva[ऊर्णोनूयते] |  |

| @deva[खन्] to dig | @deva[चङ्खन्यते] or @deva[चंखन्यते] or @deva[चाखायते] | @deva[चंखनीति], @deva[चङ्खन्ति], &c. |
| @deva[गॄ] to swallow | @deva[जेगिल्यते] | @deva[जागर्ति] |
| @deva[चर्] to walk | See @ref[630] a. | @deva[चञ्चरीति] or @deva[चञ्चर्ति] |
| @deva[चाय्] to worship | @deva[चेकीयते] | @deva[चेकीयति] or @deva[चेकेति] |
| @deva[जन्] to be born | See @ref[630] a. | @deva[जञ्जनीति] or @deva[जञ्जन्ति], &c. |
| @deva[द्युत्] to shine | @deva[देद्युत्यते] | @deva[देद्युतीति] or @deva[देद्योति] |
| @deva[फल्] to expand | See @ref[630] a. | @deva[पंफुलीति] or @deva[पंफुल्ति] |
| @deva[शी] to lie down | @deva[शाशय्यते] | @deva[शेशयीति] or @deva[शेशेति] |
| @deva[श्वि] to swell | @deva[शोश्वियते] or @deva[शोशूयते] | @deva[शेश्वयीति] or @deva[शेश्वेति] |
| @deva[सन्] to obtain | @deva[संसन्यते] or @deva[सासायते] | @deva[संसनीति] or @deva[संसन्ति] |
| @deva[हन्] to injure | @deva[जेघीयते] | @deva[जघनीति] or @deva[जघान्ति] |
| in other cases | @deva[जङ्घन्यते] or @deva[जंघन्यते] |  |

rules.title: Introduction to Nominal Verbs
rules.body:
**IV. NOMINAL VERBS.**

## Introduction to Nominal Verbs

Verbs are formed from nominal bases by means of certain affixes. These are not very much in common use and are generally used in the Present Tense. They have various meanings. They sometimes convey the notion of performing, practising, or using, or treating like the thing or quality expressed by the noun and are used transitively; sometimes they express the idea of acting, behaving or becoming like the person or thing expressed by the noun; and at others they yield the sense of desiring or wishing for the thing expressed by the noun. These will be arranged here under four heads, according to the affixes by which they are derived.

**(a) By means of the affix @deva[य] (@deva[क्यच्]) and Conjugated in Parasm.**

rules.title: Formation of Nominal Verbs Expressing Wish (@deva[क्यच्])
rules.body:
## Formation of Nominal Verbs Expressing Wish (@deva[क्यच्])

When the sense of 'wish' is to expressed, a nominal verb may be derived from any *Subanta* or nominal stem by affixing @deva[य] to it. The derivative verbal base derived in this manner is conjugated in the Parasm. only.

rules.title: Vowel Changes Before @deva[य] in Nominal Verbs
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes Before @deva[य] in Nominal Verbs

Before this @deva[य],

(1) final @deva[अ] and @deva[आ] are changed to @deva[ई]; @deva[पुत्रं आत्मनः इच्छति]—@deva[पुत्रीयति] (@deva[पुत्र]+@deva[य]=@deva[पुत्री]+@deva[य]+@deva[ति]) 'he wishes for a son.'

(2) final @deva[इ] and @deva[उ] are lengthened; @deva[कवि]—@deva[कवीयति] 'he wishes for a poet.'

(3) final @deva[ऋ] is changed to @deva[री]; @deva[कर्तृ]—@deva[कर्त्रीयति].

(4) final @deva[ओ] and @deva[औ] are changed to @deva[अव्] and @deva[आव्]; @deva[गो]—@deva[गव्यति]; @deva[नौ]—@deva[नाव्यति].

(5) a final nasal is dropped and the preceding vowel is changed like an original final vowel; @deva[राजन्]—@deva[राजीयति] 'he wishes for a king.'

(6) in other cases the final consonant remains unchanged; @deva[वाच्]—@deva[वाच्यति] 'he wishes for words,' @deva[दिव्]—@deva[दिव्यति] (@deva[दीव्यति] according to some) 'he wishes for heaven,' @deva[समिध्]—@deva[समिध्यति] 'he wishes for holy sticks,' &c.

(7) The Tad. affix expressing 'a descendant of' is dropped and then the changes mentioned above take place; @deva[गार्ग्य] (the son of @deva[गर्ग]) @deva[आत्मनः इच्छति] @deva[गार्गीयति] (@deva[गार्ग्य]+@deva[य]+@deva[ति]=@deva[गार्ग]+@deva[य]+@deva[ति]=@deva[गार्गी]+@deva[य]+@deva[ति]), &c.

rules.title: Insertion of @deva[स्] and @deva[अस्] in Nominal Verbs
rules.body:
## Insertion of @deva[स्] and @deva[अस्] in Nominal Verbs

The consonant @deva[स्] and the syllable @deva[अस्] are inserted between any nominal stem and the affix @deva[य]; @deva[मधु आत्मन इच्छति] @deva[मधुस्यति] or @deva[मध्वस्यति] 'he wishes for honey'; so @deva[दधिस्यति], @deva[दध्यस्यति], &c. Final @deva[अ] is dropped before @deva[अस्]; @deva[पुत्रस्यति].

(a) @deva[अस्] is inserted after @deva[वृष] and @deva[अश्व] when the sense to be conveyed is that of longing for them, after @deva[क्षीर] and @deva[लवण] when the one is desired to be drunk and the other to be licked; @deva[वृषस्यति गौः] 'the cow longs for the ox,' @deva[अश्वस्यति वडवा] 'the mare longs for the horse;' @deva[क्षीरस्यति बालः] 'the child desires to drink,' @deva[लवणस्यति उष्ट्रः] 'the camel wishes for licking the salt.' But @deva[वृषीयति] 'he desires to have a bull,' @deva[अश्वीयति] 'he wishes for a horse,' @deva[क्षीरीयति], @deva[लवणीयति].

rules.title: Restriction on @deva[य] Affix with @deva[म्]-Ending Nouns
rules.body:
## Restriction on @deva[य] Affix with @deva[म्]-Ending Nouns

The affix @deva[य] is not added to nouns ending in @deva[म्] and to indeclinables; @deva[कामिच्छति], @deva[स्वरिच्छति] (he longs for heaven).

rules.title: Exceptional Forms with Double Meanings
rules.body: @deva[अशन] has @deva[अशनायति] 'he wishes to eat,' and @deva[अशनीयति] 'he wishes to possess food,' @deva[उदक] has @deva[उदन्यति], 'he wishes to drink water' and @deva[उदकीयति] 'he wishes to possess water,' and @deva[धन] has @deva[धनायति] 'he wishes to acquire money,' and @deva[धनीयति] 'he wishes to be wealthy,'

rules.title: Non-Desiderative Uses of @deva[य] Nominal Verbs
rules.body:
This form of the Nominal verb has not always a desiderative meaning.

(a) The affix @deva[य] is added in the sense of 'treating or considering like;' @deva[पुत्रीयति छात्रम्] 'he treats the pupil as a son,' @deva[विष्णूयति द्विजम्] 'he treats the Brâhmaṇa like Vishṇu,' @deva[प्रासादीयति कुट्यां भिक्षुः] 'the beggar considers his hut a palace,' @deva[कुटीयति प्रासादे राजा] 'the king in his palace considers himself to be in a hut.'

(b) It is added to @deva[नमस्], @deva[वरिवस्] and @deva[चित्र] in the senses of 'adoring,' 'serving' and 'striking with wonder' respectively, @deva[नमस्यति देवान्] 'he adores the gods', @deva[वरिवस्यति गुरुम्] 'he serves the preceptor', @deva[चित्रीयते लोकान्] 'he strikes the people with wonder.' It is also added to @deva[तपस्] in the sense of 'practising,' @deva[तपस्यति].

rules.title: Dropping of @deva[य] in General Tenses
rules.body: In the general tenses the affix @deva[य] (@deva[क्यच्] and @deva[क्यङ्] to be given hereafter) is dropped when preceded by a consonant, @deva[समिधांचकार] Perf. 1 sing. @deva[समिधिता], @deva[समिधिष्यति] 1st. and 2nd Fu. 3 sing. from @deva[समिध्यति], but @deva[पुत्रीयांचकार] from @deva[पुत्रीयति].

rules.title: Formation with @deva[काम्य] Affix
rules.body:
**(b) By means of the affix @deva[काम्य] (@deva[काम्यच्]) and conjugated in Par.**

## Formation with @deva[काम्य] Affix

To express the sense of wishing for that which is denoted by the noun; the affix @deva[काम्य] is also added like the above and the base so derived conjugated in the Par. as before, @deva[पुत्रकाम्यति] 'he wishes for a son,' @deva[यशस्काम्यति] 'he wishes for fame,' @deva[सर्पिष्काम्यति] 'he wishes for ghee.'

rules.title: Exception to § 644 for @deva[काम्य] Affix
rules.body: The restriction given at @ref[644] does not hold good in the case of this affix, @deva[किंकाम्यति], @deva[स्वःकाम्यति].

rules.title: Nominal Verbs Without Added Affix
rules.body:
**(c) By means of the affix @deva[क्विप्] (o) and conjugated in Par.**

## Nominal Verbs Without Added Affix

Nominal bases are formed without the addition of any affix: the characteristic signs of the tenses and moods and the personal terminations being added immediately to the nominal base. The bases thus derived convey the notion of acting or behaving like that which is expressed by the noun, and are conjugated in the Parasm.

rules.title: Vowel Changes in Nominal Verbs Formed Without an Affix
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes in Nominal Verbs Formed Without an Affix

The penultimate @deva[अ] of a noun ending in a nasal is lengthened. The base is treated like a root of the 1st conjugation, its last vowel only taking Guṇa before this @deva[अ]; @deva[अ] (name of Vishṇu) @deva[इव आचरति]—@deva[अति] 'he acts like Vishṇu,' @deva[कृष्ण]—@deva[कृष्णाति] 'he acts like @deva[कृष्ण]' (@deva[कृष्णामि] 1st sing.), @deva[कवि]—@deva[कवयामि] 'I act the poet or behave like a poet,' @deva[वि]—@deva[वयति] 'he behaves like a bird,' @deva[माला]—@deva[मालाति] 'he or it acts like a garland' (Perf. @deva[मालांच॰] &c.), @deva[पितृ]—@deva[पितरति] 'he acts like a father.' @deva[भू]—@deva[भवति] 'acts like the earth' (Perf. @deva[बुभाव], &c. as @deva[भू] is the base), @deva[राजन्]—@deva[राजानति] 'he acts like a king,' @deva[पथिन्]—@deva[पथीनति] 'it serves as a road,' &c. So @deva[इदामति] from @deva[इदम्], @deva[ऋभुक्षीणाति] from @deva[ऋभुक्षिन्] name of Indra.

(b) The words @deva[अवगलभ] (a bold man), @deva[होड] (a child) and @deva[क्लीब] take the affixes @deva[क्यङ्] and @deva[क्विप्] optionally and are conjugated in the Atmane. @deva[अवगलभते] or @deva[अवगलभायते], @deva[होडते] or @deva[होडायते], @deva[क्लीबते] or @deva[क्लीबायते].

**(d) By means of the affix @deva[य] (@deva[क्यङ्]) and conjugated in the Atm.**

rules.title: Formation with @deva[क्यङ्] Affix
rules.body:
## Formation with @deva[क्यङ्] Affix

The affix @deva[य] (@deva[क्यङ्]) is added in the same sense as above to nominal stems and the nominal verbs so derived are conjugated in the Atm.

rules.title: Vowel Changes Before @deva[क्यङ्]
rules.body:
## Vowel Changes Before @deva[क्यङ्]

Before this affix the final @deva[अ] of a nominal base is lengthened, @deva[आ] remains unchanged, other final letters undergo the same changes as they do before the other @deva[य] (@deva[क्यच्]). The final @deva[स्] of a noun is changed to @deva[आ] optionally and that of @deva[अप्सरस्] and @deva[ओजस्] necessarily; @deva[कृष्ण इव आचरति], @deva[कृष्णायते] 'he acts like @deva[कृष्ण];' @deva[यशस्]—@deva[यशायते], @deva[यशस्यते] 'he behaves like one who is famous,' @deva[विद्वस्]—@deva[विद्वायते], @deva[विद्वस्यते] 'he acts like a learned man, &c.; but @deva[ओजस्]—@deva[ओजायते] 'acts like one who is lustrous' (powerful); @deva[अप्सरस्]—@deva[अप्सरायते] 'she behaves like an Apsaras.'

(a) A *feminine* noun not having @deva[ऋ] for its penultimate drops its *fem.* term., @deva[कुमारीव आचरति]—@deva[कुमारायते] 'he behaves like a girl,' @deva[हरिणीव आचरति] @deva[हरिणायते] 'she acts like a female deer'; @deva[गुर्वीव आचरति] @deva[गुरूयते] 'acts like a stout woman' But @deva[पाचिका इव आचरति] @deva[पाचिकायते] 'she acts like a female cook,' and not @deva[पाचकायते].

(b) @deva[सपत्नी] has @deva[सपत्नायते], @deva[सपत्नीयते] and @deva[सपतीयते] she acts like a co-wife, @deva[युवति] has @deva[युवायते] 'she behaves like a young woman.'

rules.title: @deva[य] Affix for 'Becoming What It Was Not Before'
rules.body:
## @deva[य] Affix for 'Becoming What It Was Not Before'

The affix @deva[य] is added to a few nouns such as @deva[भृश] 'much,' @deva[मन्द] 'slow,' '@deva[पण्डित]' 'learned,' @deva[सुमनस्] 'generous-minded,' @deva[उन्मनस्] 'agitated,' &c. in the sense of 'becoming what it was not before,' or 'what it was not like to before,' @deva[भृशः भवति] @deva[भृशायते] 'what was not much now becomes much,' @deva[उन्मनायति] 'he (who was not agitated before) becomes agitated,' similarly @deva[सुमनायते] &c.

rules.title: Special Uses of @deva[क्यङ्] Affix
rules.body:
## Special Uses of @deva[क्यङ्] Affix

The following are the different senses in which the affix @deva[क्यङ्] is used in the particular cases given below.

(a) It is added to @deva[सत्र], @deva[कष्ट], @deva[कृच्छ्र] and @deva[गहन] in the sense of 'desirous of committing sin;' @deva[पापं चिकीर्षति]—@deva[सत्रायते], @deva[कष्टायते], &c., added to @deva[कष्ट] it has also the sense of 'prompt in', @deva[कष्टाय क्रमते]—@deva[कष्टायते] (@deva[पापं कर्तुमुत्सहते इत्यर्थः], Sid Kau.).

(b) to @deva[रोमन्थ] used objectively, @deva[रोमन्थायते] 'is ruminating.'

(c) to @deva[बाष्प] 'tears,' @deva[ऊष्मन्] 'heat,' and @deva[फेन], in the sense of 'sending forth, vomiting;' @deva[बाष्पायते] 'he sheds tears,' @deva[ऊष्मायते] 'gives out heat,' @deva[फेनायते] 'sends forth foam.'

(d) to @deva[सुख] and others in the sense of 'experiencing or enjoying,' @deva[सुखं वेदयते] @deva[सुखायते] 'he enjoys happiness'; but @deva[परस्य सुखं वेदयते] 'he shows the happiness of another.'

(e) to @deva[शब्द], @deva[वैर], @deva[कलह], @deva[अभ्र], @deva[कण्व] 'sin', @deva[सुदिन] 'a fair day', @deva[दुर्दिन] 'a cloudy day' and @deva[नीहार] 'fog, heavy dew,' in the sense of 'making or doing;' @deva[शब्दं करोति] @deva[शब्दायते] 'he makes a sound' (also @deva[शब्दयति] cau.), @deva[सुदिनायते] &c.

**(e) By means of the affix @deva[क्यष्] (@deva[य]) and conjugated in Parasm. and Atm.**

rules.title: Formation with @deva[क्यष्] (@deva[य]) Affix
rules.body:
## Formation with @deva[क्यष्] (@deva[य]) Affix

The affix @deva[य] is added to @deva[लोहित] and some other words and to words ending in the affix @deva[आ] (@deva[डाच्]) and the nominal base thus formed is conjugated in the Parasm. and Atmane.; *e. g.* @deva[लोहित]—@deva[लोहितायति-ते] 'becomes red.' @deva[पटपटायते] 'utters the sound *Patpat*.'

**(f) By means of the affix @deva[इ] (@deva[णिङ्] and @deva[णिच्]) and conjugated in Parasm. and Atm.**

rules.title: Formation with @deva[इ] Affixes (@deva[णिङ्] and @deva[णिच्])
rules.body:
## Formation with @deva[इ] Affixes (@deva[णिङ्] and @deva[णिच्])

Verbal bases are formed from the nouns given below by the addition of the affixes @deva[इ] (@deva[णिङ्]), and @deva[इ] (@deva[णिच्]) with various senses; those derived by means of @deva[णिङ्] are conjugated in the Atm. and those by @deva[णिच्] in the Par; *e. g.* @deva[पुच्छं] with @deva[वि], @deva[उत्], and @deva[परि]—@deva[उत्पुच्छयते] 'raises the tail,' @deva[विपुच्छयते], @deva[परिपुच्छयते]; @deva[सम्भाण्डयते] 'collects together the vessels'; @deva[सञ्चीवरयते भिक्षुः] 'the mendicant collects together or wears tattered garments;' @deva[मुण्ड]—@deva[मुण्डयति माणवकम्] 'he shaves Māṇavaka', @deva[मिश्र]—@deva[मिश्रयति अन्नम्] 'he mixes boiled rice with (curds, curry, &c.);' @deva[श्लक्ष्ण]—@deva[श्लक्ष्णयति वस्त्रम्] 'he weaves cloth of a very thin texture,' @deva[लवणयति व्यञ्जनम्] 'mixes salt with condiments;' @deva[व्रतयति पयः] 'he observes the vow of living upon milk only;' @deva[व्रतयति शूद्रान्नम्] 'he observes the vow of abstaining from eating food at a Shudra's house;' @deva[वस्त्र]—@deva[संवस्त्रयति] 'he clothes with a garment;' @deva[हल]—@deva[हलयति] 'he uses a large plough;' @deva[कलि]—@deva[कलयति] 'he quarrels!' @deva[कृत]—@deva[कृतयति] (@deva[कृतं गृह्णाति] Sid. Kau.). @deva[तूस्त] 'sin or hair or matted hair,' (@deva[तूस्तं केशा इत्येके जटीभूता केशा इत्यन्ये पापमित्यपरे] । Sid. Kau.)—@deva[तूस्तयति] 'ties into a braid the hair,' &c.

rules.title: Change of @deva[इ] to @deva[आपि]
rules.body:
## Change of @deva[इ] to @deva[आपि]

@deva[इ] is changed to @deva[आपि] when added to @deva[सत्य], @deva[अर्थ] and @deva[वेद]; @deva[सत्यं करोति आचष्टे वा]—@deva[सत्यापयति]; @deva[अर्थापयति], @deva[वेदापयति].

rules.title: Additional Uses of @deva[इ] Affix
rules.body:
## Additional Uses of @deva[इ] Affix

@deva[इ] is further added in the following cases;—@deva[सेनया अभियाति]—@deva[अभिषेणयति]; @deva[लोमानि अनुमार्ष्टि]—@deva[अनुलोमयति]; @deva[वीणया उपगायति]—@deva[उपवीणयति], @deva[श्लोकैः उपस्तौति]—@deva[उपश्लोकयति]; @deva[त्वचं गृह्णाति]—@deva[त्वचयति]; @deva[चर्मणा संनह्यति]—@deva[संचर्मयति]; @deva[वर्णं गृह्णाति]—@deva[वर्णयति]; @deva[चूर्णैः अवध्वंसते]—@deva[अवचूर्णयति]; @deva[एनीमाचष्टे]—@deva[एनयति] (declares her variegated); &c., &c.

The various changes taking place here before the affix @deva[य] the student will easily notice as irregularities.

**(g) By means of the affix @deva[य] (@deva[यक्]).**

rules.title: Roots That Are Also Prātipadika (@deva[यक्] Derivatives)
rules.body:
## Roots That Are Also Prātipadika (@deva[यक्] Derivatives)

There are several roots[^1] which are also *Pratipadikas* and which may be regarded as Nominal verbal bases derived from those *Pratipadikas* by means of the affix @deva[य] (@deva[यक्]). The more important of these are given below:—

| | |
|---|---|
| @deva[कण्डू]-@deva[कण्डूयति-ते] he scratches. | @deva[सपर]—@deva[सपर्यति] he worships. |

rules.title: Parasmaipada and Ātmanepada: Meaning of the Two Padas
rules.body:
**CHAPTER XIII.**

*Parasmaipada and Atmanepada.*

## Parasmaipada and Ātmanepada: Meaning of the Two Padas

As already remarked there are two Padas in Sanskrit, the Parasmaipada and the Atmanepada. The Parasm. denotes that the fruit of the action accrues to some one different from the agent, as @deva[पचति] 'he cooks for another,' @deva[कारयति] 'makes some one do something for another, &c.' The Atm. denotes that the fruit of the action is @deva[कर्तृगामि] *i. e.* it accrues to the agent, @deva[पचते] 'he cooks for himself,' @deva[कारयते] 'he makes another do something for himself,'[^1] &c.

(a) If, however, there be a word showing the accrual of the fruit of the action to the agent, the Atm. is optionally used, as @deva[स्वं यज्ञं यजते] or @deva[यजति] 'he offers his own sacrifice,' @deva[स्वं कटं कुरुते] or @deva[करोति] 'he weaves his own mat,' @deva[स्वं यज्ञं कारयति-ते] &c.

(b) When the causal form of a transitive verb is used reflexively, or when the object in the primitive sense becomes the agent in the causal, the Atm. is used except in the sense of 'remembering with eagerness, &c.;' @deva[भक्ताः भवं पश्यन्ति] 'devotees see Bhava;' @deva[भवो भक्तान् दर्शयते] 'Bhava shows himself to his devotees,' but @deva[स्मरति वनगुल्मं कोकिला]; @deva[स्मरयति वनगुल्मः (कोकिलं)]; @deva[उत्कण्ठापूर्वकस्मृतौ विषयो भवतीत्यर्थः] (Sid. Kau.). Vide Sid. Kau. on Pān. 1. 3. 67.

(c) When the agent of the action denoted by a verb cannot be other than an animal, the causal of the verb takes the Par. even when the action refers to the agent as @deva[कृष्णः शेते] 'Krishna sleeps,' @deva[गोपी कृष्णं शाययति] 'the cowherdess lulls Krishna to sleep,' but @deva[फलं पतति] 'the fruit falls down.' @deva[वायुः फलं पातयति] 'the wind causes the fruit to fall down,' &c.

(d) In the case of verbs meaning 'to eat,' except @deva[अद्], and 'to move,' their causals take the Parasm. even when the fruit of the action refers to the agent; @deva[निगारयति], @deva[आशयति] 'makes another eat,' @deva[चालयति], @deva[कम्पयति], 'he shakes' &c.

Exceptions to (c) and (d)—to (c) @deva[दम्] 'to pacify,' @deva[यम्] with @deva[आ] 'to draw in' @deva[यस्] with @deva[आ] 'to endeavour,' @deva[परिमुह्] 'to faint,' @deva[रुच्] 'to shine,' @deva[वद्] 'to speak,' @deva[वस्] 'to dwell', and @deva[घे] 'to drink;' to (d)—@deva[पा] 'to drink,' @deva[नृत्] 'to dance;' in the case of these roots the usual rule holds good; @deva[दमयति], @deva[दमयते]; @deva[शमयति-ते] &c.

[^1]: This distinction, however, seems to be very little observed in practice. Even the best Sanskrit writers are found using both the Padas promiscuously. It cannot even be supposed that this distinction is meant to be observed where a root admits of both the Padas. The Dashakumārácharita and the Kádambari afford several instances in which the two Padas are used exactly in the same sense.

rules.title: Ātmanepada for Exchange of Action
rules.body:
## Ātmanepada for Exchange of Action

When the notion of @deva[कर्मव्यतिहार] *i. e.* doing what is not proper for one to do, or the exchange of duties is to be implied, the Atm. is used, @deva[ब्राह्मणः सस्यानि व्यतिलुनीते] 'the Brāhmana reaps corn' (which is the work of a Śûdra and not his): @deva[धर्मः व्यतिस्ते] 'the religious duty is changed' (as when a S'ûdra discharges the duties enjoined upon a Vaisya, &c. @deva[संप्रहरन्ते राजानः] 'the kings exchange blows.

(a) But verbs implying motion, or meaning to kill, the roots @deva[हस्] and other similar roots do not take the Atm. even when an exchange of action is implied, @deva[व्यतियच्छन्ति], @deva[व्यतिघ्नन्ति], @deva[व्यतिहसन्ति], @deva[व्यतिजल्पन्ति].

rules.title: Causals of Certain Roots Take the Parasmaipada
rules.body:
## Causals of Certain Roots Take the Parasmaipada

The Causals of the roots @deva[बुध्], @deva[युध्], @deva[नश्], @deva[जन्], @deva[इ] with @deva[अधि], @deva[प्रु], @deva[द्रु], and @deva[स्रु] are Parasm.: @deva[बोधयति पद्मम्], @deva[योधयति काष्ठानि], @deva[नाशयति दुःखम्], @deva[जनयति सुखम्], @deva[अध्यापयति], @deva[प्रावयति प्रापयन्तीत्यर्थः] (Sid. Kau.); @deva[द्रावयति विलापयतीत्यर्थः] (Sid. Kau.). @deva[स्रावयति स्यन्दयतीत्यर्थः] (Sid. Kau.).

Primary Nominal Bases: Kṛt Affixes
rules.body:
**CHAPTER XIV.**

**VERBAL DERIVATIVES**

**or**

**PRIMARY NOMINAL BASES.**

**Derived by means of the Kṛt Affixes.**

## Primary Nominal Bases: Kṛt Affixes

The Kṛt affixes (Vide @ref[337]) are added to roots or to their modified forms to form nouns, adjectives, and indeclinables; *e. g.* @deva[कृ]—@deva[कार], @deva[कर्तृ], @deva[करण], @deva[कुर्वत्], @deva[करिष्यत्], @deva[चकृवस्], @deva[कृत्वा], @deva[कर्तुम्] &c. These are called Kṛdantas or Primary Nominal Bases as distinguished from the Secondary Derivatives formed with the Taddhita affixes.

rules.title: Unādi Affixes and Introduction to Participles
rules.body:
## Unādi Affixes and Introduction to Participles

There is a peculiar class of Kṛt or Primary affixes technically designated by Sanskrit grammarians—*Unādi* or those beginning with the affix @deva[उण्] *i. e.* the affix @deva[उ] with the mute or indicatory letter @deva[ण्], so called from the words @deva[कारु], @deva[वारु], &c. in the first Sûtra being derived with the affix. These Unādi affixes form primary nouns, like other Kṛt affixes form verbal roots, but are classed separately because their application is limited, because the nouns derived by their means are either formed irregularly, or the connection between their senses and the meanings of roots from which they are supposed to be derived is not so clearly discernible as in the case of other primary derivatives; *e. g.* @deva[अश्नुते अध्वानं व्याप्नोतीति वा अश्वः] 'a horse' which is derived either from @deva[अश्] 'to pervade,' or from @deva[अध्वन्] 'road;' and @deva[आप्] with @deva[वि], &c.; @deva[कारु] 'an artisan' from @deva[कृ] 'to do,' &c.

**SECTION I.**

**PARTICIPLES** (Declinable and Indeclinable)

*1. Participles* (*Declinable*)

(*a*) Participles of the Present Tense

rules.title: Formation of Present Parasmaipada Participle
Declension of @deva[अत्] Participles
rules.body:
## Declension of @deva[अत्] Participles

The declension of the Participles in @deva[अत्] has been treated of in @ref[116].

rules.title: Formation of Present Ātmanepada Participle
rules.body:
## Formation of Present Ātmanepada Participle

The participles of the Present Atm. is formed by adding @deva[आन] to the root which undergoes the same changes before it, as before the termination @deva[अते] or @deva[अन्ते] of the 3rd pl. pre. @deva[आन] is changed to @deva[मान], in the case of roots of the 1st, 4th, 6th and 10th classes, and all derived roots, or rather when the base ends in @deva[अ], before which the @deva[अ] of the base remains unchanged; *e. g.* @deva[एध्] (1. cl.) @deva[एधमान] 'growing;' @deva[वन्द्] (1 cl.) @deva[वन्दमान] 'saluting'; @deva[शी] (2. cl.) @deva[शयान] 'lying down;' @deva[द्विष्] (2. cl.) @deva[द्विषाण], @deva[हन्] with @deva[आ] (2. cl) @deva[आघ्नान] 'killing;' @deva[धा] (3. cl.) @deva[दधान] 'holding; @deva[हु] (3. cl.) @deva[जुह्वान]; @deva[दिव्] (4. cl.) @deva[दीव्यमान] 'playing;' @deva[सु] (5. cl.) @deva[सुन्वान] 'extracting;' @deva[तुद्] (6. cl.) @deva[तुदमान] 'giving pain;' @deva[रुध्] (7. cl.) @deva[रुन्धान] 'obstructing;' @deva[कृ] (8. cl) @deva[कुर्वाण] 'doing;' @deva[तन्] (8. cl.) @deva[तन्वान] 'stretching;' @deva[क्री] (9. cl.) @deva[क्रीणान] 'buying;' @deva[चुर्] (10, cl) @deva[चोरयमाण] 'stealing;' &c. @deva[बुध्] (1. cl)—cau. @deva[बोधयति]-@deva[बोधयमान] 'causing to know;'—desiderative @deva[बुबोधिषति]-@deva[बुबोधिषमाण] 'being desirous to know,' &c.

rules.title: Special Forms of @deva[आन] Participles
rules.body:
## Special Forms of @deva[आन] Participles

(a) The @deva[आ] of @deva[आन] is changed to @deva[ई] in the case of the root @deva[आस्] (2. cl.) 'to sit;' Pre. P. @deva[आसीन].

(b) @deva[आन] added to the roots @deva[पू] and @deva[यज्] forms nouns; *e. g.* @deva[पवमानः] 'that which purifies, hence, the wind' (*cf.* Rag. VIII. 9.) also, 'one of the sacred fires;' @deva[यजमानः] 'one who sacrifices.'

rules.title: Extended Use of @deva[आन] for Habit and Capacity
rules.body:
## Extended Use of @deva[आन] for Habit and Capacity

[^1]The termination @deva[आन] may be added to any root in the sense of 'in the habit of' or 'to show a particular standard of age, or capacity to do a thing; *e. g.* @deva[भोगं भुंजानः] 'one habituated to enjoy pleasures;' @deva[कवचं बिभ्राणः] 'of a sufficient age *i. e.* young enough to bear armour;' @deva[शत्रुं निघ्नानः] 'able to kill the enemy,' &c.

[^1]: @deva[ताच्छील्यवयोवचनशक्तिषु चानश्] । Pāṇ. III. 2. 126.

rules.title: Formation of Present Passive Participle
rules.body:
## Formation of Present Passive Participle

The participle of the Pre. Passive is formed by adding @deva[मान] to the Passive base in @deva[य]; *e. g.* @deva[बुध्यमान] 'who or what is known,' @deva[अद्यमान] 'what is eaten,' @deva[दीयमान] who or what is given, @deva[चीयमान] 'who or what is gathered,' @deva[क्रियमाण] 'what is done,' @deva[कॄ]—@deva[कीर्यमाण] 'what is scattered,' @deva[चोर्यमाण] 'who or what is stolen' @deva[बुध्]—cau. Pass. @deva[बोध्यमान] 'who or what is caused to know,' Des. Pass. @deva[बुबोधिष्यमाण] 'who or what is desired to know,' &c.

rules.title: Declension of @deva[मान] Participles
rules.body:
## Declension of @deva[मान] Participles

The participles formed according to @ref[669] are declined like nouns ending in @deva[अ] *m. f.* and *n.*

rules.title: Weak Terminations in Perfect and Past Participles
rules.body:
**(b) Participles of the Perfect.**

## Weak Terminations in Perfect and Past Participles

The terminations of the Perf. and the Past participles are weak, and therefore the radical vowel does not take its Guṇa substitute before these. The penultimate nasal is generally dropped (see @ref[584]).

rules.title: Formation of Perfect Participles
rules.body:
## Formation of Perfect Participles

The participle of the Perf. Par. and Atm. is formed by adding @deva[वस्] and @deva[आन] generally to that form of the root which it assumes before the termination of the 3rd per. plural. If this form consists of one syllable only or when the root ends in @deva[आ], @deva[वस्] has the intermediate @deva[इ] added to it. @deva[इ] is optionally prefixed to @deva[वस्] in the case of the roots @deva[गम्], @deva[हन्], @deva[दृश्], @deva[विश्] and @deva[विद्] (6 cl.); @deva[जन्] and @deva[खन्], and @deva[गम्] and @deva[हन्] when they do not take @deva[इ], form this participle from that base which they would assume before the 2nd per. sing. termination, *e. g.*

rules.title: Irregular Perfect Participles from @deva[ॠ]-Ending Roots
rules.body:
## Irregular Perfect Participles from @deva[ऋ]-Ending Roots

Roots ending in @deva[ॠ] (@deva[तॄ] and @deva[जॄ] included) form their Perf. P. irregularly; @deva[वस्] is added to the root, which then undergoes the changes mentioned in @ref[394], and is finally reduplicated; when a root is Atm. it is first reduplicated and @deva[आन] afterwards added, the final @deva[ॠ] changing as before; *e. g.* @deva[कॄ]+@deva[वस्]=@deva[कीर्वस्], by reduplication @deva[चिकीर्वस्]; @deva[कॄ]—by reduplication @deva[चकॄ]+@deva[आन]=@deva[चकिराण]; similarly @deva[तॄ]—@deva[तितीर्वस्]; @deva[ततिराण]; @deva[शॄ]—@deva[शिशीर्वस्] @deva[शशिराण]; @deva[पॄ]—@deva[पुपूर्वस्], @deva[पपुराण], &c.

rules.title: Frequency of Perfect Participle Usage
rules.body:
## Frequency of Perfect Participle Usage

The Perfect participle is not frequently used. The only participles that are most commonly to be met with are those formed from the roots @deva[सद्], @deva[वस्], @deva[स्था] and @deva[श्रु].

rules.title: Periphrastic Perfect Participles
rules.body:
## Periphrastic Perfect Participles

The participles of the Periphrastic Perfect Par. and Atm. are formed by the addition of the Perf. Participial forms of the auxiliary verbs @deva[कृ], @deva[अस्] or @deva[भू] to the base in @deva[आम्] *e. g.* @deva[दयामासिवस्], @deva[उन्दांबभूवस्]. @deva[गण्]—@deva[गणयामासिवस्], @deva[गणयांबभूवस्] &c.

rules.title: Formation of Past Passive Participle
rules.body:
**(c) Past Passive Participles.**

## Formation of Past Passive Participle

The Past Passive Participle is formed by the addition of the affix @deva[त] to the root; *e. g.* @deva[स्ना]—@deva[स्नात] 'bathed,' @deva[जि]—@deva[जित] 'conquered,' @deva[नी]—@deva[नीत] 'carried,' @deva[श्रु]—@deva[श्रुत] 'heard,' @deva[भू]—@deva[भूत] 'become,' @deva[हृ]-@deva[हृत] 'taken away,' @deva[त्यज्]—@deva[त्यक्त] 'abandoned,' @deva[चित्]—@deva[चित्त] 'thought or meditated upon,' &c.

rules.title: Samprasāraṇa Before @deva[त] Affix
rules.body:
## Samprasāraṇa Before @deva[त] Affix

Roots capable of taking Samprasāraṇa take it before the affix @deva[त].

rules.title: Affix @deva[त] Is Weak with Exceptions
rules.body:
The affix @deva[त] is weak.

**Exceptions:—**

(a) The roots @deva[शी], @deva[स्विद्] 1 cl., @deva[मिद्], @deva[क्ष्विद्], @deva[धृष्] and @deva[मृष्] admit of the Guṇa change before @deva[त] when @deva[इ] is prefixed to it; @deva[पू] 1. A also does the same when it takes @deva[इ] (see @ref[686]b).

(b) Such of the roots of the 1st class as have @deva[उ] for their penultimate change their vowel to Guṇa optionally, when the affix @deva[त] is added with the intermediate @deva[इ], and the P. P. Participle is used impersonally, or when it conveys the sense of beginning to perform the action or undergoing the condition expressed by the root; @deva[मुद्] 'to delight' @deva[मुदित], but 'to begin to delight' @deva[प्रमुदित] or @deva[प्रमोदित]; @deva[प्रमुदितं] or @deva[प्रमोदितं साधुना]; @deva[प्रमुदितः] or @deva[प्रमोदितः साधुः]; similarly, @deva[द्युत्]-@deva[प्रद्युतित] or @deva[प्रद्योतित] &c.

rules.title: Penultimate Radical Nasal Generally Dropped
rules.body: The Penultimate radical nasal is generally dropped. (See @ref[674]).

rules.title: Augment @deva[इ] Prefixed to @deva[त] in Certain Roots
rules.body: The augment @deva[इ] is prefixed to this @deva[त] in the case of certain roots, optionally in the case of some and not at all in the case of others.

rules.title: Roots Not Taking @deva[इ] Before @deva[त] with Examples
rules.body:
As a general rule, all roots ending in a vowel, and such as take the @deva[इ] optionally before any termination, and Aniṭ roots ending in consonants generally, do not take @deva[इ]; the rules of Sandhi given in the foregoing chapters that are applicable in particular cases ought to be observed,—

| Roots. | P. P. Ptc. | | Roots. | P. P. Ptc. |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[पा] | @deva[पात] protected | | @deva[त्यज्] | @deva[त्यक्त] abandoned. |
| @deva[श्रि] | @deva[श्रित] resorted to | | @deva[भ्रस्ज्] | @deva[भृष्ट] fried. |
| @deva[नी] | @deva[नीत] carried. | | @deva[यज्] | @deva[इष्ट] sacrificed |
| @deva[श्रु] | @deva[श्रुत] heard. | | @deva[बुध्] | @deva[बुद्ध] awakened. |
| @deva[भू] | @deva[भूत] become. | | @deva[व्यध्] | @deva[विद्ध] pierced. |
| @deva[कृ] | @deva[कृत] done. | | @deva[स्वप्] | @deva[सुप्त] slept. |
| @deva[ऊर्णु] | @deva[ऊर्णुत] covered. | | @deva[लभ्] | @deva[लब्ध] obtained. |
| @deva[वे] | @deva[उत] woven | | @deva[बन्ध्] | @deva[बद्ध] bound. |
| @deva[व्ये] | @deva[वीत] covered | | @deva[दृश्] | @deva[दृष्ट] seen. |
| @deva[ह्वे][^1] | @deva[हूत] called &c., | | @deva[क्रुश्] | @deva[क्रुष्ट] cried out &c. |

| Roots. | P. P. Ptc. | | Roots. | P. P. Ptc. |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[वच्] | @deva[उक्त] spoken | | @deva[दंश्] | @deva[दष्ट] bitten |
| @deva[गुह्] | @deva[गूढ] concealed | | @deva[द्विष्] | @deva[द्विष्ट] hated, &c. |
| @deva[मृज्] | @deva[मृष्ट] wiped off, &c. | | @deva[शास्][^2] | @deva[शिष्ट] governed |
| @deva[सिध्] | @deva[सिद्ध] accomplished, &c. | | @deva[दह्] | @deva[दग्ध] burnt |
| @deva[तृप्] | @deva[तृप्त] satisfied | | @deva[वह्] | @deva[ऊढ] borne |
| @deva[नश्] | @deva[नष्ट] perished, &c. | | @deva[सह्] | @deva[सोढ] endured |
| @deva[वृध्] | @deva[वृद्ध] grown | | @deva[ध्वंस्] | @deva[ध्वस्त] destroyed |
| @deva[वृत्] | @deva[वृत्त] happened, completed, &c. | | @deva[लिह्] | @deva[लीढ] licked |
| @deva[शक्] | @deva[शक्त] able | | @deva[मुह्] | @deva[मुग्ध] or @deva[मूढ] fainted |
| @deva[सिच्] | @deva[सिक्त] sprinkled | | @deva[नह्] | @deva[नद्ध] bound |
| @deva[प्रच्छ्] | @deva[पृष्ट] asked | | @deva[स्रंस्] | @deva[स्रस्त] dropped |

**Exceptions:—**

(a) @deva[शी], @deva[जागृ], @deva[स्था] and @deva[दरिद्रा] take @deva[इ]; the final vowel of the first two takes Guṇa substitute, and the last two drop their final; @deva[शयित], @deva[जागरित]; @deva[स्थित], @deva[दरिद्रित].

(b) @deva[पत्] takes @deva[इ] though it admits of @deva[इ] optionally in Desiderative; @deva[पतित].

(c) The Anit roots @deva[वस्] and @deva[क्षुध्] admit @deva[इ] before @deva[त] and @deva[त्वा]; @deva[उषित], @deva[क्षुधित].

[^1]: @deva[ह्वे] substitutes @deva[ऊ] for its @deva[व].

[^2]: Vide @ref[437].

rules.title: Seṭ Roots and Derivative Bases Admitting @deva[इ]
rules.body:
Seṭ roots (subject to @ref[684]), and all derivative bases admit of @deva[इ]; roots of the Tenth Class and causals reject their final @deva[अय], Par. Frequentatives their final @deva[अ], and Ātm. Frequentatives their @deva[य]:—

| Roots. | P. P. Ptc. | | Roots. | P. P. Ptc. |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[शङ्क्] | @deva[शङ्कित] 'suspected.' | | @deva[कथ्] | @deva[कथित] 'told.' |
| @deva[वद्] | @deva[उदित] 'spoken.' | | @deva[प्रथ्] | @deva[प्रथित] 'spread.' |

| Roots. | P. P. Ptc. | | Roots. | P. P. Ptc. |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[एध्] | @deva[एधित] 'increased.' | | @deva[बोधय्] cau. Base of @deva[बुध्], @deva[बोधित] 'made to know.' |
| @deva[कम्प्] | @deva[कम्पित] 'shaken.' | | @deva[चिकीर्ष्] des. b. of @deva[कृ], @deva[चिकीर्षित] 'desired to do.' |
| @deva[मुष्] | @deva[मुषित] 'stolen; deceived.' | | @deva[बोबुध्य] Ātm. Fre. Base of @deva[बुध्], @deva[बोबुधित] 'frequently known.' |
| @deva[ग्रह्] | @deva[गृहीत] 'taken.' | | @deva[बोभूय]—Par. Fre. Base of @deva[भू], @deva[बोभूयित]. |

**Exceptions:—**@deva[इन्ध्], @deva[ऋष्], 'to go, to kill,' &c., @deva[चित्] 'to know, to observe,' &c., @deva[जुष्], @deva[त्रस्], @deva[दीप्], @deva[मद्] and @deva[यत्]; @deva[इद्ध], @deva[ऋष्ट], @deva[चित्त], @deva[जुष्ट], @deva[त्रस्त], @deva[दीप्त], @deva[मत्त], @deva[यत्त].

N. B. There are many Seṭ roots which reject the intermediate @deva[इ] but as some of them form their P. P. participles in @deva[न] and others irregularly, they will be given in their proper places.

rules.title: Roots Inserting @deva[इ] Optionally Before @deva[त]
rules.body:
The following roots insert @deva[इ] optionally:—

(a) @deva[दम्], @deva[शम्], @deva[पुर्], @deva[दस्], @deva[स्पश्], @deva[छद्], @deva[ज्ञप्], @deva[रुष्], @deva[अम्], @deva[घुष्], with @deva[सम्], @deva[स्वन्] with @deva[आ], and @deva[हृष्] 4. 1. Par. when used with @deva[लोमन्] 'the hair,' or when it means 'to be surprised or disappointed;' @deva[दान्त], @deva[दमित]; (see @ref[696] a.); @deva[शान्त], @deva[शमित]; @deva[पूर्ण] (see @ref[688]), @deva[पूरित]; @deva[दस्त] 'wasted, perished,' @deva[दासित]; @deva[स्पष्ट], @deva[स्पशित]; @deva[छन्न], @deva[छादित]; @deva[ज्ञप्त], @deva[ज्ञपित]; @deva[रुष्ट], @deva[रुषित]; @deva[आन्त] (See @ref[696] a), @deva[अमित]; @deva[सङ्घुष्ट] @deva[सङ्घुषित]; @deva[आस्वान्त], @deva[आस्वनित]; @deva[हृष्ट]-@deva[हृषित]-@deva[लोमन्] 'horripilated with joy,' @deva[हृष्टो]-@deva[हृषितो मैत्रः] @deva[विस्मितः प्रतिहतो वा].

(b) @deva[क्लिश्] and @deva[पू] take @deva[इ] optionally before @deva[त] and @deva[त्वा]; @deva[क्लिष्ट], @deva[क्लिशित]; @deva[पूत], @deva[पवित].

(c) The following roots admit of @deva[इ] optionally before @deva[त] when the P. P. Participle is used impersonally, or conveys the sense of beginning to perform the action or to undergo the state expressed by the root; @deva[तृष्], @deva[स्वर्], @deva[धृष्], @deva[फल्], @deva[भिद्], @deva[मूर्च्छ्], @deva[स्विद्], 1. 4. cl. @deva[स्फुर्च्छ्], @deva[स्फुर्ज्]. @deva[क्ष्विद्] and @deva[क्ष्विद्] 1. 4. P. 1 A.; @deva[स्विद्]-@deva[प्रस्वेदितः] or @deva[प्रस्विन्नः चैत्रः] 'Chaitra has begun to perspire;' @deva[प्रस्वेदितं] or @deva[प्रस्विन्नमनेन] 'he has perspired,' &c.: @deva[स्विद्] 4 cl. has @deva[स्विदित] also.

N. B. When the participle is not used in the sense given above these roots reject @deva[इ]; @deva[क्ष्विद्]-@deva[क्ष्विण्ण]; 'perspired, sounded inarticulately,' &c.

rules.title: Special Rules for @deva[अञ्च्], @deva[धृष्] and @deva[शस्]
rules.body:
(a) @deva[अञ्च्] in the sense of 'to worship' takes @deva[इ]; @deva[अञ्चित] 'worshipped;' but @deva[अक्तः] 'gone'; with @deva[सम्]-@deva[समक्त] (@deva[समक्तौ शकुने पादौ])

(b) @deva[धृष्] and @deva[शस्] reject @deva[इ] when they express the idea of 'immodesty or rudeness;' @deva[धृष्ट] 'rude,' @deva[विशस्तः] 'ill-mannered;' but @deva[धर्षित] 'overpowered, trifled with,' &c, @deva[विशासित] 'tormented or ill-treated'.

rules.title: Substitution of @deva[न] for @deva[त] After @deva[द्] or @deva[र्]
rules.body:
@deva[न][^1] is substituted for @deva[त] when it immediately follows a final @deva[द्] or @deva[र्]; this final @deva[द्] is also changed to @deva[न्]: @deva[भिद्]-@deva[भिन्न], @deva[शॄ]-@deva[शीर्ण]; @deva[तुर्व्]-@deva[तूर्ण] (See @ref[698])

**Exceptions:—**

(a) @deva[भिद्] has @deva[भित्त] when it means 'a part, a portion,' @deva[भिन्न] in other senses

(b) @deva[विद्] 6 P. A. takes @deva[त] in the sense of 'fit for enjoyment or famous;' @deva[वित्तं] 'wealth, property,' @deva[वित्तः] 'famous'; @deva[विन्न] in other cases.

(c) @deva[मद्], @deva[पुर्] and @deva[मूर्च्छ्]; @deva[मत्त], @deva[पूर्त] 'filled,' (also @deva[पूर्ण] when it means the same as @deva[पू]), @deva[मूर्त].

[^1]: @deva[रदायां निष्ठातो नः पूर्वस्य च दः । संयोगादेरातो धातोर्यण्वतः । ल्वादिभ्यः ।] Pāṇ. VIII. 2. 42–44.

rules.title: Roots with Conjunct Consonants Substituting @deva[न] for @deva[त]
rules.body:
Roots ending in @deva[आ][^1] (@deva[ए], @deva[ऐ] and @deva[ओ] changeable to @deva[आ]) and beginning with a conjunct consonant containing a semi-vowel also substitute @deva[न] for @deva[त]; @deva[द्रा] 'to run, to sleep,' @deva[द्राण]; @deva[ग्लै] 'to fade,' @deva[ग्लान]; @deva[स्त्यै]-@deva[स्त्यान] 'collected to a mass,' &c

**Exceptions:—**@deva[ख्या] 'to name,' &c. @deva[ध्यै] 'to contemplate,' @deva[व्ये] and @deva[ह्वे]; @deva[ख्यात], @deva[ध्यात], @deva[वीत] and @deva[हूत].

[^1]: @deva[रदायां निष्ठातो नः पूर्वस्य च दः । संयोगादेरातो धातोर्यण्वतः । ल्वादिभ्यः ।] Pāṇ. VIII. 2. 42–44.

rules.title: Roots from § 414 and @deva[ज्या] Substituting @deva[न] for @deva[त]
rules.body:
The roots given at @ref[414] and @deva[ज्या] substitute @deva[न] for @deva[त].[^1]

| Roots | | P. P. Ptc. | Roots | | P. P. Ptc. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[री] | to flow, to move | @deva[रीण] | @deva[जॄ] | to grow old | @deva[जीर्ण] |
| @deva[ली] | to melt, etc. | @deva[लीन] | @deva[दॄ] | to tear | @deva[दीर्ण] |
| @deva[व्ली] | to go, to hold | @deva[व्लीन] | @deva[नॄ] | to lead | @deva[नीर्ण] |
| @deva[प्ली] | to go, to move | @deva[प्लीन] | @deva[पॄ] | to fill, to gratify | @deva[पूर्ण] |
| @deva[धू] | to shake | @deva[धून] | @deva[भॄ] | to bear, to nourish | @deva[भूर्ण] |
| @deva[पू] | to destroy | @deva[पून] | @deva[मॄ] | to hurt, to kill | @deva[मूर्ण] |
| @deva[लू] | to cut | @deva[लून] | @deva[वॄ] | to choose | @deva[वूर्ण] |
| @deva[ऋ] | to go | @deva[ईर्ण] | @deva[शॄ] | to tear asunder | @deva[शीर्ण] |
| @deva[कॄ] | to scatter | @deva[कीर्ण] | @deva[स्तॄ] | to scatter | @deva[स्तीर्ण] |
| @deva[गॄ] | to utter a sound, to praise, etc. | @deva[गीर्ण] | @deva[ज्या] | to grow old | @deva[जीन] |

[^1]: @deva[रदायां निष्ठातो नः पूर्वस्य च दः । संयोगादेरातो धातोर्यण्वतः । ल्वादिभ्यः ।] Pāṇ. VIII. 2. 42–44.

rules.title: @deva[दु] and @deva[गु] Substituting @deva[न] for @deva[त] with Vowel Lengthening
rules.body: @deva[दु] and @deva[गु] 'to sound indistinctly,' substitute @deva[न] for @deva[त] and lengthen their vowels; @deva[दून] 'gone,' @deva[गून].

rules.title: Comprehensive List of Roots Substituting @deva[न] for @deva[त]
rules.body:
The following roots substitute @deva[न] for @deva[त]:—

| Roots | | P. P. Ptc. | Roots | | P. P. Ptc. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[डी] | 4 A. to fly | @deva[डीन], @deva[उड्डीन] | @deva[वै] | to dry, to be languid | @deva[वान] |
| @deva[दू] | to torment | @deva[दून] | @deva[व्री] | 4 A. to move, to cover | @deva[व्रीण] |
| @deva[धी] | to hold, to accomplish | @deva[धीन] | @deva[श्वि] | 1. P, to grow, to swell | @deva[शून] |

| @deva[विज्] | | @deva[विग्न], @deva[उद्विग्न] | @deva[लस्ज्] | to be ashamed | ,, |
| @deva[व्रश्च्] | | @deva[वृक्ण] | @deva[स्कन्द्] | with @deva[वि] | @deva[विस्कन्न] |
| @deva[स्फूर्ज्] | 1. P. | @deva[स्फूर्ण] | | with @deva[परि] | @deva[परिस्कन्न]-@deva[स्कण्ण] |
| | | | @deva[विद्] | 4. A | @deva[विन्न] |

rules.title: Contextual Substitution of @deva[न] for @deva[त] - Special Rules
rules.body:
(a) @deva[ऋ][^1] when it means 'to incur debt' substitutes @deva[न]; @deva[ऋण] 'debt;' but @deva[ऋत], 'gone.'

(b) @deva[क्षि], when the P. P. Participle has an active sense, substitutes @deva[न] and lengthens its @deva[इ]; @deva[क्षीण], reduced, emaciated; but when a curse is implied, or pity expressed, the change is optional; @deva[क्षीणायुः] or @deva[क्षितायुः भव] i. e. 'die;' @deva[क्षीण] or @deva[क्षितः अयं तपस्वी] 'oh, the poor ascetic has grown thin' but @deva[क्षितः कामो मया].

(c) @deva[दिव्][^2] takes @deva[न] when it does not mean 'to gamble;' @deva[द्यून] 'a sport in which nothing is staked,' but @deva[द्यूतं] 'gambling.'

(d) @deva[वा][^2] with @deva[निर्] takes @deva[न] except when it has @deva[वात] for its subject; @deva[निर्वाणोऽग्निः] 'the fire is extinguished;' @deva[निर्वाणो मुनिः] the sage is absolved; but @deva[निर्वातः वातः]

(e) @deva[श्यै] takes @deva[न] when the notion of touch is not present; @deva[संश्यानो वृश्चिकः] 'a scorpion contracted through cold;' when it means 'to be coagulated or cold' its @deva[य्] takes @deva[संप्रसारण] (@deva[ई]); @deva[शीनं घृतं], but @deva[शीतं उदकं] and not @deva[शीनं] as the idea of touch is present here; also when preceded by @deva[प्रति]; @deva[प्रतिशीनं घृतं], &c.; with @deva[अभि] and @deva[अव] the change is optional; @deva[अभिश्यानं] or @deva[अभिशीनं घृतं], @deva[अवश्यानो] or @deva[अवशीनो वृश्चिकः]; but @deva[समवश्यातः]

[^1]: @deva[ऋणमाधमर्ण्ये ।] Pāṇ. VIII. 2. 60.

[^2]: @deva[दिवोऽविजिगीषायाम् । विर्वाणोऽवाते ।] Pāṇ. VIII. 2. 49–50.

rules.title: Roots Optionally Taking @deva[न] or @deva[त]
rules.body: The roots @deva[नुद्], @deva[विद्], 6. A., @deva[उन्द्], @deva[त्रै], @deva[घ्रा] and @deva[ह्री] take @deva[न] or @deva[त]; @deva[नुन्न] or @deva[नुत्त], @deva[विन्न] or @deva[वित्त], @deva[त्राण] or @deva[त्रात], @deva[घ्राण] or @deva[घ्रात] and @deva[ह्रीण] or @deva[ह्रीत].

rules.title: Special Rules for @deva[प्याय्] with Contextual Conditions
rules.body: @deva[प्याय्] has @deva[पीन] when it is used with 'one's own limbs.' @deva[पीनं मुखं], and @deva[प्यान] or @deva[पीन] in other cases, as @deva[प्यानः] or @deva[पीनः स्वेदः]; when it is preceded by a preposition, @deva[ई] is not substituted for its vowel; @deva[प्रप्यानः]; but when it is used with @deva[अन्धु] or @deva[ऊधस्] with the preposition @deva[आ], @deva[ई] is necessarily substituted; @deva[आपीनः अन्धुः], @deva[आपीनं ऊधः].

rules.title: Nasal-Ending Roots - Vowel Lengthening and Nasal Dropping
rules.body:
(a) Roots ending in a nasal lengthen their penultimate vowel before a weak termination beginning with any consonant except a nasal or a semivowel, or before the affix @deva[क्विप्] @deva[शम्]—@deva[शान्त्], @deva[क्रम्]—@deva[क्रान्त्], &c

(b) Aniṭ roots ending in a nasal, the root @deva[वन्] 1. P. and the eight roots of the 8th class—@deva[तन्] and others (see p. 355) drop their nasal before a weak termination beginning with any consonant except a nasal or a semivowel:—

| Roots. | P. P Ptc. | | Roots | P. P. Ptc. |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[मन्] 'to think', &c. | @deva[मत] | | @deva[नम्] 'to bow' | @deva[नत] |
| @deva[हन्] 'to strike,' | @deva[हत] | | @deva[यम्] 'to restrain' | @deva[यत] |
| @deva[रम्] 'to sport' | @deva[रत] | | @deva[वन्] 1. P. 'to sound, to serve,' &c. | @deva[वत] |
| @deva[गम्] 'to go' | @deva[गत] | | @deva[घृण्] 'to shine' | @deva[घृत] |
| @deva[तन्] | @deva[तत] | | @deva[तृण्] 'to graze' | @deva[तृत] |
| @deva[क्षण्] | @deva[क्षत] | | @deva[वन्] 'to beg' | @deva[वत] |
| @deva[ऋण्] | @deva[ऋत] | | | |

rules.title: @deva[खन्], @deva[जन्], @deva[सन्] Dropping Nasal with Vowel Lengthening
rules.body: The roots @deva[खन्], @deva[जन्] and @deva[सन्], drop their nasal and at the same time lengthen their vowel; @deva[खात], @deva[जात], @deva[सात].

rules.title: Radical @deva[व्] Changing to @deva[ऊ] Before @deva[त] or @deva[न]
rules.body: A radical @deva[व्] preceding or following a vowel is sometimes changed to @deva[ऊ] before @deva[त] or @deva[न]; when it is preceded by @deva[र्] it is dropped; @deva[वर्]—@deva[ऊर्ण], @deva[त्वर्]—@deva[तूर्ण], @deva[तुर्व्]—@deva[तूर्ण], @deva[सिव्]—@deva[स्यूत], @deva[दिव्]—@deva[द्यूत] or @deva[द्यून] (See @ref[693], c.).

rules.title: Roots Rejecting @deva[इ] in Limited Senses
rules.body:
The following roots (some forming their P. P. P. irregularly) reject @deva[इ] in the limited sense attached to each:—

| | | | |
|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[क्षुभ्]—@deva[क्षुब्ध] | 'a churning handle.' | @deva[विरेभ्]—@deva[विरिब्ध] | 'a note.' |
| @deva[स्वन्]—@deva[स्वान्त] | 'the mind.' | @deva[फण्]—@deva[फाण्ट] | 'a decoction easily prepared.' (@deva[अनायाससाध्यः कषायविशेष] Sid. Kau.) |
| @deva[ध्वन्]—@deva[ध्वान्त] | 'darkness.' | | |
| @deva[लग्]—@deva[लग्न] | 'attached.' | | |
| @deva[म्लेच्छ्]—@deva[म्लिष्ट] | 'indistinct.' | @deva[वाह्]—@deva[वाढ] | 'much.' |

In their usual senses they have @deva[क्षुभित], @deva[ध्वनित], @deva[लगित], @deva[म्लेच्छित], @deva[विरेभित], @deva[फाणित] and @deva[वाहित].

rules.title: @deva[दा] and @deva[दे] - Special @deva[द] Dropping After Vowel-Ending Prepositions
rules.body:
@deva[दा] 'to give,' and @deva[दे], form their P. P. Ptc. as @deva[दत्त]; the @deva[द] of @deva[दत्त] is dropped after a preposition ending in a vowel; @deva[प्रत्त]-@deva[अवत्त] &c; in this latter case the preceding @deva[इ] or @deva[उ] is lengthened; @deva[नीत्त], @deva[सूत्त], &c.; @deva[द] may optionally be retained also; @deva[प्रदत्त], @deva[अवदत्त], @deva[सुदत्त],[^1] &c.

[^1]: @deva[अवदत्तं विदतश्च प्रदतश्चादिकर्मणि । सुदत्तमनुदन्तश्च निदत्तमिति चेष्यते ॥]

rules.title: Comprehensive List of Irregular Past Passive Participles
rules.body:
The following roots form their P. P. Participles irregularly:—

| Roots | | P. P. Ptc. | Roots | | P. P. Ptc. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| @deva[अद्] | to eat. | @deva[जग्ध, अन्न] | @deva[ज्यो] | to instruct. | @deva[जीत] |
| @deva[अर्द्] | with @deva[सम्], | @deva[समर्ण, न्यर्ण,] | @deva[दो] | to cut. | @deva[दित] |
|  | @deva[नि] or @deva[वि] | @deva[व्यर्ण] |  | to be bulky or strong. | @deva[दृढ] |
|  | with @deva[अभि] in the sense of 'being near.' | @deva[अभ्यर्ण] | @deva[दृह्] | otherwise | @deva[दृंहित] |
|  | in other cases | @deva[अर्दित] | @deva[धा] | to put. | @deva[हित] |
| @deva[ऊय्] | 1. A. to weave. | @deva[ऊत] | @deva[धाव्] | to cleanse | @deva[धौत] or @deva[धावित] |
| @deva[कष्] | to be difficult or painful. | @deva[कष्ट], as @deva[कष्टं व्याकरणम्]. The study of grammar is very difficult; @deva[कष्टं वनं] &c.; but @deva[कषितं सुवर्णम्] 'gold rubbed on the touchstone.' | @deva[धे] | to suck | @deva[धीत] |
| @deva[कृश्] | to be lean. | @deva[कृश] | @deva[पच्] | to cook. | @deva[पक्व] |
| @deva[क्षीब्] | to be intoxicated. | @deva[क्षीब] | @deva[पा] | to drink. | @deva[पीत] |
| @deva[क्नूय] | to stink. | @deva[क्नूत] | @deva[पूय्] | to stink, to putrify. | @deva[पूत] |
| @deva[क्ष्माय] | to shake | @deva[क्ष्मात] | @deva[फल्] | to expand. | @deva[फुल्ल] |
| @deva[क्षै] | to be thin | @deva[क्षाम] | @deva[मव्] | to bind. | @deva[मूत] |
| @deva[गै] | to sing | @deva[गीत] | @deva[मा] | to measure. | @deva[मित] |
| @deva[छा] | to split | @deva[छात] or @deva[छित] | @deva[मे] | to barter. |  |
|  |  |  | @deva[मूर्च्छ्] | to faint. | @deva[मूर्त] or @deva[मूर्च्छित] |
|  |  |  | @deva[लाघ्] | with @deva[उत्] | @deva[उल्लाघ] 'convalescent' |
|  |  |  | @deva[वृ (बृ) ह्] or @deva[वृं (बृं) ह्] |  | @deva[परिवृढ] a master, with @deva[परि] [@deva[परिवृ (बृ) हित] or @deva[परिवृं (बृं) हित] &c. 'grown, increased'] |
|  |  |  | @deva[शो] | 'to sharpen,' | @deva[शात] or @deva[शित] |

---

| Roots | | P. P. Ptc. | Roots | | P. P. Ptc. |
